name_en: Reactive joint-κ dimer and discovery scheduler
name_zh: 联合 κ 曲率与发现调度
idea_en: A climber pushes only along bonds that can react and is let loose once the ground curves like a pass, while a dispatcher, like a prospector counting new finds per hour, picks the next trail. v0.5.1 tested a κ-dimer with reactive-subspace escape, joint κ (global and gradient-orthogonal curvature from one shared Ritz subspace) and branching, plus a scheduler that ranks four proposal families by new channels per force call.
idea_zh: 登山者先只沿能反应的键用力，一出现鞍部式弯曲就放开攀爬；调度员像淘金者那样按“每小时新收获”挑下一条路。0.5.1 版的 κ-dimer 含反应子空间逃逸、在共享 Ritz 子空间中同时求全局与梯度正交曲率（joint-κ）和分支；调度器按每次力调用的新通道数给四类提议排序。
systems_en: 8 original EARLY IS: methoxy/Cu(111); formic acid, ethylene glycol and glycolaldehyde+2H on Pt(111); n-butane/H-MFI; two methanol/H-CHA; two ethanol/H-MFI, dry and with two water. 4 configurations (ASE uniform restarts, ASE + scheduler, original TSASE κ-dimer, reactive joint-κ) × 20 seeds = 640 campaigns of 3 attempts (≤12,000 force calls each), plus 80 exploratory 12-attempt campaigns.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 8 个原始初态：甲氧基/Cu(111)；甲酸、乙二醇、乙醇醛+2H/Pt(111)；正丁烷/H-MFI；两甲醇/H-CHA；两乙醇/H-MFI（干燥与含两个水）。4 种配置（ASE 均匀重启、ASE + 调度、原版 TSASE κ-dimer、反应子空间 joint-κ）× 20 个种子 = 640 个 campaign，每个 3 次尝试（每次 ≤12,000 次力调用）；另有 80 个 12 次尝试的探索性补测。
result_en: Metric: distinct reaction channels per campaign. Reactive joint-κ found 0 target reaction channels on every system, and the scheduler showed no positive adjusted interval over plain ASE restarts, also in the 80 longer campaigns. Only a validator-level saving held: dense-Hessian validation needed fewer calls than the matrix-free setting (matrix-free/dense 1.16–2.95 on the 7 cases both passed). Recommendation: plain ASE restarts.
result_zh: 指标：每 campaign 反应通道数。joint-κ 目标通道为 0；调度器对 ASE 均匀重启无正向区间，80 个长程补测亦然。仅稠密 Hessian 验证省调用（7 例中 matrix-free 用其 1.16–2.95 倍）。建议普通 ASE 重启。

idea_en: A surveyor cuts the mountain into parallel slices, finds the lowest point on each slice and walks slice by slice until the slope along the route turns downhill. v0.6 fixed progress along a seed direction (hyperplane aᵀx = s), relaxed all other coordinates with L-BFGS, bracketed the zero of the force along this relaxed path, then refined with the standard ASE dimer in full space; v0.6.1 reused orthogonal L-BFGS history between slices.
idea_zh: 测量员把山切成平行截面，逐片找最低点并前进，直到沿路线的坡度由升转降。0.6 版沿种子方向固定进度（超平面 aᵀx = s），用 L-BFGS 松弛其余坐标，括住松弛路径上的力零点，再用标准 ASE dimer 全空间精修；0.6.1 在相邻截面间复用正交 L-BFGS 历史。
systems_en: Analytic: 3 model potentials × 2 methods × 20 paired seeds (120 campaigns). NEP89 on 3 EARLY IS (ethylene glycol/Pt(111), two methanol/H-CHA, dry two ethanol/H-MFI): 20 new seeds, 120 campaigns of 1 attempt (≤12,000 force calls); v0.6.1: 80 more campaigns on the Pt and CHA systems at 4,000 calls.
systems_zh: 解析势：3 个模型势 × 2 种方法 × 20 对种子（120 个 campaign）。NEP89：EARLY 集 3 个初态（乙二醇/Pt(111)、两甲醇/H-CHA、干燥两乙醇/H-MFI），20 个新种子，120 个 campaign，每个 1 次尝试（≤12,000 次力调用）；0.6.1 在 Pt 与 CHA 上再做 80 个 campaign（4,000 次调用）。
result_en: Analytic: only the bent coupled valley gained (channels 0 → 0.40, adjusted interval [0.10, 0.75]), and CPU time rose. NEP89: the new method found 0 target reactions; on CHA it was worse than ASE (−0.35 channels per campaign, [−0.65, −0.05]), and 54 of 60 trajectories ran out of optimizer steps. v0.6.1 found only reorientation or transport events. Not adopted.
result_zh: 解析势上仅弯曲耦合谷提升（通道 0 → 0.40，区间 [0.10, 0.75]），且更耗 CPU。NEP89 上目标反应为 0；CHA 上每 campaign 通道比 ASE 少 0.35（[−0.65, −0.05]），54/60 条轨迹耗尽步数。

idea_en: Instead of slicing the mountain with flat planes, the surveyor follows contour lines of one bond length, which bend with the molecule so it cannot slip around the reaction by rotating. v0.7 tracked constrained minima on c(x) = s for the reactant bond best aligned with the proposal, using the Lagrangian Hessian H − λ∇²c, reprojection and transported tangent-space L-BFGS history, found the path-force root, then refined without constraint.
idea_zh: 不再用平面切山，而是沿一根键长的“等高线”走：它随分子弯曲，分子无法靠转动绕开反应。0.7 版对与提议最对齐的反应物键，在 c(x)=s 上跟踪条件极小，使用拉格朗日 Hessian H−λ∇²c、重投影和切空间 L-BFGS 历史输运，求出路径力零点后在无约束全空间精修。
systems_en: Analytic model potentials only (radial double well, bent radial valley; ASE given the same bond proposals): 200 development campaigns (v0.7.0) and 80 new-seed campaigns (v0.7.1). No NEP89 runs; the real-system test followed in round 4.
systems_zh: 仅解析模型势（径向双阱、弯曲径向谷；ASE 使用同样的键方向提议）：200 个开发 campaign（0.7.0）与 80 个新种子 campaign（0.7.1）。没有 NEP89 搜索，真实体系检验留到第四轮。
result_en: New seeds (v0.7.1), ASE vs bond-dimer: hits 20/20 vs 19/20 (radial double well) and 18/20 vs 18/20 (bent valley); mean model calls 127.55 vs 100.55 and 319.95 vs 187.85 (about 21 % and 41 % fewer), but no higher hit rate and no robust CPU gain. Promising call savings, unverified on NEP89; in round 4 it did not beat the anchored ASE control.
result_zh: 模型势新种子上 ASE 对 bond-dimer 命中 20/20 对 19/20、18/20 对 18/20；调用 127.55 对 100.55、319.95 对 187.85，命中率未升，CPU 无稳健优势。第四轮在 NEP89 上未胜过锚定 ASE。

name_zh: 键法向锚定的 ASE 起点
idea_en: Instead of starting where a scout's long jump landed, the climber takes one short step from camp along the rope that best points the chosen way. The common ± probe still picked the direction, but the ASE dimer started from the initial state moved at most 0.1 Å along the gradient of the reactant bond best aligned with it; the four-way test also gave bond-dimer, TSASE κ-dimer and plain ASE identical proposals.
idea_zh: 不从侦察兵远跳的落脚处出发，而是从营地沿最指向目标的“绳子”迈一小步。共同的 ± 探测仍负责选方向，但 ASE dimer 改从初态沿与该方向最对齐的反应物键梯度移动 ≤0.1 Å 处起步；四方对照中 bond-dimer、TSASE κ-dimer 与 ASE 用相同提议。
systems_en: 3 EARLY IS: ethylene glycol/Pt(111), two methanol/H-CHA, dry two ethanol/H-MFI; 4 configurations (ASE, ASE-anchor, TSASE κ-dimer, bond-dimer) × 20 new seeds = 240 campaigns, 3 attempts each with ≤12,000 force calls.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 3 个初态：乙二醇/Pt(111)、两甲醇/H-CHA、干燥两乙醇/H-MFI；4 种配置（ASE、ASE-anchor、TSASE κ-dimer、bond-dimer）× 20 个新种子 = 240 个 campaign，每个 3 次尝试、每次 ≤12,000 次力调用。
result_en: Ethylene glycol/Pt: distinct qualified reaction channels 0.70 → 1.45 per campaign (mean ratio 2.07, difference interval [0.40, 1.00], 15 wins, 5 ties, 0 losses, Holm p = 0.000427246) for 3.2 % more calls; C–O scission in 17 seeds instead of 1. Fewer channels on CHA and no significant MFI gain; bond-dimer did not beat this control. Shipped as an optional preset, not the default.
result_zh: 乙二醇/Pt 每 campaign 合格通道 0.70 → 1.45（2.07 倍，差值区间 [0.40, 1.00]，15 胜 5 平 0 负，Holm p=0.000427246），调用仅多 3.2%。CHA 上通道减少，MFI 不显著。作可选预设。

name_zh: 曲率缩放 L-BFGS 平移
idea_en: Once a climber feels the pass, cautious fixed strides give way to strides sized from remembered slopes, and the memory is wiped whenever the trail bends. Scored as connected hits per search ionic step, the translation kept ASE in convex regions but used L-BFGS on the reflected force where curvature is negative (initial scale 1/|λ|, positive-curvature history only, reset when mode overlap < 0.9, 0.1 Å cap); v2 added a residual-force guard.
idea_zh: 登山者一进入鞍部就不再走固定碎步，而按记住的坡度估计步幅；路线一转弯就清空记忆。平移在凸区沿用 ASE，在负曲率区对反射力做 L-BFGS（初始尺度 1/|λ|、只留正曲率历史、模式重叠 <0.9 时重置、步长上限 0.1 Å）；第二版另加方向残余力保护。
systems_en: 2 EARLY IS, ethylene glycol/Pt(111) and two methanol/H-CHA, against same-start ASE-anchor: 540 NEP89 trajectories (60 development + 2 × 240 new-seed). Follow-up v0.10–0.12 (before round 6) on the original systems: 1,760 multi-TS campaigns and 384 exclusion campaigns.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 2 个初态（乙二醇/Pt(111)、两甲醇/H-CHA），对照同起点 ASE-anchor：共 540 条 NEP89 搜索轨迹（60 条开发 + 两批各 240 条新种子）。后续 0.10–0.12（第六轮之前）在原始体系上：1,760 个多 TS campaign 与 384 个排除 campaign。
result_en: Connected hits per search ionic step, new kernel vs ASE-anchor: 2.033 on Pt (5/13,308 vs 4/21,640) and 1.337 on CHA in the latest batch, but 1.718 and 0.823 in the previous one; adjusted intervals include zero and the guard never triggered. Follow-up (v0.10–0.12): continuous multi-TS walkers never beat the strongest baseline; candidate exclusion gave +2.1 %–21.7 % (observational) and carried into round 6.
result_zh: 每离子步命中，新内核对 ASE：Pt 上 2.033 倍（5/13,308 对 4/21,640）、CHA 上 1.337 倍，前一批 1.718 与 0.823，调整区间含零。后续连续多 TS 未胜最强基线；候选排除提高 2.1%–21.7%，进入第六轮。

name_zh: 全原子提议、能量证书与排除
idea_en: Scatter scouts from every movable atom instead of a few bonds, and let a referee stop a downhill check as soon as it is certain to fail. Round 6 widened start proposals from reactant atoms to all movable atoms (still 85 % projected on reactive bonds), added harmonic energy-shell starts along the most downward-bending direction (ADD), a monotone energy certificate that ends endpoint quenches once they drop below the IS energy, and candidate exclusion.
idea_zh: 侦察兵从每个可动原子出发，而不只守着几根键；裁判一旦能断定下坡检查必然失败就叫停。第六轮把起始提议从反应物原子扩大到全部可动原子（仍以 85% 概率投影到反应键），新增谐振能量壳上沿最“向下弯”方向的起点（ADD）、端点淬火能量一低于初态即停的单调能量证书，以及候选排除。
systems_en: 15 EARLY IS: the 8 original surface and zeolite systems plus 7 held-out reaction-network nodes never used in development; frozen final with new seeds, 1,200 searches per method; validator replay on 1,336 archived candidates.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 15 个初态：8 个原始表面/分子筛体系 + 7 个开发中从未用过的留出网络节点；新种子冻结终测，每法 1,200 次搜索；验证器在 1,336 个历史候选上回放。
result_en: Distinct strict saddles per 10,000 ionic steps (probes charged): all-atom proposals + exclusion 1.90× [1.48, 2.04] vs the original pipeline and 1.71× [1.33, 1.82] vs ASE with the new validator; ADD shell + exclusion 1.87×. Saddles 28 → 42–44; held-out +73 % vs original +69 %. The certificate gave identical decisions (250/250 accepted, 1,086/1,086 rejected) with 10 % fewer total steps. Shipped as presets.
result_zh: 每万离子步独立严格鞍点：全原子 + 排除对原流程 1.90 倍 [1.48, 2.04]，对新验证器 ASE 1.71 倍；ADD + 排除 1.87 倍。鞍点 28 → 42–44。能量证书判决全部一致，总步 −10%。发布为预设。

name_zh: 力调用全计费与精简验证
idea_en: Charge for every litre of fuel, not just the kilometres driven, then trim the trip: no detours, a short leash, a cap on wandering. From round 7 the main metric became distinct strict saddles per NEP89 force call with everything charged (search, rotation, refinement, validation, Hessians); the main method combined all-atom proposals, exclusion, lean dense-Hessian validation, a 4 Å trust sphere and a 300-step cap.
idea_zh: 不只按行驶里程，而按每一升油计费，再精简行程：不绕路、拴短绳、限制闲逛。第七轮起主指标改为每次 NEP89 力调用的独立严格鞍点，搜索、转动、精修、验证、Hessian 全部计费；主方法组合全原子提议、排除、精简稠密 Hessian 验证、4 Å 信赖球与 300 步上限。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS: the 8 original systems on Pt(111)/Cu(111) and in H-CHA/H-MFI plus 13 held-out network nodes (7 first- and 6 second-generation); 21 IS × 16 settings × 8 new seeds = 2,688 frozen campaigns of 10 launches.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态：Pt(111)/Cu(111) 表面与 H-CHA/H-MFI 中的 8 个原始体系 + 13 个留出网络节点（第一代 7 个、第二代 6 个）；21 个初态 × 16 种设置 × 8 个新种子 = 2,688 个冻结 campaign，每个 10 次启动。
result_en: Force calls per distinct saddle: main method 40,209 (63 saddles) vs ASE 119,967 (49), i.e. U/call 2.984× [2.357, 3.061], and 1.705× [1.656, 1.880] vs the round-6 best. A post-hoc frugal combination reached 35,987; the original κ-dimer needed 881,943 (4 saddles). Lanczos eigen-certification and forward-difference Hessians were rejected. Shipped as presets.

idea_en: A mechanic tunes every gear on the same bike: start from the ring of equal height where the ground sags most, waste fewer pedal strokes on turning, quit hopeless rides early, and measure the slope only when needed. ADD-combo stacked energy-shell (ADD) starts, exclusion, lean validation, the 4 Å trust sphere and 300-step cap with tuned dimer rotation, early stopping and a lazily computed Hessian.
idea_zh: 技师把同一辆车的每个齿轮都调一遍：从“等高圈”上地面塌陷最多处出发，少在转向上空踩，没希望的行程早收工，只在需要时才量坡度。ADD-combo 叠加能量壳（ADD）起点、排除、精简验证、4 Å 信赖球与 300 步上限，并调整 dimer 转动、加入早停与惰性 Hessian。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original surface and zeolite systems + 13 held-out network nodes) × 8 new seeds for the main comparison; pre-registered confirmation on 8 further new seeds (336 campaigns) against the round-7 most frugal combination.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个原始表面/分子筛体系 + 13 个留出网络节点）× 8 个新种子做主比较；另以 8 个新种子做预注册确认（336 个 campaign），参照第七轮最省组合。
result_en: Force calls per saddle: 31,359 vs 43,127 (round-7 best; saddles 52 vs 39) and 102,942 (ASE). Confirmation on new seeds: 33,519 vs 38,786, U/call 1.157× [1.000, 1.373], one-sided p = 0.025, passed; the gain came from held-out nodes (originals 0.749, generation 1 1.318, generation 2 1.699). EF soft-mode bias (0.894) and EF→dimer relay (0.929) failed. Shipped as a preset.

idea_en: Stop paying twice for the same X-ray: reuse the scan taken at validation and the one taken of the camp, and read only the sign pattern instead of the full picture. Round 9 reused the validation's dense certificate, stored the initial-state Hessian at qualification for energy-shell starts (ADD-cert), and added CPI, which counts negative eigenvalues via Sylvester's law of inertia and a short Krylov subspace on L⁻¹HL⁻ᵀ, whitened by the IS Hessian.
idea_zh: 同一张 X 光片别拍两次，且只读正负号。第九轮复用验证的稠密证书，资格认证时存下初态 Hessian 供能量壳起点用（ADD-cert），并新增 CPI：在初态 Hessian 白化的 L⁻¹HL⁻ᵀ 上，用短 Krylov 子空间加 Sylvester 惯性定律数负本征值。
systems_en: Replay of 1,540 archived round-8 candidates; development on the 8 original IS × 6 seeds; final on 21 EARLY IS (8 original + 13 held-out network nodes) × 8 new seeds, 840 campaigns.
systems_zh: 回放 1,540 个第八轮历史候选；开发：8 个原始初态 × 6 个种子；终测：EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个原始 + 13 个留出网络节点）× 8 个新种子，共 840 个 campaign。
result_en: Force calls per saddle fell 30,379 → 25,133 (certificate reuse) → 22,432 (stored IS Hessian, ADD-cert: identical decisions, 4.36× ASE) → 17,271 (CPI). Confirmed: CPI vs ADD-cert U/call 1.299× [1.250, 1.357] (Holm passed), 1.184× vs the round-7 best, 5.66× vs ASE. About 19 % of CPI channels fail the dense criterion, so ADD-cert stays the strict option.
result_zh: 每鞍点力调用 30,379 → 22,432（ADD-cert）→ 17,271（CPI）。CPI 对 ADD-cert 1.299 倍 [1.250, 1.357]（Holm 通过），ASE 的 5.66 倍；约 19% 的 CPI 通道过不了稠密判据。

idea_en: κ-dimer works like a ceiling that forbids rising above the pass height, keeping the walker in the valley; instead, draw rings of equal height around camp and follow each ring's lowest point outward. Round 10 proved κ < 0 ⟺ gᵀH⁻¹g < 0 (energy below the local quadratic saddle) and tested SHELL-path: minimise on harmonic shells ½xᵀH_ISx = ε, grown ×1.6 over ≤6 stages, handing over to the dimer once energy drops.
idea_zh: κ-dimer 像天花板：不许高过鞍点能量，步行者只好贴着谷底；不如沿营地周围“等高圈”的最低点向外走。第十轮证明 κ<0 ⟺ gᵀH⁻¹g<0，并测试能壳路径：在 ½xᵀH_ISx=ε 上求最低点，ε 每级 ×1.6、至多 6 级，能量一降即交给 dimer。
systems_en: κ autopsy on 1,680 archived κ-dimer searches and 480 development searches; final on 21 EARLY IS (8 original + 13 held-out network nodes) × 8 new seeds, 1,008 campaigns.
systems_zh: κ 剖析：1,680 次历史 κ-dimer 搜索与 480 次开发搜索；终测：EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个原始 + 13 个留出网络节点）× 8 个新种子，共 1,008 个 campaign。
result_en: Original κ-dimer: 1,657 of 1,680 searches hit the 500-step limit (82 % start where the isoenergy surface is already non-convex, 28 % stall at κ ≈ 0); 0 saddles even inside the best pipeline. SHELL-path: 21,542 force calls per saddle, U/call 1.126× [1.012, 1.320] vs ADD-cert (p = 0.016, Holm passed), 76 saddles vs 51 (ADD-cert) and 65 (ASE). Model-κ brake failed (1.083×).
result_zh: 原版 κ-dimer 1,657/1,680 次跑满步数（82% 起点已 κ>0），入最佳流程仍 0 个鞍点。能壳路径每鞍点 21,542 次调用，对 ADD-cert 1.126 倍 [1.012, 1.320]（Holm 通过），鞍点 76 对 51。

name_en: Restraints on the shell path, plus CPI
name_zh: 能壳路径上的限制与 CPI
idea_en: Keep the climber on a short rope near camp, cap how high they may go, or send them further along the rings, and let a cheap sign check vouch for each pass. On top of SHELL-path, round 11 tested freezing the region beyond 3 Å from the reactants, a Newton energy ceiling, a longer path (10 stages ×1.5) and the CPI validation from round 9.
idea_zh: 给登山者拴短绳、限制最高能爬多高，或让他沿“等高圈”走得更远，再让一个廉价的符号检查为每个鞍点作证。第十一轮在能壳路径之上测试：冻结距反应物 3 Å 以外的区域、Newton 能量天花板、更长路径（10 级 ×1.5），以及第九轮的 CPI 验证。
systems_en: Development on the 8 original IS (480 searches per arm); final on 21 EARLY IS (8 original + 13 held-out network nodes) × 8 new seeds, 840 campaigns.
systems_zh: 开发：8 个原始初态（每臂 480 次搜索）；终测：EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个原始 + 13 个留出网络节点）× 8 个新种子，共 840 个 campaign。
result_en: SHELL-path + CPI: 16,334 vs 23,496 force calls per saddle, U/call 1.438× [1.390, 1.491] (Holm passed), 6.65× ASE; 57 of 254 CPI-accepted channels (22 %) failed the uncharged dense audit and were not counted. The restraints failed: the 3 Å freeze raised validations 38 → 63 but cut saddles 13 → 10 (a funnel), the ceiling fired 3 times in 480, the long path gave 0.961×.
result_zh: 能壳路径 + CPI：每鞍点 16,334 对 23,496 次力调用，1.438 倍 [1.390, 1.491]（Holm 通过），ASE 的 6.65 倍；254 个 CPI 接受中 57 个未过稠密审计。3 Å 冻结、能量天花板与长路径均失败。

idea_en: Like a tug-of-war on one bond: pull a notch, let the molecule relax, repeat until the energy drops, then hand a walker the spot just before the drop. DRIVE-R10 stepped a bond-length coordinate (breaking bonds +0.15 Å per stage, forming bonds toward 1.05× covalent contact) with 10 relaxation steps on each ξ = const isosurface, started the dimer at the scan top along ±∇ξ and cycled coordinates without replacement.
idea_zh: 像对一根键拔河：拉一格、让其余部分放松，重复到能量下降，再把下降前的位置交给步行者。DRIVE-R10 逐级推进键长（断键每级 +0.15 Å，成键推向 1.05 倍共价接触），每级在 ξ=常数面上弛豫 10 步，dimer 从扫描顶点沿 ±∇ξ 出发，无放回轮换坐标。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS: 10 on Pt/Cu surfaces and 11 in CHA/MFI zeolites (8 original + 13 held-out network nodes); final 21 IS × 8 new seeds, 1,008 campaigns.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态：Pt/Cu 表面 10 个、CHA/MFI 分子筛 11 个（8 个原始 + 13 个留出网络节点）；终测 21 个初态 × 8 个新种子，共 1,008 个 campaign。
result_en: DRIVE-R10: 16,803 force calls per saddle, U/call 1.572× [1.320, 1.628] vs SHELL-path (Holm passed; originals 1.518, generation 1 1.422, generation 2 1.801), 6.562× ASE; 95 saddles (65 chemical or proton transfer), the most of any round so far. A shell/drive/AFIR cycle gave 1.454× [1.192, 1.456]; AFIR-lite 1.267×. Within-campaign duplicates 24 → 3. Became the recommended preset.
result_zh: DRIVE-R10：每鞍点 16,803 次力调用，对能壳路径 U/调用 1.572 倍 [1.320, 1.628]（Holm 通过），ASE 的 6.562 倍；95 个鞍点（化学 65 个），当时最多。混合循环 1.454 倍。成为推荐预设。

idea_en: If many hikers are funnelled to the same trailhead, they all walk the same path; put a cap on trailheads already used. An autopsy of 1,680 SHELL-path searches showed 26 % of starts within whitened cos > 0.95 of an earlier start in the same campaign, repeating its outcome; SHELL-CAP rejects such starts and re-runs the shell path. The round also tested 20 vs 10 relaxation steps per drive stage and forming-only drives.
idea_zh: 登山者被漏斗引到同一路口，就会走同一条路；给用过的路口加个帽子。剖析显示 26% 的能壳路径起点落在同 campaign 更早起点的白化 cos>0.95 内并重复其结局；SHELL-CAP 拒绝这类起点并重走能壳路径。本轮还测试驱动每级弛豫 20 对 10 步及只做成键驱动。
systems_en: Development: 288 campaigns on the 8 original IS; final on 21 EARLY IS (8 original + 13 held-out network nodes) × 8 new seeds, 672 campaigns.
systems_zh: 开发：8 个原始初态上 288 个 campaign；终测：EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个原始 + 13 个留出网络节点）× 8 个新种子，共 672 个 campaign。
result_en: SHELL-CAP vs SHELL-path: U/call 1.15× [1.03, 1.18] (Holm passed), saddles 63 → 81, but only 1.02× (p = 0.35) on new seeds in the round-14 grand final, so the evidence is moderate. R20 vs R10: 1.006× (p = 0.42), so 10 steps suffice. The drive replicated 1.40× over SHELL-path; forming-only drives were worse in development. Shipped only as an optional preset.
result_zh: SHELL-CAP 对能壳路径：1.15 倍 [1.03, 1.18]（Holm 通过），鞍点 63 → 81；但第十四轮新种子上仅 1.02 倍（p=0.35）。每级 20 步对 10 步 1.006 倍，10 步已够。只成键驱动更差。仅作可选预设。

name_en: Grand final 1: eleven methods head to head
name_zh: 总决赛 1：11 种方法同台
idea_en: A race on one sealed course: the leading methods so far run from the same 21 camps with fresh seeds under one frozen release, and every litre of fuel is charged. Eleven methods (traditional ASE dimer, original TSASE κ-dimer, ADD-cert, SHELL-path, SHELL-CAP, SHELL-CPI, model-κ, mix cycle, DRIVE-R10, R20 and an exploratory DRIVE-CPI) were scored by globally distinct strict saddles per force call, with three pre-registered confirmations.
idea_zh: 封闭赛道决赛：领先方法用新种子、同一冻结版本，从同样 21 个营地出发，每升油都计费。11 种方法（含 ASE dimer、κ-dimer、能壳路径、SHELL-CAP、DRIVE-R10 及探索性 DRIVE-CPI）按每次力调用的全局独立严格鞍点计分，三项预注册确证。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS: 8 original systems (methoxy/Cu(111); formic acid, ethylene glycol, glycolaldehyde+2H on Pt(111); n-butane/H-MFI; two methanol/H-CHA; two ethanol/H-MFI, dry and with two water) + 13 held-out network nodes; × 8 new seeds × 11 methods = 1,848 campaigns of 10 searches.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态：8 个原始体系（甲氧基/Cu(111)；甲酸、乙二醇、乙醇醛+2H/Pt(111)；正丁烷/H-MFI；两甲醇/H-CHA；两乙醇/H-MFI，干燥与含两个水）+ 13 个留出网络节点；× 8 个新种子 × 11 种方法 = 1,848 个 campaign，每个 10 次搜索。
result_en: DRIVE-R10 won among strict methods: 16,374 force calls per saddle, 103 saddles (70 chemical or proton transfer); U/call 7.26× [5.99, 7.79] vs ASE (118,941; 48 saddles), 30.3× vs κ-dimer (496,756; 7 saddles), 1.44× [1.22, 1.53] vs SHELL-path, all Holm-confirmed. Exploratory DRIVE-CPI: 11,903 calls per saddle (10.0× ASE), but 18 % (46/261) of its accepted saddles failed the dense audit.
result_zh: DRIVE-R10 胜出：每鞍点 16,374 次调用，103 个鞍点；对 ASE 7.26 倍 [5.99, 7.79]，对 κ-dimer 30.3 倍，对能壳路径 1.44 倍，均过 Holm。DRIVE-CPI（探索）11,903，18% 未过审计。

idea_en: If eight prospectors each re-pan the same ten claims, they find the same gold eight times; spread them over every claim. Because a drive from a given IS along a given coordinate is deterministic (scan apexes of 893/893 repeated drives were bitwise identical), round 15 replaced DRIVE-R10's alternating break/form slots with drawing from all chemical coordinates: uniformly (UNI), by a learned class prior (PRIOR), prior plus analogy (PRIOR-ANALOG), or a coverage plan (COVER).
idea_zh: 八个淘金者各淘同样十块地，同样的金子找八次；不如分散开。驱动是确定的（扫描顶点 893/893 逐位相同），第十五轮把交替断/成键槽位改为从全部化学坐标抽取：均匀（UNI）、类别先验（PRIOR）、先验 + 类比（PRIOR-ANALOG）或覆盖计划（COVER）。
systems_en: Development on the 8 original IS; final on 21 EARLY IS × 8 new seeds, 840 campaigns; confirmation on the 13 held-out network nodes that never entered the prior.
systems_zh: 开发：8 个原始初态；终测：EARLY 集 21 个初态 × 8 个新种子，共 840 个 campaign；确证只看从未进入先验的 13 个留出网络节点。
result_en: Confirmation on the 13 held-out IS, U/call vs DRIVE-R10 slots: UNI 1.242× (p = 0.0035), PRIOR 1.178× (p = 0.0027), PRIOR-ANALOG 1.122× (p = 0.028), all Holm-passed. On all 21 IS, UNI needed 14,120 force calls per saddle vs 17,753 (1.257×), with 119 saddles vs 97. The gain comes from spreading launches, not from the learned prior (PRIOR/UNI 0.99).
result_zh: 13 个留出初态上对交替槽位：UNI 1.242 倍、PRIOR 1.178 倍、PRIOR-ANALOG 1.122 倍，均过 Holm。21 个初态上 UNI 每鞍点 14,120 对 17,753 次调用，鞍点 119 对 97。收益来自分散而非先验。

idea_en: Instead of pulling one rope, push the whole molecule through a series of flat gates set by the initial-state stiffness, and start the walker facing along the path. Round 16 tested Newton-trajectory ideas: drives on fixed hyperplanes whitened by H_IS^{1/2} (PLANE-H), root-finding for the multiplier μ = 0 (PLANE-H-ROOT), and a tangent start mode (TAN), against bond-length isosurface drives (REF = DRIVE-R10).
idea_zh: 不再只拉一根绳，而是把整个分子推过按初态刚度摆放的一道道平板闸门，并让步行者顺着路径方向起步。第十六轮测试 Newton 轨迹：白化固定超平面驱动（PLANE-H）、乘子 μ=0 求根（PLANE-H-ROOT）、切线起始模式（TAN），参照为键长等值面驱动（REF）。
systems_en: Development on the 8 original IS; reduced final REF / TAN / PLANE-H on 21 EARLY IS × 8 new seeds, 504 campaigns.
systems_zh: 开发：8 个原始初态；缩减终测 REF / TAN / PLANE-H × EARLY 集 21 个初态 × 8 个新种子，共 504 个 campaign。
result_en: TAN vs REF: 1.02× (p = 0.39), no effect. REF vs PLANE-H: 1.12× (p = 0.026, just above the first Holm threshold 0.025), i.e. hyperplanes about 0.89× with 81 saddles vs 95; in development PLANE variants were 0.77–0.80×. Newton trajectories, whitened hyperplanes, μ root-finding and tangent modes were all no better than distance isosurfaces.
result_zh: TAN 对 REF：1.02 倍（p=0.39），无作用。REF 对 PLANE-H 1.12 倍（p=0.026，略高于 Holm 阈值 0.025），即超平面约 0.89 倍，鞍点 81 对 95。白化超平面、μ 求根、切线模式都不比距离等值面好。

idea_en: Once near the pass, stop shuffling and take a few confident strides using a map of the camp's stiffness that is sketched once and reused. Round 17 replaced the refinement stage with Newton–Krylov steps in coordinates whitened by the initial-state Hessian, reusing one Krylov subspace across steps; a second arm handed over earlier and did not fall back to the dimer when Newton–Krylov failed (H03-NF).
idea_zh: 快到鞍部时不再碎步挪动，而是凭一张反复使用的“营地刚度图”迈几大步。第十七轮把精修改为在初态 Hessian 白化坐标中做 Newton–Krylov，步间复用同一个 Krylov 子空间；另一臂更早交接，且 Newton–Krylov 失败时不退回 dimer（H03-NF）。
systems_en: Development on the 8 original IS; final CPI / CPI-KN / CPI-KN-H03-NF on 21 EARLY IS × 8 new seeds, 504 campaigns.
systems_zh: 开发：8 个原始初态；终测 CPI / CPI-KN / CPI-KN-H03-NF × EARLY 集 21 个初态 × 8 个新种子，共 504 个 campaign。
result_en: CPI-KN vs CPI: 12,616 vs 14,098 force calls per saddle, U/call 1.117× [1.114, 1.137] (p < 0.001, Holm passed), consistent on all subsets (1.10–1.14×); saddles 87 vs 86 and refinement calls −68 %, a pure saving. Early handover without fallback: 0.98× (p = 0.64), losing 42 % of saddles despite a large development advantage. Kept in all later stacks.

idea_en: A walker who has felt only uphill-in-every-direction ground for fifteen strides is in a bowl, not near a pass, and should turn back. Round 18 ended a dimer search after 15 consecutive steps with positive lowest curvature (A15; 10 steps was too aggressive in development), and tested it in a 2×2 factorial with dispersed prior/analogy coordinate choice on top of CPI + Newton–Krylov (STACK).
idea_zh: 连续十五步脚下都是“四面上坡”，说明人在碗底、不在鞍部附近，应该掉头。第十八轮在 dimer 最低曲率连续 15 步为正时结束本次搜索（A15；开发中 10 步过于激进），并在 CPI + Newton–Krylov 之上与先验/类比分散选键做 2×2 因子试验（STACK）。
systems_en: Development on the 8 original IS; final 2×2 factorial (CPI-KN, CPI-KN-A15, STACK, STACK-A15) on 21 EARLY IS × 8 new seeds, 672 campaigns.
systems_zh: 开发：8 个原始初态；终测 2×2 因子（CPI-KN、CPI-KN-A15、STACK、STACK-A15）× EARLY 集 21 个初态 × 8 个新种子，共 672 个 campaign。
result_en: Abort alone, CPI-KN-A15 vs CPI-KN: U/call 1.082× [1.070, 1.095] (p < 0.001, Holm passed), saddles unchanged at 83. Stacked with dispersed coordinate choice, STACK-A15 reached 9,565 force calls per saddle, 1.361× [1.185, 1.465] vs CPI-KN (13,016), saddles 83 → 110. The two effects roughly multiply (+7–8 % and +27 %).
result_zh: 对 CPI-KN，单独中止 A15 1.082 倍 [1.070, 1.095]（Holm 通过），鞍点不变（83）；叠加分散选键的 STACK-A15 每鞍点 9,565 次力调用，1.361 倍 [1.185, 1.465]，鞍点 83 → 110。

name_en: One long search with memory (1×80 sessions)
idea_en: One prospector who keeps a notebook never re-pans a claim; eight who start fresh each morning re-pan the same ones. Since a drive's outcome is deterministic, round 19 compared one 80-launch session that remembers which coordinates it has already driven against 8 independent 10-launch campaigns with the same total launches per IS, for the best stack (STACK) and for DRIVE-CPI.
idea_zh: 带笔记本的淘金者不会重淘同一块地；每天早上从头开始的八个人却会。既然驱动结局是确定的，第十九轮比较：一次记得已驱动过哪些坐标的 80 次启动长会话，对 8 个各 10 次启动的独立 campaign（每个初态启动总数相同），方法为最佳组合 STACK 与 DRIVE-CPI。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original + 13 held-out network nodes); per IS 1 × 80 launches (one session) vs 8 × 10 launches (8 new seeds), for STACK and DRIVE-CPI. A Krylov P-RFO search engine was screened on 3 IS beforehand.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个原始 + 13 个留出网络节点）；每个初态 1 × 80 次启动（一次会话）对 8 × 10 次启动（8 个新种子），方法 STACK 与 DRIVE-CPI。事先在 3 个初态上筛查了 Krylov P-RFO 搜索。
result_en: STACK, one session vs eight: 7,226 vs 9,809 force calls per saddle, 138 vs 114 saddles, U/call 1.358× [1.18, 1.52] (p = 0.0003); DRIVE-CPI 1.402× [1.29, 1.53] (p < 0.001), both Holm-passed with IS-cluster bootstrap. Same 80 launches: 21 % more saddles for 11 % fewer calls. The Krylov P-RFO search was dropped (0 saddles on formic acid/Pt).
result_zh: STACK 一次长会话对八次独立：每鞍点 7,226 对 9,809 次调用，鞍点 138 对 114，1.358 倍 [1.18, 1.52]；DRIVE-CPI 1.402 倍，均过 Holm。P-RFO 在甲酸/Pt 上 0 个鞍点，弃用。

idea_en: If you have pulled a rope 1.2 Å and the load still has not tipped over the ridge, stop: this launch is going nowhere. Archived grand-final launches showed that breaking drives which never crossed a ridge in 8 stages passed validation only 3 % of the time yet used 7.6 % of all calls; GATE-B ends such launches before any search or validation, and GATE-BF also gates forming drives.
idea_zh: 绳子已经拉长 1.2 Å，重物仍没翻过山脊，就别再白费力气。总决赛归档显示：8 级都未越脊的断键驱动只有 3% 通过验证，却花掉全部调用的 7.6%；GATE-B 让这类启动不做搜索与验证直接结束，GATE-BF 对未越脊的成键驱动也这样处理。
systems_en: Development on the 8 original IS; final CPI-KN-A15 / GATE-B / GATE-BF on 21 EARLY IS × 8 new seeds, 504 campaigns.
systems_zh: 开发：8 个原始初态；终测 CPI-KN-A15 / GATE-B / GATE-BF × EARLY 集 21 个初态 × 8 个新种子，共 504 个 campaign。
result_en: GATE-B vs CPI-KN-A15: 10,771 vs 11,125 force calls per saddle, U/call 1.033× [1.022, 1.058] (p < 0.001, Holm passed; IS-cluster p = 0.009), saddles 87 vs 89, calls −5 %: a small, steady saving. GATE-BF: 1.050× (p = 0.0013) but 19 % fewer saddles and IS-cluster p = 0.16, so unstable and not adopted.
result_zh: GATE-B 对 CPI-KN-A15：每鞍点 10,771 对 11,125 次调用，1.033 倍 [1.022, 1.058]（Holm 与初态簇均通过），鞍点 87 对 89。GATE-BF 1.050 倍，但鞍点少 19%、不稳，未采用。

name_en: Hysteresis-bracket starts; gate on best stack
name_zh: 滞回括号起点与闸门叠加
idea_en: When a relaxed scan suddenly drops, it has jumped between two branches of the landscape, and the true pass may sit on the unstable branch in between, like a ridge between two ledges. Round 21 relaxed the post-jump structure back onto the top layer, started the dimer from the highest of three points between the branches with the branch difference as mode, and stacked GATE-B on the best stack.
idea_zh: 松弛扫描能量突然下降，说明它从势能面的一支跳到了另一支，真正的鞍点可能在两支之间的不稳定支上，像两块岩台之间的山脊。第二十一轮把跳后的结构松弛回顶层，取两支连线上 3 个点中能量最高者作起点、两支之差作起始模式（滞回括号）；并把 GATE-B 叠加到最佳组合上。
systems_en: Development on the 8 original IS; final STACK-A15 / STACK-A15-HB / STACK-A15-GB / UNI-A15-GB on 21 EARLY IS × 8 new seeds, 672 campaigns.
systems_zh: 开发：8 个原始初态；终测 STACK-A15 / STACK-A15-HB / STACK-A15-GB / UNI-A15-GB × EARLY 集 21 个初态 × 8 个新种子，共 672 个 campaign。
result_en: Hysteresis brackets were harmful: STACK-A15-HB vs STACK-A15 0.83× (p = 1.0), saddles 106 → 72; in development 42 % of bracketed launches ended by the positive-curvature abort. The gate stacked on the best stack gave 1.022× [1.008, 1.037] (Holm passed; IS-cluster p = 0.043) at unchanged saddles (106), and STACK-A15-GB went to grand final 2. Uniform choice: 0.97×, not significant.
result_zh: 滞回括号有害：对 STACK-A15 0.83 倍（p=1.0），鞍点 106 → 72。闸门叠加到最佳组合：1.022 倍 [1.008, 1.037]（Holm 与初态簇均通过），鞍点不变（106），STACK-A15-GB 进入总决赛 2。

name_en: Coordinate order inside one long search
idea_en: With only 80 launches in a session, the order in which claims are panned matters: work the historically rich claim types first. Round 22 ran 80-launch sessions with CPI, Newton–Krylov, the 15-step abort and GATE-B, ordering coordinates by alternating slots (L-SLOTS), uniformly (L-UNI), by class prior (L-PRIOR) or by prior plus analogy (L-PA).
idea_zh: 一次会话只有 80 次启动，先淘哪块地很重要：先挖高产类型。第二十二轮每个初态一次 80 启动的长会话（CPI + Newton–Krylov + 中止 + 闸门），坐标顺序为交替槽位（L-SLOTS）、均匀（L-UNI）、类别先验（L-PRIOR）或先验 + 类比（L-PA）。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original + 13 held-out network nodes) × 2 independent sessions × 80 launches per order, 168 sessions.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个原始 + 13 个留出网络节点）× 每种顺序 2 次独立会话 × 80 次启动，共 168 个会话。
result_en: L-PA: 6,642 force calls per saddle and 6.62 saddles per session vs 7,930 and 4.62 for L-SLOTS, U/call 1.194× [1.07, 1.34] (p = 0.0003, Holm passed); L-PRIOR 1.182× (p = 0.001). L-UNI found more saddles (5.40) but cost more per launch: 0.99× (p = 0.55). In one long search, driving productive coordinate classes first matters.
result_zh: L-PA：每鞍点 6,642 次力调用、每会话 6.62 个鞍点，L-SLOTS 为 7,930 与 4.62，1.194 倍 [1.07, 1.34]（Holm 通过）；L-PRIOR 1.182 倍。L-UNI 0.99 倍（p=0.55）。

idea_en: A prospector who pans 30 times in a row without a new nugget should pack up and move to the next creek. Each IS has a finite, deterministic set of saddles reachable by drives, so once it is mined out more launches are pure cost; round 23 ended a session after K consecutive launches without a new distinct saddle (K = 15 or 30, at most 120 launches).
idea_zh: 淘金者连续 30 盘都没淘到新金粒，就该收工换下一条河。每个初态能被驱动找到的鞍点有限且确定，“挖完”后再多启动都是纯成本；第二十三轮在连续 K 次启动没有新的独立鞍点时结束会话（K = 15 或 30，最多 120 次启动）。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS × 2 sessions × up to 120 launches, prior-plus-analogy order with the full saving stack; L120 (no stop) vs L120-D15 and L120-D30, 126 sessions.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态 × 2 次会话 × 最多 120 次启动，先验 + 类比顺序与全部省调用部件；L120（不停）对 L120-D15、L120-D30，共 126 个会话。
result_en: D30 vs no stop: 5,614 vs 7,915 force calls per saddle, U/call 1.410× [1.21, 1.73] (p < 0.001, Holm passed), 39 % fewer launches, 97 % of saddles kept, 7.6 saddles per session. D15: 1.625× [1.32, 2.13] but kept only 77 %, stopping too early on rich IS. Methoxy/Cu, with no reachable saddle, now stops after 15–30 launches instead of 120. D30 entered the long-search preset.

idea_en: A sealed race that also climbs a ladder rung by rung: each new part is added to the previous champion, so its share of the gain can be read off. Seven methods on one frozen release: traditional ASE dimer, original TSASE κ-dimer, DRIVE-R10, DRIVE-CPI (grand-final-1 champion), + Newton–Krylov (CPI-KN), + dispersed choice and abort (STACK-A15), + breaking gate (STACK-A15-GB), with three Holm-corrected confirmations.
idea_zh: 封闭赛跑兼逐级爬梯：新部件逐个加在上一冠军上。同一冻结版本 7 种方法：ASE dimer、κ-dimer、DRIVE-R10、DRIVE-CPI，再依次加 Newton–Krylov、分散选键与中止、断键闸门（最终 STACK-A15-GB）；三项 Holm 确证。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original surface and zeolite systems + 13 held-out network nodes) × 8 new seeds × 7 methods = 1,176 campaigns of 10 searches; the round-23 long-session result is reported alongside.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个原始表面/分子筛体系 + 13 个留出网络节点）× 8 个新种子 × 7 种方法 = 1,176 个 campaign，每个 10 次搜索；同时汇报第二十三轮的长会话结果。
result_en: STACK-A15-GB: 8,742 force calls per saddle, 117 saddles; U/call 11.525× [9.890, 12.278] vs ASE (100,754; 57 saddles), about 400× vs κ-dimer (1 saddle), 1.285× [1.164, 1.444] vs DRIVE-CPI (1.417× on the 13 held-out IS, 1.063× on the originals), all Holm-passed. Every rung helped: 1.385, 1.113, 1.131, 1.020. One long search with D30: 5,614 calls per saddle, 7.6 saddles.
result_zh: STACK-A15-GB：每鞍点 8,742 次力调用，117 个鞍点；对 ASE 11.525 倍，对 κ-dimer 约 400 倍，对 DRIVE-CPI 1.285 倍，均过 Holm。阶梯每级为正：1.385、1.113、1.131、1.020。

name_en: Dense online validation vs CPI + audit (DENSE)
name_zh: 稠密在线验证取代 CPI+审计
idea_en: Rather than waving parts through a quick inspection and paying an auditor to re-check the whole batch afterwards, inspect each part properly once on the line. The grand-final-2 champion (STACK_A15_GB) screened saddles with a cheap congruence-inertia index check (CPI) plus an end-of-campaign dense-Hessian audit; the DENSE arm instead certified each candidate online with the exact dense Hessian, with no CPI and no audit, and audit calls were now charged.
idea_zh: 与其草草放行、最后请审计把整批货重检一遍，不如在流水线上每件认真检一次。总决赛 2 冠军搜索栈用廉价的同余惯性（CPI）检验加末尾稠密 Hessian 审计；DENSE 臂改为在线对每个候选做精确稠密 Hessian 证书，无 CPI、无审计；比较时审计调用也计费。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS: 8 original systems (methoxy/Cu(111); formic acid, ethylene glycol and glycolaldehyde+2H on Pt(111); n-butane/H-MFI; two methanol/H-CHA; two ethanol/H-MFI, dry and with two water) plus 13 held-out reaction-network nodes. Final: 21 IS × 8 seeds × 10 launches (1,680 searches per arm) and 21 IS × 2 long sessions (≤120 launches, stop after 30 launches without a new saddle).
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态：8 个原始体系（甲氧基/Cu(111)；甲酸、乙二醇、乙醇醛+2H/Pt(111)；正丁烷/H-MFI；两甲醇/H-CHA；两乙醇/H-MFI，干燥与含两个水）+ 13 个留出的反应网络节点。最终对照：21 初态 × 8 种子 × 10 次启动（每臂 1,680 次搜索），以及 21 初态 × 2 次长会话（≤120 次启动，连续 30 次无新鞍点即停）。
result_en: All-charged U/call, DENSE vs REF: 1.168× [1.098, 1.202] (12,697 vs 14,834 force calls per saddle; U 117 vs 109); long sessions 1.120× [1.076, 1.157] (8,050 vs 9,013). With the audit left free the ranking reverses (0.757× [0.710, 0.784]). About half the gain is saved cost, half more saddles. Dense validation became the honest strict baseline (v0.31) and later part of `long-best`.
result_zh: 全计费 U/调用：DENSE/REF 1.168 倍 [1.098, 1.202]，U 117 对 109，约一半来自省成本；长会话 1.120 倍。审计不计时排序反转（0.757 倍）。v0.31 起为稠密严格基准，后进入 `long-best`。

idea_en: A prospector who logged every pan on past trips can replay them on paper to decide which claims to work first and when to pack up. Because a launch on a given IS and coordinate is deterministic, archived launches were replayed exactly to design session rules: greedy prior order of bond coordinates, stop once every coordinate has been driven, plus a 25-dry-launch stop (GX25) or a Bayesian expected-remaining-yield stop (GB).
idea_zh: 淘金者留着以往每一盘的记录，就能在纸上重演，决定先淘哪块地、何时收工。固定协议下同一初态、同一坐标的启动结局是确定的，于是用归档启动零成本精确重放来设计会话规则：按先验贪心排序键坐标、全部坐标驱动过就停，再加连续 25 次无新鞍点即停（GX25）或贝叶斯剩余产率停止（GB）。
systems_en: Offline: archived launches on the 21 EARLY IS (8 original surface and zeolite systems + 13 held-out network nodes), rules tuned only on the 8 originals and tested on the 13 held-out IS. Final: 21 IS × 2 long sessions (≤120 launches) per arm, 4 arms; reference LONG_D30 (the grand-final-2 stack as one long search, stopping after 30 launches without a new saddle).
systems_zh: 离线：EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个表面与分子筛原始体系 + 13 个留出网络节点）的归档启动，只在 8 个原始体系上调参、在 13 个留出初态上检验。最终：每臂 21 初态 × 2 次长会话（≤120 次启动），共 4 臂；参照 LONG_D30（总决赛 2 的搜索栈作为一次长搜索，连续 30 次无新鞍点即停）。
result_en: U/call vs LONG_D30: GX25 1.218× [1.149, 1.306] (all-charged 1.122×), 335 vs 324 saddles; GB 1.288× [1.164, 1.488] but it shifted saddles from small IS to rich MFI IS; stop-when-exhausted alone 1.084× at identical U. The simulator predicted launches and U of every GX25 and GB session exactly. GX25 was recommended as the long-search default (merged in v0.32, off by default) and later became part of `long-best`.
result_zh: U/调用（对 LONG_D30，审计不计）：GX25 1.218 倍 [1.149, 1.306]，U 335 对 324；GB 1.288 倍，但鞍点偏向富 MFI 初态。模拟器对两者逐会话命中。GX25 被推荐为长搜索默认，后进入 `long-best`。

name_en: Learned launch gate from scan features
idea_en: A seasoned prospector glances at the first shovelful and walks away from claims that rarely pay before hauling in the heavy equipment. A leave-one-IS-out logistic model on 34 features known when the relaxed bond scan ends (energy profile, element-pair chemistry, scan-top geometry) predicts whether a launch will yield a countable saddle, and launches with low predicted value per expected call are skipped before the dimer search starts.
idea_zh: 老练的淘金者看一眼第一铲土，就放弃很少出金的地块，不再把重型设备运上去。用弛豫键扫描结束时已知的 34 个特征（能量剖面、元素对化学类别、扫描顶点几何）训练留一初态逻辑回归，预测本次启动能否给出可计入的严格鞍点；“预测价值/预期力调用”低的启动在 dimer 搜索开始前直接跳过。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original surface and zeolite systems + 13 held-out network nodes); gate tables trained on archived launches leave-one-IS-out, plus leave-one-family-out tables as the honest estimate for unseen chemistry; final 21 IS × 8 seeds × 10 launches per arm vs STACK_A15_GB (grand-final-2 champion).
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个表面与分子筛原始体系 + 13 个留出网络节点）；闸门表用归档启动按留一初态训练，另有留一家族表作为新化学体系的诚实估计；最终每臂 21 初态 × 8 种子 × 10 次启动，对照 STACK_A15_GB（总决赛 2 冠军）。
result_en: U/call vs STACK_A15_GB: leave-one-IS-out gate 1.387× [1.296, 1.484] (all-charged 1.221× [1.151, 1.298]), 6,781 vs 9,405 calls per saddle, but U fell 109 → 93 (−15 %); leave-one-family tables 1.187× [1.146, 1.229] with U −6 %. The pre-stated ≤5 % saddle-loss target was missed. Merged as an opt-in option (v0.29), never default.
result_zh: U/调用（对 STACK_A15_GB，审计不计）：留一初态闸门 1.387 倍 [1.296, 1.484]，但 U 109→93（−15 %）；留一家族表 1.187 倍，U −6 %。未达 U 损失 ≤5 % 的预设目标。v0.29 仅作可选项合入。

idea_en: A postal sorter glances at each envelope and pulls out those obviously addressed to another town, walking a few steps down the road only for smudged addresses. Before refinement and two-sided validation, a leave-one-IS-out logistic model on 10 zero-call features of the coarse candidate (shift from search start and IS, IS-Hessian harmonic energy, bond changes) rejects likely disconnected candidates; uncertain ones get a descent probe of at most 30 steps (COMBO).
idea_zh: 分拣员扫一眼信封，就把明显寄错城市的信挑出来，地址模糊的才沿路走几步核实。精修和两侧验证之前，用粗候选的 10 个零调用特征（相对起点与初态的位移、初态 Hessian 谐振能、键变化）做留一初态逻辑回归，拒掉预测连不回初态的候选；不确定的再做 ≤30 步下降探针（COMBO）。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original surface and zeolite systems + 13 held-out network nodes); offline leave-one-IS-out evaluation on archived STACK_A15_GB candidates; final 21 IS × 8 seeds × 10 launches, three arms (STACK_A15_GB reference, learned screen, learned screen + probe).
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个表面与分子筛原始体系 + 13 个留出网络节点）；先在 STACK_A15_GB 的归档候选上做留一初态离线评估；最终 21 初态 × 8 种子 × 10 次启动，三臂（STACK_A15_GB 参照、学习筛、学习筛 + 探针）。
result_en: U/call vs STACK_A15_GB: screen + probe (COMBO) 1.053× [1.040, 1.086] (all-charged 1.029× [1.020, 1.058]); learned screen alone 1.041× [1.029, 1.074]. Price: 3 rare saddles rejected systematically (U 96 → 93, −3.1 %). Disconnected candidates are ~17 % of launches at ~1,000 calls each; the probe alone did not pay. Merged as opt-in (v0.30).
result_zh: U/调用（对 STACK_A15_GB，审计不计）：学习筛 + 探针（COMBO）1.053 倍 [1.040, 1.086]，单独学习筛 1.041 倍；代价是 3 个稀有鞍点被系统性误杀（U 96→93，−3.1 %）。v0.30 仅作可选项合入。

name_en: New coordinates: fragment translation, rotation, atom transfer
name_zh: 新坐标族：平移、转动、原子转移
idea_en: When every marked trail out of the valley has been walked, try off-trail moves: slide the whole tent across the meadow, spin it, or pass one pole to the neighbouring camp. Once the bond-coordinate list ran out or 15 launches in a row found nothing, the long search drove new coordinates with the same relaxed-scan engine: rigid fragment translation (0.25 Å steps), fragment rotation (11.25° steps) and atom transfer between fragments.
idea_zh: 山谷里所有标记的小路都走遍了，就试试离开小路的动作：把整顶帐篷挪过草地、原地转一转，或把一根支杆递给邻营。键坐标用完或连续 15 次启动无新鞍点后，长搜索改用同一弛豫扫描引擎驱动新的集体坐标：吸附碎片刚体平移（每级 0.25 Å）、碎片转动（每级 11.25°）和碎片间原子转移。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original systems on Cu(111), Pt(111), H-MFI and H-CHA + 13 held-out network nodes); final 21 IS × 2 long sessions per arm (≤120 launches), reference LONG_D30 (one long search stopping after 30 launches without a new saddle).
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（Cu(111)、Pt(111)、H-MFI、H-CHA 上的 8 个原始体系 + 13 个留出网络节点）；最终每臂 21 初态 × 2 次长会话（≤120 次启动），参照 LONG_D30（一次长搜索，连续 30 次无新鞍点即停）。
result_en: Session U/call vs LONG_D30: switching at 15 dry launches (NF) 0.948× [0.880, 1.004] with fewer saddles (292 vs 336); only after the bond list is exhausted (NF-EX) 0.970× [0.925, 0.995], significantly worse. 1,063 new-family launches gave 8 new saddles (0.75 % per launch vs 10–13 % for bonds), none on surfaces: hop and spin ridges are too flat for the dimer to converge. Not adopted.
result_zh: 长会话 U/调用（对 LONG_D30）：干旱 15 次即切换 0.948 倍 [0.880, 1.004]，鞍点 292 对 336；键坐标用完才用 0.970 倍，显著更差。1,063 次新族启动仅 8 个新鞍点，均不在表面：鞍区极平，dimer 难收敛。

idea_en: A hiker almost at the pass keeps zig-zagging in a narrow gully; once close, he switches to a local map that straightens the gully, and re-checks his compass only when it has likely moved. Once curvature is negative and fmax ≤ 0.05, the dimer translation and the fallback refine switch to an initial-state-Hessian preconditioner (eigenvalues floored at 0.3), and the rotation's trial image is skipped when the predicted rotation angle is below 2°.
idea_zh: 快到山口的登山者却在窄沟里来回折返；知道已很近时，换一张把窄沟“拉直”的局部地图，且只在指南针可能变了时才校准。dimer 一旦测到负曲率且 fmax ≤ 0.05，平移与回退精修改用初态 Hessian 预条件（本征值下限 0.3）；预测转角 < 2° 时跳过转动试探像。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original surface and zeolite systems + 13 held-out network nodes); final 21 IS × 8 seeds × 10 launches per arm vs STACK_A15_GB; secondary long sessions 21 IS × 2 vs LONG_D30.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个表面与分子筛原始体系 + 13 个留出网络节点）；最终每臂 21 初态 × 8 种子 × 10 次启动，对照 STACK_A15_GB；次要长会话 21 初态 × 2，对照 LONG_D30。
result_en: U/call vs STACK_A15_GB (audit not charged): combined T5LM2 1.202× [1.140, 1.278] (all-charged 1.115× [1.066, 1.173]), U 123 → 117 (−4.9 %); preconditioning alone 1.119× [1.064, 1.144]; lazy rotation alone 1.027×, not significant. Tail median 48.5 → 11 steps, refine calls −65 %. Long sessions 1.235× [1.173, 1.293]. Saddles are lost when walkers leave the search radius. Merged in v0.33 and later part of `long-best`.
result_zh: U/调用（对 STACK_A15_GB，审计不计）：1.202 倍 [1.140, 1.278]（全计费 1.115 倍），U 123→117；仅预条件 1.119 倍；长会话 1.235 倍。v0.33 合入，后进入 `long-best`。

name_en: Pausable lazy quenches in dense validation (PAUSE-Q)
idea_en: A driver checking whether a road leads home pulls over halfway: if the town ahead is plainly not home, he turns back instead of driving to its centre. In dense-strict validation each downhill quench from the saddle pauses at fmax 0.01; a side clearly not the initial state (≥0.05 eV above it and >3× the matching tolerance away) is rejected without the 0.01 → 5×10⁻⁴ tail; otherwise the quench resumes.
idea_zh: 开车确认这条路是否通往家：半路看一眼，前方明显不是自家小镇就掉头，不必开到镇中心。稠密严格验证中，从鞍点两侧下降的淬火在 fmax 0.01 处暂停；若该侧明显不是初态（比初态高 ≥0.05 eV 且匹配距离超容差 3 倍），省掉到 5×10⁻⁴ 的尾段直接判不连通，否则续跑。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original surface and zeolite systems + 13 held-out network nodes); archive analysis and replay of the round-25 dense candidates first, then final 21 IS × 8 seeds × 10 launches vs STACK_DENSE (dense-strict stack, no audit) and secondary long sessions 21 IS × 1 vs LONG_DENSE.
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个表面与分子筛原始体系 + 13 个留出网络节点）；先对第 25 轮稠密臂的候选做归档分析与重放，最终每臂 21 初态 × 8 种子 × 10 次启动，对照 STACK_DENSE（稠密严格、无审计）；次要长会话 21 初态 × 1，对照 LONG_DENSE。
result_en: All-charged U/call vs STACK_DENSE: 1.033× [1.029, 1.038] (13,753 → 13,312 calls per saddle) with U 110 = 110 and all 1,680 paired verdicts identical; validation-quench calls −13.8 %. Long sessions 1.040× [1.031, 1.053], ΣU 154 = 154. The planned ‘connectivity before dense certificate’ idea was already baseline behaviour. Merged in v0.34 and later part of `long-best`.
result_zh: 全计费 U/调用（对 STACK_DENSE）：1.033 倍 [1.029, 1.038]，U 不变，1,680 次配对判决相同；淬火调用 −13.8 %；长会话 1.040 倍。“先连通再证书”早已是基线。v0.34 合入，后进入 `long-best`。

name_en: Learned filters and capture abort in long search
name_zh: 长搜索中的学习过滤与捕获中止
idea_en: A gold panner skips streams his notes call barren, sets aside fool's gold, and stops washing a pan once he recognises a nugget he already owns. On the long dense-strict GX25 search, the round-27 learned launch gate and round-28 disconnection screen were combined (gated launches do not count toward the dry spell), and a capture abort stops a dimer search within 0.3 Å of a known candidate with matching mode.
idea_zh: 淘金者按笔记跳过贫瘠溪段，提前挑出“愚人金”，认出已到手的金粒就停止淘洗。在稠密严格、GX25 停止的长搜索上叠加第 27 轮学习闸门与第 28 轮不连通筛（被闸启动不计入干旱期），并加捕获中止：fmax<0.1、离已知候选 0.3 Å 内且模重叠 ≥0.9 即提前结束搜索。
systems_en: 21 EARLY IS (8 original surface and zeolite systems + 13 held-out network nodes); final 21 IS × 2 long sessions per arm (≤120 launches); reference LONG_DENSE_GX25 (dense-strict validation + round-26 GX25 session policy).
systems_zh: EARLY 集 21 个初态（8 个表面与分子筛原始体系 + 13 个留出网络节点）；最终每臂 21 初态 × 2 次长会话（≤120 次启动）；参照 LONG_DENSE_GX25（稠密严格验证 + 第 26 轮 GX25 会话策略）。
result_en: All-charged U/call vs LONG_DENSE_GX25: gate + screen 1.137× [1.064, 1.233] but U −10.2 % (325 → 292), narrowly missing both targets (≥1.15×, ≤10 % loss); capture added 1.012× [1.008, 1.016] with zero false captures and unchanged U; leave-one-family tables 1.069× [1.032, 1.118], U −2.8 %. Capture entered `long-best` (v0.35); gate and screen stayed an opt-in package.
result_zh: 全计费 U/调用：闸门+筛 1.137 倍 [1.064, 1.233]，但 U −10.2 %，两个目标都差一点；再加捕获 1.012 倍 [1.008, 1.016]，零误捕。捕获进入 `long-best`（v0.35），闸门与筛仅作可选包。

name_en: Turning failed searches into saddles (SALVAGE, INDEX-2)
name_zh: 失败变鞍点：连接器与二阶鞍点
idea_en: A prospector whose tunnel surfaced in the wrong valley checks if it is a nook of home and digs the link, or climbs a col to spot a sibling pass. SALVAGE searched the step from the IS to the nearer end of a disconnected saddle when that end was an IS variant (RMSD ≤ 1.5 Å, same bonding); INDEX-2 climbed a known saddle's second mode to an index-2 saddle and descended to a sibling.
idea_zh: 淘金者的坑道通到了别的山谷：先看那是不是自家山谷的一角，是就挖条短通道；或爬上垭口找兄弟山口。SALVAGE：不连通鞍点离初态较近的端点若是初态变体（RMSD ≤1.5 Å、键图相同），就搜索初态到它的一步；INDEX-2：从已知鞍点沿第二模爬到二阶鞍点，再下到兄弟鞍点。
systems_en: Falsification replays only, no campaign. SALVAGE: 60 archived disconnected candidates on 6 EARLY IS (Pt(111) surfaces, H-CHA and H-MFI zeolites). INDEX-2: 42 known saddles × 2 directions = 84 climbs on 7 EARLY IS. Cost benchmark: LONG_D30 at 5,614 calls per saddle.
systems_zh: 只做证伪重放，未开 campaign。SALVAGE：EARLY 集 6 个初态（Pt(111) 表面与 H-CHA、H-MFI 分子筛）上 60 个归档的不连通候选；INDEX-2：7 个初态上 42 个已知鞍点 × 2 个方向 = 84 次爬升。成本参照 LONG_D30（每鞍点 5,614 次力调用）。
result_en: SALVAGE: 34/60 = 56.7 % of near ends were IS variants, but only 4/21 = 19.0 % of connector searches gave a new strict saddle (gate 25 %), at 11,267 calls per new saddle vs 5,614 for LONG_D30; 3 of the 4 lay outside the all-method union of 303 saddles. INDEX-2: 1/84 = 1.2 %, 32,781 calls per new saddle. Both failed their pre-registered gates; not adopted.
result_zh: SALVAGE：连接器仅 4/21 = 19.0 % 得到新严格鞍点（门槛 25 %），每个新鞍点 11,267 次力调用（LONG_D30 为 5,614）；INDEX-2 仅 1/84 = 1.2 %，每个 32,781 次。均未过预注册门槛，未采用。

name_zh: 反应网络热启动（坐标库）
idea_en: A hiker exploring the next valley borrows a friend's trail log from the neighbouring one: paths that led to a pass there are tried first here. For a child IS in a reaction network (same atoms as its parent), the parent session's coordinate outcomes became likelihood-ratio multipliers on the coordinate priors, reordering the child's launches (NET) and optionally also feeding its expected-yield stop (NET-Y).
idea_zh: 探隔壁山谷的人借来朋友的路线日志：那边通到山口的小路，这边先试。反应网络中子初态与父初态原子相同；把父会话各坐标的结局变成坐标先验的似然比乘子（父上有产出的坐标在子上 45 % 再有产出，否则 7.3 %），重排子会话顺序（NET），并可让库进入剩余产率停止（NET-Y）。
systems_en: 13 child IS of the EARLY reaction networks (N-* and N2-* nodes of the original surface and zeolite systems), 4 long sessions each; parent (root) sessions identical in all arms and charged once; reference = round-26 GB session policy; development used independent parent libraries.
systems_zh: EARLY 反应网络中的 13 个子初态（原始表面与分子筛体系的 N-*、N2-* 节点），每个 4 次长会话；父（根）会话在各臂相同、只计费一次；参照为第 26 轮 GB 会话策略；开发阶段使用独立的父会话库。
result_en: Session U/call vs GB: library + library-aware stop (NET-Y) 1.085× [1.024, 1.191] (all-charged 1.046× [1.018, 1.116]) but kept only 0.933 of the saddles, below the 0.95 retention rule, so it was not recommended; library ordering alone (NET) 0.995× [0.957, 1.018] with +4.3 % saddles. The simulator predicted both ratios exactly. Default unchanged; the library shipped as an opt-in network option (v0.36).
result_zh: 长会话 U/调用（对 GB，审计不计）：库 + 库修正停止（NET-Y）1.085 倍 [1.024, 1.191]，但鞍点只保留 0.933（规则 ≥0.95），不推荐；仅库排序（NET）0.995 倍，鞍点 +4.3 %。库仅作可选项合入 v0.36。

name_en: Integration: the honest best long search (LONG_BEST)
idea_en: Like assembling a car only from parts that each passed their own road test, then testing the whole car. LONG_BEST stacks every separately confirmed piece on the dense-validation long session (LONG_DENSE): greedy coordinate order, stop once all coordinates are driven or 25 launches in a row find nothing new, tail IS-Hessian preconditioning with lazy rotation, a pausable lazy quench and capture abort. A second arm lifts the 120-launch cap for large zeolites.
idea_zh: 像用各自路试合格的零件组装整车，再试整车。LONG_BEST 在稠密验证的 LONG_DENSE 上叠加全部单独确证的部件：贪心坐标顺序、驱动完或连续 25 次无新鞍点即停、尾段初态 Hessian 预条件与惰性转动、可暂停淬火、捕获中止；另一臂对大分子筛取消 120 次上限。
systems_en: 21 original IS (Cu and Pt surfaces, H-MFI and H-CHA zeolites), 2 long sessions per IS and arm with paired seeds; the uncapped arm on the 11 zeolite IS (8 MFI, 3 CHA), 2 sessions each; secondary comparison on the 8 held-out G3 IS, 2 sessions each.
systems_zh: 21 个原始初态（Cu、Pt 表面与 H-MFI、H-CHA 分子筛），每臂每初态 2 次长会话、种子配对；不设上限臂用其中 11 个分子筛初态（MFI 8、CHA 3）各 2 次；次要比较：8 个 G3 留出初态各 2 次。
result_en: U/call LONG_BEST/LONG_DENSE 1.288× [1.207, 1.436], p < 0.00025: 6,287 vs 8,100 calls per saddle, 7.76 vs 8.33 saddles per session (U retention 0.931); G3 1.573×. Uncapped zeolite sessions found 9.0 % more saddles (target 10 %) at 0.969× [0.953, 0.995]. H1 passed, H2 missed, so officially inconclusive; LONG_BEST became the recommended `long-best` preset.
result_zh: 对 LONG_DENSE：U/调用 1.288 倍 [1.207, 1.436]，每会话鞍点 7.76 对 8.33；G3 1.573 倍。分子筛不设上限多找 9.0 %（目标 10 %）。H1 过、H2 未过，判“不确定”；定为推荐预设 long-best。

idea_en: A hiker climbing a foggy ridge normally stops at every step to feel the ground carefully; here he extrapolates from his last two footprints and keeps his stride length, so fewer checks are needed. Each stage of the relaxed bond scan started from a secant extrapolation of the previous relaxed points and reused the last Barzilai–Borwein step, cutting relaxation from 10 to 5–6 steps per stage.
idea_zh: 雾中沿山脊上行的人，原本每走一步都要停下来细细摸索地面；现在按最近两个脚印外推下一步、沿用上一步的步幅，就能少摸几次。技术上：键坐标弛豫扫描的每一级从前几级弛豫点的割线外推出发，并沿用上一级的 Barzilai–Borwein 步长，把每级弛豫从 10 步减到 5–6 步。
systems_en: No search campaigns. Scan-only NEP replay of archived bond drives from the 21 original IS: sample A 306 drives, independent sample B 256 drives (18 IS); the 10-step reference scans were reproduced bit for bit.
systems_zh: 未跑搜索战役。只对 21 个原始初态的归档键驱动做扫描阶段的 NEP 重放：样本 A 306 个驱动，独立样本 B 256 个（18 个初态）；10 步参照扫描逐位复现。
result_en: The cheap scan (6 steps + secant + step memory) reproduced the reference scan top in only 26.5 % of drives (31.2 % launch-weighted; sample B 25.0 %) against an 80 % gate; the best variant reached 37–44 %, even 20-step scans only 24–27 %. Scan calls fell to 0.60–0.67×, but scans are just 7.8 % of all calls (gain ceiling ≈ 1.03×). Kill rule triggered; no campaign.
result_zh: 便宜扫描（6 步+割线+步长记忆）只在 26.5 % 的驱动上复现参照扫描顶点（门槛 80 %），最好变体 37–44 %。扫描调用降到 0.60–0.67 倍，但扫描只占总调用 7.8 %，收益上限约 1.03 倍。淘汰规则触发，未跑战役。

idea_en: Round 30 let the walker, near the pass, size its strides with a curvature map of the home valley (the IS Hessian); this saved steps but sometimes overshot out of the 4 Å search sphere. Four guard rails were tried: unlatching when forces rise or the walker drifts, a trust radius, separate scaling of soft IS modes, and memory variants. The best, C10, combined soft-mode projection with an earlier latch at h = 0.1.
idea_zh: 第 30 轮让行走者在接近山口时按“家乡山谷”的曲率图（初态 Hessian）决定步幅，省了步数，却偶尔迈出 4 Å 搜索球。本轮试四种护栏：力回升或偏离时解锁、信赖半径、初态软模单独标度、记忆/反应中心变体；最好的 C10 = 软模投影 + 提前到 h = 0.1 锁存。
systems_en: Paired NEP replay of 1,599 archived launches on the 21 original IS; development on 8 of them × 6 seeds × 10 launches; final 21 IS × 8 seeds × 10 launches (1,680 launches per arm) against the dense-validated STACK_DENSE_T; secondary 21 IS × 2 long sessions.
systems_zh: 在 21 个原始初态上对 1,599 个归档启动做配对 NEP 重放；开发用其中 8 个初态 × 6 种子 × 10 次启动；最终 21 初态 × 8 种子 × 10 次启动（每臂 1,680 次），参照为稠密验证的 STACK_DENSE_T；次要：21 初态 × 2 次长会话。
result_en: Final U/call C10/reference 0.980× [0.966, 1.013], p 0.833, U 111 → 112: the guard removed 82 % of the extra radius exits, but the rescued walkers only found duplicate saddles. Key finding: under dense validation round 30's saddle loss did not exist (U 111 with or without preconditioning). Unprotected h = 0.1 was descriptively 1.045× [0.997, 1.072]; long sessions 0.996×.
result_zh: C10/参照 U/调用 0.980 倍 [0.966, 1.013]，p 0.833，U 111 → 112：额外出界少 82 %，救回的却都是重复鞍点。关键发现：稠密验证下第 30 轮的鞍点损失并不存在。无保护的 h = 0.1 描述性 1.045 倍。

idea_en: An exam with questions the students have never seen: eight new-chemistry initial states, never used for tuning, were attacked with five frozen methods to check whether gains measured on the 21 development systems carry over. Arms: the classic ASE dimer, bond-drive launches (DRIVE_R10), the dense stack (STACK_DENSE), the dense greedy long session (GX25), and GX25 plus the learned launch gate and disconnection screen.
idea_zh: 像用学生没见过的题目考试：8 个从未参与调参的新化学初态，用 5 个冻结方法去跑，看 21 个开发体系上的收益能否迁移。各臂：传统 ASE dimer、键驱动 DRIVE_R10、稠密栈 STACK_DENSE、稠密贪心长会话 GX25，及 GX25 加学习闸门与不连通筛。
systems_en: 8 held-out G3 IS: CO2+2H/Cu(211), NH3+H/Ru(0001), propane/Pt(111), C2H2+2H/Pd(111), CO+H/Rh(111), methanol+ethene/H-MFI (301 atoms), propene/H-CHA, formaldehyde+methanol/H-CHA. ASE dimer 8 seeds × 10 launches; DRIVE_R10 and STACK_DENSE 16 seeds × 10 launches; the two GX25 arms 4 long sessions per IS.
systems_zh: 8 个 G3 留出初态：CO2+2H/Cu(211)、NH3+H/Ru(0001)、丙烷/Pt(111)、C2H2+2H/Pd(111)、CO+H/Rh(111)、甲醇+乙烯/H-MFI（301 原子）、丙烯/H-CHA、甲醛+甲醇/H-CHA。ASE dimer 8 种子 × 10 次启动；DRIVE_R10 与 STACK_DENSE 16 种子 × 10 次；两个 GX25 臂每初态 4 次长会话。
result_en: With one saddle-counting rule for both, GX25 beat the classic ASE dimer 3.0–4.2× in U/call (per-run 4.20× [2.60, 7.95]); the pre-registered mixed count gave 11.56× [8.86, 20.37]. That is about half the 21-IS advantage. Learned gate + screen: 1.198× but U −23 % (158 → 121). STACK_DENSE/DRIVE_R10 1.138×. Only the ASE dimer found 14 of the 59 union saddles. Officially inconclusive.
result_zh: 同口径下 GX25 对 ASE dimer 的 U/调用为 3.0–4.2 倍（每运行 4.20 倍 [2.60, 7.95]），约为 21 初态上的一半；学习闸门+筛 1.198 倍但 U −23 %；59 个鞍点中 14 个只有 ASE dimer 找到。

name_zh: 一键 explore 与并行启动
idea_en: Turn a lab bench into a one-button appliance, then let several helpers work at once. A single `dimer-explore explore` command relaxes and certifies the initial state, computes its Hessian, runs one long search and writes the saddles plus a summary, with resume/extend and three presets (long-dense, fast, classic). `--workers N` runs N launches of the same search concurrently and merges results in launch order.
idea_zh: 把实验台变成一键家电，再让几个帮手同时开工。一条 dimer-explore explore 命令完成初态弛豫、极小证书与 Hessian、一次长搜索，写出鞍点与摘要，可续跑，带三个预设；--workers N 让同一搜索的 N 次启动并发运行，按启动顺序合并。
systems_en: 8 original IS: formic acid/Pt(111), glycolaldehyde+2H and ethylene glycol/Pt(111) with two reaction-network nodes, two methanol/H-CHA plus one node, and n-butane/H-MFI; one long-dense session per IS with a single seed, serial versus 8 workers (16 exploratory).
systems_zh: 8 个原始初态：甲酸/Pt(111)、乙醇醛+2H 与乙二醇/Pt(111) 及 2 个网络节点、两个甲醇/H-CHA 及 1 个节点、正丁烷/H-MFI；每初态 1 次 long-dense 长会话、单一种子，串行对比 8 个 worker（16 个为探索性）。
result_en: Serial `explore` was bit-identical to the batch pipeline on 8/8 IS. With `--workers 8` the merged saddle count was 0.877 of serial (default design) at 0.956× the calls per saddle, and wall time dropped 3.9× (4.7× with 16 workers). The whole loss came from one n-butane/MFI session stopping early on its dry-spell rule. Pre-registered verdict negative; CLI and presets shipped in v0.37, parallelism opt-in.
result_zh: 串行 explore 与批处理 8/8 逐位一致。--workers 8 的鞍点数为串行的 0.877，每鞍点调用 0.956 倍，墙钟快 3.9 倍；损失全来自一个正丁烷/MFI 会话提前停止。预注册判负；CLI 与预设进入 v0.37，并行可选。

name_zh: G3 上两步反应网络扩展
idea_en: If the room you want has no door on the hallway, walk into a neighbouring room and look for doors from there. Each certified product of an IS session (up to 12 per IS, certificates reused at zero cost from the parent's dense validation) became a new node with its own LONG_BEST session (depth 2), testing whether the four missing G3 target reactions are one hop away; a WARM arm reused the parent's coordinate library.
idea_zh: 想去的房间在走廊上没有门，就先走进隔壁房间，再从那里找门。把初态会话的每个认证产物（每初态最多 12 个，证书零调用取自父会话的稠密验证）当作新节点，各跑一次 LONG_BEST 会话（深度 2），检验 G3 上缺失的四个目标反应是否只差一跳；WARM 臂沿用父会话的坐标库。
systems_en: 8 held-out G3 IS plus 3 original benchmark IS (formic acid, glycolaldehyde+2H and ethylene glycol on Pt(111)); 38 G3 child nodes run COLD and WARM, one LONG_BEST session per node; exploratory depth 3.
systems_zh: 8 个 G3 留出初态 + 3 个原始基准初态（Pt(111) 上的甲酸、乙醇醛+2H、乙二醇）；38 个 G3 子节点分 COLD/WARM 两臂，每节点 1 次 LONG_BEST 会话；另有探索性的深度 3。
result_en: Only 2 of the 4 target reactions appeared by depth 2 (Ru N–H breaking, effective barrier 1.033 eV; an MFI C–C coupling, 1.349 eV), so H1 failed. Depth-2 network-new saddles per call were 0.843× of depth 1 [0.681, 1.043], above the pre-set two-thirds floor; the eight G3 networks grew from 39 to 277 saddles. WARM 1.001×. Post hoc, 92 % of 412 'disconnected' launches were strict saddles.
result_zh: 深度 2 只找到 2/4 个目标反应（Ru 上 N–H 断裂、MFI 中 C–C 成键）。深度 2 新鞍点/调用为深度 1 的 0.843 倍 [0.681, 1.043]，网络鞍点 39 → 277；WARM 无效。另：92 % 的“不连通”启动是严格鞍点。

name_en: Safe learned launch gate for unseen chemistry
name_zh: 对新化学安全的学习启动闸门
idea_en: A bouncer trained on regulars waves through faces he has never seen and re-tunes his judgement on tonight's guests. The round-27 learned gate skips launches whose scan features predict low value; safeguards were added: never gate rare coordinate classes or IS containing elements absent from training, and recalibrate online (Bayesian) on the session's own outcomes, skipping only when confidently low. An offline simulator screened 624 variants before confirmation.
idea_zh: 只认得熟客的门卫，遇到生面孔一律放行，并按今晚来客的表现随时校准。第 27 轮的学习闸门按扫描特征跳过预计无产出的启动；本轮加保护：稀有坐标类别不闸、初态含训练中没见过的元素时不闸、用会话自身结局做贝叶斯在线校准，只有确信低价值才跳过。离线模拟器先筛了 624 个变体。
systems_en: Final 222 long sessions against LONG_DENSE_GX25_TP: 21 original IS × 2 sessions (family-holdout gate tables) and the 8 held-out G3 IS × 4 sessions, for each of three arms (reference, SAFE, ALT).
systems_zh: 最终 222 次长会话，参照 LONG_DENSE_GX25_TP：21 个原始初态 × 2 次（家族留出闸门表）与 8 个 G3 留出初态 × 4 次，三臂（参照、SAFE、ALT）各一套。
result_en: On G3, SAFE/reference U/call was 1.021× [0.907, 1.098], p 0.29, with U 158 → 146 (−7.6 %): failed. On the 21 IS 1.027× [1.014, 1.053], U 320 → 318: significant but far below the 1.10× target. The novel-element guard cost nothing; online calibration turned Cu(211) pessimism into a hard veto on two new saddles. Options merged default-off (v0.37).
result_zh: G3 上 SAFE/参照 U/调用 1.021 倍 [0.907, 1.098]，U −7.6 %，未过；21 初态 1.027 倍 [1.014, 1.053]，远低于 1.10 倍目标。新元素保护零损失；在线校准误杀 Cu(211) 两个新鞍点。默认关闭。

name_en: Completeness mode: random probes after bond drives
name_zh: 完整性模式：键坐标后随机探针
idea_en: After working the known veins, a prospector sweeps the rest of the hillside with a metal detector until several passes in a row turn up nothing. When a session's bond-driven phase ends, it continues with random-probe dimer launches until 8 probes in a row find no new saddle (cap 40); the main arm (PA8) used classic ASE-style probes, a secondary arm (PA8-S) the session's own cheaper dimer numerics with adsorbate-restricted directions.
idea_zh: 探矿者挖完已知矿脉，再拿金属探测器扫剩下的山坡，直到连续几趟一无所获。会话的键驱动阶段结束后做随机探针 dimer 启动，连续 8 次无新鞍点即停（上限 40 次）；主臂 PA8 用传统 ASE 式探针，次要臂 PA8-S 用会话自身更便宜的 dimer 数值、只沿吸附物方向。
systems_en: Per arm, 8 held-out G3 IS × 4 sessions + 21 original IS × 2 sessions (222 sessions over three arms), reference LONG_DENSE_GX25_T.
systems_zh: 每臂 8 个 G3 留出初态 × 4 次会话 + 21 个原始初态 × 2 次（三臂共 222 次会话），参照 LONG_DENSE_GX25_T。
result_en: ASE-style probes (PA8) added 14.7 % saddles per session on G3 and 4.3 % on the 21 IS (needed 15 % and 8 %) at U/call 0.719× [0.649, 0.765]: both gates failed. Session-numerics probes (PA8-S) gave about the same gain at 0.962× [0.933, 0.987] for +6.4 % saddles, filling bond-drive blind spots (H hops, rotations, multi-bond events); shipped as the `long-complete` preset in v0.38.
result_zh: ASE 式探针：鞍点 G3 +14.7 %、21 初态 +4.3 %（需 15 %、8 %），U/调用 0.719 倍 [0.649, 0.765]，未过。便宜探针 0.962 倍换 +6.4 % 鞍点，补上键驱动盲区，成为 long-complete 预设。

name_en: SCAN-NEB: climbing image on the scan path
idea_en: Instead of letting the climber roam freely from the highest point of a scouted trail, stretch a short rope between the trail points on either side of the summit and pull it taut over the pass. A three-image climbing-image NEB band was placed between the relaxed-scan points bracketing the scan top, then handed to Krylov–Newton refinement (or a dimer), replacing the free dimer walk.
idea_zh: 不让登山者从侦察路线的最高点自由乱走，而是在山顶两侧的路线点之间拉一根短绳，把它绷紧在山口上。在括住扫描顶点的两个弛豫扫描点之间放 3 个图像的爬坡像 NEB 带，再交给 Krylov–Newton 精修（或 dimer），取代自由 dimer 行走。
systems_en: Replay only, no campaign: 304 archived bond coordinates on the 21 original IS whose scans bracket a barrier (from round-31 and round-35 launches), paired against the dimer walk.
systems_zh: 只做重放、未跑战役：21 个原始初态上 304 个扫描括住势垒的归档键坐标（取自第 31、35 轮的启动），与 dimer 行走配对比较。
result_en: Distinct validated saddles fell 48 % (best variant, SN-D3) to 78 % versus the dimer walk; efficiency proxy 0.596–0.924× (SN-D3 0.924× [0.714, 1.146]). Bands converged in only 23–81 of 304 launches within 60 iterations (initial climbing-image force median 4.3 eV/Å), and even converged bands left disconnected coordinates disconnected: disconnection is a property of the scan path itself. All variants killed at replay.
result_zh: 相对 dimer 行走，不同的已验证鞍点少 48 %–78 %；效率代理 0.596–0.924 倍。60 次迭代内 304 条带只有 23–81 条收敛；收敛后原本不连通的坐标仍不连通，问题出在扫描路径本身。全部变体在重放阶段淘汰。

idea_en: Unfold the curvature map of the home valley (the IS Hessian) earlier on the final climb to the pass. The tail preconditioner latches once curvature is negative and the maximum force falls below h; on STACK_BEST, the current best stack, h was raised from 0.05 to 0.1 or 0.2 eV/Å. A paired replay, judged now on validated distinct saddles and calls rather than radius exits, first eliminated h = 0.3.
idea_zh: 爬向山口的最后一段，更早摊开“家乡山谷”的曲率图（初态 Hessian）定步幅。尾段预条件在负曲率且最大力低于 h 时锁存；本轮在最佳栈 STACK_BEST 上把 h 从 0.05 提到 0.1 或 0.2 eV/Å。成对重放按已验证鞍点与调用判淘汰，淘汰了 h = 0.3。
systems_en: Paired replay of 1,605 archived launches (round-37 dense reference arm) on the 21 original IS; final 21 IS × 8 seeds × 10 launches (1,680 launches per arm); secondary 21 IS × 2 long sessions per arm.
systems_zh: 21 个原始初态上对 1,605 个归档启动（第 37 轮稠密参照臂）做成对重放；最终 21 初态 × 8 种子 × 10 次启动（每臂 1,680 次）；次要：每臂 21 初态 × 2 次长会话。
result_en: h = 0.2: U/call 1.040× [1.001, 1.088], p 0.0228 (just under the Holm threshold 0.025), U 122 = 122, confirmed; h = 0.1: 1.028× [0.987, 1.049], p 0.124, not. The gain comes from 9.2 % fewer search calls; saddle sets swap but do not shrink. Long sessions: 1.038× [1.000, 1.091] but 4.3 % fewer saddles per session. Recommended as opt-in override; presets kept 0.05.
result_zh: h = 0.2：U/调用 1.040 倍 [1.001, 1.088]，p 0.0228（勉强过 Holm），U 不变，确证；h = 0.1 为 1.028 倍，未过。搜索调用少 9.2 %。长会话 1.038 倍但每会话鞍点少 4.3 %。仅作可选覆盖。

idea_en: A surveyor used to throw away any pass that did not lead back to base camp; now such passes stay on the map as roads between other valleys, and if one end sits next to a valley already linked to camp, an elastic-band bridge is built. Option `network_edges` relaxes 'disconnected' strict saddles to certified end minima and stores them as edges; `edge_link` joins near ends back to the IS side by IDPP + CI-NEB.
idea_zh: 测量员以前把通不回大本营的山口丢掉；现在把它们当作其他山谷间的道路记在地图上，若一端紧挨已连到大本营的山谷，再架弹性带便桥。`network_edges` 把不连通的严格鞍点两侧弛豫到认证极小，存为网络边；`edge_link` 用 IDPP + CI-NEB 把近端连回初态。
systems_en: 21 benchmark IS (Cu(111)/Pt(111) surfaces; H-MFI and H-CHA zeolites) and 8 held-out G3 IS (Cu(211), Ru(0001), Pd, Rh, Pt, MFI, CHA); 2 `long-best` sessions per IS for the reference and for network-edge mode (116 sessions).
systems_zh: 21 个基准初态（Cu(111)/Pt(111) 表面；H-MFI、H-CHA 分子筛）与 8 个留出的 G3 初态（Cu(211)、Ru(0001)、Pd、Rh、Pt、MFI、CHA）；参照与网络边模式在每个初态上各跑 2 次 `long-best` 会话（共 116 个会话）。
result_en: Network saddles per call: 1.207× [1.099, 1.380] on the 21 IS and 1.191× [1.004, 1.543] on G3 (metals 1.61×) – significant but short of the 1.5× target; network saddles doubled (807 vs 404). U was bit-identical in all 58 sessions, yet U per call fell to 0.607×. Links succeeded 24/87; only 1 of 4 missing G3 reactions was recovered. Merged as an opt-in network option.
result_zh: 网络鞍点/力调用：21 个初态 1.207 倍 [1.099, 1.380]，G3 1.191 倍 [1.004, 1.543]，显著但未达 1.5 倍目标；网络鞍点翻倍。U 不变，但 U/力调用降至 0.607 倍；连接成功 24/87。作为可选功能合入。

idea_en: Same base camps, different guide: from exactly the same scan-top starting points, the dimer walker was replaced by Sella, a trust-region optimiser that builds a curvature model as it climbs. Sella (RS-PRFO with iterative Hessian diagonalisation) was added as `search_engine="sella"`, default off, and replayed on 304 archived bond-scan tops with identical dense strict validation, in four variants: Cartesian start or certified IS-Hessian seed, each with or without Newton refinement.
idea_zh: 同一批大本营，换一位向导：从相同的扫描顶点出发，用边爬边积累曲率模型的信赖域优化器 Sella 代替 dimer。新增默认关闭的 Sella 引擎（RS-PRFO + 迭代 Hessian 对角化），在 304 个归档扫描顶点上用相同的稠密严格验证重放 4 个变体。
systems_en: Replay on the 21 benchmark IS (Cu(111)/Pt(111) surfaces, H-MFI/H-CHA zeolites): 304 bracketed scan-top coordinates as the main sample plus 115 unbracketed ones, each run with the STACK_BEST dimer reference and the Sella variants; no confirmation campaign.
systems_zh: 在 21 个基准初态（Cu(111)/Pt(111) 表面、H-MFI/H-CHA 分子筛）上重放：主样本为 304 个可括住的扫描顶点坐标，另有 115 个不可括住的坐标；每个坐标分别用 STACK_BEST dimer 参照与各 Sella 变体运行；未做确认。
result_en: Best variant (IS-Hessian seed, straight to 1e-5): saddles per call 1.030× [0.839, 1.290], not significant. Sella used 1.86× fewer search+refine calls per saddle but found 14–30 % fewer distinct validated saddles and was 2.0–4.8× slower in wall time. All four variants hit the pre-registered kill rule; no campaign. Post hoc: 1.35× on the 10 surface IS, which motivated round 53.
result_zh: 最佳变体（初态 Hessian 起步）：效率 1.030 倍 [0.839, 1.290]，不显著；每鞍点搜索调用仅 1/1.86，但已验证鞍点少 14–30 %，墙钟慢 2.0–4.8 倍，四个变体均被淘汰。事后：表面上 1.35 倍，引出第 53 轮。

name_zh: 重拟合学习型启动闸门
idea_en: A doorman glances at each guest and turns away those unlikely to be worth a seat; this round retrained the doorman on 24,106 launches from the current protocol. The round-27 logistic gate scores each launch from 34 bond-scan features (success probability divided by predicted cost) and skips the dimer walk below a threshold; it was refitted as `launch_gate_tables="v2"` with family hold-out and a novel-element safeguard, thresholds set by an exact session simulator.
idea_zh: 门卫看一眼客人就决定放不放行；本轮用当前协议下的 24,106 次启动重新训练门卫。第 27 轮的逻辑回归闸门用 34 个键扫描特征估计“成功概率/预计成本”，低于阈值就不跑 dimer；重拟合为 v2 表（留一家族验证、新元素保护），阈值由精确会话模拟器选出。
systems_en: Refit on 24,106 archived current-protocol launches. Confirmation: 21 benchmark IS (C1) and 8 held-out G3 IS (C2), 2 `long-best` sessions per IS and arm, three arms (reference, refitted gate, a more aggressive gate setting), 174 sessions.
systems_zh: 在 24,106 次归档的当前协议启动上重拟合；确认：21 个基准初态（C1）与 8 个留出的 G3 初态（C2），每组每个初态 2 次 `long-best` 会话，3 个组（参照、重拟合闸门、更激进的闸门设置），共 174 个会话。
result_en: 21 IS: 1.006× [0.984, 1.022], p = 0.24, U 321 vs 323 – below the ≥ 1.08× target. G3: 1.014× [0.973, 1.089] with U 79/83 = 0.952, non-inferiority just passed. Refitting did not move the efficiency–U trade-off: a perfect gate could give 1.52–1.62×, but the classifier separates good from bad launches poorly (family AUC 0.693 vs 0.682 for the old tables). Not adopted.

name_zh: 无损并行启动（知情停止）
idea_en: Eight scouts search at once, but news travels slowly: when one reports a find, others have already set off unaware. The old rule counted these uninformed scouts towards the 'nothing new lately' tally and quit early; the new rule counts only scouts sent after the latest find was logged. In code, the `informed` rule for parallel workers excludes the N−1 launches in flight at each merged discovery from the dry-spell count.
idea_zh: 八名侦察兵同时出发，但消息传得慢：一人报告新发现时，其他人已不知情地出发。旧规则把这些不知情者算进“最近一无所获”的计数，提前收队；新规则只统计最新发现登记之后才派出的人。实现上，并行进程的 `informed` 停止规则不把每次合并发现时已在途的 N−1 次启动计入干旱期。
systems_en: 21 benchmark IS × 2 seeds with `long-best`: a serial reference (bit-identical to the archived serial sessions, 42/42) against 8 workers with the old and new stop rules; 16 workers on the 11 zeolite IS (8 H-MFI, 3 H-CHA); exploratory runs on the 8 H-MFI IS with 2 new seeds.
systems_zh: 21 个基准初态 × 2 个种子，`long-best`：串行参照（与归档串行会话逐位相同，42/42）对比 8 进程下的新旧停止规则；在 11 个分子筛初态（8 个 H-MFI、3 个 H-CHA）上测 16 进程；另在 8 个 H-MFI 初态上用 2 个新种子做探索性运行。
result_en: Informed rule with 8 workers: U ratio 1.003 [0.942, 1.063] (327 vs 326 saddles) at 1.049× [1.018, 1.098] calls per saddle, i.e. about 5 % more calls; the old rule lost saddles (U 0.917). Wall-clock speed-up 2.84× on zeolites (target 3×) and 2.58× on surfaces; 16 workers reached 4.12× on zeolites. `--parallel-stop` now defaults to `informed`; `--workers` stays 1.
result_zh: 知情规则、8 进程：U 比 1.003 [0.942, 1.063]，每鞍点调用 1.049 倍；旧规则 U 0.917。墙钟加速：分子筛 2.84 倍（目标 3 倍）、表面 2.58 倍。`--parallel-stop` 默认改为 `informed`。

name_en: Session stopping policy v2 and long-complete check
idea_en: When should a prospector abandon a claim? The standing rule was 'quit after 25 empty pans in a row'; this round let patience grow with the size of the claim and re-tested a heavier kit, `long-complete` (`long-best` plus stack probes). Policies were screened with an exact offline session simulator built from archived sessions; the winner sets the dry-spell limit to D = clip(⌈0.25·n⌉, 15, 35) for n drivable coordinates.
idea_zh: 淘金者何时该放弃一块矿地？原规则是“连续 25 盘空手就收工”；本轮让耐心随矿地大小增长，并复测更重的装备 `long-complete`。策略用基于归档会话的精确离线模拟器筛选，选出的干旱期 D = clip(⌈0.25·n⌉, 15, 35)，n 为可驱动坐标数。
systems_en: Offline screening on 165 archived sessions plus 593 forced-coordinate replays. Confirmation: 21 benchmark IS and 8 held-out G3 IS, 2 sessions per IS and arm, three arms (`long-best` reference, scaled dry spell, `long-complete`), 174 sessions.
systems_zh: 离线筛选基于 165 个归档会话与 593 次强制坐标重放；确认：21 个基准初态与 8 个留出的 G3 初态，每组每个初态 2 次会话，3 个组（`long-best` 参照、缩放干旱期、`long-complete`），共 174 个会话。
result_en: Scaled dry spell vs `long-best`: U per session 1.020× [1.000, 1.044] and U per call 0.999× [0.980, 1.027], p = 0.046 above the Holm threshold 0.025 – fail. `long-complete`: +3.2 % saddles [1.0 %, 5.7 %] but 0.962× [0.936, 0.980] per call, p = 0.154 – fail. Stopping rules lie on a flat frontier (at most +2 % efficiency); the simulator had predicted the result exactly.
result_zh: 缩放干旱期：每会话 U 1.020 倍 [1.000, 1.044]（未过 Holm），效率 0.999 倍 [0.980, 1.027]；`long-complete` 鞍点 +3.2 %，效率 0.962 倍，未过。停止规则前沿平坦（效率至多 +2 %）。

idea_en: Instead of mapping only the home valley, the explorer now walks into each neighbouring valley it discovers, maps that too, up to a chosen depth, and hands back a road atlas. `dimer-explore explore IS --network-depth K` turns the products of certified channels into child initial states (re-certified at zero cost), runs a long search from each, can add network edges and NEB links, and writes nodes, edges, TS structures and lowest-barrier paths.
idea_zh: 探险者不再只画自家山谷，而是走进发现的每个相邻山谷继续测绘，直到设定深度，交回一本路网图册。`--network-depth K` 把认证通道的产物作为子初态（零调用证书），在每个节点上跑长搜索，可加网络边与 NEB 连接，输出节点、边、过渡态与最低能垒路径。
systems_en: Reproduction of the round-40 depth-2 networks on the 5 metal G3 IS and of the round-45 edge sessions (Ru(0001), Cu(211)); consistency checks on 14 networks; demonstrations on held-out G4 CH3/Ni(111) (depth 2 with edges and links) and CO+O/Pd(100), plus NH3+H/Ru(0001).
systems_zh: 在 5 个金属 G3 初态上复现第 40 轮的深度 2 网络，并复现第 45 轮的网络边会话（Ru(0001)、Cu(211)）；在 14 个网络上做一致性检查；在留出的 G4 体系 CH3/Ni(111)（深度 2 + 边 + 连接）与 CO+O/Pd(100) 上演示，另有 NH3+H/Ru(0001)。
result_en: All acceptance checks passed: round-40 networks reproduced exactly on 5/5 systems, round-45 edge sessions 2/2, 283 zero-call child certificates valid, resume and deepening consistent. CH3/Ni(111) demo: 38 network saddles (25 connected to the IS) at 2,209 calls each, giving CH3 → CH2 + H (0.529 eV) → CH + 2H from one command. Shipped in v0.42; search defaults unchanged.
result_zh: 验收通过：第 40/45 轮结果逐位复现（5/5、2/2），283 个子节点证书有效。CH3/Ni(111) 演示：38 个网络鞍点（25 个连回初态），一条命令给出 CH3 → CH2 + H（0.529 eV）→ CH + 2H。v0.42 发布。

name_zh: 能量窗口探索（扫描顶点能量上限）
idea_en: A hiker with an altitude limit glances at each trail's elevation profile and skips any trail whose summit is too high. Each launch starts with a relaxed bond scan; in the EW-L arm, if the scan top lies more than 1.75 eV above the IS the dimer walk is skipped (and not counted as a dry launch), so effort goes to saddles with barriers ≤ 1.5 eV, the kinetically relevant ones at 500–700 K.
idea_zh: 带着海拔上限的徒步者先看每条路线的高程剖面，最高点超标的就不走。每次启动本来就先做键长弛豫扫描；EW-L 组中若扫描顶点比初态高出 1.75 eV 以上，就不跑 dimer（也不计入干旱期），把力调用集中到能垒 ≤ 1.5 eV、在 500–700 K 下动力学相关的鞍点上。
systems_en: 21 benchmark IS and 8 held-out G3 IS, 2 sessions per IS and arm, three arms (`long-best` reference, EW-L energy cap, EW-S scan-first with ascending scan-top order), 174 sessions; the scan-top/barrier correlation was checked on archived and new launches.
systems_zh: 21 个基准初态与 8 个留出的 G3 初态，每组每个初态 2 次会话，3 个组（`long-best` 参照、EW-L 能量上限、EW-S 先扫描后按顶点能量升序启动），共 174 个会话；扫描顶点能量与能垒的相关性在归档与新启动上检验。
result_en: Saddles with barrier ≤ 1.5 eV per call: EW-L 1.916× [1.759, 2.061], p < 0.00025, finding 159 such saddles vs 160 (7,982 vs 15,297 calls each); EW-S 1.555× [1.315, 1.781]. Cost: only 54–55 % of all `long-best` saddles are found. Scan-top energy predicts the barrier with R² 0.70–0.74. Shipped as opt-in preset `long-lowbarrier` (v0.41); default unchanged.
result_zh: 能垒 ≤ 1.5 eV 鞍点/力调用：EW-L 1.916 倍 [1.759, 2.061]，此类鞍点 159 对 160。代价：只找到 `long-best` 全部鞍点的 54–55 %。作为可选预设 `long-lowbarrier` 发布（v0.41）。

name_en: Learned early abort of dimer walks
idea_en: A coach watches the first strides of each runner and pulls those who look unlikely to finish, saving energy for the others. A logistic classifier read the first 15, 30 or 45 dimer steps (curvature sign and trend, force trend, share of force along the mode, plus 34 scan features) and would abort launches unlikely to end in a validated saddle; it was trained on 30,907 archived searches.
idea_zh: 教练看每位选手起跑后的前几步，把看起来跑不完的人叫下场，把体力留给别人。逻辑回归分类器读取 dimer 的前 15/30/45 步（曲率符号与趋势、力的趋势、沿模式方向的力占比，加 34 个扫描特征），对不太可能得到已验证鞍点的启动提前中止；用 30,907 次归档搜索训练。
systems_en: Offline on 30,907 archived current-protocol searches: fitted on the 21 benchmark IS, predicted on the 8 held-out G3 IS with an exact `long-best` session simulator; runtime smoke test on 4 IS (glycolaldehyde/Pt(111), two methanol/H-CHA, G3 CO2+2H/Cu(211) and acetylene+2H/Pd(111)). No final NEP campaign.
systems_zh: 离线：30,907 次归档的当前协议搜索；在 21 个基准初态上拟合，用精确的 `long-best` 会话模拟器在 8 个留出的 G3 初态上预测；在 4 个初态（乙醇醛/Pt(111)、两甲醇/H-CHA、G3 的 CO2+2H/Cu(211) 与乙炔+2H/Pd(111)）上做运行时冒烟测试；未做最终 NEP 对照。
result_en: Prediction too weak: AUC 0.780 (leave-one-IS-out) and 0.727 (leave-one-family-out) at 30 steps, below the 0.80 target. The selected rule simulated at 1.020× [1.010, 1.034] (U kept 0.998), under the 1.03× kill threshold, so no final run. Reason: 54 % of calls go to launches that do find new saddles, and failed launches still alive at step 15 cost only 200–650 calls; even a perfect abort caps at 1.49×.
result_zh: 30 步时 AUC 0.780（留一初态）/ 0.727（留一家族），低于 0.80。选出的规则离线模拟 1.020 倍（U 保留 0.998），低于 1.03 终止线，未做最终对照。原因：54 % 的调用花在产出新鞍点的启动上；完美中止上限仅 1.49 倍。

name_en: Per-family engine: Sella on metal surfaces
name_zh: 分族引擎：金属表面用 Sella
idea_en: Match the guide to the terrain: on open metal surfaces send the climber who carries a curvature map (Sella), inside zeolite pores keep the dimer walker, which did better there. The new `search_engine="auto"` recognises metal surfaces (d-block metal fraction ≥ 0.5 plus a vacuum gap) and runs Sella seeded with the certified IS Hessian, converged directly to 1e-5; other systems keep the dimer stack. It classified all 29 test IS correctly.
idea_zh: 按地形选向导：金属表面派带着曲率地图的 Sella，分子筛孔道里仍用更擅长的 dimer。新增 `search_engine="auto"`：自动识别金属表面（29 个初态全对），改用认证初态 Hessian 起步、直接收敛到 1e-5 的 Sella，其余体系用 dimer。
systems_en: 15 metal-surface IS: the 10 surface IS of the 21 benchmark set plus 5 held-out G3 metals (Cu(211), Ru(0001), Pd(111), Rh(111), Pt(111)); 4 sessions per IS and arm, arms `long-best`, Sella-auto and an exploratory no-abort Sella (180 sessions). G4 was not ready yet.
systems_zh: 15 个金属表面初态：21 个基准中的 10 个表面初态加 5 个留出的 G3 金属体系（Cu(211)、Ru(0001)、Pd(111)、Rh(111)、Pt(111)）；每组每个初态 4 次会话，组别为 `long-best`、自动 Sella 与探索性的无中止 Sella（共 180 个会话）。G4 当时尚未就绪。
result_en: U per call 1.449× [1.113, 1.904], p = 0.0065 (Holm significant); 2,593 vs 3,757 calls per saddle and 19 % more saddles (232 vs 195); wall time 1.219× per session, within the 2× limit. The gain is concentrated on G3 metals (1.710×); the original 10 surfaces alone gave 1.255× [0.847, 2.099]. Shipped as preset `long-best-auto` (v0.41), later the CLI default.
result_zh: 每力调用 U 1.449 倍 [1.113, 1.904]，鞍点多 19 %。增益集中在 G3 金属（1.710 倍），原 10 个表面单独不显著（1.255 倍）。作为预设 `long-best-auto` 发布（v0.41），后成为 CLI 默认。

name_zh: 总决赛 3：统一口径的方法阶梯
idea_en: A race with one stopwatch: ten methods run the same 36 courses, and every method is scored by one rule – distinct certified saddles per force call, counted per user run with every call charged. Arms ranged from κ-dimer and plain ASE dimer campaigns through the grand-final-2 champion and short stack campaigns to `long-best`, `long-best-auto` and `long-lowbarrier` sessions; 1,440 runs, IS-cluster bootstrap and Holm-corrected pre-registered hypotheses.
idea_zh: 一块秒表定胜负：十种方法跑同样的 36 条赛道，统一按“每次运行的独立认证鞍点/全部力调用”计分。参赛者从 κ-dimer、传统 ASE dimer、总决赛 2 冠军，到 `long-best` 及其 Sella 版、低能垒版长会话；共 1,440 次运行，Holm 校正。
systems_en: GF3 set of 36 IS: 21 benchmark IS + 8 G3 + 7 held-out G4 (NO/Rh(100), H2O/Cu(110), CH3/Ni(111), CO+O/Pd(100), water in H-FAU, H-MOR and H-FER); 10 arms × 4 runs per IS = 1,440 runs, none censored.
systems_zh: GF3 集 36 个初态：21 个基准 + 8 个 G3 + 7 个留出的 G4（NO/Rh(100)、H2O/Cu(110)、CH3/Ni(111)、CO+O/Pd(100)，以及 H-FAU、H-MOR、H-FER 中的水）；10 个组 × 每初态 4 次运行 = 1,440 次运行，无删失。
result_en: `long-best` vs standard ASE dimer: 5.94× [4.63, 8.16] saddles per call; vs long ASE sessions 11.28×; vs κ-dimer 33.39× (all pass); vs the GF2 champion 0.99× [0.87, 1.18] (fails – a Simpson effect), hence inconclusive.
