Ten-launch STACK_BEST is cheapest per saddle (4,232 vs 5,666 calls); long sessions instead give about 4× more saddles per run. `long-best-auto`: 1.50× [1.20, 1.92] on 19 metal surfaces.
result_zh: `long-best` 对 ASE dimer 5.94 倍 [4.63, 8.16]，对 κ-dimer 33 倍；对总决赛 2 冠军 0.99 倍（辛普森悖论），无定论。每鞍点最省的是 10 次启动的 STACK_BEST；长会话每次运行约得 4 倍鞍点。

name_en: Sella mode polish and dimer-to-Sella tail
name_zh: Sella 模式打磨与尾段接力
idea_en: Two relay hand-offs were retuned. On metals, Sella passes its negative-curvature direction to the checker; polishing that baton first should spare slow re-checks. In zeolites, the cheap dimer runs most of the climb and Sella sprints the last stretch. H1 refined Sella's converged mode with a few Jacobi–Davidson Hessian–vector products; H2 stopped the dimer once curvature < 0 and fmax ≤ 0.05 or 0.1 eV/Å, then Sella converged to 1e-5 eV/Å.
idea_zh: 像接力赛的两次交棒：金属上用 Davidson 迭代把 Sella 交给验证的负曲率方向“磨好”，免得验证反复重测；分子筛上让便宜的 dimer 跑大半程，Sella 只冲最后一段（曲率 < 0 且 fmax ≤ 0.05/0.1 eV/Å 时接棒，收敛到 1e-5）。
systems_en: The 36-IS development set: H1 on its 19 metal-surface IS × 4 sessions against LONG_AUTO (`long-best` with Sella on metals); H2 on its 17 zeolite IS against `long-best`, first replaying archived launches, then in exploratory sessions.
systems_zh: 36 个初态开发集：H1 用其中 19 个金属表面初态 × 4 次会话，对照 LONG_AUTO（`long-best` + 金属上用 Sella）；H2 用 17 个分子筛初态，对照 `long-best`，先重放归档发射，再做探索性会话。
result_en: H1: U/call 0.977× [0.888, 1.021], p = 0.756; mode-check cap hits fell 583 → 32 and calls −2.2 %, but U dropped 272 → 260 (−4.4 %) as near-flat saddles flipped in validation. H2: all four variants failed the pre-registered wall-clock rule in replay (1.78–1.88× per launch); exploratory sessions gave 1.050× [1.017, 1.084] at 1.58× wall time. Not merged.
result_zh: H1：U/调用 0.977 倍 [0.888, 1.021]；模式检查封顶 583→32，但 U 272→260（近平坦鞍点翻转）。H2：重放全部被墙钟规则淘汰（每发射 1.78–1.88 倍）；探索性会话 1.050 倍，墙钟 1.58 倍。未合并。

name_zh: 残差失败鞍点的精度挽救
idea_en: A passport photo is rejected as blurry: did the sitter move, or is the camera too coarse? In archived runs 16 % of certificate residual checks failed; the check demands that the negative-mode curvature agree when re-measured with half the finite-difference step. The rescue made the sitter hold perfectly still: up to 3 Newton steps with the cached dense FD Hessian to fmax ≤ 1e-6 eV/Å, then the unchanged certificate.
idea_zh: 证件照被判“模糊”：是人动了，还是相机分辨率不够？归档中 16 % 的残差检查失败（负曲率模用半步长有限差分复测须一致）。本轮让“人”静止：用缓存的稠密 Hessian 做至多 3 步 Newton，精修到 fmax ≤ 1e-6 eV/Å，再走不变的证书。
systems_en: Offline re-certification on the 36-IS dev set (metal surfaces and zeolites): 161 residual-check failures from round-54 `long-best` runs (127 would have been new saddles in their run), 88 failures from round 35, and a matched random control; no sessions were run.
systems_zh: 在 36 个初态开发集（金属表面与分子筛）上离线重新认证：第 54 轮 `long-best` 运行的 161 个残差失败（其中 127 个本可成为该运行的新鞍点）、第 35 轮的 88 个失败，另设匹配随机对照；未跑会话。
result_en: Rescue rate 0/161 (Wilson 95 % CI [0, 2.3 %]), also 0/127 would-be-new saddles, 0/88 in round 35 and 0/161 in the random control; kill rules fired (projected U/call 0.955×), no sessions. Newton moved atoms 4e-6 Å (median): failures stem from finite-difference truncation at h = 1e-3 Å and NEP89 curvature jumps; h = 2.5e-4 Å passes 84.5 %. A definition issue, later settled by exact-Hessian certificates.
result_zh: 挽救率 0/161（95 % 置信区间 [0, 2.3 %]），其他样本与随机对照亦为 0，预计 U/调用 0.955 倍。失败源于 1e-3 Å 差分截断与 NEP89 曲率跳变（更小步长通过 84.5 %），是证书定义问题，后由精确 Hessian 解决。

idea_en: Bond drives try every door handle in the house; this probe instead pushes on the walls where the building is softest, hoping to reach rooms no handle opens. MODES_R added a probe phase to `long-best`: relaxed drives along ± the 4 softest adsorbate-localized normal modes of the IS Hessian (8 probes per session), each followed by a dimer launched from the scan top.
idea_zh: 键驱动像逐个拧每扇门的把手；本轮改推房子最“软”的墙，想进入把手打不开的房间。MODES_R 在 `long-best` 上加探针阶段：沿初态 Hessian 中最软的 4 个吸附物定域简正模正反方向松弛驱动（每会话 8 个探针），再从扫描顶点放 dimer。
systems_en: The 36-IS dev set (19 metal-surface and 17 zeolite IS), 2 sessions per IS against `long-best`; test 1 targeted the 9 saddles on GEN3/GEN4 metal IS that only ASE-dimer baselines had found in the grand final 3 union.
systems_zh: 36 个初态开发集（19 个金属表面、17 个分子筛），每初态 2 次会话，对照 `long-best`；检验 1 针对 GEN3/GEN4 金属初态上第三次总决赛并集中只有 ASE dimer 基线找到的 9 个鞍点。
result_en: Test 1: 0 of 9 ASE-only saddles recovered. Test 2: U/session 1.009× [1.000, 1.027] (needed 1.05), U/call 0.992× [0.979, 1.004]; both tests failed. Probes added new saddles on only 2 metal IS: the softest modes are flat collective slides and rotations, whereas the missed saddles are 0.9–2.8 eV concerted reactions. Not merged.
result_zh: 检验 1：ASE 独有鞍点找回 0/9。检验 2：U/会话 1.009 倍 [1.000, 1.027]（需 1.05），U/调用 0.992 倍 [0.979, 1.004]。最软模多为整体滑移/转动，漏掉的是 0.9–2.8 eV 协同反应。未合并。

name_en: Saddle census and completeness stop rule
name_zh: 鞍点普查与完整度停止规则
idea_en: Ecologists estimate how many species live in a forest from how many were trapped only once or twice. The round pooled 25,771 archived runs on the 36 dev IS into a saddle census, estimated the true number of IS-connected saddles with a jackknife estimator, and tested whether completeness-based stop rules could end sessions earlier without losing saddles.
idea_zh: 生态学家根据只被捕到一两次的物种数，估计森林里共有多少物种。本轮把 36 个开发初态上 25,771 次归档运行汇成鞍点普查，用 jackknife 估计量推断与初态相连的鞍点总数，并检验按完整度提前停止会话的规则能否省力调用。
systems_en: Offline analysis of 25,771 archived runs (rounds 8–54) on the 36-IS dev set (metal surfaces, H-CHA, H-MFI and the newer metal and zeolite IS); stop rules were replayed on the round-49 session simulator and on 144 round-54 sessions. No new searches.
systems_zh: 离线分析：36 个初态开发集（金属表面、H-CHA、H-MFI 及新金属/分子筛初态）上第 8–54 轮的 25,771 次归档运行；停止规则在第 49 轮会话模拟器和第 54 轮 144 个会话上回放。无新搜索。
result_en: 669 strict IS-connected saddles known; Jackknife-2 estimates 952 (archive about 70 % complete). One `long-best` run finds an estimated 22.5 % [19.2, 26.7] (an upper bound), a standard ASE dimer run 3.5 %; a third of known saddles were never found by any bond drive. Best stop rule only 1.007× at equal U (target 1.03), so none was added; a completeness estimate now appears in the `explore` summary.
result_zh: 已知严格鞍点 669 个，Jackknife-2 估计 952 个（归档完整度 70 %）；一次 `long-best` 运行只找到约 22.5 % [19.2, 26.7]。最佳停止规则仅 1.007 倍（目标 1.03），未采用；运行摘要新增完整度估计。

name_zh: 动力学引导的低能垒网络
idea_en: A caver mapping a cave system follows only passages whose highest point stays within 1.5 eV of the entrance, easiest first. In network mode (new searches from each product), `explore --network-window E` does not expand nodes whose path barrier from the IS exceeds E, caps each node's scan top relative to the root IS and expands the lowest-barrier node first; arm KG = `long-lowbarrier` + window 1.5 eV.
idea_zh: 像探洞者只走最高点不超过洞口 1.5 eV 的通道，且先走最容易的。网络模式下，`--network-window E` 不扩展相对初态路径能垒 > E 的节点，按根初态限制扫描顶点，并先扩展能垒最低者；KG = `long-lowbarrier` + 1.5 eV 窗口。
systems_en: Depth-2 reaction networks on 18 IS (8 GEN3, 7 GEN4 and 3 early benchmark IS), 1 seed; arms REF (`long-best`), KG0 (`long-lowbarrier` without window) and KG. The rule was designed offline on the 11 round-40 networks; the 7 GEN4 IS were unseen.
systems_zh: 18 个初态（8 个 GEN3、7 个 GEN4、3 个早期基准初态）的两层反应网络，1 个种子；比较 REF（`long-best`）、KG0（不加窗口的 `long-lowbarrier`）与 KG。规则在第 40 轮的 11 个网络上离线设计，7 个 GEN4 初态此前未见。
result_en: Network saddles ≤ 1.5 eV per call: KG/REF 2.417× [1.515, 3.968] (Holm-significant), with 0.401× the calls and coverage 0.960 [0.912, 0.989]; KG/KG0 1.186× [1.012, 1.483], p = 0.0073. The window itself missed nothing; 8 misses came from the zeolite scan-top energy proxy (metal coverage 1.000, zeolite 0.885). Shipped as an opt-in option.
result_zh: 每调用低能垒（≤1.5 eV）网络鞍点：KG/REF 2.417 倍 [1.515, 3.968]（Holm 显著），调用 0.401 倍，覆盖率 0.960；相对 KG0 1.186 倍。窗口本身零遗漏，8 个遗漏来自分子筛扫描顶点能量代理。以可选项发布。

name_en: Low-barrier recipe: per-family caps and engines
name_zh: 低能垒配方：分族上限与引擎
idea_en: A guide sets a separate altitude ceiling for each mountain range, and the right gear per range, instead of one rule everywhere. `long-lowbarrier` skips dimer launches whose relaxed scan top lies over 1.75 eV above the IS; AUTO added `search_engine=auto` (Sella on metals, dimer in zeolites) and FAM then used family caps (metals 1.35 eV, zeolites 1.70 eV, chosen leave-one-IS-out). Metric: saddles ≤ 1.5 eV per call.
idea_zh: 向导按山脉分别设海拔上限、选装备，而不是处处一个规则。`long-lowbarrier` 跳过扫描顶点高于初态 1.75 eV 的启动；AUTO 加 `search_engine=auto`（金属用 Sella），FAM 再用分族上限（金属 1.35、分子筛 1.70 eV）。
systems_en: The 36-IS dev set (19 metal-surface and 17 zeolite IS), 2 sessions per IS; reference `long-lowbarrier`.
systems_zh: 36 个初态开发集（19 个金属表面、17 个分子筛初态），每初态 2 次会话；参照 `long-lowbarrier`。
result_en: Family caps (FAM/AUTO): 1.056× [1.020, 1.102] saddles ≤ 1.5 eV per call, p < 0.00025 (Holm), keeping 100.5 % of them; adopted into the `long-lowbarrier` preset. Engine switch (AUTO/REF): 1.107× [0.938, 1.292], p = 0.104, not significant (needed 1.10×): 1.326× on metals but 0.963× on the 21 early benchmark IS, where Sella lost 19 low-barrier saddles on Pt.

idea_en: Rehearse a scene with only the lead actors moving while the extras stand frozen, then shoot the final take with the full cast. During the metric dimer walk only, framework atoms more than R = 5 or 6.5 Å from the reacting atoms were frozen at their scan-top positions; refinement and validation stayed full-space. The older `climb_region` option (frozen beyond R, environment reset to the IS) was replayed as CR5.
idea_zh: 像排练时只让主角走位、群演不动，正式拍摄再全员上场。仅在 metric dimer 行走阶段，把距反应原子超过 R = 5 或 6.5 Å 的骨架原子冻结在扫描顶点位置；精修与验证仍用全空间。旧的 `climb_region`（R 外冻结、环境重置回初态）作为 CR5 重放。
systems_en: Offline replay of 300 archived `long-best` launch coordinates from round 54 on the 17 zeolite IS of the dev set (e.g. H-MFI, H-CHA, H-FAU); the kill rule fired, so no sessions were run.
systems_zh: 离线重放：开发集 17 个分子筛初态（如 H-MFI、H-CHA、H-FAU）上第 54 轮 `long-best` 的 300 个归档启动坐标；终止规则触发，未跑会话。
result_en: Efficiency proxy 0.767 [0.679, 0.866] (R = 5 Å), 0.787 [0.719, 0.867] (6.5 Å) and 0.635 [0.546, 0.728] for CR5; search-plus-refine calls per saddle rose ×1.58/×1.38 and retention was 0.835/0.913, so the kill rule stopped the round. The frozen environment leaves full-space forces of 0.11–0.18 eV/Å, and 39–48 % of refinements meet a second negative curvature.

name_en: Out-of-order parallel merge for faster wall time
name_zh: 并行发射乱序合并提速
idea_en: Eight cooks work at once and plates are served in menu order by a shared kitchen clock, so nobody waits for the slowest pan and the meal is the same every time. With 8 workers, `--parallel-merge virtual` lets launches finish out of order but commits them in launch order on a virtual clock counted in NEP calls; `--parallel-stop displaced` adapts the dry-spell stop rule; H2 added `--speculate 7`.
idea_zh: 八个厨师并行，按共享时钟与菜单顺序上菜：不等最慢的锅，每次结果一致。8 个工作进程下，`--parallel-merge virtual` 让发射乱序完成，再按发射顺序在 NEP 调用计数的虚拟时钟上提交；另加干旱期停止规则 `displaced`，H2 再试投机发射。
systems_en: The 21 early benchmark IS (8 H-MFI, 3 H-CHA, 10 Pt/Cu surface IS), 2 seeds, `long-best` with 8 workers against archived serial runs that rerun bit-identically; 11 zeolite IS also with 16 workers.
systems_zh: 早期开发集的 21 个基准初态（8 个 H-MFI、3 个 H-CHA、10 个 Pt/Cu 表面初态），2 个种子，`long-best` 用 8 个工作进程，对照可逐位复现的归档串行运行；另在 11 个分子筛初态上测 16 个进程。
result_en: Raw speed-up on MFI/CHA 3.07× [2.55, 3.58], short of the 4× target, and calls per saddle 1.064× [1.031, 1.109] (limit 1.05), so the round failed; U was unchanged (1.009). Against plain in-order parallelism on the same node it was 1.56× [1.39, 1.71] faster (utilisation 0.36 → 0.60); speculation gave only 1.054× at 1.103× calls per saddle. Shipped as opt-in flags; defaults unchanged.
result_zh: MFI/CHA 上原始加速 3.07 倍 [2.55, 3.58]（目标 4 倍），每鞍点调用 1.064 倍 [1.031, 1.109]（上限 1.05），未过；U 不变。同节点比顺序并行快 1.56 倍 [1.39, 1.71]。作为可选参数发布。

name_en: Failover: retry with the other engine
idea_en: If one guide fails to find the pass from a trailhead, a guide with a different style tries once from the same spot before the group moves on. After a failed launch, the walk was rerun once from the same scan top with the other engine: Sella → metric dimer on metals (scan top ≤ 1.0 eV), dimer → Sella from the IS Hessian in CHA-type zeolites (≤ 1.75 eV, ≤ 130 atoms).
idea_zh: 向导在登山口没找到山口，就换一位风格不同的向导原地再试一次。发射失败后，从同一扫描顶点用另一引擎重走一次：金属上 Sella → metric dimer（扫描顶点 ≤1.0 eV），CHA 类分子筛上 dimer → Sella（≤1.75 eV、≤130 个原子）。
systems_en: The 36-IS dev set (19 metal-surface and 17 zeolite IS), 2 sessions per IS, against LONG_AUTO (`long-best` with Sella on metals). The zeolite branch was chosen beforehand on a replay of 926 failed zeolite launch coordinates from grand final 3, where only the CHA-type tier passed (MFI and FAU/FER/MOR did not).
systems_zh: 36 个初态开发集（19 个金属表面、17 个分子筛初态），每初态 2 次会话，对照 LONG_AUTO（`long-best` + 金属上用 Sella）。分子筛分支事先在第三次总决赛 926 个失败发射坐标的重放上选定：只有 CHA 类通过，MFI 与 FAU/FER/MOR 未通过。
result_en: Full FAILOVER: saddles per search 1.096× [1.045, 1.164], just below the +10 % line, U/call 1.025× [0.989, 1.071], p = 0.096: inconclusive. Metal branch alone: saddles 1.055× [1.016, 1.119], U/call 1.033× [1.004, 1.078], both Holm-significant. It helped the early benchmark surfaces (U/call 1.166×) but not GEN3/GEN4 metals (0.928×); it entered `long-best-auto` and was made optional again after grand final 4 (0.90× on new metal IS).
result_zh: 每次搜索鞍点 1.096 倍 [1.045, 1.164]（未达 +10 %），U/调用 1.025 倍 [0.989, 1.071]，不确定。仅金属分支两项均显著（1.055、1.033 倍），并入 `long-best-auto`，第四次总决赛后改回可选。

name_en: Superbasin-first: also search from near-degenerate neighbours
name_zh: 超盆优先：也从近简并邻居搜索
idea_en: A hiker looking for passes out of a valley also climbs from the adjacent hollows that are almost as low and one easy step away, because the ridges look different from there. After the IS session, one `long-best` session each was run from up to 3 certified near-degenerate neighbours among its products: same chemical graph, |ΔE| ≤ 0.15 eV and path barrier ≤ 0.3 eV. Metric: network saddles linked to the IS per call.
idea_zh: 寻找山谷出口的人，也去旁边几乎一样低、一步可达的洼地爬，那里看到的山脊不同。初态会话后，再从其产物中至多 3 个经认证的近简并邻居各跑一次 `long-best` 会话：化学图相同、|ΔE| ≤ 0.15 eV、路径能垒 ≤ 0.3 eV。指标：每调用连到初态的网络鞍点数。
systems_en: The 36-IS dev set (metal surfaces and zeolites), 2 sessions per IS, four arms: `long-best`, the round-45 network-edge mode, superbasin-first, and superbasin plus network edges.
systems_zh: 36 个初态开发集（金属表面与分子筛），每初态 2 次会话，四个臂：`long-best`、第 45 轮网络边模式、超盆优先、超盆 + 网络边。
result_en: Network saddles linked to the IS per call: 1.506× [1.325, 1.747] vs network-edge mode and 1.090× [0.993, 1.202] (p = 0.038) vs `long-best`, so the frozen rule confirmed it. Yet within each family it is ≤ 1.003× `long-best`: members exist on only 12/36 IS, where saddles are already cheap, so the pooled gain is a composition effect. U is unchanged, so U/call fell to 0.757×. Not merged.
result_zh: 连到初态的网络鞍点/调用：对网络边模式 1.506 倍 [1.325, 1.747]，对 `long-best` 1.090 倍 [0.993, 1.202]，按冻结规则确认；但各家族内 ≤1.003，属组成效应。U 不变，U/调用 0.757 倍，未合并。

name_en: Zero-call rate constants and mechanism tables
name_zh: 零调用速率常数与机理表
idea_en: A surveyor who already measured the slopes around every pass can turn the same notebook into a traffic forecast without another trip. The finite-difference Hessian columns cached during dense validation are mass-weighted into vibrational spectra, giving Vineyard prefactors, harmonic rate constants k(T) at 300/500/700 K and a mechanism table that groups saddles into site hops, elementary steps and reaction classes, at zero extra force calls.
idea_zh: 测量员早已量过每个山口四周的坡度，翻出同一本笔记就能预报通行量。致密验证已缓存的有限差分 Hessian 列经质量加权得到振动谱，给出 Vineyard 前因子、300/500/700 K 的谐振速率常数 k(T)，以及把鞍点归为跃迁、基元步和反应类别的机理表，零额外力调用。
systems_en: NEP89 runs on GEN3/GEN4 chemistry: round-50 reaction networks grown from NH3+H on Ru(0001) and CO+O on Pd(100), plus single-IS searches for C2H2+2H on Pd(111) and water with an acidic proton in H-FAU (5 `long-best` commands, 18 sessions); 9 round-50 networks for mechanism counts; 144 GF3 `long-best` checkpoints (36 IS × 4) for file size.
systems_zh: NEP89 上的 GEN3/GEN4 化学：第五十轮由 Ru(0001) 上 NH3+H、Pd(100) 上 CO+O 展开的反应网络，以及 Pd(111) 上 C2H2+2H、H-FAU 中水 + 酸性质子的单初态搜索（5 条 `long-best` 命令、18 个会话）；机理计数用第五十轮 9 个网络；文件体积用 GF3 的 144 个 `long-best` 检查点（36 个初态 × 4）。
result_en: Zero extra force calls: all 18 sessions identical to the base version, and three round-50 networks reproduced exactly. The 178 prefactors (89 strict saddles) agree with an independent ASE recomputation to max |Δlog10 ν*| = 2.7×10⁻⁴. Nine networks: 283 saddles → 44 elementary steps. Storing spectra grew online checkpoints by a median 5.7 %, so it is opt-in (`--prefactors`); mechanism tables are written by default since v0.45.0.
result_zh: 零额外力调用：18 个会话与旧版逐位相同。178 个前因子与独立 ASE 重算的 log10 ν* 差 ≤ 2.7×10⁻⁴。存谱使在线检查点中位增大 5.7 %，故设为可选（`--prefactors`）；机理表 v0.45.0 起默认输出。

name_zh: 验证簿记：失败备忘与交错判否
idea_en: A building inspector keeps a list of houses already condemned and walks out as soon as one cracked beam settles the verdict. Within a session, refined candidates matching an earlier failure (within 0.02 Å and 2 meV) are closed without re-validation, and dense finite-difference certificate columns are computed reaction-centre first so Cauchy interlacing can reject a wrong-index candidate exactly before the full Hessian is built.
idea_zh: 房屋检查员把判过不合格的房子记下来不再复查，发现一根断梁就当场下结论。会话内精修后的候选若与已失败的候选相距 0.02 Å、能量差 2 meV 以内，直接按已知失败结束；致密有限差分证书先算反应中心的列，用柯西交错定理在 Hessian 算完之前精确判否。
systems_en: Confirmation on the GF3 development set: 36 IS (21 early systems + 8 GEN3 + 7 GEN4; metal surfaces and zeolites) × 2 paired sessions, `long-best` with vs without the failure memo and interlacing exit.
systems_zh: GF3 开发集确认：36 个初态（早期体系 21 + GEN3 8 + GEN4 7；金属表面与分子筛）× 2 次配对会话，`long-best` 加与不加失败备忘和交错判否对比。
result_en: U/call 1.0175× [1.0024, 1.0434] (p < 0.00025, Holm), below the pre-registered 1.03 target, hence inconclusive. Exact: U 439 = 439 and 0 decision differences in 3,367 paired launches; it saves 1.72 % of calls (memo 1.67 %, interlacing 0.045 %). As free, lossless bookkeeping it entered the recommended `long-*` presets in v0.49.0.
result_zh: U/调用 1.0175 倍 [1.0024, 1.0434]，未达预注册的 1.03 目标，判为不确定。U 439 = 439，3,367 对启动决定零差异，省 1.72 % 力调用。精确且免费，v0.49.0 起写入推荐的 `long-*` 预设。

idea_en: Inspect a bridge's wobbly middle span from both sides but tap the stiff pillars from one side only, and sign off only when an error bound proves the verdict. Certificates used central differences on the reaction-centre/soft subspace and one-sided differences on the stiff rest (d+k+1 instead of 2d force calls); a Haynsworth inertia argument with error bounds could only accept, otherwise the full central certificate ran.
idea_zh: 验桥：晃动的中段两侧都测，坚固的桥墩只从一侧敲，误差界能证明结论才签字。证书在反应中心/软子空间用中心差分、在刚性子空间用单侧差分（d+k+1 次而非 2d 次调用），由 Haynsworth 惯性定理加误差界判定；只能判“接受”，否则退回完整中心差分证书。
systems_en: Replay of 659 archived certificate candidates, then confirmation on the 36 GF3 IS (21 early + 8 GEN3 + 7 GEN4; metals and zeolites) × 2 paired sessions: product-only split (SP) and product + TS split (SPT) vs the full central-difference certificate.
systems_zh: 先重放 659 个归档证书候选，再在 GF3 的 36 个初态（早期 21 + GEN3 8 + GEN4 7；金属与分子筛）× 2 次配对会话上确认：仅产物分段（SP）、产物 + 过渡态分段（SPT）对完整中心差分证书。
result_en: Decisions identical to full central differences (659 replayed candidates, 144 paired sessions; U 435 unchanged). U/call: product-only split (SP) 1.034× [1.020, 1.045]; product + TS split (SPT) 1.056× [1.032, 1.078]. Both Holm-significant but below the pre-registered thresholds: SP cut calls by 3.3 % (needed ≥ 5 %) and SPT by only 2.0 points more (needed 4). Not merged.
result_zh: 判定与全中心差分完全一致。U/调用：仅产物分段 1.034 倍 [1.020, 1.045]，产物 + 过渡态 1.056 倍 [1.032, 1.078]；虽显著，但调用只少 3.3 %（需 ≥ 5 %），后者调用只再少 2.0 个百分点（需 4）。未合并。

idea_en: Instead of one surveyor taking every slope measurement in turn, send a team out at once and have one clerk write the results into the notebook in the original order. The 2d force calls of each dense finite-difference Hessian are farmed out to N forked single-core workers, while the main process replays the bookkeeping, so results stay bit-identical and only wall time changes.
idea_zh: 不再让一个测量员逐个量坡度，而是派一队人同时去量，由一名记录员按原顺序登记。每个致密有限差分 Hessian 的 2d 次力调用分给 N 个派生的单核工作进程，主进程按原顺序重放簿记，结果逐位相同，只改变墙钟时间。
systems_en: 8 early-set IS on NEP89: 4 in H-MFI (n-butane and one of its network nodes; two ethanol, dry and with two water), 2 with two methanol in H-CHA, 2 on Pt(111) (ethylene glycol; glycolaldehyde+2H). Wall-time ratios confirmed on the 4 MFI IS.
systems_zh: 8 个早期体系初态（NEP89）：H-MFI 4 个（正丁烷及其一个网络节点；两个乙醇，干燥与含两个水）、H-CHA 中两个甲醇 2 个、Pt(111) 2 个（乙二醇；羟基乙醛 + 2H）。墙钟比值在 4 个 MFI 初态上确认。
result_en: Results bit-identical in 16/16 sessions (565,116 prefetched calls, 0 misses). MFI wall-time speed-up with 16 Hessian workers vs 1: 1.71× [1.40, 1.83] (target 1.6); with `--workers 8` added, 5.32× [2.69, 7.37] (target 5.0). Point estimates pass, but only 4 IS. The Hessian phase itself ran 12–14× faster on MFI, 9× on CHA, 5× on surfaces. Opt-in `--hessian-workers` (v0.48.0).
result_zh: 结果逐位相同（16/16）。MFI 墙钟加速 1.71 倍 [1.40, 1.83]（16 个 Hessian 进程），加 `--workers 8` 达 5.32 倍 [2.69, 7.37]；点估计达标，但仅 4 个初态。仅作可选项（v0.48.0）。

idea_en: A shorter measuring stick reads gentle curves more precisely, but where the road has a sharp kink, the short stick can sit entirely on one side and miss it. Strict-v2 kept the certification rules and call count but shrank the certificate finite-difference step from 1e-3 to 2.5e-4 Å; every candidate newly accepted by v2 was checked against independent five-point reference Hessians.
idea_zh: 更短的量尺量缓弯更准，但路面若有急拐点，短尺可能整个落在拐点一侧而看不见它。strict-v2 保持认证规则与调用数不变，只把证书有限差分步长从 1e-3 Å 缩到 2.5e-4 Å；v2 新接受的候选逐一用独立的五点参考 Hessian 核验。
systems_en: GF3 development set (36 IS: 21 early + 8 GEN3 + 7 GEN4; metals and zeolites): 1,071 candidates newly accepted by v2 checked with five-point references; `long-best` re-baseline sessions, v2 vs v1, on 36 IS × 2; offline rescoring of all GF3 arms.
systems_zh: GF3 开发集（36 个初态：早期 21 + GEN3 8 + GEN4 7；金属与分子筛）：v2 新接受的 1,071 个候选用五点参考核验；`long-best` 会话 v2 对 v1 重新基线，36 个初态 × 2；离线重评 GF3 全部臂。
result_en: Failed the pre-registered no-false-accept test: of 1,071 candidates newly accepted by v2, five-point references confirmed 962 = 89.8 % [87.9, 91.5] (target ≥ 97 %); 24 were true false accepts sitting on the 2 Å ZBL switching kink of NEP89. U/call v2/v1 1.106 [1.044, 1.165] (p = 0.0003; U +17.2 %, calls +6.0 %), but untrustworthy, so not adopted.
result_zh: “不误收”检验失败：v2 新接受的 1,071 个候选中只有 89.8 % [87.9, 91.5] 经五点参考确认（要求 97 %），24 个真误收在 ZBL 2 Å 拐点上。U/调用 1.106 倍 [1.044, 1.165]，但不可信，未采用。

idea_en: Push a bond step by step and, at each step, let the rest of the molecule settle completely, guided by a map of which directions are stiff and remembering the last settled shape, instead of giving it a brief shake. Bond-drive scans used converged projected L-BFGS relaxations preconditioned with the initial-state Hessian, carrying the L-BFGS memory between stages, aiming to halve calls per drive without changing which pathway is followed.
idea_zh: 逐步拉一根键时，每一步都让分子其余部分完全弛豫——用一张“哪里硬、哪里软”的地图引导，并记住上一步的形状——而不是只晃几下。键驱动扫描改为以初态 Hessian 预条件、投影 L-BFGS 收敛到底并跨阶段保留记忆的约束弛豫，目标是每次驱动调用减半且不改变所走路径。
systems_en: NEP replay of archived bond drives, no search sessions: sample A = 355 drives on all 36 GF3 IS (21 early + 8 GEN3 + 7 GEN4), replication sample B = 295 drives on 33 IS; reference = the standard relaxed scans.
systems_zh: 对归档键驱动做 NEP 重放，未跑搜索会话：样本 A 为 GF3 全部 36 个初态（早期 21 + GEN3 8 + GEN4 7）上的 355 次驱动，复核样本 B 为 33 个初态上的 295 次驱动；参照为现行弛豫扫描。
result_en: Calls per drive 0.809× (needed ≤ 0.50; metals 0.651, zeolites 1.007). The scan top became a nearly unbiased TS-energy estimate (median 0.000 eV), but drives switched branch in 41.4 % vs 14.1 % for the reference scan (McNemar 117/20, p = 3.6e-18): full relaxation lands in a different constrained basin. Fallbacks also failed; sample B replicated (0.799×, 42.7 % vs 18.3 %). Not adopted.
result_zh: 每次驱动调用 0.809 倍（要求 ≤ 0.50；金属 0.651、分子筛 1.007）。扫描顶点是过渡态能量的近无偏估计（中位 0.000 eV），但分支切换率 41.4 %，参照仅 14.1 %（p = 3.6e-18）；样本 B 复现。未采用。

idea_en: A chess club records every unfinished game, so after a power cut each one is replayed from the scoresheet to the same position instead of being scored as a loss. In-flight launches are logged in a dispatch journal and replayed after a kill, preemption or requeue instead of being retired; the old retire rule charged each lost launch 60,000 phantom force calls and dropped its coordinate.
idea_zh: 棋社把每盘未下完的棋都记谱，停电后按棋谱复盘到原局面，而不是判负。进行中的启动写入派发日志，被 kill、抢占或 requeue 后按日志重放，而不是“退役”；旧的退役规则给每个丢失的启动记 60,000 次虚拟力调用，并丢掉它的坐标。
systems_en: Analytic toy potentials (128 random SIGKILLs); NEP89 sessions on n-butane/H-MFI with `long-best` (serial and `--workers 8`, two kill -9 each) and on two methanol/H-CHA (graceful stops; a real preemptible job requeued onto another node).
systems_zh: 解析玩具势（128 次随机 SIGKILL）；NEP89 会话：H-MFI 中正丁烷，`long-best`（串行与 `--workers 8`，各两次 kill -9）；H-CHA 中两个甲醇（正常停止；真实可抢占作业 requeue 到另一节点）。
result_en: Bit-identical everywhere: analytic toys 64/64 trials after 128 SIGKILLs; MFI serial (U 8, 54,499 calls) and `--workers 8` (U 22, 138,045 calls) matched uninterrupted references after two kill -9 each, whereas the old retire rule lost 3 saddles at +682 % calls; a preempted job requeued on another node reproduced the CHA run exactly (U 20, 82,859 calls). All explore presets now replay (v0.47.0).
result_zh: 玩具势 128 次 SIGKILL、MFI 串行与 `--workers 8` 各两次 kill -9、真实抢占作业 requeue 换节点后，结果均与参照逐位相同；旧退役规则丢 3 个鞍点、调用 +682 %。所有 explore 预设改用 replay。

idea_en: A bargain hunter checks the price tag before carrying an item to the checkout instead of queueing, paying and then returning it. Once a saddle search converges, a candidate whose barrier already exceeds 1.5 eV skips refinement and dense validation (its energy matches the refined saddle within 4.8×10⁻⁵ eV); `--max-barrier E` sets up the whole low-barrier workflow with one flag.
idea_zh: 只想买便宜货的人先看价签，再决定拿不拿去结账，而不是排队付完款再退货。鞍点搜索收敛后，若候选能垒已超过 1.5 eV，就跳过精修和致密验证（候选能量与精修后鞍点相差不到 4.8×10⁻⁵ eV）；`--max-barrier E` 一个参数即可设好整套低能垒流程。
systems_en: Offline simulator gate, then confirmation on the 36 GF3 IS (21 early + 8 GEN3 + 7 GEN4; metals and zeolites) × 2 sessions: `long-lowbarrier` + 1.5 eV post-search cap vs `long-lowbarrier`.
systems_zh: 先做离线模拟器门槛，再在 GF3 的 36 个初态（早期 21 + GEN3 8 + GEN4 7；金属与分子筛）× 2 次会话上确认：`long-lowbarrier` 加 1.5 eV 搜索后上限，对比 `long-lowbarrier`。
result_en: U(≤1.5)/call 1.192× [1.095, 1.311] (p < 0.00025, Holm); zeolites 1.271×, metals 1.025×; calls per low-barrier saddle 6,479 → 5,434, with the count of such saddles 1.037× (expected 0.992 on new seeds). Total U fell 16.7 %, so it suits only the low-barrier goal. The frozen simulator predicted all 144 sessions exactly. Folded into `long-lowbarrier` (v0.47.0).
result_zh: U(≤1.5)/调用 1.192 倍 [1.095, 1.311]（Holm 显著），每个低能垒鞍点的调用 6,479 → 5,434。全部 U 少 16.7 %，只适合低能垒目标。并入 `long-lowbarrier`（v0.47.0）。

name_en: Exact NEP89 Hessians by automatic differentiation (EXACT-HESS)
idea_en: Instead of estimating a valley's shape by poking the ground in every direction, read the curvature straight off the terrain's blueprint. NEP89 was re-implemented in JAX (float64) so exact Hessians come from automatic differentiation of the per-atom energies and replace central-difference Hessians in certification; an MFI Hessian costs 48.6–59.1 force-call equivalents instead of 1,800–1,872 finite-difference calls.
idea_zh: 从设计图上直接读出山谷的曲率，而不是向四面八方戳地面去估计。用 JAX（float64）重写 NEP89，对每原子能量自动微分得到精确 Hessian 用于认证：MFI 体系一个只需 48.6–59.1 次力调用当量，有限差分要 1,800–1,872 次。
systems_en: Gates on 67 structures and the 36 GF3 IS (21 early + 8 GEN3 + 7 GEN4), including 249 residual certificate failures from round 56; confirmation on the 17 zeolite IS × 2 sessions, exact vs finite-difference certificates; exploratory run on the 19 metal-surface IS × 2.
systems_zh: 门槛：67 个结构与 GF3 的 36 个初态（早期 21 + GEN3 8 + GEN4 7），含第 56 轮 249 个残差失败候选；确认：其中 17 个分子筛初态 × 2 次会话，精确证书对有限差分证书；探索：19 个金属表面初态 × 2。
result_en: Gates: forces match calorine to 2.7e-13 eV/Å on 67 structures; inertia identical on 36/36 IS; all 249 round-56 residual failures are true index-1 saddles. Zeolites: U/all-charged call 2.236× [1.858, 2.605] (p < 2.5e-4), calls −43 %, U +28 % (313 → 401), wall time 1.67× faster; 2.17× counting JIT compile. Metals (exploratory) 1.199×, ≈1.0× with compile. Opt-in in v0.51.0; default certificate after round 90.
result_zh: 分子筛 U/全计费调用 2.236 倍 [1.858, 2.605]：调用 −43 %、U +28 %。第 56 轮 249 个残差失败候选全是一阶鞍点。金属仅 1.199 倍（计入编译约 1.0）。v0.51.0 为可选项，第 90 轮后成为默认证书。

name_zh: 动力学自适应能垒窗口
idea_en: A search party looking for the easiest way out of a valley stops checking routes that climb far above the lowest exit already found. In each session the bond-drive energy cap becomes min(family cap, lowest barrier found so far + 0.55 eV), aiming at the kinetic set K (saddles within 0.3 eV of the lowest escape) that matters for kinetic Monte Carlo and microkinetics.
idea_zh: 寻找最省力出口的搜索队一旦找到较低的出口，就不再去查比它高出很多的路线。会话中键驱动的能量上限取 min(家族上限, 已找到的最低能垒 + 0.55 eV)，瞄准动力学集合 K（最低逃逸能垒 0.3 eV 以内的鞍点），服务于 kMC 与微观动力学。
systems_en: Zero-call simulator gate using the round-58 census K sets, then confirmation on the 36 GF3 IS (21 early + 8 GEN3 + 7 GEN4; metals and zeolites) × 2 sessions: `long-lowbarrier` + adaptive cap vs `long-lowbarrier`.
systems_zh: 零调用模拟器门槛（用第 58 轮普查的 K 集合），再在 GF3 的 36 个初态（早期 21 + GEN3 8 + GEN4 7；金属与分子筛）× 2 次会话上确认：`long-lowbarrier` 加自适应上限，对比 `long-lowbarrier`。
result_en: K-set saddles per call 1.192× [1.096, 1.316] (p < 0.00025, Holm) with K-recall kept at 0.990 [0.954, 1.019] (95 vs 95 K saddles); lowest escape per call 1.138× [1.001, 1.283]; calls −16 %. No gain on GEN3 (1.003×). Cost: U(≤1.5) −17.6 %, total U −19.1 %. Shipped as the new opt-in preset `long-kinetic` (v0.47.0); defaults unchanged.
result_zh: 动力学集合鞍点每调用 1.192 倍 [1.096, 1.316]（Holm 显著），K 召回保持 0.990；调用 −16 %，GEN3 无增益。代价：U(≤1.5) −17.6 %、全部 U −19.1 %。新预设 `long-kinetic`，默认不变。

name_en: Cheaper last steps to the saddle (TAIL BUNDLE)
idea_en: Near the pass, a hiker whose compass has settled checks it only every other step and estimates small turns from recent readings. ROT-MODEL fits a model to the dimer's last eight curvature probes and skips the trial-rotation force call when the predicted turn is under 6°; in the final approach, TAIL-A-THIN skips one image evaluation every other step while the mode is stable. An outlier-corrected model-Newton tail (OCT) was also screened.
idea_zh: 像快到山口的登山者：指南针稳定后隔一步才看一次，小转弯凭最近读数推算。ROT-MODEL 用 dimer 最近 8 次曲率探测建模型，预测转角 < 6° 时省掉试探转动的力调用；TAIL-A-THIN 在模态锁定后的最后逼近段隔步跳过像点 A；另筛选离群校正牛顿尾段（OCT）。
systems_en: Gate: paired NEP89 replay of 597 archived long-best launches from the third grand final (GF3), five variants each. Final: the 36 GF3 IS (21 early IS on Cu/Pt surfaces and in H-MFI/H-CHA + 8 G3 + 7 G4), two seeds, 144 sessions, reference long-best.
systems_zh: 闸门：对第三届总决赛（GF3）归档的 597 次 long-best 发射做成对 NEP89 重放，每次 5 个变体。终验：36 个 GF3 初态（21 个早期 Cu/Pt 表面与 H-MFI/H-CHA 分子筛初态 + 8 个 G3 + 7 个 G4），2 个种子，144 个会话，参照 long-best。
result_en: Gate: OCT cost more than it saved in its target phase (saving −0.299) and was dropped. Final, long-best + ROT-MODEL + TAIL-A-THIN vs long-best: U/call 1.063× [1.030, 1.094], p < 0.00025, Holm reject; U ratio 0.978. Per-IS estimate only 1.023× [0.990, 1.051]; honest expectation 1.02–1.03×. Options in v0.49.0; added to long-best in v0.55.0 after GF4 (1.033× on new IS).
result_zh: 对 long-best：U/力调用 1.063 倍 [1.030, 1.094]，p < 0.00025，U 比 0.978；按初态平均仅 1.023 倍 [0.990, 1.051]。OCT 闸门淘汰。GF4 后于 v0.55.0 并入 long-best。

name_en: Reaction networks reuse certified saddles (NETWORK II)
name_zh: 反应网络复用已认证鞍点（NETWORK II）
idea_en: A survey team mapping a chain of valleys hands each new base camp the list of passes and valley floors already surveyed, so nobody re-climbs a known pass. In depth-2 reaction networks (products become new initial states), child-node searches import the network's certified saddles and minima (NET-IMPORT) without changing any search decision; EDGE-WINDOW skips certifying edges above the energy window, and TRANSPLANT copies known bond-change events onto new child nodes.
idea_zh: 像测绘一串山谷的勘测队：每个新营地都拿到已测山口和谷底清单，不再重爬已知山口。深度 2 反应网络（产物作新初态）中，子节点导入网络已认证的鞍点与极小（NET-IMPORT），决策不变；EDGE-WINDOW 不认证能量窗口外的边；TRANSPLANT 把已知键变化移植到新子节点。
systems_en: 18 IS (8 G3 + 7 G4 + 3 early benchmark IS; metal surfaces and zeolites), reaction networks of depth 2, one seed, four arms: windowed low-barrier networks (long-lowbarrier, 1.5 eV window) and plain long-best networks, each with and without import + transplant.
systems_zh: 18 个初态（8 个 G3 + 7 个 G4 + 3 个早期基准初态，金属表面与分子筛），深度 2 反应网络，1 个种子，四组：低能垒窗口网络（long-lowbarrier，1.5 eV 窗口）与普通 long-best 网络，各有/无导入 + 移植。
result_en: Windowed networks: saddles ≤ 1.5 eV per call 1.076× [1.047, 1.100]; plain networks: saddles per call 1.046× [1.031, 1.067], saddle ratio 1.010; both p < 0.00025, Holm reject. 143 paired child sessions made identical decisions: a small but exact saving. Transplant added saddles only on Pd/acetylene (+3 low-barrier). EDGE-WINDOW lost 1 of 117 in-window saddles with NEB linking. Import on by default in recommended presets from v0.50.0.
result_zh: 窗口网络 ≤1.5 eV 鞍点/力调用 1.076 倍 [1.047, 1.100]，普通网络 1.046 倍 [1.031, 1.067]，均 p < 0.00025；节省小而精确。移植只在 Pd 乙炔上 +3 个鞍点。v0.50.0 起推荐预设默认导入。

name_en: Lowest barrier for one bond class (QUERY)
name_zh: 只问一类键的最低能垒（QUERY）
idea_en: Instead of mapping every pass, a traveller asks one question (the lowest pass where a C–H bond breaks), tries matching trails from the lowest-looking upward, and stops once no remaining trail could beat the best found. explore --ask scans only coordinates of the requested class (e.g. break:C-H), drives them in ascending scan-top energy, and stops with a certificate once the next scan top exceeds the lowest class barrier found plus 0.25 eV.
idea_zh: 不测绘全部山口，只问一个问题（如 C–H 键断裂的最低山口），从看似最低的路线往上试，确信剩下的不可能更低就停。explore --ask 只扫描该类键坐标（如 break:C-H），按扫描顶点能量升序驱动；下一个顶点高于已找到的同类最低能垒 + 0.25 eV 时带证书停止。
systems_en: The 36 GF3 IS (early systems + G3 + G4; metal surfaces and zeolites), 513 query runs, one seed; primary test on 114 lowest-barrier questions on 32 IS, answers checked against archived reference class minima; compared with full long-best sessions.
systems_zh: 36 个 GF3 初态（早期体系 + G3 + G4，金属表面与分子筛），513 次查询，1 个种子；主检验为 32 个初态上的 114 个最低能垒问题，以归档参考中的同类最低能垒为真值，并与完整 long-best 会话比较。
result_en: Accuracy 0.930 (106/114) [0.864, 0.980] at 0.134 [0.109, 0.169] of a full session's calls; the 0.90 accuracy bar was met on the point estimate only. Full long-best sessions answered only 0.612 correctly (they stop early in dry spells): +0.318 accuracy and 11.4× [9.3, 13.2] fewer calls per correct answer. Shipped as explore --ask in v0.50.0.
result_zh: 正确率 0.930 [0.864, 0.980]，力调用只需完整会话的 0.134 [0.109, 0.169]（0.90 门槛按点估计通过）；完整会话仅答对 0.612，查询每个正确答案的力调用少 11.4 倍。v0.50.0 以 --ask 发布。

name_en: Rescue empty searches with another engine (ZERO-RESCUE)
idea_en: If a guide comes back with one pass or none, send a second guide with a different technique up the same failed trailheads, lowest first, with half the original time. When a long-best session ends with at most one saddle, its failed launches are re-walked from their recorded search starts with the other engine (dimer → Sella) in ascending scan-top energy, within 0.5× the session's calls; other sessions are untouched.
idea_zh: 向导只带回一个山口或空手而归时，派一位技法不同的向导沿同样失败的路口由低到高重走，只给一半时间。long-best 会话只找到 ≤ 1 个鞍点时，用另一引擎（dimer → Sella）从原搜索起点按扫描顶点能量升序重走失败的发射，预算为会话力调用的 0.5 倍；其他会话不变。
systems_en: Trigger set: the 11 GF3 IS whose archived long-best sessions had ended with ≤ 1 saddle at least once (metal surfaces and zeolites), two seeds; 8 other GF3 IS, one seed, as a bit-identity check; recall counted over all 36 GF3 IS (early systems, G3, G4).
systems_zh: 触发集：GF3 归档 long-best 会话中出现过 ≤ 1 个鞍点的 11 个初态（金属表面与分子筛都有），2 个种子；另 8 个 GF3 初态 1 个种子作逐位一致核对；召回按全部 36 个 GF3 初态（早期体系、G3、G4）统计。
result_en: IS with at least one saddle: 30–31 of 36 → 35 of 36 at +2.41 % calls (bar ≤ 3 %); non-triggering sessions bit-identical 8/8. Trigger set: U ×2.150 [1.341, 6.333], U/call ×1.779 [1.233, 4.154], Holm both reject; estimated over all 36 IS, U/call ×1.029. Only H2O/Cu(110) stays empty. On by default in long-best from v0.48.0.
result_zh: 有鞍点的初态 30–31/36 → 35/36，额外力调用 2.41 %；未触发会话逐位相同。触发集 U/力调用 ×1.779 [1.233, 4.154]（Holm 拒绝），36 个初态整体 ×1.029。v0.48.0 起 long-best 默认开启。

idea_en: Before a second expedition into the same valley, hand the team the first expedition's notebook: passes already found, dead ends and scans already walked. explore --resume-from lets a second search on the same IS import the first run's certified saddles as a known catalogue, its candidate memory (to abort walks heading into known saddles), product certificates and cached scans; the second run used a different preset per family (Sella-based long-best-auto on metals).
idea_zh: 再进同一山谷前，先把上次笔记交给队伍：已找到的山口、死胡同和走过的路。explore --resume-from 让第二次搜索导入首次认证的鞍点、候选记忆（走向已知鞍点即提前中止）、产物证书和扫描缓存，并换用另一预设（金属上用 Sella 的 long-best-auto）。
systems_en: The 36 GF3 IS (early systems, G3, G4; metal surfaces and zeolites); one second run per IS, paired with the archived GF3 first run; reference = the same second run without memory.
systems_zh: 36 个 GF3 初态（早期体系、G3、G4，金属表面与分子筛）；每个初态做一次第二次搜索，与归档的 GF3 第一次搜索配对；参照为不带记忆的同一第二次搜索。
result_en: Second-run cost 0.579× [0.536, 0.632] of the memory-free run, but the pre-registered bar (significantly ≤ 0.6) failed: p = 0.199. New saddles kept 64/65; new saddles per call 1.753× [1.582, 1.945]. Additionally skipping already validated coordinates lost 12 saddles (fail). Not merged then (clashed with the round-76 import); revived as opt-in --resume-from in rounds 92 and 115.
result_zh: 第二次搜索力调用为无记忆的 0.579 倍 [0.536, 0.632]，但未显著低于预注册的 0.6（p = 0.199）；新鞍点保留 64/65，新鞍点/力调用 1.753 倍。当时未合并，第 92、115 轮以可选 --resume-from 复活。

name_en: Automatic atom roles and next-step advice (AUTO-ROLES/NEXT-STEP)
name_zh: 自动识别原子角色与下一步建议（AUTO-ROLES/NEXT-STEP）
idea_en: Like a lab assistant who glances at the sample, labels which atoms are catalyst and which are reactants, and suggests a promising next experiment. AUTO-ROLES assigns roles from geometry when no role array is given (framework or metal atoms = host; acidic protons, water and other molecules get adsorbate roles; oxides and MOFs ask for --reactant-atoms); NEXT-STEP adds a ranked list of follow-up searches with yields predicted from archived runs.
idea_zh: 像实验室助手：看一眼样品就分出催化剂和反应物原子，再建议下一步。AUTO-ROLES 无角色数组时按几何自动标注（骨架/金属为主体，酸性质子、水和其他分子为吸附物；氧化物与 MOF 需 --reactant-atoms）；NEXT-STEP 按归档数据给后续搜索排序并预测产率。
systems_en: Roles checked on the 36 GF3 IS and 6 held-out G5 IS (geometry only, no searches), plus explore sessions on 6 IS for bit-identity; the advisor was scored by leave-one-out on archived GF3 follow-up searches (primary set: the 15 G3 + G4 IS).
systems_zh: 角色在 36 个 GF3 初态与 6 个留出的 G5 初态上核对（只看几何、不搜索），另在 6 个初态上核对 explore 会话逐位一致；建议器用归档 GF3 后续搜索做留一检验（主集为 15 个 G3 + G4 初态）。
result_en: Auto roles matched hand labels on 34/36 GF3 IS (the two differences: migrated protons, one coordinate each) and on 6/6 G5 IS; explore sessions were bit-identical on 6/6. Advisor: the top suggestion gave 11.45× [5.33, 33.55] new saddles per call vs the median alternative (pass), but predicted yields were within ×1.5 on only 6/15 IS (fail): ranking reliable, numbers rough. Shipped in v0.47.0.
result_zh: 自动角色与手工一致：GF3 初态 34/36（差异为迁移质子）、G5 6/6；会话 6/6 逐位相同。建议器首选的新鞍点/力调用为中位备选的 11.45 倍 [5.33, 33.55]，但产率预测仅 6/15 在 ×1.5 内。v0.47.0 发布。

name_zh: 金属表面行走者拴绳（METAL LEASH）
idea_en: A leashed dog cannot run into the next field: a walker straying far from its start is called back. On metals, LEASH-D ends a dimer walk once any atom moves over 1.6 Å from the search start; a drift gate skips walks whose spectator atoms moved over 0.75 Å in the scan; LEASH-S does the same for Sella at 2.2 Å from the IS, or without fmax < 0.1 by step 60.
idea_zh: 像给狗拴上绳：走远就拉回。金属上，LEASH-D 在任一原子离搜索起点 > 1.6 Å 时结束 dimer 行走；漂移闸门跳过旁观原子在扫描中已移动 > 0.75 Å 的发射；LEASH-S 对 Sella 同理（离初态 2.2 Å），第 60 步未达 fmax 0.1 也结束。
systems_en: 19 GF3 metal-surface IS (10 early Cu/Pt IS + 5 G3 + 4 G4, e.g. Cu(211), Ru(0001), CH3/Ni(111), NO/Rh(100)), two seeds, 236 sessions, plus 4 zeolite IS to confirm bit-identity; held-out per-launch check on the 30 G-FACTORY development metal IS.
systems_zh: 19 个 GF3 金属表面初态（10 个早期 Cu/Pt 初态 + 5 个 G3 + 4 个 G4，如 Cu(211)、Ru(0001)、CH3/Ni(111)、NO/Rh(100)），2 个种子，236 个会话，另用 4 个分子筛初态核对逐位一致；在 30 个 G-FACTORY 开发集金属初态上逐发射做留出检查。
result_en: Dimer leash + drift gate vs long-best: U/call 1.220× [1.165, 1.298], U 110 vs 110; Sella leash vs long-best-auto: 1.074× [1.054, 1.097], U 136 vs 136; Holm both reject. On the 30 held-out metal IS the dimer leash cut 10/134 new saddles (H/O hops and C–H/N–H dissociations move atoms > 1.6 Å), so it stayed opt-in; the Sella leash lost 1/194 and joined long-best-auto in v0.48.0.
result_zh: Sella 拴绳对 long-best-auto：U/力调用 1.074 倍 [1.054, 1.097]，U 不变，v0.48.0 并入。dimer 拴绳+漂移闸门对 long-best 1.220 倍，但留出金属上丢 10/134 个新鞍点，仅可选。

name_en: Repeat searches switch generator, not seed (PORTFOLIO-2)
name_zh: 重复搜索换生成器而非换种子（PORTFOLIO-2）
idea_en: A prospector returning to the same hillside should bring a different tool, say a metal detector instead of a pan, rather than panning again at a new random spot. Second-search passes add blind deterministic coordinate families and import the first search's memory: HOP-H moves an H from a C/N/O donor toward a framework Si, HOP-T hops framework O between T atoms, ADATOM pulls a top-layer metal atom 3 Å out.
idea_zh: 重返同一山坡的探矿者该换工具（金属探测器代替淘金盘），而非换个地方再淘一遍。第二次搜索的通道加入盲的确定性坐标族并导入首次搜索记忆：HOP-H 把 C/N/O 上的 H 推向骨架 Si，HOP-T 让骨架 O 在 T 原子间跳跃，ADATOM 把顶层金属原子拉出 3 Å。
systems_en: The 36 GF3 IS, with its 17 zeolite IS for the adsorbate-saddle test; first searches = archived GF3 long-best runs (two seeds), 72 pass sessions; reference = two reseeded long-best runs.
systems_zh: 36 个 GF3 初态，其中 17 个分子筛初态用于吸附物鞍点检验；第一次搜索取归档的 GF3 long-best 结果（2 个种子），共 72 个通道会话；参照为两次换种子的 long-best。
result_en: Union saddles per call vs two reseeded runs: zeolites U_ads/call 1.701× [1.613, 1.794]; all 36 IS U/call 1.702× [1.611, 1.811]; Holm both reject. But a single search already beats two reseeds 1.78–1.83×, the passes lower U/call relative to one search (0.93–0.96), and 81 % of the adsorbate gain was five-coordinate Si–H, likely NEP89 artefacts. Not merged.
result_zh: 对两次换种子：分子筛 U_ads/力调用 1.701 倍 [1.613, 1.794]，36 个初态 U/力调用 1.702 倍 [1.611, 1.811]。但相对单次搜索，加通道效率降为 0.93–0.96，吸附物增益多为可疑的五配位 Si–H。未合并。

name_en: Searching higher branches of productive bonds (BRANCH-II)
name_zh: 高产键坐标的高阶分支（BRANCH-II）
idea_en: A relaxed scan is like water running downhill: it always takes the lowest channel, so side branches of the same bond (another acceptor, a symmetric twin) are never reached. Three re-drive arms: PINNED constrains two distances at once to force a new acceptor or twin; TABU-REDRIVE repeats the scan with a Gaussian penalty on the old path; RESCAN continues past the first energy turn-down to a second scan top.
idea_zh: 松弛扫描像顺坡流下的水，总走最低的沟，所以同一根键的旁支（换一个受体、对称的孪生通道）永远到不了。三个重驱动臂：PINNED 同时约束两个距离，强制走新受体或孪生分支；TABU-REDRIVE 在旧路径上加高斯惩罚后重扫；RESCAN 越过第一次能量下转，扫到第二个顶点再出发。
systems_en: Replay on the 36 GF3 IS (targets on 34; zeolites and metal surfaces): 1,206 forced single launches derived from archived long-best sessions, memory-free, plus 30 determinism controls; exploratory follow-up branch phase on all 144 GF3 sessions.
systems_zh: 在 36 个 GF3 初态上重放（34 个有目标，分子筛与金属表面）：由归档 long-best 会话导出的 1,206 次强制单发射，无记忆，另有 30 次确定性对照；探索性地在全部 144 个 GF3 会话上续跑分支阶段。
result_en: Kill rule (hit rate ≥ 0.08 and ≤ 15k calls per new saddle): PINNED 0.071 [0.053, 0.085], 17,177 calls/new; TABU 0.042, 51,829; RESCAN 0.035, 13,051; all dropped. All 66 new saddles involved the adsorbate, but the second constraint did not help (11.3 % vs 10.4 %, p = 1). Exploratory in-session TABU: U_ads ×1.042, U/call ×0.980. Not merged.
result_zh: 淘汰规则：命中率 ≥ 0.08、≤ 1.5 万次力调用/新鞍点。PINNED 0.071、17,177 次；TABU 0.042、51,829；RESCAN 0.035、13,051，全部淘汰。双约束不提高分支命中（11.3 % 对 10.4 %）。未合并。

name_en: Earlier stopping for the kinetic preset (K-RECALL II)
name_zh: 动力学预设更早收手（K-RECALL II）
idea_en: If you only need the lowest ways out of a valley, stop polishing passes clearly higher than the lowest one found, and count trails skipped as too high as fruitless days, so scouting ends sooner. For long-kinetic, launches ended by the adaptive energy window now count toward the dry-spell stop (A), and candidates above the lowest barrier found + 0.30 eV are dropped before refinement and validation (B).
idea_zh: 只需要山谷最低的几条出路时，就别再打磨明显高于已知最低山口的山口，并把因太高而跳过的路线也算作“白跑一趟”，让考察更早收工。long-kinetic 中：被自适应能量窗口结束的发射计入干旱期停止（A）；能垒高于已找到最低能垒 + 0.30 eV 的候选在精修与验证前丢弃（B）。
systems_en: The 36 GF3 IS (early systems, G3, G4; metal surfaces and zeolites), two sessions each, reference long-kinetic (v0.47.0); 33 G-FACTORY development IS, one session each, as a generalisation stratum; the variants were first gated in a zero-cost replay simulator.
systems_zh: 36 个 GF3 初态（早期体系、G3、G4，金属表面与分子筛），各 2 次会话，参照 long-kinetic（v0.47.0）；33 个 G-FACTORY 开发集初态各 1 次会话作为推广分层；变体先在零成本重放模拟器中过门槛。
result_en: Kinetic-set saddles (within 0.3 eV of the lowest escape) per call 1.569× [1.346, 1.741], p < 0.00025, Holm reject; K-recall kept 0.982 [0.949, 1.000] (91 vs 93); calls −38 %; zeolites 1.716×, metals 1.061×; G-FACTORY dev 1.172× [1.015, 1.378]. Trade-off: all saddles −31 %. Added to long-kinetic in v0.52.0.
result_zh: 动力学集合鞍点/力调用 1.569 倍 [1.346, 1.741]，K 召回 0.982，力调用 −38 %，全部鞍点 −31 %；G-FACTORY 开发集 1.172 倍 [1.015, 1.378]。v0.52.0 并入 long-kinetic。

name_en: Completion pass after bond driving (LONG-COMPLETE v2)
idea_en: A prospector who has worked the promising streams then ranks every untouched creek by how low its entry looks and checks them in that order until the next one is clearly higher than the best find so far. After a session's bond-driving phase stops, every still-undriven bond coordinate is scanned and dimer walkers are launched in ascending scan-top energy until it exceeds the lowest barrier found plus 0.5 eV (with a scan ceiling).
idea_zh: 淘金者把有希望的溪流淘完后，把没碰过的支流按入口高低排队逐一查看，直到下一条明显高于目前最好的发现才收工。会话的键驱动阶段停止后，扫描每个尚未驱动的键坐标，按扫描顶能量升序释放 dimer 行走者，直到扫描顶超过已找到的最低能垒 + 0.5 eV（另设扫描上限）。
systems_en: 36 GF3 development IS (early systems + N3 + N4; metal surfaces and zeolites) × 2 seeds plus 33 G-FACTORY dev IS × 1 = 105 sessions per arm; reference `long-complete`. The candidate setting was picked beforehand by an offline simulator gate on 29 IS (no force calls).
systems_zh: 36 个 GF3 开发集初态（早期体系 + N3 + N4，金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子，加 33 个 G-FACTORY dev 初态 × 1，每臂 105 个会话；参照 `long-complete`。候选设置事先由 29 个初态上的离线模拟闸门（零力调用）选定。
result_en: Saddles per search 1.010× [0.971, 1.058] (needed ≥ 1.03) and U/call 0.966× [0.907, 1.035] (needed ≥ 0.97), p = 0.963: no gain over `long-complete`. Scan-top energy did not predict where new saddles were. Driving all remaining coordinates gave +22 % saddles per search vs `long-best` (zeolites +34 %) at 0.79× U/call, mostly barriers > 1.5 eV. Options stay off by default.
result_zh: 每次搜索鞍点 1.010 倍 [0.971, 1.058]，U/调用 0.966 倍 [0.907, 1.035]，p = 0.963，均未达门槛。驱动全部剩余坐标每次搜索 +22 %，但 U/调用仅为 `long-best` 的 0.79 倍。选项默认关闭。

name_en: Sella finishing tail with size rule (SELLA TAIL)
name_zh: 尺寸规则下的 Sella 尾段
idea_en: A hiker climbs most of the way by feel, then hands the last stretch to a guide with a detailed contour map, but only on hills small enough that drawing the map is affordable. The dimer walker climbs until the curvature is negative and fmax ≤ 0.1 eV/Å, then Sella, seeded with the initial-state Hessian, converges the saddle; the handover applies only when 3N ≤ 469, a cut-off taken from earlier wall-time ratios.
idea_zh: 登山者大半程凭手感攀爬，最后一段交给带详细等高线图的向导，但只在小到画图划算的山上这样做。dimer 行走者爬到曲率为负且 fmax ≤ 0.1 eV/Å 时，交给以初态 Hessian 起步的 Sella 收敛鞍点；仅当 3N ≤ 469 时交接，该阈值只由早先的墙钟比推出。
systems_en: Zeolite stratum: 10 IS within the size rule (7 GF3 IS in H-CHA, H-FAU and H-MOR; G-FACTORY dev CHA, FAU, MOR) × 2 sessions; metal stratum: 30 G-FACTORY dev surfaces × 2; 2 seeds; reference `long-best`. Large MFI cells fall outside the rule.
systems_zh: 分子筛层：规则内 10 个初态（GF3 的 7 个 H-CHA/H-FAU/H-MOR 初态，G-FACTORY dev 的 CHA、FAU、MOR）× 2 次会话；金属层：30 个 G-FACTORY dev 表面 × 2；2 个种子；参照 `long-best`。大晶胞 MFI 不在规则内。
result_en: Zeolites (10 IS): U/call 1.083× [1.060, 1.114], p < 0.00025, saddles 183 vs 174, at 1.179× the wall time per session. Metals: 1.168× [1.080, 1.305] at 1.119× the wall time. About half the gain came from cheaper tails and refinement, half from extra saddles. Added to `long-best-auto` in v0.52.0; `long-best` stays Sella-free.

name_en: Chemist-ready reports and batch runs (REPORT-2 + BATCH)
name_zh: 面向化学家的报告与批处理
idea_en: Like handing a field geologist not just a list of passes but a trail guide: route profiles, warning stickers on dubious finds, a list of trails never walked, and ready-made inputs for the DFT follow-up. `explore` gained downhill IS→saddle→product paths with energy profiles, certificate columns, a not-searched ledger, chemical-plausibility flags and VASP/CP2K hand-off files, all at zero extra force calls; `dimer-explore batch` runs many IS in one command.
idea_zh: 给野外地质学家一本路书而非山口清单：路线剖面、可疑点警示贴、未走路线清单和 DFT 输入。`explore` 新增下坡路径与能量剖面、证书列、未搜索清单、合理性标记和 VASP/CP2K 交接文件，不增加力调用；`dimer-explore batch` 一条命令跑多个初态。
systems_en: 15 held-out IS (8 N3 + 7 N4; metal surfaces and zeolites) run with `long-best`, one seed, 60 saddles; plausibility flags audited blind on archived GF3-final `long-best` saddles (30 flagged + 30 unflagged per audit).
systems_zh: 15 个留出初态（8 个 N3 + 7 个 N4，金属表面与分子筛），`long-best`，1 个种子，共 60 个鞍点；合理性标记在 GF3 总决赛存档的 `long-best` 鞍点上盲审（每次 30 个有标记 + 30 个无标记）。
result_en: Path recording cost 0 extra force calls (15/15 runs identical); batch outputs byte-identical 30/30; DFT round-trip 60/60; scripted chemist task passed. Flag rules v1 failed the blind audit (precision 0.767 [0.58, 0.90] < 0.8); revised v2 scored 30/30 on a fresh sample. Batch CPU occupancy 0.49 missed the 0.8 target (file-system I/O). Reviewers judged about 2/3 of zeolite saddles chemically suspicious. Shipped in v0.53.0.
result_zh: 路径记录零额外力调用，DFT 往返 60/60；批处理与单跑 30/30 逐字节一致，CPU 占用 0.49 < 0.8。标记 v1 盲审精度 0.767 < 0.8 未过，v2 新样本 30/30。约 2/3 分子筛鞍点被判化学可疑。v0.53.0 发布。

name_en: New intermediates first in reaction networks (NOVELTY-FIRST)
name_zh: 反应网络中新中间体优先
idea_en: A tourist with limited days visits a new town before touring a third district of a town already seen. In depth-2 reaction networks, site and conformer variants with the same adsorbate bond graph were lumped into one intermediate, and child nodes that are genuinely new intermediates were expanded first (`--child-order novelty`), with optional caps on variant sessions and on the network budget.
idea_zh: 像假期有限的游客，先去没去过的城市，而不是在去过的城市再逛第三个街区。在深度 2 反应网络中，把吸附物键图相同的位点/构象变体并为同一中间体，优先展开真正的新中间体（`--child-order novelty`），并可限制变体会话数与网络预算。
systems_en: Zero-force-call gate: exact replay of 18 archived depth-2 networks (8 N3 + 7 N4 + 3 early Pt(111) benchmarks; 9 eligible for the statistic). The planned NEP89 test on the 15 N3/N4 networks was cancelled by the gate.
systems_zh: 零力调用闸门：精确重放 18 个存档的深度 2 网络（8 个 N3 + 7 个 N4 + 3 个早期 Pt(111) 基准，9 个计入统计量）；原定在 15 个 N3/N4 网络上的 NEP89 检验因闸门取消。
result_en: Gate statistic (calls to reach 80 % of a network's elementary steps, novelty/barrier order, lower is better) 0.901 (session level 0.915), above the 0.85 kill line, so no NEP89 runs were made; only 4 of 15 networks changed order at all. Post-hoc replays pointed instead to network-edge mode (predicted 2.01×) and a one-variant cap (1.20×), tested in round 93.
result_zh: 闸门统计量（达到网络 80 % 基元步的调用，新颖序/能垒序，越低越好）0.901，高于 0.85 淘汰线，未做 NEP89 计算；15 个网络仅 4 个顺序改变。事后重放指向网络边模式（预测 2.01 倍）与单变体上限（1.20 倍），由第 93 轮检验。

idea_en: A sealed-envelope tournament: every contender runs the same courses, most of which nobody has practised on, and every step is billed. Twelve arms (classic ASE dimer, κ-dimer, current presets, their GF3-era versions and candidate options) each made two seed-paired runs per IS under seven pre-registered hypotheses with Holm correction; release v0.49.0, measurement only.
idea_zh: 像密封信封的锦标赛：所有选手跑同样的赛道，其中多数谁都没练过，每一步都计费。12 个臂（经典 ASE dimer、κ-dimer、当前各预设、其 GF3 时期版本及候选选项）在每个初态上各做 2 次种子配对运行，用 Holm 校正检验 7 个预注册假设；只测量（v0.49.0）。
systems_en: 109 IS: GF3 set 36 (early systems + N3 + N4) + G5 6 + 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS; 73 had never been seen by any round. The 33 G-FACTORY dev IS formed an extra stratum. 12 arms × 2 seed-paired runs, 3,410 runs, all calls charged.
systems_zh: 109 个初态：GF3 集 36 个（早期体系 + N3 + N4）+ G5 6 个 + 67 个 G-FACTORY 密封初态，其中 73 个从未被任何轮次见过；33 个 G-FACTORY dev 初态作额外分层。12 个臂 × 2 次种子配对运行，共 3,410 次运行，全部调用计费。
result_en: `long-best` now vs its GF3 version: U/call 1.075× [1.035, 1.125] (pass); vs ASE dimer 6.550× [5.476, 8.103]; vs κ-dimer 27.420× [18.877, 46.610]. Calls per saddle: `long-best` 4,279, ASE dimer 28,026. `long-best-auto` now vs GF3 on 76 metals: 0.972 [0.923, 1.025] (fail; 0.903 on 52 new metals). Low-barrier and tail options passed, kinetic failed: overall inconclusive. v0.55.0 made the metal failover optional again.
result_zh: `long-best` 现版对 GF3 版 U/调用 1.075 倍 [1.035, 1.125]，通过；对 ASE dimer 6.550 倍，对 κ-dimer 27.420 倍。`long-best-auto` 金属上 0.972 倍未过，总判定不确定。

name_en: Exact-Hessian certificates with a kink guard (EXACT-HESS v2)
name_zh: 精确 Hessian 证书 v2
idea_en: Instead of tapping a wall at many points to guess its shape, take one X-ray, but double-check wherever the material changes abruptly. Saddles and minima are certified with the exact float64 NEP89 Hessian from JAX instead of finite differences; a guard re-checks the verdict on the other side of the potential's short-range switching kink, the Hessian's cost is measured in-process, compiles are cached and resumed runs reuse the stored IS Hessian.
idea_zh: 不再沿墙敲很多点来猜形状，而是拍一张 X 光片，并在材料突变处复查。用 JAX 的 float64 精确 NEP89 Hessian 取代有限差分来认证鞍点与极小；守卫在势函数短程切换折点的另一侧复核结论，计费在进程内实测，编译结果持久缓存，续跑复用已存的初态 Hessian。
systems_en: 36 GF3 IS (early systems + N3 + N4) × 2 seeds + 33 G-FACTORY dev IS × 1 = 69 IS, 105 sessions per arm; reference `long-best` with finite-difference certificates. The guard was also checked offline on earlier side-dependent candidates.
systems_zh: 36 个 GF3 初态（早期体系 + N3 + N4）× 2 个种子 + 33 个 G-FACTORY dev 初态 × 1，共 69 个初态、每臂 105 个会话；参照为有限差分证书的 `long-best`。守卫另在早先的候选鞍点上离线检验。
result_en: U/call 1.746× [1.466, 1.980] over all 69 IS; metals 1.152× [1.090, 1.216], zeolites 2.101× [1.771, 2.402]. Saddles 539 → 645 (+19.7 %) with 31.5 % fewer calls; unresolved-curvature cases 78 → 0; wall time 1.32× faster. The guard rejected 24/24 known false accepts with 0/1,047 false rejections. From v0.56.0 all long-* presets certify with exact Hessians.

name_en: Exact-Hessian modes in the search tail (EXACT-TAIL)
idea_en: Near the pass, the hiker stops feeling for the slope with a pair of boots and instead orders a full survey of the terrain every few steps. In the search tail, dimer rotations were replaced by the lowest mode of the exact NEP89 Hessian (refreshed every 1, 3 or 5 steps), or by exact Newton/RS-PRFO steps plus Newton refinement, or by exact Newton refinement alone.
idea_zh: 近山口时，登山者不再用两只脚试探坡度，而是每走几步就把地形完整测绘一遍。搜索尾段的 dimer 转动改用精确 NEP89 Hessian 的最低模（每 1、3 或 5 步更新），或用精确 Newton/RS-PRFO 尾段加 Newton 精修，或只做精确 Newton 精修。
systems_en: Paired replay gate, no new sessions: 463 archived launches from the 36 GF3 IS (early systems + N3 + N4) × 8 variants = 3,704 replays; an arm had to cost ≤ 0.80× the reference while changing ≤ 5 % of saddles.
systems_zh: 配对重放闸门，不跑新会话：36 个 GF3 初态（早期体系 + N3 + N4）上 463 次存档发射 × 8 个变体 = 3,704 次重放；某臂成本须 ≤ 参照的 0.80 倍且改变的鞍点 ≤ 5 %。
result_en: Search+refine cost vs reference (lower is better, needed ≤ 0.80): exact mode every step 6.91 [6.02, 7.82], every 3 steps 2.71, every 5 steps 2.03; Newton tail 1.28 [1.21, 1.35]; Newton refine only 1.03 [1.02, 1.05]. No arm survived, so sessions were not run. At handover the second eigenvalue is tiny (median 0.013 eV/Å²): the tail is a slow crawl along a soft mode.
result_zh: 搜索+精修成本比（需 ≤ 0.80）：精确模每 1/3/5 步更新 6.91/2.71/2.03，Newton 尾段 1.28，仅 Newton 精修 1.03 [1.02, 1.05]，均未过闸。交接点 λ2 中位仅 0.013 eV/Å²，尾段沿软模慢爬。

name_en: Second search that remembers the first (SECOND-SEARCH v2)
idea_en: A second expedition to the same valley carries the first team's logbook: passes already mapped, dead ends, and trails already surveyed. A repeat search on the same IS imports the first run's certified saddles, candidates, failed launches, product certificates and scan cache through one shared module that network child nodes also use (`explore --resume-from`); it ports round 79's idea and unifies it with round 76's network import.
idea_zh: 第二支考察队带着首支队伍的日志进山：哪些山口已测、哪些是死路、哪些路已走。同一初态的重复搜索经共享模块（网络子节点也用它，`explore --resume-from`）导入首次搜索的已认证鞍点、候选、失败发射、产物证书和扫描缓存；移植第 79 轮并与第 76 轮网络导入统一。
systems_en: 36 GF3 IS (21 early + 8 N3 + 7 N4): second search with memory vs an archived memory-less second search, same seed as round 79; independent replication with a second seed; 4 archived network designs as an identity check.
systems_zh: 36 个 GF3 初态（21 个早期 + 8 个 N3 + 7 个 N4）：带记忆的第二次搜索对比存档的无记忆第二次搜索（与第 79 轮同种子）；另一个种子独立重复；4 个存档网络设计做一致性检查。
result_en: Calls with vs without memory: Q 0.579 [0.536, 0.632] (upper bound 0.622 < 0.65, p = 0.005), keeping 64/65 new saddles; new saddles per call 1.75× [1.58, 1.95]. These runs reproduced round 79 call for call, confirming the port. A second seed repeated the saving (Q 0.581) but kept only 0.903 of new saddles (zeolites 0.837, high-barrier MFI saddles); metals lost none. Opt-in in v0.54.0.
result_zh: 有/无记忆调用比 Q = 0.579 [0.536, 0.632]，p = 0.005，新鞍点保留 64/65，新鞍点/调用 1.75 倍；逐调用复现第 79 轮，确认移植。另一种子 Q 0.581，保留率仅 0.903，损失在分子筛。v0.54.0 起可选。

name_zh: 网络边模式下新颖优先
idea_en: With a fixed travel budget, a mapmaker charting roads between towns visits unseen towns first and explores each town from just one street corner. In budgeted network-edge mode (NEB edge links, budget 3× the root session), new intermediates were expanded first (`--child-order novelty`); in plain depth-2 networks each intermediate got at most one site-variant session (`--max-variant-sessions 1`). Metric: elementary steps per call.
idea_zh: 预算有限的绘图员测绘道路，先去新城镇，每城只从一个街口进入。网络边模式（NEB 连边，预算为根会话 3 倍）下先展开新中间体（`--child-order novelty`）；普通深度 2 网络中每个中间体至多一个变体会话（`--max-variant-sessions 1`）。
systems_en: 33 G-FACTORY dev IS (30 metal surfaces + 3 zeolites), never used to tune these options; `long-best`, depth-2 networks, one seed, 5 arms (barrier vs novelty order with edges, uncapped vs capped plain networks, plus an unbudgeted edge network for reference).
systems_zh: 33 个 G-FACTORY dev 初态（30 个金属表面 + 3 个分子筛），从未用于调这些选项；`long-best`，深度 2 网络，1 个种子，5 个臂（边模式下能垒序对新颖序、普通网络无上限对上限 1，另加无预算边网络作描述）。
result_en: Edge mode: elementary steps per call 1.102× [1.026, 1.190], p = 0.0023 (127 → 140 steps at equal calls), but low-barrier saddles per call 0.941× [0.880, 0.996]. Variant cap: 1.055× [1.013, 1.114], p = 0.0013, keeping 65/65 steps with 5.2 % fewer calls. Both confirmed, though smaller than replay predictions (2.0×, 1.20×). Opt-in only from v0.54.0; defaults unchanged.

name_en: Certify only each node's lowest escapes (ESCAPE-SKELETON)
name_zh: 逃逸骨架网络（只认证最低逃逸）
idea_en: Instead of mapping every corridor out of each room, a surveyor only certifies the three lowest exits and stops once the next unexplored door is clearly higher. Network nodes ran round 77's escape query instead of full sessions: scan all drivable coordinates, drive them in ascending scan-top energy, and stop when the next exceeds the third-lowest escape barrier + 0.25 eV; children come only from certified escapes (`--node-mode escape-query`).
idea_zh: 测量员不测绘房间的全部通道，只认证最低三个出口，下一扇门明显更高就停。网络节点以第 77 轮逃逸查询代替完整会话：扫描可驱动坐标，按扫描顶能量升序驱动，超过第 3 低逃逸能垒 + 0.25 eV 即停；子节点只取已认证逃逸（`--node-mode escape-query`）。
systems_en: 48 IS: 33 G-FACTORY dev (30 metal surfaces + 3 zeolites) + 8 N3 + 7 N4; depth-2 networks, one seed; reference `long-lowbarrier` networks with a 1.5 eV window; a full-coverage run at every expanded node gave the true escapes; a 3-network smoke test came first.
systems_zh: 48 个初态：33 个 G-FACTORY dev（30 个金属表面 + 3 个分子筛）+ 8 个 N3 + 7 个 N4；深度 2 网络，1 个种子；参照为 1.5 eV 窗口的 `long-lowbarrier` 网络；每个已展开节点另做全覆盖运行作真值；先在 3 个网络上冒烟检验。
result_en: K-complete nodes per call 0.999× [0.920, 1.086], p = 0.495, far below the required 1.5×; lowest-barrier paths agreed on 67/67 nodes. The query used 0.858× the calls but was complete on 0.927 of nodes vs 0.971: reference low-barrier sessions already cover the window, and scan-top energy overestimated some barriers. Kept as an optional output mode.
result_zh: K 完整节点/调用 0.999 倍 [0.920, 1.086]，p = 0.495，远未达 1.5 倍；67 个节点最低能垒路径全一致。查询调用 0.858 倍，但完整率 0.927 对 0.971：参照会话已覆盖窗口，扫描顶能量又高估部分能垒。保留为可选。

name_en: Goal-directed search to a stated product (TARGET-A*)
name_zh: 朝指定产物的目标导向搜索（TARGET-A*）
idea_en: A traveller bound for one town does not survey every village near home: the satnav extends whichever route is closest to the destination and, once a route exists, only tries detours with a lower highest pass. TARGET-A* (`explore --target`) grew the reaction network best-first by missing target bond changes and bottleneck barrier, drove target bonds first in each node session, capped scan tops at the incumbent bottleneck and stopped with a certificate.
idea_zh: 去某镇的旅行者不会先勘察家附近每个村子：导航先延伸离目的地最近的路线，有路后只试最高山口更低的绕行。TARGET-A*（`explore --target`）按“缺几个目标键变化 + 瓶颈能垒”最佳优先扩展网络，节点会话先驱动目标键，扫描以现任瓶颈封顶，瓶颈无法再降时给出证书。
systems_en: Depth-2 reaction networks with `long-best` sessions, one seed. Primary test: 12 two-step targets on metal surfaces (e.g. CH3 → CH on Pt(211) and Ni(111), NH3 → NH on Ru(0001), CH3O → CHO on Cu(211), formic acid and ethylene glycol dehydrogenation on Pt(111), H2O → O + 2H on Cu(110)), 6 G-FACTORY dev and 6 GF3 dev IS. Network-edge extension: the same 12 plus 8 new metal IS (Ag, Au, Cu, Rh). Zeolite networks were too costly. A zero-NEP gate replayed archived networks.
systems_zh: 深度 2 反应网络，`long-best` 会话，1 个种子。主检验：金属表面上 12 个两步目标（如 Pt(211) 与 Ni(111) 上 CH3→CH、Ru(0001) 上 NH3→NH、Cu(211) 上 CH3O→CHO、Pt(111) 上甲酸与乙二醇脱氢、Cu(110) 上 H2O→O+2H），G-FACTORY dev 与 GF3 开发集各 6 个初态；网络边模式扩展：同 12 个 + 8 个新金属初态（Ag、Au、Cu、Rh）。分子筛网络太贵未纳入；另有 0 次 NEP 的存档回放门控。
result_en: Primary test (no network edges): both arms reached only 3/12 targets, too few to test. Network-edge mode, pooled n = 9: calls to the first strict path 0.402× [0.200, 0.794] (p = 0.0045), but the returned path was no worse than the plain network's in 8/9 = 0.889, one short of the 0.9 bar → inconclusive. Unreached targets (11/20) cost about a full network. Shipped as opt-in `--target` (v0.57.0).
result_zh: 主检验两组仅到达 3/12 个目标。网络边模式合并 n = 9：首条严格路径调用 0.402 倍 [0.200, 0.794]（p = 0.0045），但路径不差于普通网络的仅 8/9 = 0.889 < 0.9 → 不确定。未达者约耗一整网络。以可选项发布。

name_en: Shorter validation steps for stiff saddles (STEP-ADAPT)
name_zh: 刚性鞍点的端点步长阶梯（STEP-ADAPT）
idea_en: On a narrow, sharply curved pass, the standard stride to each side, meant to roll back into both valleys, can hit the valley wall and go uphill. For candidates rejected because a side did not descend, STEP-ADAPT computed the exact Hessian first, then re-validated once with the largest ladder step (0.12, 0.06, 0.03 Å) descending on both sides; arm B (IRC2-START) kept 0.12 Å but bent the start along the path's curvature.
idea_zh: 在窄而弯的山口，向两侧各迈一标准步本想滚回山谷，却可能撞上谷壁而上坡。STEP-ADAPT 对一侧不下坡而被拒的候选先算精确 Hessian，再取阶梯（0.12、0.06、0.03 Å）中两侧都下坡的最大步长重验一次；IRC2-START 臂仍用 0.12 Å，但沿曲率弯着起步。
systems_en: Audit: ladder acceptances on archived exact-Hessian candidates from round 73 (GF3: 17 zeolite + 19 metal IS) checked against an independent curved-start reference descent. Sessions: `long-best` with exact certificates, three arms, 36 GF3 dev IS × 2 seeds plus 33 G-FACTORY dev IS × 1 seed (315 sessions).
systems_zh: 审计：在第 73 轮精确 Hessian 存档候选（GF3：17 个分子筛 + 19 个金属初态）上，用独立的弯曲起点参考下降核对阶梯接受。会话：带精确证书的 `long-best`，三臂，GF3 开发集 36 个初态 × 2 个种子 + G-FACTORY dev 33 个初态 × 1 个种子（共 315 次）。
result_en: Kill rule fired: only 56/59 = 94.9 % of ladder acceptances were confirmed by the reference descent (< 95 %), so the ladder is negative although sessions showed U +12 % and U/call 1.043× [1.0003, 1.082]. IRC2 curved start: 45/45 confirmed, U +10.3 %, 1.037× [1.005, 1.068], Holm-adjusted p 0.0255, just missing 0.025 → inconclusive. No default changed.
result_zh: 阶梯接受仅 94.9 % 被参考下降确认（< 95 %），虽 U/调用 1.043 倍仍淘汰。IRC2 弯曲起点 45/45 确认，U/调用 1.037 倍 [1.005, 1.068]，Holm p = 0.0255 未过 0.025 → 不确定。默认不变。

name_en: Plausibility audit of the method ranking
name_zh: 方法排名的化学合理性审计
idea_en: Like re-judging a cooking contest after removing dishes made with a suspect ingredient: does the winner change? With no new calculations, every archived saddle was tagged with chemistry flags (radicals, Si–H, double protonation, …), samples were judged blind by two independent reviewers, and the GF3 (round 54) method ranking plus 14 later confirmatory comparisons were re-scored on unflagged saddles and on a new metric, U_plausible.
idea_zh: 像比赛后剔除用了可疑食材的菜再重新评分，看冠军会不会变。本轮不做新计算：给全部存档鞍点打上化学标记（自由基、Si–H、双质子化等），抽样由两位独立评审盲评，再在无标记鞍点和新指标 U_plausible 上重算 GF3（第 54 轮）的方法排名及其后 14 个确证比较。
systems_en: No new NEP calculations; archives only: GF3 grand-final runs on the 36 GF3 dev IS (1,440 runs), final batches of rounds 60–86 (including G-FACTORY dev IS) and the round-58 census of 669 distinct saddles, 10,861 archived saddles in total.
systems_zh: 不做新的 NEP 计算，只用存档：GF3 开发集 36 个初态上的 GF3 总决赛运行（1,440 次）、第 60–86 轮终验批次（含 G-FACTORY dev 初态）以及第 58 轮普查的 669 个不同鞍点，共 10,861 个存档鞍点。
result_en: The ranking holds on U_plausible: all pooled GF3 conclusions and all 14 later confirmations were unchanged (one per-family secondary result lost significance). `long-best` vs the classic ASE dimer, U/call 5.94× → 5.62× [4.22, 8.01]; on strictly unflagged saddles 8.64×, though six conclusions shift. Only five-coordinate Si–H was judged an NEP89 artefact (20/20 votes). The flag fix shipped in v0.56.0; U_plausible was proposed as a companion metric.
result_zh: 按 U_plausible，GF3 全部结论与后续 14 个确证不变（仅一个分族次要结论不再显著）；`long-best` 对 ASE dimer 的 U/调用 5.94 → 5.62 倍 [4.22, 8.01]；严格无标记 8.64 倍，但六处结论改变。

name_en: One command from molecule to initial states (ADSORB-ENSEMBLE)
name_zh: 从分子到初态系综的一条命令（ADSORB-ENSEMBLE）
idea_en: Instead of hand-placing a molecule and hoping it sits in the right spot, scatter it over every symmetry-distinct site and orientation, let each copy settle and keep the distinct low-lying ones. `dimer-explore adsorb` places one or more molecules on top, bridge and hollow sites or next to a zeolite's acid proton, runs ≤ 50 screening relaxations, drops reacted or desorbed results, certifies the minima and can run `--ask` or `--explore` on each member.
idea_zh: 与其手工摆放分子碰运气，不如把它撒到每个不等价位点和取向上各自弛豫，留下低能互异构型。`dimer-explore adsorb` 把分子放在顶位、桥位、穴位或分子筛酸性质子旁，≤ 50 次筛选弛豫，剔除反应或脱附者，认证极小后可逐个跑 `--ask`/`--explore`。
systems_en: 15 held-out generation-3/4 systems rebuilt from molecule names only (e.g. CO2+2H/Cu(211), NH3+H/Ru(0001), propane/Pt(111), methanol+ethene/H-MFI, NO/Rh(100), CH3/Ni(111), water in H-FAU, H-MOR and H-FER), plus 4 zero-yield IS (methoxy/Cu(111), two formic-acid/Pt(111) nodes, H2O/Cu(110)); one seed.
systems_zh: 只按分子名重建的第 3、4 代留出集 15 个体系（如 CO2+2H/Cu(211)、NH3+H/Ru(0001)、丙烷/Pt(111)、甲醇+乙烯/H-MFI、NO/Rh(100)、CH3/Ni(111)、H-FAU/H-MOR/H-FER 中的水），另有 4 个零产出初态（甲氧基/Cu(111)、两个甲酸/Pt(111) 节点、H2O/Cu(110)）；1 个种子。
result_en: All three pre-registered tests passed: the lowest ensemble member matched or beat the hand-built IS on 15/15 systems (9 lower by 0.04–0.54 eV); `--ask` over the ensemble found the generation-4 target step within 2× the calls of one `long-best` session on 6/7 (pooled 0.85×, build included); all 4 zero-yield IS gave saddles. Main risk: NEP89 artefact minima. Shipped as `dimer-explore adsorb` (v0.57.0).
result_zh: 三项全过：最低系综成员 15/15 不高于手搭初态（9 个低 0.04–0.54 eV）；系综 `--ask` 在 6/7 个第 4 代体系以 ≤ 2 倍成本找到目标步（合计 0.85 倍单次 `long-best`，含建系综）；零产出初态 4/4 出鞍点。

name_en: Grow the network where kinetics goes (AKMC-IN-THE-LOOP)
name_zh: 沿动力学去向生长反应网络（AKMC-IN-THE-LOOP）
idea_en: A town planner paves only the roads that traffic will actually use within the planning period. AKMC-in-the-loop treated the reaction network as a kinetic Monte Carlo chain (harmonic TST, equal prefactors, 500 K, a 1.316 s horizon) with unexplored minima as absorbing states, expanded the minimum that captured the most probability, and stopped once at most 1 % could still leak out of the explored network.
idea_zh: 城市规划者只修规划期内车流真会走的路。AKMC-in-the-loop 把反应网络当作动力学蒙特卡洛链（谐振过渡态理论、等前因子、500 K、1.316 s 时间视界），未探索极小当作吸收态，每次展开吸收概率最大的极小，可外泄概率 ≤ 1 % 时停止。
systems_en: Zero-NEP gate: replay of 29 archived energy-window networks (1.5 eV window) from round 59 on GF3 metal and zeolite IS; post hoc replications on 84 more networks from rounds 76 and 94 (including the 33 G-FACTORY dev IS). The planned NEP test on 42 metal IS (12 GF3 + 30 G-FACTORY dev) was not run.
systems_zh: 0 次 NEP 门槛：重放第 59 轮存档的 29 个能量窗口网络（窗口 1.5 eV；GF3 金属与分子筛初态）；事后在第 76、94 轮的另 84 个网络上复现（含 G-FACTORY dev 33 个初态）。原计划在 42 个金属初态（12 个 GF3 + 30 个 G-FACTORY dev）上的 NEP 检验未运行。
result_en: Killed at the gate: kinetic flux captured per call 0.977× [0.925, 1.056] of the archived window networks (needed ≥ 1.2), coverage 0.804 (needed ≥ 0.98). A corrected model reached only 1.0095× [1.000, 1.032]: inside the 1.5 eV window, 500 K kinetics reaches most minima anyway, so pruning saves just 1–4 %. A zero-call `dimer-explore akmc` analysis tool shipped (v0.57.0).
result_zh: 门槛淘汰：每调用动力学通量为存档网络的 0.977 倍 [0.925, 1.056]（需 ≥ 1.2），覆盖率 0.804（需 ≥ 0.98）；修正后也仅 1.0095 倍，剪枝只省 1–4 %。仅发布零调用分析工具 `dimer-explore akmc`。

name_zh: 驱动全部剩余坐标（LONG-COMPLETE v3）
idea_en: A prospector who has worked the promising claims keeps digging every remaining marked spot, then re-digs old holes from the other side. After a normal `long-best` session, CPA drove every leftover bond coordinate in order of scan-top energy; CPABR added a branch phase (reverse rescans, pinned branches, tabu re-drives) to reach saddles on other branches of coordinates already driven.
idea_zh: 淘金者挖完有希望的矿点后，再把地图上剩下的每个标记点都挖一遍，并从另一侧重挖旧坑。CPA 在普通 `long-best` 会话结束后按扫描顶点能量依次驱动全部剩余键坐标；CPABR 再加分支阶段（反向重扫、钉扎分支、禁忌重驱动），去够已驱动坐标另一分支上的鞍点。
systems_en: 105 sessions per arm on metal surfaces and zeolites: the 36 GF3 dev IS × 2 seeds plus 33 G-FACTORY dev IS × 1 seed; arms `long-best`, `long-complete`, CPA and CPABR.
systems_zh: 每臂 105 次会话（金属表面与分子筛）：GF3 开发集 36 个初态 × 2 个种子 + G-FACTORY dev 33 个初态 × 1 个种子；四臂为 `long-best`、`long-complete`、CPA、CPABR。
result_en: More saddles per search (`long-best` 5.31, CPA 6.10, CPABR 6.81), but at a cost: CPA 1.174× [1.103, 1.254] saddles vs `long-complete` with U/call 0.815× [0.733, 0.883] vs `long-best`; CPABR 1.310× and 0.751×. No Holm rejection (p 0.51–1.00); 86 % of extra zeolite saddles carried suspect-chemistry flags. Surprise: `long-complete` was dominated by `long-best`. Phases later shipped opt-in (v0.60.0).
result_zh: 鞍点更多，但 CPA、CPABR 的 U/调用为 `long-best` 的 0.815 倍 [0.733, 0.883]、0.751 倍；Holm 全不拒绝，分子筛新增鞍点 86 % 带标记。`long-complete` 竟劣于 `long-best`。

name_en: One question across a series of IS (SCREEN)
name_zh: 一系列初态问同一个问题（SCREEN）
idea_en: To learn which of several mountain ranges has the lowest pass of one kind, a scout asks each range one cheap question, or races them by always checking the most promising candidate across all ranges next. `dimer-explore screen LIST.csv --ask CLASS` ran one round-77 class query per IS of a series and ranked the answers; `--race` put every IS's coordinates into one global queue ordered by scan-top energy.
idea_zh: 想知道哪条山脉的某类山口最低，侦察兵向每条山脉问一个便宜的问题，或让它们赛跑、总先查全局最有希望的候选。`dimer-explore screen --ask CLASS` 对系列中每个初态跑一次类查询并排名；`--race` 把全部坐标放进按扫描顶点能量排序的全局队列。
systems_en: Pre-registered screening set: 21 series, 117 questions, 66 IS (6 archived series of the original benchmarks, GF3 dev IS grouped by metal or framework, G-FACTORY dev IS grouped by host metal). Only the kill-rule smoke ran: 13 questions on the ethylene glycol/Pt(111) series and the G-FACTORY Pt series; a zero-NEP replay of round-77 archives (42 questions) followed.
systems_zh: 预注册筛选集：21 个系列、117 个问题、66 个初态（原始基准的 6 个存档系列、按金属/骨架分组的 GF3 开发集、按宿主金属分组的 G-FACTORY dev）。只跑了杀伤规则冒烟：乙二醇/Pt(111) 系列与 G-FACTORY Pt 系列共 13 题；之后做了 0 次 NEP 的第 77 轮存档重放（42 题）。
result_en: Stopped by the smoke kill rule: per-IS query accuracy 0.692 (9/13) < 0.90; costs also missed (query 0.170× of a session vs ≤ 0.15; race 0.739× of query cost vs ≤ 0.6). Failures came from the underlying round-77 queries (unreliable scan-top certificates on metal–adsorbate bonds), not the series logic. Archive replay: accuracy 0.857–0.923 at 0.136× session cost. Not merged.
result_zh: 冒烟即淘汰：逐初态查询正确率 0.692（9/13）< 0.90；成本也超标（查询为会话的 0.170 倍，限 0.15；竞速为查询的 0.739 倍，限 0.6）。失败源自第 77 轮单初态查询本身。存档重放正确率 0.857–0.923。未合并。

name_zh: 不连通发射的近邻连接器（EXACT-CONNECT）
idea_en: Many passes found lead out of a neighbouring hollow rather than the home valley; the hollow is often home slightly shifted, so the missing piece is the small pass between them. For launches judged disconnected, EXACT-CONNECT kept the side nearest the IS, interpolated from the IS to that neighbour and ran an exact-Hessian P-RFO saddle search from the highest image (trust radius 0.1 Å, ≤ 10 steps, known saddle deflated).
idea_zh: 很多山口连着旁边的小洼地而非自家山谷；洼地常是“挪了一点的家”，缺的是两者间的小山口。对“不连通”的发射，EXACT-CONNECT 取离初态较近一侧的极小，在两者间插值，从最高像用精确 Hessian 的 P-RFO 找鞍点（信赖半径 0.1 Å，≤ 10 步，排除已知鞍点）。
systems_en: Replay, with fresh NEP evaluations, of all 596 disconnected launches (71 sessions) from the exact-Hessian arm of round 73: 17 zeolite + 19 metal GF3 dev IS × 2 seeds, giving 213 distinct eligible near-side minima.
systems_zh: 用 NEP 重新计算回放第 73 轮精确 Hessian 臂全部 596 个“不连通”发射（71 次会话；GF3 开发集 17 个分子筛 + 19 个金属初态 × 2 个种子），得到 213 个不同的合格近端极小。
result_en: Replay kill: only 43/213 = 20.2 % of near-side minima yielded a new IS-connected saddle (needed ≥ 35 %), at 4,048 force-call equivalents per new saddle (needed ≤ 3,000). Projected U/call 0.971× [0.940, 1.010]; the 43 extra saddles (+8.3 %) all had barriers ≤ 1.5 eV, 29 without bond change. 70 % of P-RFO walks did not converge within 10 steps. Not merged.
result_zh: 回放即淘汰：213 个近端极小仅 20.2 % 得到与初态直连的新鞍点（需 ≥ 35 %），每个耗 4,048 次力调用当量（限 3,000）。投影 U/调用 0.971 倍 [0.940, 1.010]；新增鞍点（+8.3 %）多为无键变化的翻转。

name_en: Same saddles for any worker count (WINDOW-W)
name_zh: 与进程数无关的并行窗口（WINDOW-W）
idea_en: Picture a kitchen where each new order is planned only from tickets finished at least eight orders earlier: one cook or eight cooks serve the same menu, just at different speeds. With `--parallel-window W`, launch k is decided from launches up to k − W, whatever the number of worker processes N; before, the window was tied to N, so `--workers 4` and `--workers 8` returned different saddles.
idea_zh: 厨房里每张新单只参考早至少 8 单的结果，于是 1 个或 8 个厨师出菜相同，只是快慢不同。`--parallel-window W` 让第 k 次发射只依据第 k − W 次及更早的结果，与进程数 N 无关；此前窗口随 N 变，`--workers 4` 与 8 给出不同鞍点。
systems_en: Analytic toy sessions with SIGTERM/SIGKILL resume chains; NEP89 on 4 original benchmark IS (n-butane/H-MFI, two ethanol + two water/H-MFI, glycolaldehyde+2H/Pt(111), methoxy/Cu(111)), 7 IS×seed combinations, `long-best` preset, N ∈ {1, 4, 8} at W = 8.
systems_zh: 解析玩具会话（含 SIGTERM/SIGKILL 中断续跑链）；NEP89 上 4 个原始基准初态（正丁烷/H-MFI、两乙醇+两水/H-MFI、乙醇醛+2H/Pt(111)、甲氧基/Cu(111)），共 7 个初态×种子组合，`long-best` 预设，W = 8 时 N ∈ {1, 4, 8}。
result_en: Negative under the strict byte-identity rule (2/36 toy resume chains and 3/3 resumed saddle files differed), but neither failure depended on N: a replay cap after repeated kills, and per-atom column order after resume (fixed). At W = 8, N = 1/4/8 gave identical saddles and calls in 14/14 NEP comparisons, whereas `--workers 4` vs 8 differed in 7/7 (n-butane: U 18 vs 25). Merged as opt-in (v0.58.0).
result_zh: 按逐字节规则判负（玩具续跑链 2/36、续跑鞍点文件 3/3 不同），但两处都与 N 无关（重放上限；列顺序，已修）。W = 8 时 N = 1/4/8 的鞍点与调用 14/14 相同，而 `--workers 4` 与 8 有 7/7 不同。以可选项并入。

idea_en: Hand the Sella climber a surveyed contour map instead of a sketch made by poking the slope. Sella normally probes curvature with a short finite-difference Davidson probe and then only updates its approximate Hessian; EXACT-SELLA instead supplied the exact NEP89 Hessian (automatic differentiation, charged like certificates) at the start only (E0), every 5 steps (E5), every step (E1), or at the start plus after 3 positive-curvature steps (EP).
idea_zh: 给登山者一张实测等高线图，而非戳坡面画的草图。Sella 原本用有限差分 Davidson 探曲率、此后只做近似更新；EXACT-SELLA 改用按证书计费的精确 NEP89 Hessian：仅起点（E0）、每 5 步（E5）、每步（E1），或起点加 3 步正曲率后（EP）。
systems_en: Development kill test on 12 GF3 dev IS × 2 seeds: 8 metals (methoxy/Cu(111), formic acid, ethylene glycol and glycolaldehyde+2H/Pt(111), CO+H/Rh(111), acetylene+2H/Pd(111), CH3/Ni(111), H2O/Cu(110)) and 4 zeolites (two methanol and formaldehyde+methanol/H-CHA, water/H-FAU, water/H-MOR); reference `long-best-auto` (v0.56). Descriptive follow-up on 49 metal IS (19 GF3 × 2 seeds + 30 G-FACTORY dev × 1).
systems_zh: 开发淘汰检验：GF3 开发集 12 个初态 × 2 个种子，8 个金属（甲氧基/Cu(111)、Pt(111) 上甲酸/乙二醇/乙醇醛+2H、CO+H/Rh(111)、乙炔+2H/Pd(111)、CH3/Ni(111)、H2O/Cu(110)）与 4 个分子筛（H-CHA 上两甲醇、甲醛+甲醇，H-FAU 与 H-MOR 中的水）；参照 `long-best-auto`（v0.56）。描述性复查：49 个金属初态（19 个 GF3 × 2 个种子 + 30 个 G-FACTORY dev × 1）。
result_en: Killed at development: best arm E0 U/call 0.962× [0.855, 1.031] (needed ≥ 1.10); EP 0.913×, E5 0.731×, E1 0.310×, despite 2–13 % more saddles. An exact Hessian (43–61 call equivalents) costs more than the Davidson probe it replaces (13–20 calls), and Sella's step count is set by its trust radius, not Hessian quality. Side finding: Sella never re-diagonalised, leaving 23 % of metal launches in positive-curvature aborts.
result_zh: 开发即淘汰：最佳臂 E0 的 U/调用 0.962 倍 [0.855, 1.031]（需 ≥ 1.10），EP 0.913 倍，刷新越频繁越差。精确 Hessian 要 43–61 次调用当量，贵于 Davidson 的 13–20 次，而步数受信赖域所限。

idea_en: The home valley is ringed by a ridge; known passes are its low points, and between two neighbouring passes the ridge rises to a summit. Hop from a known pass over that summit down to the next pass. Technically, an exact-Hessian P-RFO climb led from a certified saddle along a soft stable mode to an index-2 saddle, then descended to a neighbouring saddle; an ablation restarted a saddle search pushed off along that mode.
idea_zh: 初态山谷四周是一圈山岭：已知山口是岭上的低点，相邻山口之间岭线升到岭顶。从已知山口翻过岭顶，再下到下一个山口。具体：从已认证鞍点出发，用精确 Hessian 的 P-RFO 沿一个软的稳定模式爬到二阶鞍点，再下降到相邻鞍点；消融臂只是沿该模式推开后重做鞍点搜索。
systems_en: Replay on 12 of the 36 GF3 dev IS (8 metal surfaces, e.g. methoxy/Cu(111), propane/Pt(111); 4 zeolites, e.g. n-butane/H-MFI, water/H-FAU) from earlier exact-certificate sessions, 1 seed: up to 6 lowest-barrier saddles per IS, 52 seed saddles, 208 hop starts per variant.
systems_zh: 从 36 个 GF3 开发集初态中取 12 个（8 个金属表面，如 Cu(111) 上的甲氧基、Pt(111) 上的丙烷；4 个分子筛，如 H-MFI 中的正丁烷、H-FAU 中的水），重放早先的精确证书会话，1 个种子：每个初态取最多 6 个最低能垒鞍点，共 52 个起点鞍点，每种变体 208 次跳跃。
result_en: All eight variant/mode combinations failed the gate (≥30 % hop success at ≤4,639 force calls per new saddle). Best was ridge restart along the single softest mode: 3.85 % (4/104) at 4,507 calls per new saddle. The P-RFO hop gave 1 new saddle in 208 starts (165,644 calls). Only 5 distinct new saddles overall; 40 % of index-2 saddles never touch the IS basin. Not adopted.
result_zh: 8 种组合均未过门槛（成功率 ≥30 % 且 ≤4,639 次力调用/新鞍点）：最佳为最软模式山脊重启，3.85 %（4/104）、4,507 次/新鞍点；P-RFO 跳跃 208 次仅 1 个新鞍点。共 5 个新鞍点；40 % 二阶鞍点不接触初态盆地。

idea_en: Record long dashcam drives with relaxed rules and a trace of every step, then edit the footage to see where each stricter rule would have stopped: hundreds of rule sets scored without driving again. A launch-level simulator scored 992 one- or two-knob settings on recorded exact-certificate sessions; the frozen pick triggers the Sella re-walk rescue while a session has ≤3 saddles (was ≤1) and shrinks `search_radius` from 4.0 to 3.25 Å.
idea_zh: 像行车记录仪：先用宽松规则跑长程、记下每一步，再“剪片”看每条更严规则会在哪停下，无需重跑即可评分。模拟器在精确证书会话上评估 992 组配置；选定会话鞍点 ≤3 个（原 ≤1）即触发 Sella 重走救援、`search_radius` 由 4.0 缩至 3.25 Å。
systems_en: Simulator 'world': recorded exact-certificate sessions on the 36 GF3 dev IS (metal surfaces + zeolites), 3 seeds. Confirmation on 33 G-FACTORY dev IS (30 metal, 3 zeolite), 2 seeds, against `long-best` v0.56.
systems_zh: 模拟器“世界”：36 个 GF3 开发集初态（金属表面 + 分子筛）上已录制的精确证书会话，3 个种子。确认：33 个 G-FACTORY 开发集初态（30 个金属、3 个分子筛），2 个种子，参照 `long-best` v0.56。
result_en: Confirmation: U/call 1.175× [1.089, 1.289], one-sided p < 2.5e-4; U +17 % (224 → 262) with −0.4 % force calls; metals 1.188×, zeolites 1.086×.
