The zero-call simulator had predicted 1.116× [1.074, 1.177]. Looser session rules all scored worse (0.95–0.997×). Shipped as the `long-best` retune in v0.62.

idea_en: In fog, a hiker checks whether the downhill direction at their feet still points home; if it keeps pointing away, they have probably crossed the watershed and the walk is wasted. The compass ρ is the cosine between the force and the vector back to the IS, at zero extra calls; a walker is aborted after 12 consecutive steps with ρ < −0.05 while the maximum force exceeds 0.5 eV/Å.
idea_zh: 雾中的登山者看脚下的下坡方向是否仍指向家；若持续指向别处，多半已越过分水岭，这段路白走了。罗盘 ρ 为力与指向初态向量夹角的余弦，不需额外力调用；冻结规则：连续 12 步 ρ < −0.05 且最大力 > 0.5 eV/Å 时中止该行走器。
systems_en: New telemetry sessions with `long-best` v0.56 on the 36 GF3 dev IS (metal surfaces + zeolites), 2 seeds: 3,834 launches, 257k walker steps; the rule was chosen by nested leave-one-family-out over 21 reaction families (840-rule grid). The planned confirmation on 33 G-FACTORY dev IS was not run.
systems_zh: 在 36 个 GF3 开发集初态（金属表面 + 分子筛）上用 `long-best` v0.56 新跑遥测会话，2 个种子：3,834 次发射、257k 步；在 840 条规则的网格上按 21 个反应族做嵌套留一族选择。原计划在 33 个 G-FACTORY 开发集初态上的确认未运行。
result_en: The compass cannot separate good from bad walks: validated and disconnected walks have the same share of ρ < 0 steps (46.8 % vs 45.8 %); apex AUC 0.50, best rule along the walk 0.72. The frozen rule removed only 7.1 % of calls on disconnected walks (40 % needed) and cut 1.35 % of validated launches; offline estimate U/call 1.025× (1.05× needed), U 0.974×. Kept as telemetry.
result_zh: 罗盘无判别力：验证通过与不相连行走的 ρ < 0 步占比相同（46.8 % 对 45.8 %），顶点 AUC 0.50。冻结规则只省下不相连行走 7.1 % 的调用（需 40 %）；离线 U/调用 1.025 倍（需 1.05）。仅作诊断保留。

idea_en: A recipe proven in a test kitchen is cooked for a banquet: does it still fit the oven and stay cheap? Finite-difference certificates cost 2·3N force calls, so on cells with 1,305–1,791 free coordinates they dominate; an exact NEP89 Hessian costs about 40–110 call equivalents. The round tested exact-Hessian `long-best` against the finite-difference route on six large systems.
idea_zh: 试验厨房里成功的菜谱拿去办宴席：还放得进烤箱、还省钱吗？有限差分证书要 2·3N 次力调用，在 1,305–1,791 个自由坐标的大晶胞上占主导；NEP89 精确 Hessian 仅约 40–110 次力调用当量。本轮在 6 个大体系上对比精确与有限差分两条路线。
systems_en: Six large self-built IS (1,305–1,791 free coordinates): H-FAU conventional cell with a methanol dimer; H-MFI 1×1×2 with ethanol + water; Pt(111) 12×12×4 with ethanol; Pt(111) 14×14×4 with ethoxy + H; Cu(211) with CO + H; Pt(211) with formate + H. 2 seeds, first 30 launches per session.
systems_zh: 6 个自建大初态（自由坐标 1,305–1,791）：H-FAU 惯用晶胞 + 甲醇二聚体；H-MFI 1×1×2 + 乙醇 + 水；Pt(111) 12×12×4 + 乙醇；Pt(111) 14×14×4 + 乙氧基 + H；Cu(211) 上 CO + H；Pt(211) 上甲酸根 + H。2 个种子，每个会话取前 30 次发射。
result_en: Confirmed: exact-Hessian `long-best` vs the finite-difference route, U/call 4.355× [3.766, 5.516], one-sided p < 2.5e-4 (zeolites 5.67×, metals 3.81×); U 48 → 55 with 74 % fewer calls and 2.3× faster wall time. New failure: one H-MFI initial state sat on an NEP89 cutoff kink that the finite-difference check accepted; an exact check with escape at preparation entered the presets in v0.61.
result_zh: 确认：精确证书对有限差分证书 U/调用 4.355 倍 [3.766, 5.516]，p < 2.5e-4；U 48 → 55，力调用 −74 %。新问题：一个 H-MFI 初态落在 NEP89 截断折点上，有限差分误判；v0.61 预设加入精确检查与逃逸。

idea_en: A prospector stops assaying rocks already known to be fool's gold. NEP89 produces artefact saddles, such as hydrogen hopping onto a zeolite framework Si/Al atom or O–O bond formation; the opt-in screen (`plausibility_mode`, CLI `explore --plausible`) does not drive bonds whose product would be such an artefact and skips flagged framework-hydride and O–O candidates before validation.
idea_zh: 淘金者不再化验早已知道是“愚人金”的石头。NEP89 会给出伪鞍点，如 H 跳到分子筛骨架 Si/Al（T 原子）上或生成 O–O 键；可选筛选（`explore --plausible`）不驱动产物属于此类伪像的键，并在验证前跳过被标记的骨架氢化物与 O–O 候选。
systems_en: Z20 (primary): 17 GF3 zeolite IS + 3 G-FACTORY dev zeolite IS (CHA, FAU, MOR), 2 seeds; M10 (descriptive): 10 of the 19 GF3 metal IS, 1 seed. Reference `long-best` v0.57 with exact certificates.
systems_zh: Z20（主检验）：17 个 GF3 分子筛初态 + 3 个 G-FACTORY 开发集分子筛初态（CHA、FAU、MOR），2 个种子；M10（描述性）：19 个 GF3 金属初态中的 10 个，1 个种子。参照 `long-best` v0.57（精确证书）。
result_en: Zeolites: U_plausible/call 1.121× [1.069, 1.181], p < 0.00025; plausible saddles 384 vs 383 with 10.6 % fewer calls, while total U fell 12.9 % (framework-hydride saddles 67 → 8), so raw U/call was 0.974 [0.926, 1.023]. Metals: U unchanged (31/31), calls −2.4 %. Spot check: no plausible saddle among 40 skipped candidates (at most 5 arguable). Shipped opt-in in v0.62.
result_zh: 分子筛：每调用合理鞍点 1.121 倍 [1.069, 1.181]，p < 0.00025；合理鞍点 384 对 383，力调用 −10.6 %；总 U −12.9 %（骨架氢化物 67 → 8）。抽查 40 个跳过候选无误删。v0.62 以可选项发布。

idea_en: A bond scan follows one valley floor at each fixed rope length; missed saddles may sit in parallel valleys at the same length. Deflation marks visited spots as repelling, so the solver must land somewhere new. A bordered KKT Newton solver with the exact Hessian and Farrell deflation found other constrained minima at fixed bond length, each followed by scan, apex and dimer; a cheap control arm reversed the scan from its far end.
idea_zh: 键扫描在每个“绳长”下只走一条谷底，漏掉的鞍点可能藏在平行谷里；deflation 把去过的点变成“排斥点”，逼求解器另寻他处。做法：精确 Hessian 的 KKT 牛顿法加 deflation 找同一键长下的其他约束极小，再接扫描与 dimer；对照臂从远端反向扫描。
systems_en: From the r58 saddle census of the 36 GF3 dev IS (metal surfaces + zeolites): 129 adsorbate saddles never reached by driving although their bond had been driven in earlier exact-certificate sessions (oracle level; the scan apex sat a median 1.24 Å away), 98 distinct coordinates at realistic apex levels, and 48 random driven coordinates as a control.
systems_zh: 取自 36 个 GF3 开发集初态（金属表面 + 分子筛）的 r58 鞍点普查：129 个吸附物鞍点，其键在早先精确证书会话中已被驱动却从未被找到（oracle 层；扫描顶点离鞍点中位 1.24 Å），98 个不同坐标（现实顶点层），以及 48 个随机已驱动坐标作对照。
result_en: Oracle level: deflation recovered 4.6 % [1.7, 9.9] of missed saddles (≥25 % needed) at 33,164 force calls per new saddle; realistic level 7.1 % [2.9, 14.2] (≥15 % needed) at 74,454. The reverse scan matched 7.1 % at 3,660 calls per new saddle, about 20× cheaper (McNemar p = 1.0). 0/48 on random coordinates; 95 % of deflated roots were rotamers or conformers. Not adopted.
result_zh: deflation 找回率：oracle 层 4.6 %（需 ≥25 %），现实层 7.1 %（需 ≥15 %），每个新鞍点 74,454 次力调用；反向扫描同为 7.1 %，仅 3,660 次。随机坐标 0/48；95 % 的根是转子/构象体。

idea_en: A walker has strayed over the watershed. Locate the watershed between home and the stray point by dropping a ball halfway, watching where it rolls, and repeating; then start a fresh climb right on the ridge. For each launch that ended outside the IS basin, quench bisection bracketed the boundary to 0.04 Å, a dimer started at the bracket midpoint pointing across it, and an exact P-RFO retry used at most 15 Hessians.
idea_zh: 行走器越过了分水岭。在“家”与走失点之间反复取中点放小球、看它滚向哪边，定位分水岭，再从岭上重新爬坡。具体：对每个不相连的发射，用淬火二分把盆地边界夹到 0.04 Å，从夹区中点沿跨边界方向启动 dimer，失败时用最多 15 个精确 Hessian 的 P-RFO 重试。
systems_en: Replay of all 300 disconnected launches from earlier exact-certificate sessions on the 36 GF3 dev IS (metal surfaces + zeolites), one seed; novelty checked against the r58 saddle census.
systems_zh: 重放 36 个 GF3 开发集初态（金属表面 + 分子筛）早先精确证书会话中全部 300 次不相连发射，1 个种子；新颖性对照 r58 鞍点普查判断。
result_en: 40 new strictly certified IS-connected saddles = 13.3 % of boundary restarts (≥15 % needed) at 12,366 force calls per new saddle (≤10,000 needed); 50 % were new to the census (≥40 % needed, passed). Bracketing took 55 % of the cost: even with free walkers ≥6.8k calls per new saddle, twice the ≈3.4k marginal cost of longer searching. Projected session effect: U ×1.057, U/call ×0.82. Off by default.
result_zh: 新增 40 个严格认证且连回初态的鞍点，占边界重启的 13.3 %（需 ≥15 %），12,366 次力调用/新鞍点（需 ≤10,000）；50 % 不在普查中（需 ≥40 %，通过）。会话推算：U ×1.057，U/调用 ×0.82。默认关闭。

idea_en: Pulling a spring: if it still pushes back hard at the top of the pull, you are nowhere near the snapping point, so stop pulling. On metal IS, a launch ends before the dimer's first rotation when the curvature along the driven bond at the scan apex exceeds 40 eV/Å²; the curvature comes from the dimer image computed anyway, so the gate costs zero extra calls.
idea_zh: 拉弹簧：拉到顶点时若它仍强力回弹，说明离“断开”还远，不如停手。具体：在金属初态上，若扫描顶点处沿被驱动键的曲率超过 40 eV/Å²，就在 dimer 首次旋转前结束该发射；曲率取自 dimer 本来就要算的镜像，零额外力调用。
systems_en: Zero-call replay of GF4 grand-final archives on 52 sealed G-FACTORY metal IS × 2 seeds; development on 49 metal IS (19 GF3 + 30 G-FACTORY dev), 1 seed; confirmation on 52 sealed G-FACTORY metal IS (1 seed) + 5 G5 metal IS (2 seeds), 62 sessions per arm, against `long-best` v0.58.
systems_zh: 零调用重放 GF4 总决赛归档：52 个 G-FACTORY sealed 金属初态 × 2 个种子；开发：49 个金属初态（19 个 GF3 + 30 个 G-FACTORY 开发集），1 个种子；确认：52 个 G-FACTORY sealed 金属初态（1 个种子）+ 5 个 G5 金属初态（2 个种子），每臂 62 个会话，参照 `long-best` v0.58。
result_en: Confirmation: U/call 1.080× [1.045, 1.110], p < 0.00025, but U 0.959× [0.919, 0.988] (244 → 234) broke the 0.97 saddle-count guard, so negative. Lost saddles were mostly >2.1 eV adsorbate dissociations (NH2/CH2/ethyl C–H); U(≤1.5)/call 1.116×. Harmful on zeolites (U −24…−30 %). Shipped as the default-off option `search_stiff_start` in v0.61.
result_zh: 确认：U/调用 1.080 倍 [1.045, 1.110]，但 U 0.959 倍（244 → 234）低于 0.97 护栏，判负；丢失多为 >2.1 eV 的吸附物解离。U(≤1.5)/调用 1.116 倍；分子筛有害。v0.61 以默认关闭选项发布。

idea_en: A mystery shopper visits the store with nothing but the signage: can a new user get a certified transition state from the README alone? The tester picked three tasks outside every benchmark and used only the documented CLI: an α-C–H break of ethoxy on Pd(100) with `long-best`, isobutene protonation in H-CHA, and the lowest C–H-break barrier of the first system via `--ask break:C-H`.
idea_zh: 像“神秘顾客”只看店内指示牌：新用户仅凭 README 能否拿到认证过渡态？测试者自选三个基准外的任务：Pd(100) 上乙氧基 α-C–H 断裂（`long-best`）、H-CHA 中异丁烯质子化、用 `--ask break:C-H` 找最低 C–H 断裂能垒。
systems_en: Three new user tasks outside every benchmark: ethoxy on Pd(100) (α-C–H break); an isobutene π-complex in H-CHA (36 T sites, 1 Al; protonation); the lowest C–H break of the ethoxy system. Single user sessions; no statistical comparison.
systems_zh: 三个不在任何基准中的新用户任务：Pd(100) 上的乙氧基（α-C–H 断裂）；H-CHA（36 个 T 位、1 个 Al）中的异丁烯 π 络合物（质子化）；乙氧基体系最低的 C–H 断裂。单次用户会话，无统计对比。
result_en: Usability goal 1 missed: 0/3 target steps certified (2/3 tasks got certified saddles only after workarounds; first certified TS after 24–25 min). Five blocking issues, e.g. install failing on Python 3.13, a calorine import error, `adsorb` placing the acid proton out of reach, and target saddles found but judged disconnected and invisible in outputs. Goal 2 met after fixes, shipped in v0.63; search results unchanged.
result_zh: 目标 U1 未达成：3 个目标步骤 0 个获认证（变通后 2/3 任务得到认证鞍点）。5 个阻断问题，如 Python 3.13 装不上、`adsorb` 把酸性质子放得够不着、目标鞍点被判不相连且在输出中不可见。修复随 v0.63 发布，U2 达成。

name_zh: 修复 Sella 曲率重检
idea_en: The climber's 'recheck the slope' alarm was wired to a sensor reading zero along frozen directions (fixed atoms), so it never rang; near the top, stride length was judged from noisy altitude changes. Arm D makes Sella's on-demand Davidson re-diagonalisation use the Hessian projected onto free coordinates (D1: once per walk); arm R uses a gradient-norm trust ratio below fmax 0.01 eV/Å plus a 0.01 Å trust floor; DR combines both.
idea_zh: 登山者“重测坡度”的警报接在沿冻结方向恒为零的传感器上，从不报警；近山顶时步长按带噪声的高度变化来定。D 臂让 Sella 的 Davidson 重对角化改看投影到自由坐标的 Hessian（D1 限每次行走一次）；R 臂近收敛时改用梯度范数定信赖半径；DR 两者兼用。
systems_en: Development on 49 metal IS (19 GF3 + 30 G-FACTORY dev), 1 seed, against `long-best-auto` v0.58; zeolite tail check on 10 IS (7 GF3 zeolites with up to 469 degrees of freedom + 3 G-FACTORY dev); side test on the 17 GF3 zeolites with the Sella engine forced, 1 seed. The planned confirmation on 52 sealed G-FACTORY metals was not run.
systems_zh: 开发：49 个金属初态（19 个 GF3 + 30 个 G-FACTORY 开发集），1 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto` v0.58；分子筛尾段检查 10 个初态（7 个自由度 ≤469 的 GF3 分子筛 + 3 个 G-FACTORY 开发集）；附加测试：17 个 GF3 分子筛强制使用 Sella 引擎，1 个种子。原计划 52 个 sealed 金属的确认未运行。
result_en: U/call vs `long-best-auto`: D 0.981 [0.936, 1.038], D1 1.001 [0.958, 1.050], R 0.994 [0.972, 1.019], DR 0.973 [0.929, 1.030]; all below the 1.04 go/no-go line, so the sealed confirmation was skipped. The bug was real (positive-curvature aborts −38 %), but rescued saddles cost about 1,760 calls each vs 1,497 on average. Side test: unfixed Sella engine on zeolites 1.142× [1.066, 1.247], U_ads −16 %.
result_zh: 对 `long-best-auto` 的 U/调用：D 0.981、D1 1.001、R 0.994、DR 0.973，最佳也低于 1.04 门槛，未做确认。缺陷属实（正曲率中止 −38 %），但救回鞍点每个约 1,760 次调用，平均为 1,497 次。

idea_en: A prospector going back to the same hillside brings last trip's map, so known veins are skipped instead of dug again. The round measured what the 2nd–4th search of one IS is worth: independent reseeds, a chain where each search imports the previous memory (`--resume-from`: known saddles recognised in flight, scans reused), or a memory chain that rotates presets (`long-best` → `long-best-auto` → `long-complete` → `long-best`).
idea_zh: 淘金者再回同一片山坡时会带上次的地图，已知矿脉不再重挖。本轮测量对同一初态做第 2–4 次搜索的价值：独立换种子重跑；用 `--resume-from` 导入上次记忆（已知鞍点途中即识别，扫描复用）；或带记忆并在三种预设间轮换。
systems_en: 69 IS: the GF3 dev set (36 IS: early benchmark, GEN3 and GEN4 metal surfaces and zeolites) plus 33 G-FACTORY dev IS. Three four-search chains per IS sharing the first `long-best` search, 690 user-CLI explore sessions with v0.58 exact-Hessian presets, all calls charged.
systems_zh: 69 个初态：GF3 开发集 36 个（早期基准、GEN3、GEN4 的金属表面与分子筛）+ G-FACTORY 开发集 33 个。每个初态三条 4 次搜索链，共用第一次 `long-best` 搜索，共 690 次 explore 会话（v0.58 精确 Hessian 预设），全部力调用计费。
result_en: Memory chain vs independent reseeds (4 searches, union U/call): 1.793× [1.727, 1.851], p < 0.00025, the same 411 saddles for 0.558× the calls. Preset-rotating chain vs memory chain: 1.132× [1.071, 1.214], +20.4 % saddles, all from metals (1.323×; zeolites 1.006×). Same-preset reseeds add only 4.7/1.6/0.5 %. No default change; the advisor now recommends `--resume-from` (v0.65.0).
result_zh: 记忆链对独立重跑：并集 U/调用 1.793 倍 [1.727, 1.851]，鞍点同为 411 个；轮换预设再高 1.132 倍 [1.071, 1.214]，鞍点 +20.4 %，全来自金属。advisor 转而推荐 `--resume-from`。

idea_en: Like a wildlife survey that re-checks old camera-trap sightings with a sharper camera, then asks how much of the population one walk actually sees. All archived saddles on the GF3 set were pooled into census v2; entries certified only by finite differences were re-checked with exact NEP89 Hessians and current validation rules, and each method's single-run completeness was measured against a jackknife estimate of the total.
idea_zh: 像野生动物普查：先用更清晰的相机复核旧照片里的每个物种，再问一次巡查能看到多少。本轮把 GF3 集历次归档的鞍点汇总为普查 v2，用精确 NEP89 Hessian 与现行验证规则复验仅有有限差分证书的条目，并以 jackknife 估计的总数衡量各方法单次运行的完整度。
systems_en: GF3 dev set, 36 IS (19 metal surfaces, 17 zeolites; early benchmark + GEN3 + GEN4). Mostly offline: 913 archived saddles from 31,985 earlier run units; NEP89 was used only to re-validate 659 saddles under exact and finite-difference control protocols.
systems_zh: GF3 开发集 36 个初态（金属表面 19、分子筛 17；早期基准 + GEN3 + GEN4）。以离线普查为主：31,985 个历史运行单元归档的 913 个鞍点；NEP89 只用于在精确与有限差分对照协议下复验 659 个鞍点。
result_en: Formally negative: 93.5 % [91.0, 95.4] of finite-difference-only entries stayed valid (95 % required), yet exact certificates rejected only 0.4 %; 2.0 % were false 'disconnected' verdicts from the r31 lazy quench. Census v2: 880 exact-valid saddles, estimated total 1,056 (a lower bound). One exact `long-best` session finds 24.8 % [22.7, 27.5] (1.104× round 58); `long-best-auto` 30.2 %; ASE dimer 3.0 %; κ-dimer 0.3 %.
result_zh: 有限差分条目仅 93.5 % [91.0, 95.4] 仍有效，未达 95 % 门槛，而精确证书只否定 0.4 %。估计鞍点总数 1,056；单次 `long-best` 会话找到 24.8 % [22.7, 27.5]，ASE dimer 3.0 %。

idea_en: Like a final exam on a sealed paper no contestant has seen, marked on correct answers per minute of work. Grand final 5 ran eleven arms, from classic ASE dimer, κ-dimer and Sella (10-launch campaigns) to the exact-Hessian presets `long-best` and `long-best-auto`, with unchanged v0.60.0 search code; every force call was charged, exact Hessians as measured call equivalents.
idea_zh: 像一场用全新密封试卷的期末考，按单位时间答对题数评分。总决赛 5 不改搜索代码，比较 11 个臂，从 ASE dimer、κ-dimer、Sella（各 10 次启动）到精确 Hessian 预设 `long-best`、`long-best-auto`，全部力调用计费。
systems_en: PRIMARY: G-FACTORY-2 sealed, 62 never-run IS (42 metal: hcp(0001), bcc(110)/(100), fcc(110)/(311) of Ru, Os, Re, Fe, W, Mo, Pt, Pd, Cu, Ni, Rh, Ag; 20 zeolite: MFI, MWW, BEA, AEI, TON, LTA, CHA), 2 paired runs per method and IS. CONTINUITY: GF4's 109 IS (GF3 36 + G5 6 + G-FACTORY sealed 67). 2,890 runs in total.
systems_zh: 主表：G-FACTORY-2 sealed 的 62 个从未运行过的初态（金属 42：Ru、Os、Re、Fe、W、Mo、Pt、Pd、Cu、Ni、Rh、Ag 的 hcp(0001)、bcc(110)/(100)、fcc(110)/(311) 表面；分子筛 20：MFI、MWW、BEA、AEI、TON、LTA、CHA），每个方法与初态 2 次配对运行。连续性对照：GF4 的 109 个初态（GF3 36 + G5 6 + G-FACTORY sealed 67）。共 2,890 次运行。
result_en: On the 62 unseen IS, force calls per saddle: classic dimer 24,613, κ-dimer 278,495, Sella 17,777, `long-best` 2,760, `long-best-auto` 1,962. `long-best` U/call vs classic dimer 8.916× [7.201, 11.409], vs κ-dimer 100.887×, vs Sella 6.440×, vs its GF4 version 1.606×; `long-best-auto`/`long-best` 1.407× [1.274, 1.557], made CLI default in v0.64. Two variant tests (IRC2, CPA*) failed, so formally 'inconclusive by rule'.
result_zh: 62 个新初态上每个鞍点耗力调用：传统 dimer 24,613，`long-best` 2,760，U/调用为前者的 8.916 倍 [7.201, 11.409]；auto 版再高 1.407 倍，v0.64 起为默认。两项变体检验未过，故判不确定。

name_en: Auto engine for every long preset (PRESET-HARMONY)
idea_en: Like a car maker rolling the flagship's proven upgrades (better engine, rescue kit) out to every model in the line-up. Each `long-*` preset received the confirmed improvements of `long-best-auto`: the engine block (Sella on metal surfaces, dimer elsewhere), the round-75 tail options and the round-78 Sella re-walk rescue with `rescue_trigger_u=3`, tested as AUTO2, LOW-AUTO and KIN-AUTO against their parent presets.
idea_zh: 像车厂把旗舰车型验证过的升级推广到全系。本轮让每个 `long-*` 预设继承已确认的改进：auto 引擎块（金属表面用 Sella）、第 75 轮尾部选项与第 78 轮 Sella 重走救援，以 AUTO2、LOW-AUTO、KIN-AUTO 对照各自原预设检验。
systems_en: Development: 69 IS (GF3 dev set 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33). Confirmation: 73 held-out IS (G-FACTORY sealed 67 + G5 6; metal surfaces and zeolites), one session per arm, all calls charged.
systems_zh: 开发：69 个初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY 开发集 33）。确认：73 个留出初态（G-FACTORY sealed 67 + G5 6；金属表面与分子筛），每臂 1 个会话，全部力调用计费。
result_en: Confirmation (73 IS): LOW-AUTO vs `long-lowbarrier` U(≤1.5)/call 1.313× [1.214, 1.437], p < 0.00025, +40.6 % saddles; KIN-AUTO vs `long-kinetic` kinetic-set saddles/call 1.568× [1.385, 1.812], +56.5 % saddles. AUTO2 vs `long-best-auto` 0.963× [0.925, 1.003]: 12.8 % more saddles but not per call, failed. New presets `long-lowbarrier-auto` and `long-kinetic-auto` shipped in v0.64.0; `long-best-auto` unchanged.
result_zh: 对照原预设：LOW-AUTO U(≤1.5)/调用 1.313 倍 [1.214, 1.437]，KIN-AUTO 动力学鞍点/调用 1.568 倍 [1.385, 1.812]；AUTO2 0.963 倍，未过。前两者随 v0.64.0 成为新预设。

name_en: Reaction networks in the exact era (NETWORK-EXACT)
idea_en: Instead of mapping only the passes out of one valley, the hiker crosses each pass, camps in the next valley and maps its passes too. With `--network-depth 2`, every certified product becomes a new IS that is searched in turn; the round measured what depth-2 networks give with the current exact-Hessian release (v0.62) versus v0.55-equivalent finite-difference presets, with no code change.
idea_zh: 不只画一个山谷通往外面的山口，而是翻过每个山口到下一个山谷扎营，再画那里的山口。`--network-depth 2` 让每个经认证的产物成为新初态继续搜索；本轮不改代码，比较当前精确 Hessian 版（v0.62）与 v0.55 等价有限差分预设的深度 2 网络。
systems_en: 20 root IS chosen by a pre-registered hash rule: 6 GF3 metal surfaces (Cu, Pt), 6 GF3 zeolites (5 MFI, 1 CHA) and 8 G-FACTORY dev metal IS; four depth-2 networks per root (kinetic and exhaustive, old and new presets), 80 networks.
systems_zh: 按预注册哈希规则选 20 个根初态：GF3 金属表面 6 个（Cu、Pt）、GF3 分子筛 6 个（5 个 MFI、1 个 CHA）、G-FACTORY 开发集金属 8 个；每个根 4 个深度 2 网络（动力学/穷举 × 新/旧预设），共 80 个网络。
result_en: Kinetic networks (`long-lowbarrier`, window 1.5 eV): low-barrier network saddles per call 1.402× [1.209, 1.735], p < 0.00025 (138 → 168 saddles at 0.868× the calls; metals 1.189×, zeolites 1.897×). Exhaustive networks (`long-best`, budget 3): 1.568× [1.298, 1.854] on 18 roots. 78/80 networks completed, no finite-difference fallbacks. No code change; a README section explains what to expect.
result_zh: 动力学网络中新预设对旧预设：低能垒鞍点/调用 1.402 倍 [1.209, 1.735]，鞍点 138 → 168、调用 ×0.868；穷举网络 1.568 倍 [1.298, 1.854]。80 个网络完成 78 个；README 补充网络用法。

name_en: Count saddles of the reactant superbasin (SUPERBASIN)
name_zh: 按反应物超盆地计鞍点（SUPERBASIN）
idea_en: Count the doors out of a house, not the doors between its rooms: a molecule rattling between nearly equal pockets lives in one reactant state. An opt-in post-session state pass (`reactant_superbasin`) grouped the IS with neighbour minima linked by barriers ≤ 0.15 eV in both directions, dropped hops inside that state, and credited 'disconnected' saddles that connect to a state member instead of the IS itself.
idea_zh: 数房子通往外面的门，而不是房间之间的门：在几个近乎等能的口袋间来回跳的分子处在同一个反应物状态。可选的会话后审查（`reactant_superbasin`）把初态与正逆势垒均 ≤ 0.15 eV 的相邻极小并为一个状态，去掉状态内跳迁，并记入连到状态成员的“断连”鞍点。
systems_en: Replay of 105 archived exact-Hessian `long-best` sessions from round 90 on 69 IS (GF3 dev set 36 × 2 seeds + G-FACTORY dev 33 × 1; 49 metal, 20 zeolite). Live test: the two hand-built round-113 trial IS (ethoxy on Pd(100), isobutene π-complex in H-CHA) plus 6 G-FACTORY dev IS, 2 seeds each.
systems_zh: 回放第 90 轮 105 个归档的精确 Hessian `long-best` 会话，覆盖 69 个初态（GF3 开发集 36 × 2 个种子 + G-FACTORY 开发集 33 × 1；金属 49、分子筛 20）。实测：第 113 轮的两个手搭试用初态（Pd(100) 上的乙氧基、H-CHA 中的异丁烯 π 络合物）加 6 个 G-FACTORY 开发集初态，各 2 个种子。
result_en: Replay: state-counted saddles / plain U = 0.941 [0.885, 0.982], below the required 1.10 (kill rule). The pass cost 6.0 % of calls, removed 53 intra-state hops and credited only 15 new saddles (all-charged efficiency 0.888×; metals 0.808, zeolites 1.012). The trial target steps stayed uncredited: they hang on lower minima the session never connects to the IS. Not merged.
result_zh: 回放：按状态计的鞍点/原 U = 0.941 [0.885, 0.982]，低于要求的 1.10，判负。审查花 6.0 % 调用，去掉 53 个状态内跳迁，只记入 15 个新鞍点。试用目标步挂在会话从未连到初态的更低极小上，仍不能计入。未合并。

name_en: Rescue failed launches in every session (RESCUE-WIDE)
name_zh: 每个会话都救援失败发射（RESCUE-WIDE）
idea_en: When a climber turns back below a promising pass, send a second climber with different gear up the same route, but only where the top looked low. Rescue ran in every session, not only after sessions with ≤ 3 saddles: failed launches were re-walked with the other engine, queue capped at scan-top energy ≤ 1.0 eV; LBW-Z applied this to `long-best` on metal surfaces only, AUTOW to `long-best-auto`.
idea_zh: 登山者在山口下折返，派换了装备的人沿原路再上，只走山顶不高的路线。救援改为每个会话都开（原先只在鞍点 ≤ 3 时）：失败发射换另一引擎重走，限扫描顶 ≤ 1.0 eV；LBW-Z 仅在金属表面用于 `long-best`，AUTOW 用于 `long-best-auto`。
systems_en: Development: 69 IS (GF3 dev set 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33). Confirmation: 73 held-out IS (G-FACTORY sealed 67 + G5 6; metal surfaces and zeolites), one session per arm, all calls charged.
systems_zh: 开发：69 个初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY 开发集 33）。确认：73 个留出初态（G-FACTORY sealed 67 + G5 6；金属表面与分子筛），每臂 1 个会话，全部力调用计费。
result_en: Confirmation (73 IS): LBW-Z vs `long-best` U/call 1.041× [0.998, 1.085], p 0.032 (passes Holm, marginal), U 307 vs 299; per-IS log-mean ratio 0.966. AUTOW vs `long-best-auto`: ΣU 1.129× [1.090, 1.173] but U/call 0.970× [0.940, 1.002], guards failed. Merged only as opt-in options (v0.68.0); a metal-only wide rescue was adopted later (round 141).
result_zh: 确认集：LBW-Z 对 `long-best` 的 U/调用 1.041 倍 [0.998, 1.085]，p 0.032 勉强通过；AUTOW 鞍点 +12.9 %，但 U/调用 0.970 倍，护栏未过。仅作可选项合并；金属版在第 141 轮采纳。

name_en: Audit of lazy-quench false disconnects (LAZY-QUENCH AUDIT)
name_zh: 惰性淬火假断连审计（LAZY-QUENCH AUDIT）
idea_en: A referee who whistles as soon as a runner seems to leave the track can miss that the runner was only drifting wide. The round-31 lazy quench stops a downhill check once a side looks clearly not the IS; the audit replayed 3,388 such stops to count false 'disconnected' verdicts and tested an opt-in fix (`quench_lazy_resume` band mode) that finishes descents paused within 0.15 eV of the IS before rejecting.
idea_zh: 裁判一见选手像是出了跑道就鸣哨，可能错过他只是绕了大弯。第 31 轮惰性淬火一见某侧“明显不是初态”就停止下坡验证；本轮重放 3,388 次此类拒绝统计假“断连”，并检验可选修正 `quench_lazy_resume`：暂停时距初态 < 0.15 eV 的侧先降到底再判。
systems_en: Audit: replayed lazy rejections from archived `long-best` sessions on the GF3 dev set (36 IS) and G-FACTORY dev (33 IS). Fix test: Z20 = 20 zeolite IS (17 GF3 + 3 G-FACTORY dev) × 2 sessions, plus 19 GF3 metal IS × 1 session, 118 sessions in total.
systems_zh: 审计：重放 GF3 开发集（36 个初态）与 G-FACTORY 开发集（33 个）归档 `long-best` 会话中的惰性拒绝。修正检验：Z20 = 20 个分子筛初态（GF3 17 + G-FACTORY 开发集 3）× 2 个会话，另加 GF3 的 19 个金属初态 × 1 个会话，共 118 个会话。
result_en: Audit: zeolite false-disconnected rate 1.49 % [0.92, 2.40] (16/1,075; metals 0/1,096), but all 26 false cases were just 3 distinct saddles, 2 of them framework-hydride artefacts. In replay the band fix recovered 85 % of lost saddles for 0.5–0.7 % more calls. Live (Z20): U/call 1.0062× [0.993, 1.025], p 0.254; U 1.0105×, all from one IS; no unsafe decisions. Not significant; not merged.
result_zh: 审计：分子筛假断连率 1.49 % [0.92, 2.40]（金属 0），但 26 个假断连只是 3 个不同鞍点。修正实测：U/调用 1.0062 倍 [0.993, 1.025]，p 0.254；U 1.0105 倍，全来自一个初态。不显著，未合并。

name_en: Stop endpoint descents early once matched (LOOSE-MATCH-G)
name_zh: 端点下降匹配即提前停（LOOSE-MATCH-G）
idea_en: Once the taxi has turned into your street and you can see your front door, you don't need the driver to park to the centimetre before you know where you are. Downhill checks that already match the reference minimum within matcher tolerance now stop at fmax 0.05 eV/Å instead of 0.01, but only if fmax fell strictly over the last two accepted steps (`early_match_fmax=0.05`, `early_match_guard=2`).
idea_zh: 出租车拐进你家那条街、看得见家门时，不必等它停到厘米级才确认到了。端点下坡验证一旦在匹配器容差内与参考极小匹配，就在 fmax 0.05 eV/Å（而非 0.01）结束，前提是最近两步 fmax 严格下降（`early_match_guard=2`）。
systems_en: Identity replay: 574 launches (1,682 descent sides) from archived GF3 dev set and G-FACTORY dev sessions. Live test: Z20 (17 GF3 + 3 G-FACTORY dev zeolites) plus 19 GF3 metal IS, 39 IS × 2 seeds, 156 paired `long-best` sessions.
systems_zh: 身份重放：GF3 开发集与 G-FACTORY 开发集归档会话中的 574 次发射（1,682 条下降侧）。实测：Z20（GF3 17 + G-FACTORY 开发集 3 个分子筛）加 GF3 的 19 个金属初态，共 39 个初态 × 2 个种子，156 个配对 `long-best` 会话。
result_en: Replay: 0 decision flips on 1,682 sides (877 negatives). Live: U/call 1.034× [1.024, 1.043], p < 0.00025 (zeolites 1.040×, metals 1.018×) with identical saddle counts (562 = 562) and bit-identical bond phases; about 105 force-call equivalents saved per validated zeolite launch (55 on metals). Merged into the presets in v0.66.0.
result_zh: 重放 1,682 条下降侧：0 次判决翻转。实测 U/调用 1.034 倍 [1.024, 1.043]（分子筛 1.040、金属 1.018），鞍点数不变（562 = 562）；分子筛每次已验证发射约省 105 个力调用当量。v0.66.0 并入预设。

name_en: Re-anchor the search at the local floor (AUTO-REANCHOR)
idea_en: A hiker dropped on a ledge should walk down to the valley floor before looking for passes. `explore --reanchor` checks a finished session for evidence that the user's IS is not the local floor (a certified exit of ≤ 0.5 eV to a lower minimum with the same chemical graph, or a disconnected saddle with both sides below the IS) and then searches again from the lowest such minimum, at most twice.
idea_zh: 被放在半山腰平台上的登山者，应先走到谷底再找山口。`explore --reanchor` 检查会话是否表明初态并非局部谷底（≤ 0.5 eV 的认证出口通向化学图相同的更低极小，或两侧都低于初态的断连鞍点），若是，就从最低的这类极小重新搜索，至多两次。
systems_en: Target test: 10 cases, the two hand-built round-113 trial IS (ethoxy on Pd(100), isobutene π-complex in H-CHA) plus 8 G-FACTORY dev IS perturbed onto higher minima; control runs from the unperturbed design IS. Trigger test: 12 unperturbed GF3 dev set IS (metal surfaces and zeolites).
systems_zh: 目标检验：10 个测试例——第 113 轮的两个手搭试用初态（Pd(100) 上的乙氧基、H-CHA 中的异丁烯 π 络合物）与 8 个被扰动到更高极小的 G-FACTORY 开发集初态；对照从未扰动的设计初态出发。触发检验：12 个未扰动的 GF3 开发集初态（金属表面与分子筛）。
result_en: Target step found in 1/10 cases (only the H-CHA protonation, after 37,668 calls) versus ≥ 70 % required; plain runs 0/10. From the design IS the same command found the step 8/8 (829–3,876 calls), so the failure lies in locating the right floor. It also triggered on 4/12 unperturbed IS (≤ 2 allowed), adding 55 % calls. Original sessions stayed identical. Not merged.
result_zh: 目标步只在 1/10 个测试例中找到（要求 ≥ 70 %），普通运行 0/10；从设计初态出发同一命令 8/8 找到，可见失败在于找不到正确的谷底。在 12 个未扰动初态上触发 4 次（允许 ≤ 2），多花 55 % 调用。原会话不变，未合并。

name_en: Matcher audit: is U honest? (MATCHER AUDIT)
idea_en: A census can count one household twice because it was logged at two nearby addresses, or merge two look-alike neighbours. Here two saddles count as one only when both TS and downhill product agree (RMSD ≤ 0.1 Å, max deviation ≤ 0.25 Å, energies within 0.02 eV, under IS symmetry operations and atom permutations); the audit replayed this matcher on archived grand-final runs and checked sampled pairs with NEP89.
idea_zh: 人口普查可能因门牌略有出入把一户数两次，也可能把两户相像的邻居并成一户。匹配器只在过渡态与下坡产物都吻合（RMSD ≤ 0.1 Å、最大偏差 ≤ 0.25 Å、能量差 ≤ 0.02 eV，允许初态对称与原子置换）时才算同一鞍点；本轮在总决赛归档上重放并用 NEP89 抽样核对。
systems_en: No new searches. Archived GF4 runs (3,410; ALL109 = 36 GF3 + 6 G5 + 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS, plus 33 G-FACTORY dev IS) and GF5 runs (2,890; P62 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS, plus the 109-IS continuity set), the 913-saddle census on the 36 GF3 IS, and 440 sampled pairs checked against NEP89 ground truth.
systems_zh: 不跑新搜索。重放 GF4 归档（3,410 次运行；ALL109 = 36 个 GF3 + 6 个 G5 + 67 个 G-FACTORY 封存初态，另有 33 个 G-FACTORY dev 初态）与 GF5 归档（2,890 次运行；P62 = 62 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存初态，另有 109 个初态的连续性组），以及 36 个 GF3 初态上 913 个鞍点的普查；440 对用 NEP89 真值核对。
result_en: Zero false splits in per-run U across all 6,300 runs (e.g. `long-best` 0/935 saddles on GF4 ALL109, 95 % upper bound 0.41 %). Corrected GF4 ratio `long-best`/standard ASE dimer 6.550 → 6.515 (−0.53 % [−1.70, 0.00]); all GF5 ratios unchanged. Classifier matched NEP89 truth on 438/440 pairs. A matcher without symmetry/permutation would inflate ASE-dimer U by up to 13.7 %. U is honest; nothing changed.
result_zh: 6,300 次运行中 U 的假拆分为 0（`long-best` 0/935）；校正后 GF4 `long-best`/ASE dimer 6.550 → 6.515（−0.53 %），GF5 不变；NEP89 核对一致 438/440。U 可信，无改动。

name_zh: 共享记忆的预设接力链
idea_en: Two mountain guides walk the same valley in turn, sharing one notebook so the second does not re-log passes the first already found. `explore --complete` runs a chain of searches in one output directory, each step resuming from the previous step's memory and switching preset (metals: `long-best` then `long-best-auto`; zeolites: the reverse; no truncation, chosen on development IS), and writes one union report.
idea_zh: 两位向导轮流走同一片山谷、共用一本笔记，后一位不再重记已找到的山口。`explore --complete` 在同一目录里串行运行共享记忆的搜索链，每步从上一步记忆续跑并换预设（金属先 `long-best` 后 `long-best-auto`，分子筛相反），写出并集报告。
systems_en: Chain order chosen on 69 development IS (36 GF3 + 33 G-FACTORY dev). Confirmation on 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal surfaces + 20 zeolites), 1 seed, three arms: the chain, one `long-best-auto` run, and the old `long-complete`.
systems_zh: 在 69 个开发初态（36 个 GF3 + 33 个 G-FACTORY dev）上选定链的顺序；在 62 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存初态（42 个金属表面 + 20 个分子筛）上确认，1 个种子，三臂：接力链、一次 `long-best-auto`、旧 `long-complete`。
result_en: Confirmation: versus one `long-best-auto` run the chain gave 1.217× [1.152, 1.290] saddles per command but U/call 0.750× [0.714, 0.785], below the required 0.80, so H1 failed: more saddles, each costing more calls. Versus the old `long-complete`: 1.442× [1.314, 1.599] saddles and U/call 1.273× [1.160, 1.404], p < 0.00025. `long-complete` was not redefined; `--complete` shipped as an opt-in command in v0.71.
result_zh: 确认：较单次 `long-best-auto`，鞍点 1.217 倍，U/调用 0.750 倍 [0.714, 0.785]，低于 0.80 门槛；较旧 `long-complete` 为 1.273 倍。v0.71 以可选 `--complete` 发布。

name_zh: 分子筛逐发射选行走器
idea_en: A driver checks how steep the pass is before choosing a vehicle: low passes in the nimble car, high ones in the heavy truck. On zeolite IS the new option `search_engine_split` lets each launch pick its walker from its own bond scan: Sella when the scan top lies more than 1.0 eV above the IS, the dimer otherwise (rule E1, selected on development zeolites).
idea_zh: 司机先看山口多陡再选车：低山口开灵活的小车，高山口换重卡。新选项 `search_engine_split` 让分子筛上的每次发射按自己的键长扫描选行走器：扫描顶点比初态高 1.0 eV 以上用 Sella，否则用 dimer（规则 E1，在开发集分子筛上选出）。
systems_en: Development: 20 zeolite IS (17 GF3 + 3 G-FACTORY dev), 1 seed. Confirmation: 36 held-out zeolite IS (15 sealed G-FACTORY, 1 G5 H-MWW, 20 sealed G-FACTORY-2) × 2 seeds = 144 sessions, rule E1 versus `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：20 个分子筛初态（17 个 GF3 + 3 个 G-FACTORY dev），1 个种子。确认：36 个留出分子筛初态（15 个 G-FACTORY 封存、1 个 G5 H-MWW、20 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存）× 2 个种子 = 144 次会话，规则 E1 对 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation: U/call 1.117× [1.054, 1.182], p = 0.00025 (H1 passed), but adsorbate saddles per call 0.974× [0.898, 1.051] (H2 failed). The gain came entirely from no-bond-change reorientations (7 → 49); adsorbate saddles fell 11 %, and wall-clock rose 1.85× on average (2–4× on MFI). Shipped as an opt-in option in v0.74; `long-best-auto` unchanged.

idea_en: A surveyor hired to find passes below a client's height limit can stop climbing once he is above it: that route is already ruled out. CAP-EXIT (`drive_scan_cap_exit`) ends a relaxed bond scan at the first stage above the preset's energy cap, because the launch would be skipped anyway. Two riskier shortcuts were also tested: ending the scan early at the energy turn, and ending each stage's relaxation once it stops descending.
idea_zh: 受托只找低于某高度山口的测量员，一旦爬过该高度即可停下。CAP-EXIT（`drive_scan_cap_exit`）让松弛键长扫描在第一次超过预设能量帽的那一级结束，因为该发射反正会被跳过。另测两种更冒险的捷径：能量转折处提前结束扫描、每级弛豫一停止下降就结束。
systems_en: Replay of 2,488 archived scans from the 69 development IS; sessions on the same 69 IS (36 GF3 + 33 G-FACTORY dev, metal surfaces and zeolites) × 2 seeds per arm with `long-best`, `long-best-auto`, `long-lowbarrier-auto` and `long-kinetic-auto`. No held-out pool, so all numbers are development numbers.
systems_zh: 回放 69 个开发初态上归档的 2,488 个扫描；会话在同样 69 个初态（36 个 GF3 + 33 个 G-FACTORY dev，金属表面与分子筛）上，每臂 2 个种子，预设 `long-best`、`long-best-auto`、`long-lowbarrier-auto`、`long-kinetic-auto`。无留出池，均为开发集数字。
result_en: Development numbers. CAP-EXIT changed no skip decision in the replay and kept identical final saddle lists in 276/276 session pairs, while U/call rose 1.040× [1.031, 1.050] for `long-lowbarrier-auto` and 1.037× [1.026, 1.048] for `long-kinetic-auto` (scan calls −12.3 % / −11.8 %). The turn exit was rejected; the stage-stall exit failed (0.964× on `long-best`, 1.047× n.s. on `long-best-auto`). CAP-EXIT is on in capped presets since v0.71.
result_zh: 开发集：CAP-EXIT 不改变跳过判定，276/276 对会话鞍点列表相同；两个带帽预设 U/调用 1.040 倍 [1.031, 1.050] 与 1.037 倍 [1.026, 1.048]。另两种捷径失败。v0.71 起带帽预设默认开启。

idea_en: Bake the same recipe in two kitchens, restart it halfway, or use a cold oven instead of a warm one: is the cake identical? The round re-ran identical commands on two nodes, with cold versus warm JAX compile caches, after a hard kill plus resume, and with 4 versus 8 workers, and compared answers bit by bit and at the level of decisions.
idea_zh: 同一份菜谱在两间厨房做、做到一半重来、冷烤箱换热烤箱，蛋糕还一样吗？本轮把同一条命令在两个节点上、冷/热 JAX 编译缓存下、强制中断后续跑、4 与 8 个 worker 下重复运行，逐位并在决策层面比较答案。
systems_en: 12 IS (6 metal surfaces, 6 zeolites; GF3 and G-FACTORY dev, metals deliberately enriched in budget-limited rescues) × 3 presets (`long-best`, `long-best-auto`, `long-lowbarrier-auto`) = 36 cells, 1 seed.
systems_zh: 12 个初态（6 个金属表面、6 个分子筛；来自 GF3 与 G-FACTORY dev，金属有意多选救援因预算结束的体系）× 3 个预设（`long-best`、`long-best-auto`、`long-lowbarrier-auto`）= 36 个单元，1 个种子。
result_en: The pre-registered target (≥ 95 % bitwise identical) failed: same node 35/35 and other node 71/72, but cold vs warm cache 31/36, kill + resume 22/36, 4 vs 8 workers 15/24 (24/24 at decision level). Causes: rescue budgets priced with the measured exact-Hessian cost, a resume bug (fixed), kernel padding (last bits ≤ 4.7e-13). Opt-in `budget_exact_charge=47` gave 24/24 identical but is not archive-neutral (8/131), so not a default.
result_zh: 未达预注册的 ≥ 95 % 逐位相同：跨节点 71/72，但冷/热缓存 31/36、中断续跑 22/36、4 对 8 worker 15/24（决策层 24/24）。续跑缺陷已修复；可选 `budget_exact_charge=47` 达 24/24。

idea_en: A crash-test lab drives the car the way careless owners really do: wrong fuel, doors open, every button pressed. 109 frozen “clumsy user” cases (101 input files: POSCAR/CONTCAR names, empty files, missing cells, unusual constraints, magnetism, wrong units, interrupts, ase.build slabs, IZA CIF frameworks) went through the default command; every crash or unclear message was fixed with input checks, a relaxation fallback and clearer errors.
idea_zh: 像碰撞实验室照粗心车主的习惯开车：加错油、乱按按钮。109 个“粗心用户”用例（POSCAR/CONTCAR 文件名、空文件、缺晶胞、少见约束、磁性、单位错误、中断、ase.build 板模型、IZA CIF）走默认命令；崩溃与含糊报错靠输入预检、弛豫回退和清楚报错修复。
systems_en: 109 cases built from G-FACTORY dev IS, GF3 IS (S1 methoxy/Cu(111), Z1 two methanol/H-CHA, X1 n-butane/H-MFI, NH3/Ru(0001), water/H-FER), ase.build slabs (e.g. CO/Pt(111), C2H4/Ni(111)) and IZA CIF zeolites (CHA, MOR, FER); default command (`long-best-auto`), at most 6 launches. No efficiency comparison.
systems_zh: 109 个用例取自 G-FACTORY dev 初态、GF3 初态（S1 甲氧基/Cu(111)、Z1 两个甲醇/H-CHA、X1 正丁烷/H-MFI、NH3/Ru(0001)、水/H-FER）、ase.build 板模型（如 CO/Pt(111)、C2H4/Ni(111)）与 IZA CIF 分子筛（CHA、MOR、FER）；默认命令（`long-best-auto`），最多 6 次发射。不做效率比较。
result_en: Before the fixes: 2 crashes, 27 unclear errors, 2 silently wrong behaviours, 21 clear errors, 57 OK. After (all 109 re-run): 0 crashes, 0 unclear, 0 silent, 48 clear errors, 61 OK. Worst finds: inputs named POSCAR/CONTCAR always failed, resume after an interrupted preparation never worked, some constraints were silently dropped. Valid-input results unchanged (55 NEP cases gave the same saddles); shipped in v0.67.
result_zh: 修复前：崩溃 2、含糊报错 27、静默错误 2、明确报错 21、OK 57；修复后（全部重跑）：前三类均为 0，明确报错 48、OK 61。最严重：名为 POSCAR/CONTCAR 的文件一律失败、准备中断后无法续跑。有效输入结果不变，v0.67 发布。

idea_en: A mining manager moves money from tapped-out mines to ones still producing. For a batch of IS screened together, two greedy index policies (pooled dry-spell hazard; hazard shrunk toward the IS's own recent yield) decided where the next calls go (new launch, rescue walk or memory re-search), simulated offline on archived launch-level records.
idea_zh: 矿场经理把资金从挖空的矿转给仍在出矿的矿。对一起筛选的一批初态，用两种贪心指数策略（合并的“空窗”风险率；向本初态近期产率收缩的风险率）决定下一批力调用给谁（新发射、救援重走或带记忆的再搜索），在归档的逐发射记录上离线模拟。
systems_en: Offline only (0 NEP calls): archived launch-level records of the 36 GF3 IS (metal surfaces and zeolites) × 3 replicate batches = 108 sessions under `long-best` rules; budgets 0.5×, 1× and 2× the independent sessions' calls. The planned NEP confirmation on 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS was not run.
systems_zh: 纯离线（0 次 NEP 调用）：36 个 GF3 初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 3 个重复批次 = 108 个会话的归档逐发射记录，`long-best` 规则；预算为独立会话调用数的 0.5、1、2 倍。原定在 67 个 G-FACTORY 封存初态上的 NEP 确认未运行。
result_en: At the same total budget, total U versus independent sessions: pooled-hazard policy 0.985× [0.904, 1.049], own-yield policy 0.875× [0.793, 0.955], below the 1.10× gate, so the idea was killed offline; even a perfect-foresight oracle reached only 1.109×. Most sessions end by exhausting coordinates (60/108), the dead tail is 18.4 % of calls, and purchasable extensions cost 2–10× more per saddle. No code change.
result_zh: 同等预算下总 U 相对独立会话：V1 0.985 倍 [0.904, 1.049]、V2 0.875 倍 [0.793, 0.955]，未达 1.10 倍门槛，离线终止；完全预知上界也仅 1.109 倍。多数会话因坐标耗尽结束（60/108）。不改代码。

name_zh: 超大模型上的默认命令
idea_en: Load-testing a bridge with trucks far heavier than everyday traffic shows which beam gives way first. The default command and `long-best` were run on six oversized models with 2,943–9,243 free coordinates; above 2,000 coordinates the fixes now reuse the exact IS certificate instead of a finite-difference check, use the dimer instead of Sella, and compute only the lowest Hessian eigenpair.
idea_zh: 用远超日常车流的重卡给桥做荷载试验，看哪根梁先出问题。默认命令与 `long-best` 在 6 个自由坐标为 2,943–9,243 维的超大模型上运行；修复只在超过 2,000 维时生效：初态资格认证复用精确证书，改用 dimer 而不用 Sella，证书只求最低本征对。
systems_en: Six ASE-built huge IS: Pt(111) 18×18×4 and 32×32×4 with ethoxy + H, Pt(111) 26×26×4 with ethanol, a 12-step Cu(211) with CO + H, a doubled H-MFI cell with ethanol + water, a fourfold H-FAU cell with two methanol; 1 seed, at most 8 launches, one core, 2.5 h cap. Bit-identity check on 6 GF3 IS.
systems_zh: 6 个用 ASE 搭建的超大初态：Pt(111) 18×18×4 与 32×32×4 上的乙氧基 + H、26×26×4 上的乙醇、12 条台阶的 Cu(211) 上的 CO + H、两倍晶胞 H-MFI 中的乙醇 + 水、四倍晶胞 H-FAU 中的两个甲醇；1 个种子，最多 8 次发射，单核，2.5 h 上限；另在 6 个 GF3 初态上核对逐位一致。
result_en: Baseline v0.65 finished only 2 of 18 runs in 2 h: Sella's dense algebra stalled on every metal, finite-difference IS checks on zeolites ran out of budget or time, and the finite-difference fallback needed 15.0× more calls; memory was never the first failure. After the fixes: 12/12 runs finished within 2.5 h (peak ≤ 14 GB), and GF3 sessions stayed bit-identical (12/12). Shipped in v0.75.
result_zh: 基线 v0.65 在 2 h 内 18 次运行只完成 2 次：金属上 Sella 稠密代数卡住，分子筛有限差分初态检查超预算或超时，内存从未先出问题。修复后 12/12 在 2.5 h 内完成，GF3 会话 12/12 逐位相同，v0.75 发布。

name_zh: 一步到 DFT 的交接包
idea_en: Before a colleague re-walks your route with a better map, you hand over a ready-to-use kit, not a sticky note. The DFT hand-off folder that every run writes was audited and rewritten: grouped POSCAR with an atom-order map, KPOINTS, POTCAR list, complete VASP INCARs (IBRION=44, VTST dimer, CI-NEB, relaxation, frequencies), CP2K input, nine NEB images with the TS in the middle, and a README flagging what to check first.
idea_zh: 请同事用更好的地图（DFT）重走你的路线，要交给他现成的装备，而非一张便条。本轮审计并重写 DFT 交接目录：分组 POSCAR 与原子顺序表、KPOINTS、POTCAR 清单、完整 VASP INCAR、CP2K 输入、过渡态居中的 9 个 NEB 图像及先查项说明。
systems_en: Audit of 20 archived `long-best` runs with 120 saddles (10 metal surfaces, 10 zeolites; GF3 and G-FACTORY dev IS); NEP89 re-check of 10 pre-registered saddles. No new searches and no DFT calculations.
systems_zh: 审计 20 个归档 `long-best` 运行中的 120 个鞍点（10 个金属表面、10 个分子筛；GF3 与 G-FACTORY dev 初态）；预注册的 10 个鞍点用 NEP89 复核。不跑新搜索，也不做任何 DFT 计算。
result_en: Old hand-off: 16 of 20 checks failed (e.g. repeated element lines in 101/120 POSCARs, MODECAR pointing toward the IS in 65/120, CP2K setups that abort on 18 odd-electron metal saddles, no KPOINTS or NEB images). After: 0 failures; output outside the hand-off folder byte-identical; NEP89 re-check 10/10 (mode |cos| minimum 0.9999999999995, NEB frame energies within 4.5e-13 eV). Zero force calls; shipped in v0.69.
result_zh: 旧交接 20 项检查 16 项失败（如 101/120 个 POSCAR 元素行重复、65/120 个 MODECAR 指向初态侧）；修复后 0 项失败，其余输出逐字节不变，NEP89 复核 10/10。0 次力调用，v0.69 发布。

idea_en: A patient who already has an MRI should not also be sent for a blurry X-ray nobody will read. Exact-Hessian presets computed a finite-difference IS Hessian during preparation (2 × 3N force calls) although the session then recomputes the exact one; the option `prepare_fd_hessian="if-needed"` skips it whenever the exact IS certificate has passed, keeping only the exact eigenvalues.
idea_zh: 做过核磁共振的病人，不必再拍没人看的模糊 X 光片。精确 Hessian 预设在准备阶段算有限差分初态 Hessian（2 × 3N 次力调用），而会话会重算精确 Hessian；选项 `prepare_fd_hessian="if-needed"` 在精确证书通过时跳过它。
systems_en: 40 development IS (all 20 zeolites: 17 GF3 + 3 G-FACTORY dev; 20 metal surfaces: 10 GF3 + 10 G-FACTORY dev) × {base, new} with `long-best-auto`, 1 seed; plus 6 `long-best` rescue sessions, 5 depth-2 reaction networks, 6 large models (1,305–1,791 free coordinates) and 10 perturbed inputs. No held-out pool (decision-preserving change).
systems_zh: 40 个开发初态（全部 20 个分子筛：17 个 GF3 + 3 个 G-FACTORY dev；20 个金属表面：GF3 与 G-FACTORY dev 各 10 个）× {基线, 新}，`long-best-auto`，1 个种子；另有 6 个 `long-best` 救援会话、5 个两层反应网络、6 个大模型（1,305–1,791 维）与 10 个扰动输入。无留出池（决策保持的改动）。
result_en: Development numbers. Preparation calls fell 29,920 → 40 (−99.87 %) with launch-identical sessions (40/40, rescues 6/6, networks 5/5) and the same U (282 = 282); per-search all-charged U/call 1.053× [1.042, 1.068] (noise-free 1.048× [1.037, 1.063]). On large models preparation dropped from 21,142 to 6 calls and from 1,028 to 99 s. Set in all exact `long-*` presets in v0.70.
result_zh: 开发集：准备调用 29,920 → 40（−99.87 %），会话逐发射相同（40/40）；每次搜索全计费 U/调用 1.053 倍 [1.042, 1.068]。大模型准备 21,142 → 6 次调用。v0.70 起精确 `long-*` 预设开启。

name_en: Fair, tuned baselines with exact certificates (BASELINE-FAIRNESS)
name_zh: 精确证书下的最强诚实基线（BASELINE-FAIRNESS）
idea_en: A fair race gives every runner the same shoes and lets each find their best pace before the starting gun. The ASE dimer, TSASE κ-dimer and Sella multi-start baselines all received long-best's exact-Hessian validator and accounting, had their working points (start displacement, step and launch caps, dry-stop) grid-tuned on development initial states, and were frozen for grand final GF6; one pre-registered test pitted long-best-auto against the strongest.
idea_zh: 公平的赛跑要让选手穿同样的跑鞋，并先各自找到最佳配速。本轮给 ASE dimer、κ-dimer 和 Sella 多起点基线配上 long-best 的精确 Hessian 验证器与计费，在开发集上网格调参后冻结留给 GF6；预注册检验 long-best-auto 对最强基线。
systems_en: 69 development IS (GF3 dev set of 36 = EARLY + GEN3 + GEN4, plus 33 G-FACTORY dev; metal surfaces and zeolites): grid tuning on 60 of them (the 9 MFI IS left out), then the single test on all 69 with 2 seeds. Sealed and confirmation sets untouched.
systems_zh: 69 个开发初态（GF3 开发集 36 个 + G-FACTORY dev 33 个；金属表面与分子筛）：先在其中 60 个（去掉 9 个 MFI）上网格调参，再在全部 69 个上用 2 个种子做唯一检验；封存集与确认集未动用。
result_en: Development set, per-run U/call: long-best-auto vs the best frozen baseline (Sella with a 0.10 Å displaced start) 1.645× [1.405, 1.952], p < 1/4000; two-seed union 1.292× [1.114, 1.511]. U_ads/call 3.41×, but U(≤1.5 eV)/call 1.00× [0.80, 1.29], a tie. The exact validator alone made legacy Sella 4.20× more efficient, so GF5's 6.4× was largely a validator mismatch. No default change.
result_zh: 开发集 U/调用：long-best-auto 对最强基线 Sella 1.645 倍 [1.405, 1.952]，p < 1/4000；U(≤1.5)/调用持平。仅换精确验证器旧 Sella 就提效 4.20 倍，GF5 的 6.4 倍主要是验证器失配。

name_en: Which parts make the workflow fast (ABLATION)
name_zh: 新工作流为何快：组分消融（ABLATION）
idea_en: Like a pit crew swapping one part at a time between a stock car and a race car to see which part wins the lap time. A 2⁴ factorial design switched four components between the standard ASE dimer workflow (ASE-std) and long-best-auto — start (random probes vs bond-drive scans), engine (ASE dimer vs Sella/metric dimer), session rules, and validator (finite-difference vs exact certificates) — and split the U/call ratio by Shapley decomposition.
idea_zh: 像在普通车和赛车之间一次只换一个部件，看哪个部件缩短了圈速。本轮用 2⁴ 析因设计，在传统 ASE dimer 流程（ASE-std）与 long-best-auto 之间切换起点、引擎、会话规则和验证器（有限差分/精确证书），用 Shapley 分解拆开 U/调用 比值。
systems_en: 24 development IS (12 metal surfaces + 12 zeolites) drawn by hash from the GF3 dev set and G-FACTORY dev; 27 arms, 2 runs per arm and IS, 1,070 runs in all. Development data only; descriptive round.
systems_zh: 按哈希从 GF3 开发集与 G-FACTORY dev 选出 24 个开发初态（金属表面 12、分子筛 12）；27 组，每组每初态 2 次运行，共 1,070 次；只用开发集，描述性轮次。
result_en: Development set, per-run U/call long-best-auto / ASE-std 14.90× [11.15, 22.29]. Shapley shares: engine 3.68× (48 %), validator 2.61× (36 %), start 2.19× (29 %), session rules 0.71× (−13 %). With the same exact validator on both sides the gap is 7.53× [5.43, 11.80] (metals 20.8×, zeolites 4.92×). Starts raise yield; engine and validator cut cost. Descriptive; nothing adopted.
result_zh: 开发集 U/调用：long-best-auto 对 ASE-std 14.90 倍 [11.15, 22.29]；分解：引擎 3.68 倍、验证器 2.61 倍、起点 2.19 倍、会话规则 0.71 倍。同用精确验证器时仍差 7.53 倍。描述性，未采纳。

name_en: Stop paying for Hessian timing samples (FCE-LITE)
idea_en: Like a courier who used to bill customers for five timed practice runs before quoting each delivery, and now times one run and keeps the quote on file. Exact-Hessian sessions priced each Hessian in force-call equivalents by timing 21 force calls and five extra Hessians, all charged; FCE-LITE takes one steady-state sample and caches the price per system size and machine, while a budget offset keeps every search decision identical.
idea_zh: 像快递员以前每次报价前都要试跑五趟、试跑费还记在客户账上，现在只试跑一趟并存档报价。精确 Hessian 会话原本计时 21 次力调用和 5 个额外 Hessian 来折算力调用当量并全部计费；FCE-LITE 只取 1 个稳态样本，按体系规模与机器缓存，搜索决定不变。
systems_en: 40 development IS (all 20 zeolites + 20 metal surfaces from the GF3 dev set and G-FACTORY dev), one session each with pinned charges, under 4 exact-Hessian presets (long-best, long-best-auto, long-lowbarrier-auto, long-kinetic-auto). No held-out pool: the claim is decision identity.
systems_zh: 40 个开发初态（GF3 开发集与 G-FACTORY dev 中全部 20 个分子筛 + 20 个金属表面），每个 1 次会话、计费固定，4 个精确 Hessian 预设；主张是决策逐发射相同，因此不设留出池。
result_en: Development set: 240/240 session pairs launch-by-launch identical, U unchanged. Pooled U/call: long-best 1.0155 [1.0128, 1.0195], long-best-auto 1.0162 [1.0128, 1.0218], long-lowbarrier-auto 1.0274 [1.0238, 1.0322], long-kinetic-auto 1.0429 [1.0379, 1.0491]. Mean per-session saving 2.42–5.00 %; every session saves the same fixed amount, so short sessions gain most. Small but free; merged (v0.73) for all exact presets.
result_zh: 开发集：240/240 对会话逐发射相同，U 不变；long-best-auto U/调用 1.0162 倍 [1.0128, 1.0218]，四个精确预设 1.0155–1.0429 倍，每会话平均省 2.42–5.00 % 调用。零代价，v0.73 合并。

name_en: Skip chemical signatures that never pay (SIG-SKIP)
name_zh: 跳过从不出鞍点的签名（SIG-SKIP）
idea_en: A prospector stops digging at kinds of spots where tens of thousands of earlier digs never struck gold. A frozen skip table (23 local chemical-signature keys plus 4 post-scan strata), learned from 39k archived launches, marks bond-drive coordinates that never produced a saddle: signature hits are skipped before scanning at zero force calls, and scans landing in the strata release no walker (option drive_skip_list).
idea_zh: 淘金者不再去挖前人挖过几万次都一无所获的那类地点。本轮把从 3.9 万次存档发射学到的冻结跳过表（23 个局部化学签名键 + 4 个扫描后分层）接入预设：命中签名的键驱动坐标不扫描、0 次力调用直接跳过；扫描落入分层的不再放出行走者（选项 drive_skip_list）。
systems_en: Confirmation only: 73 sealed IS = C1 (67 G-FACTORY sealed + 6 G5; 57 metal, 16 zeolite), one paired session per arm, 4 arms (long-best and long-best-auto, each with and without the table). The table had been fitted beforehand on archived launches.
systems_zh: 只在确认集上运行：73 个封存初态 = C1（G-FACTORY sealed 67 + G5 6；金属 57、分子筛 16），4 臂（long-best、long-best-auto 各开/关跳过表），每臂每初态 1 次配对会话；跳过表事先由存档发射拟合。
result_en: Confirmation (C1, 73 IS): long-best U/call 1.0342× [1.014, 1.055], p 0.0005, U 292 → 288; long-best-auto 1.0553× [1.038, 1.074], p < 0.00025, U 288 → 287; Holm passed, all guards held. About 2 points of the auto gain is Hessian-pricing noise (denoised 1.0355×, from zeolites only). Skip precision 97.1 % (target 98.5 %). Merged into both presets (v0.71).
result_zh: 确认集 C1：long-best U/调用 1.0342 倍 [1.014, 1.055]，p = 0.0005，U 292 → 288；long-best-auto 1.0553 倍，约 2 个百分点是计费噪声。护栏全过，两预设均合并（v0.71）。

name_en: Sealed initial states built without known TSs (IS-FIRST SET)
name_zh: 不借已知过渡态的封存初态集（IS-FIRST SET）
idea_en: Earlier held-out exams were written by people who already knew the answers: every IS came from a saddle found first. This set is like questions from a stranger. 24 initial states were made the way a user would, placing molecules on surfaces or in pores with dimer-explore adsorb (default options, lowest certified member), rejected only by pre-registered physical checks, never searched, then sealed.
idea_zh: 以前的留出考题都出自已知答案的人：每个初态都先有一个已找到的鞍点。这次像请陌生人出题：用 dimer-explore adsorb 按用户的方式把分子放到表面或孔道里（默认选项、取能量最低的认证成员），只按预注册的物理检查剔除，从不运行鞍点搜索，然后封存。
systems_en: 24 sealed IS-first initial states: 14 metal (alkenes 4, oxygenates 5, amine 1, co-adsorbates 4; new facets such as Ir(311), Au(311)) and 10 zeolite (oxygenates 5, hydrocarbons 4, probe 1), with seven frameworks never used before (BEC, CON, EMT, ISV, IWR, RHO, STI); every host–guest pair is new. 35 candidates, 31 qualified.
systems_zh: 24 个封存初态（IS-first）：金属 14 个（烯烃 4、含氧物 5、胺 1、共吸附 4；新晶面如 Ir(311)、Au(311)），分子筛 10 个（含氧物 5、烃 4、探针分子 1），含 7 种首次使用的骨架（BEC、CON、EMT、ISV、IWR、RHO、STI）；宿主–客体组合全部是新的。35 个候选，31 个合格。
result_en: Built 24 sealed IS (14 metal, 10 zeolite); 4 of 35 candidates rejected; no searches run, so no efficiency ratio. The set keeps what TS-first sets excluded by construction: NEP89 over-binds carbon guests in zeolites by 2–4 eV, so 9/10 zeolite guests sit more than 2.5 Å from the acid proton; 2 IS cannot be started by bond drives; 1 is an NEP89 σ-complex artefact. Built for grand final GF6.
result_zh: 建成 24 个封存初态，35 个候选剔除 4 个；未搜索，无比值。保留了由已知过渡态反推的旧集合排除的情形：NEP89 对分子筛内含碳客体过度结合 2–4 eV，9/10 个离酸性质子 > 2.5 Å；2 个无法键驱动；1 个是 σ 络合伪影。

idea_en: A recipe book in which every recipe was actually cooked in a fresh kitchen before printing, and every photo shows the real dish. Chinese and English guides are organised by 11 user tasks (surface reactions, zeolites, targeted questions, low-barrier windows, follow-up searches, networks, adsorb, batch, large models, resume, DFT hand-off); every command was run from a clean install and the outputs shown are trimmed real logs.
idea_zh: 像一本每道菜都在新厨房里真做过、配图都是实拍的菜谱。本轮写了按 11 项用户任务组织的中英文指南（表面反应、分子筛、定向提问、低能垒窗口、二次搜索、反应网络、adsorb、批量、大模型、续跑、DFT 交接），每条命令都从全新安装真实运行，展示的输出均为真实日志节选。
systems_en: Small demonstration systems: C2H2 + 2H/Pd(111) (a GEN3 IS of the GF3 set), two methanol/H-CHA (Z1), three CH + O initial states from G-FACTORY dev for the batch example, self-built CH3O/Pt(111) slabs (the 3×3 cell gave U = 0 and became a pitfall example) and a 725-atom CH3O/Pt(111) large-model example.
systems_zh: 小型演示体系：C2H2 + 2H/Pd(111)（GF3 中的 GEN3 初态）、两个甲醇/H-CHA（Z1）、批量示例用的 3 个 G-FACTORY dev CH + O 初态、自建 CH3O/Pt(111) 平板（3×3 胞 U = 0，写成陷阱示例）以及 725 原子的 CH3O/Pt(111) 大模型示例。
result_en: No efficiency test. All 47 dimer-explore commands in the two guides were executed (0 missing). Ten doc/CLI inconsistencies were fixed without changing presets, defaults or search decisions; three were real defects (missing prefactors with exact certificates, late failure of serial-only options with --workers, resume after a kill losing the worker count). Example: C2H2 + 2H/Pd(111) gave 10 saddles in 10,189 calls, 92 s.
result_zh: 无效率检验。两份指南的 47 条 dimer-explore 命令全部实际运行。修复 10 处文档/CLI 不一致，不改预设与搜索决策；其中 3 处是真缺陷：精确证书缺指前因子、串行限定选项配 --workers 报错太晚、中断续跑丢 worker 数。

name_en: Full rescue plus capped wide rescue on metals (RESCUE-COMBINED)
name_zh: 贫会话全救援 + 金属宽层救援（RESCUE-COMBINED）
idea_en: A search party that returns nearly empty-handed sends a second guide to re-walk its failed trails; now well-stocked parties on metals also send the guide back, but only along trails whose summit looked low. In long-best, sessions with ≤ 3 bond-changing saddles keep round 78's full Sella rescue, and richer metal sessions add a Sella rewalk of failed launches whose scan top is ≤ 1.0 eV.
idea_zh: 搜索队几乎空手而归时，请第二位向导重走失败的路线；现在金属上收获多的队伍也请向导回去，但只走山口看着不高的路线。long-best 中，键变化鞍点 ≤ 3 个的会话保留第 78 轮的完整 Sella 救援；更富的金属会话另用 Sella 重走扫描顶 ≤ 1.0 eV 的失败发射。
systems_en: Development: 69 IS (GF3 dev set 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33), one session each, used to freeze the setting. Confirmation: C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal, 20 zeolite), one session per arm, never used for selection; reference long-best.
systems_zh: 开发：69 个初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33），每个 1 次会话，用于冻结设置；确认：C2 = 62 个封存 G-FACTORY-2 初态（金属 42、分子筛 20），每臂 1 次会话，从未参与选择；参照 long-best。
result_en: Confirmation on C2: U/call 1.101× [1.055, 1.154], p < 0.00025, U +16.0 % (319 → 370), IS-level recall 59 = 59, all guards held; metals 1.146× [1.082, 1.217], zeolites 1.005× (unchanged by design). Development had shown 1.031×. Wide-tier rewalks cost 947 calls per new saddle. Became part of long-best (v0.74).

name_en: What chemistry does the default workflow find? (SHOWCASE)
name_zh: 默认流程找到了哪些化学（SHOWCASE）
idea_en: After many rounds of timing the climbers, someone finally looks at which mountain passes they reached and asks whether chemists would recognise them. The default command (long-best-auto), a second seed, a follow-up long-best search with memory and a 1.5 eV low-barrier search were run on the project's original reaction panel, and the saddles were compared with the literature's key first steps.
idea_zh: 计时了这么多轮登山者之后，终于有人去看他们到底到达了哪些山口、化学家能否认出来。本轮在项目最初的反应面板上运行默认命令（long-best-auto）、换种子重跑、带记忆的 long-best 二次搜索和 1.5 eV 低能垒搜索，并把找到的鞍点与文献中的关键第一步对照。
systems_en: The original 8-IS panel (EARLY): methoxy/Cu(111), formic acid/Pt(111), ethylene glycol and glycolaldehyde + 2H/Pt(111), two methanol/H-CHA, two ethanol/H-MFI dry and with two water, n-butane/H-MFI; four searches each, plus 13 network-node minima (N-*, N2-*) run once; 45 searches in all.
systems_zh: 项目最初的 8 个初态面板（EARLY）：甲氧基/Cu(111)、甲酸/Pt(111)、乙二醇与乙醇醛 + 2H/Pt(111)、两个甲醇/H-CHA、两个乙醇/H-MFI（干、含两个水）、正丁烷/H-MFI，每个 4 次搜索；另有 13 个网络节点极小（N-*、N2-*）各跑 1 次，共 45 次搜索。
result_en: Descriptive, no ratio. 45/45 searches completed (809,298 calls); metal results identical across seeds (4/4). Only ethylene glycol/Pt(111) O–H scission (0.36 eV) matches the literature's first step; other key steps are not directly connected to these IS, and in zeolites NEP89 gives only proton hops and flagged homolytic steps. One search finds 29 % of the verified saddles in round 116's census, all four together 36 %.
result_zh: 描述性，无比值。45/45 次搜索完成，金属换种子结果相同。只有乙二醇/Pt(111) O–H 断裂（0.36 eV）对上文献第一步；其他关键步骤不与这些初态直连，分子筛上只有质子跳迁和带标记的均裂。单次搜索覆盖第 116 轮普查的 29 %，四次 36 %。

name_zh: 反应网络用 auto 预设（NETWORK-AUTO）
idea_en: Mapping a whole valley system, not one pass: each certified product becomes a new base camp and the search repeats two levels deep. The question was whether the Sella-on-metals presets pay off inside such networks: kinetic networks (1.5 eV window) with long-lowbarrier-auto vs long-lowbarrier, and budgeted networks with long-best-auto vs long-best, the network command's default.
idea_zh: 不只找一个山口，而是绘制整片山谷：每个认证产物成为新营地，再往下搜两层。本轮检验金属上改用 Sella 的 auto 预设在网络里是否划算：动力学网络（1.5 eV 窗口）比较 long-lowbarrier-auto 与原版，预算网络比较 long-best-auto 与原版。
systems_en: 20 root IS chosen by round 119's hash rule (no new selection): 14 metal (6 from the GF3 dev set, 8 G-FACTORY dev) and 6 zeolite (GF3); depth-2 networks, 4 arms, 80 networks. Development sets only, no sealed IS.
systems_zh: 20 个根初态，沿用第 119 轮的哈希规则（不做新选择）：金属 14 个（GF3 开发集 6、G-FACTORY dev 8）、分子筛 6 个（GF3）；深度 2 网络，4 臂共 80 个网络；只用开发集，未用封存初态。
result_en: Kinetic networks: low-barrier network saddles per call (N15/call) 1.258× [0.910, 2.008], p 0.0995, not significant (+65 % saddles for +31 % calls). Budgeted networks, formally untested because the first test failed: 1.062× [0.977, 1.250]; metals 1.346× [1.164, 1.605], zeolites 0.961×. 80/80 networks finished unattended. No default changed. Round 153 later made long-best-auto the network default for metal roots (1.240×, v0.78).
result_zh: 动力学网络：低能垒鞍点/调用 1.258 倍 [0.910, 2.008]，p = 0.0995，不显著（鞍点 +65 %）。预算网络未正式检验：1.062 倍，金属 1.346 倍。默认不变；第 153 轮才把金属根网络改用 long-best-auto。

idea_en: A trail guidebook rewritten from this season's hiker logs rather than routes walked with old gear, telling you after your first climb which second climb is most worth the effort, or to stop. The advisor table that ranks follow-up commands (other engine, new seed, low-barrier, kinetic, long-complete, all with memory; extend on zeolites) was refitted on exact-Hessian-era archives, keyed by the first search's preset and by metal or zeolite.
idea_zh: 像一本按本季登山者真实记录重写的路书：爬完第一次后告诉你第二次最值得爬哪条，或者该停了。本轮用精确 Hessian 时代的存档重新拟合“下一步建议”表，按第一次搜索的预设与金属/分子筛分类，为换引擎、换种子、低能垒、动力学、long-complete（均带记忆）和分子筛续跑排序。
systems_en: Fitting: exact-era archives on the 69 development IS (GF3 dev set 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33) plus 99 new fill-in sessions. Held-out calibration on the grand final GF5 archive: 135 sealed IS = C2 (62 G-FACTORY-2, 2 seeds) + C1 (67 G-FACTORY sealed + 6 G5, 1 seed), 270 units; no new searches on them.
systems_zh: 拟合：69 个开发初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33）的精确时代存档，外加 99 个补跑会话。留出校准用总决赛 GF5 的存档：135 个封存初态 = C2（G-FACTORY-2 62 个，2 个种子）+ C1（G-FACTORY sealed 67 + G5 6，1 个种子），共 270 个单位；未在其上新跑搜索。
result_en: Held-out (135 sealed IS, 270 units): the top-ranked follow-up gave 2.60× [2.19, 3.12] the new saddles per call of the median alternative, p < 0.00025 (12.1× after a first long-best search, 1.04× after long-best-auto). Count predictions fell within ×1.5 for only 25.6 % of units (target 60 %), so they are order-of-magnitude only. Report-only change, merged in v0.74.
result_zh: 留出集（135 个封存初态）：排名第一的后续命令每调用新鞍点为中位替代的 2.60 倍 [2.19, 3.12]，p < 0.00025。数量预测仅 25.6 % 落在 ×1.5 内（目标 60 %），只当数量级。只改报告，v0.74 合并。

name_zh: 第二次纯文档用户试用
idea_en: Give a newcomer flat-pack furniture with only the instruction leaflet and time how long until the first shelf stands. A tester who read only the README, the user guides, `--help` and error messages attempted four tasks on v0.72: a surface C–H scission, a zeolite methylation, the lowest barrier of one bond class via `--ask`, and a memory-assisted second search with DFT hand-off files. Every misleading output found was then fixed.
idea_zh: 像只拿说明书组装家具的新手，看多久装好第一块搁板。测试者只读 README、用户指南、`--help` 和报错信息，在 v0.72 上做四项任务：表面 C–H 断裂、分子筛甲基化、用 `--ask` 求某类键最低能垒、带记忆的二次搜索与 DFT 交接文件；随后修正误导性输出。
systems_en: Two initial states the tester built from the docs: CH3* on a bridge site of Rh(100) (ASE 4×4×4 fcc slab) for the surface, `--ask` and memory tasks, and one methanol in H-FER (IZA framework, acid site from `adsorb --al-site`) for the zeolite task. Benchmark: the first user trial (round 113).
systems_zh: 测试者按文档自建的两个初态：Rh(100) 桥位上的 CH3*（ASE 4×4×4 fcc 板），用于表面、`--ask` 与记忆任务；H-FER 中的一个甲醇（IZA 骨架，酸位由 `adsorb --al-site` 生成），用于分子筛任务。对照第 113 轮的首次用户试用。
result_en: 3 of 4 tasks reached from the docs alone (round 113: 0 of 3). The first certified, IS-connected target TS, a 0.699 eV C–H scission, came 15.5 min after opening the README (round 113: 24.2 min to a first certified TS). Zeolite methylation was not reachable, a NEP89/method limit. No setup blockers; two misleading outputs (metastable IS, skipped `--ask` coordinates) and 10+ minor issues fixed in v0.75.0.
result_zh: 只看文档完成 3/4 项任务（第 113 轮 0/3）；打开 README 15.5 分钟后得到首个认证、直连初态的目标过渡态（第 113 轮 24.2 分钟才有首个认证 TS）。分子筛甲基化受 NEP89/方法所限未达成。安装零阻塞；误导问题已修正。

idea_en: Seal the recipe, the ingredient batches and the oven settings in one box, then ask a stranger in another kitchen to bake the identical cake. The release gained a hashed dependency lock file, a third-party licence inventory, a NEP89 fetch script pinned to a GPUMD commit and checksum, and one script that reruns a 10-session subset in a clean room and compares answers bit for bit.
idea_zh: 像把配方、原料批号和烤箱设置一起封箱，请另一间厨房里的陌生人烤出同一个蛋糕。发布包新增带哈希的依赖锁文件、第三方许可清单、钉住 GPUMD 提交与校验和的 NEP89 下载脚本，以及一条命令在净室中重跑 10 个会话并逐位比对答案的复现脚本。
systems_en: Reproduction subset of 10 sessions: three sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (CH3 dissociation on Pt(311), C2H5 dissociation on W(100), an H hop in LTA zeolite) with `long-best-auto` and the classic ASE dimer, plus CH3/Ni(111) and water/H-FAU from GEN4 with the two-step `--complete` chain. Clean room on another node: fresh venv, hashed install, re-downloaded model.
systems_zh: 10 个会话的复现子集：3 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存初态（Pt(311) 上 CH3 解离、W(100) 上 C2H5 解离、LTA 分子筛中 H 跳跃）×｛`long-best-auto`、经典 ASE dimer｝，加 GEN4 的 CH3/Ni(111) 与水/H-FAU 的两步 `--complete`。净室在另一节点：新 venv、哈希校验安装、重新下载模型。
result_en: The pre-registered test missed: 8/10 answer digests matched in the first clean room, although all 10 saddle sets and force-call and exact-Hessian counts were bit-identical; both misses were `--complete` second steps whose digest embedded an import path and the Python version. With the digest fixed, replication passed 10/10 and the archive check 9/9. The upstream NEP89 file had been rewritten, so the model is now pinned. Shipped in v0.77.0.
result_zh: 预注册检验未过：首个净室答案摘要仅 8/10 相同，但鞍点集合、力调用与精确 Hessian 次数 10/10 逐位相同，差异源于 `--complete` 第二步摘要定义。修正后复制 10/10，归档检查 9/9。上游 NEP89 已被改写，现按提交钉住。

name_en: Do literature steps exist on NEP89? (TARGETED-CHEMISTRY)
name_zh: NEP89 上的文献反应步骤
idea_en: Before blaming the guide for missing famous mountain passes, check whether those passes exist on this particular map. For 19 literature reaction steps of the original eight-system panel, NEP89 was probed directly: targeted network search, constructed products plus CI-NEB checked with the same strict certificate, matching against the saddle census, and the default command rerun from neighbouring minima. Each miss was blamed on the search, the initial state or the potential-energy surface.
idea_zh: 先别怪向导漏掉名山口，先看这张地图上有没有这些山口。针对原始面板 8 个体系的 19 个文献反应步骤直接探查 NEP89：目标网络搜索、构造产物 + CI-NEB 再做同样的严格认证、与鞍点普查比对、从相邻极小重跑默认命令；每个漏掉的步骤归因为搜索、初态或势能面局限。
systems_en: The original panel: methoxy/Cu(111), formic acid/Pt(111), ethylene glycol and glycolaldehyde+2H/Pt(111), n-butane/H-MFI, two methanol/H-CHA, and two ethanol/H-MFI dry and with water (8 IS, 19 target steps), plus neighbouring adsorption minima found during the probe.
systems_zh: 原始面板 8 个初态：甲氧基/Cu(111)、甲酸/Pt(111)、乙二醇与乙醇醛+2H/Pt(111)、正丁烷/H-MFI、两个甲醇/H-CHA、两个乙醇/H-MFI（干燥与含水），共 19 个目标步骤；另含探查中找到的相邻吸附极小。
result_en: Descriptive audit, nothing adopted. Metals: 7 of 8 steps have strict NEP89 saddles (methoxy C–H 0.85 eV, formic acid O–H and C–H 0.20 eV), mostly on neighbouring adsorption variants; the default command from those minima found 3/5, and dissociated products are over-stabilised by 0.4–1 eV. Zeolites: no concerted ionic SN2/E2 saddles; NEP89 inserts spurious free methyl/ethyl minima (+0.44–0.59 eV), making mechanisms stepwise.
result_zh: 描述性审计。金属：8 个步骤中 7 个有严格鞍点（如甲氧基 C–H 0.85 eV），但多在相邻吸附变体上，从那里运行默认命令找到 3/5；解离产物过稳定 0.4–1 eV。分子筛：无协同离子型 SN2/E2 鞍点，NEP89 插入虚假的自由甲基/乙基极小。

name_en: Transplanting found saddles to twin sites (SITE-TRANSPLANT)
name_zh: 把鞍点移植到同类位点
idea_en: A locksmith who has opened one door tries the same pick on the identical doors down the corridor. For each adsorbate saddle a session found, its local displacement was rotated onto chemically equivalent atoms elsewhere (same elements, same first-shell signature), the surroundings were relaxed for at most 20 steps, and a walker was launched there. The pre-registered first step was an offline kill test replaying archived sessions.
idea_zh: 开过一扇门的锁匠，拿同一把钩子去试走廊里一模一样的门。对会话找到的每个吸附物鞍点，把其局部位移旋转映射到别处化学等价的原子上（同元素、同第一壳层特征），周围原子弛豫至多 20 步后在那里发射行走器。预注册的第一步是重放归档会话的离线淘汰检验。
systems_en: Kill test: offline replay of 43 archived `long-best` sessions on 20 development zeolites (17 from the GF3 dev set + 3 G-FACTORY dev). Exploratory, after the kill: 49 development metal IS (GF3 dev + G-FACTORY dev) replayed from archived `long-best-auto` sessions.
systems_zh: 淘汰检验：在 20 个开发集分子筛（GF3 开发集 17 个 + G-FACTORY 开发集 3 个）上离线重放 43 个归档 `long-best` 会话。淘汰后的探索性补充：49 个开发集金属初态（GF3 + G-FACTORY 开发集），续跑归档的 `long-best-auto` 会话。
result_en: Killed at the pre-registered gate: 1,791 transplant launches gave 193 new strict adsorbate saddles, a conversion of 10.8 % (needed ≥ 15 %), at 3,538 calls per new saddle versus 2,868 per saddle in the sessions themselves; 94 % of new saddles carried plausibility flags. Descriptive projection: U/call 0.937 [0.911, 0.973]. Metals looked better (11.2 %, all plausible) and got their own test in round 148m (inconclusive).
result_zh: 未过淘汰门槛：1,791 次移植得到 193 个新严格吸附物鞍点，转化率 10.8 %（需 ≥ 15 %），每个 3,538 次调用，94 % 带可信度标记；投影 U/调用 0.937 [0.911, 0.973]。金属上较好，第 148m 轮另检（不确定）。

name_zh: 分子筛曲率许可搜索半径
idea_en: A hiker past the fence but clearly still on the ridge may keep walking instead of being called back. When a zeolite dimer walker leaves its trust sphere while still on strongly negative curvature (≤ −5 eV/Å²), a check costing no extra calls licenses it to continue to a larger radius: 3.25 → 4.0 Å, or 4.0 → 4.75 Å on top of the default; optionally also for the Sella tail walker.
idea_zh: 徒步者越过围栏但明显仍在山脊上，就让他继续走，不叫回来。分子筛 dimer 行走器离开信赖球时若仍处于强负曲率（≤ −5 eV/Å²），一项零额外调用的检查许可它走到更大半径：3.25 → 4.0 Å，或在默认之上 4.0 → 4.75 Å；可选地也用于 Sella 尾段。
systems_en: 21 development zeolites × 2 sessions: 17 from the GF3 dev set (MFI 9, CHA 6, FAU, FER and MOR 1 each), 3 G-FACTORY dev and 1 G-FACTORY-2 dev. Premise correction: `long-best-auto` already uses 4.0 Å on zeolites, so a 3.25 Å reference arm and a licence on top of the default were added. No confirmation run.
systems_zh: 21 个开发集分子筛 × 2 个会话：GF3 开发集 17 个（MFI 9、CHA 6，FAU、FER、MOR 各 1）、G-FACTORY 开发集 3 个、G-FACTORY-2 开发集 1 个。前提修正：`long-best-auto` 在分子筛上本来就用 4.0 Å，故增设 3.25 Å 参照臂和默认半径上的许可臂。未做确认。
result_en: All three hypotheses failed after Holm correction. Licence vs the 3.25 Å reference: U 1.061 [1.020, 1.104] but U/call 0.975 [0.949, 0.995], failing non-inferiority. Licensing the Sella tail too: U/call 1.000 [0.993, 1.012]. Beyond the default 4.0 Å: U 451 = 451, U/call 0.978 [0.966, 0.988]; 165 licensed walks found nothing. All 17 extra saddles were flagged. Not merged.
result_zh: 三项假设经 Holm 校正全部未过。许可 vs 3.25 Å 参照：U 1.061 倍，但 U/调用 0.975 [0.949, 0.995]，非劣检验未过；默认 4.0 Å 之外 U 不变，U/调用 0.978。多出的 17 个鞍点全带标记。未合并。

idea_en: A championship final on courses no team has seen before, with the same referee and the same fuel meter for everyone. The final default `long-best-auto` (v0.74.0, no search-code changes) faced the strongest honest baselines (Sella, ASE dimer and κ-dimer with random multi-starts, tuned on development sets, frozen, same exact validator), plus legacy configurations, other presets and earlier releases, under a protocol frozen before any sealed run.
idea_zh: 像在没人跑过的赛道上办总决赛，裁判和油表人人相同。最终默认 `long-best-auto`（v0.74.0）对阵最强诚实基线（随机多起点的 Sella、ASE dimer、κ-dimer，开发集调参后冻结，同一精确验证器），并对比遗留配置与早期版本；协议先于封存运行冻结。
systems_en: Primary: 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 IS never run before (35 metal, 18 zeolite; 20 host families) × 2 seeds. Also 24 IS-first IS × 2 seeds, 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS × 1 seed for continuity with GF5, and a ladder of earlier releases (v0.41, v0.49). 2,774 runs, none missing.
systems_zh: 主集合：53 个从未运行过的 G-FACTORY-3 封存初态（金属 35、分子筛 18，20 个宿主族）× 2 个种子；另有 24 个 IS-first 初态 × 2 个种子、62 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存初态 × 1 个种子（与 GF5 衔接），以及早期版本阶梯（v0.41、v0.49）。共 2,774 次运行，无缺失。
result_en: Primary: `long-best-auto` vs the best fair baseline (Sella FAIR), per-run U/call 1.529× [1.350, 1.757], p < 0.00025; 2,093 vs 3,201 calls per saddle, 6.0 vs 1.5 saddles per search. 13 of 14 secondary tests passed (IS-first 2.135×, U_ads 2.33×, legacy ASE 10.1×); the exception, U(≤1.5)/call 1.035× [0.797, 1.318], is a tie. Core-seconds per saddle on a timing subset: 39.4 vs 132.6.
result_zh: 主检验：`long-best-auto` 对最佳公平基线 Sella FAIR 每运行 U/调用 1.529 倍 [1.350, 1.757]，p < 0.00025。次要检验 13/14 通过，唯一例外 U(≤1.5)/调用 1.035 倍，持平。

name_en: Start at the minimum-energy inflection point (MEIP)
idea_en: If a climber keeps starting on slopes that never bend over, move the start to the cheapest spot where the slope stops steepening. For stiff or never-inflecting bond-drive starts, a short SQP using finite-difference third derivatives (at most 27 extra force calls) moved the start to the lowest-energy point on the driven bond's zero-curvature surface before the walker was released; tested first as an offline kill test.
idea_zh: 登山者若总在越走越陡、看不到转折的坡上起步，就把起点挪到坡面由凸转凹那条线上最低的一点。对“僵硬”或从未出现拐点的键驱动起点，用有限差分三阶导数做一小段 SQP（至多 27 次额外力调用），把起点移到被驱动键零曲率面上能量最低的点，再释放行走器；先做离线淘汰检验。
systems_en: Offline kill test on 400 archived bond-drive launches from development sessions (GF3 dev set + G-FACTORY dev, archived `long-best` configurations), each replayed from its forced start with the production code.
systems_zh: 离线淘汰检验：取开发集会话（GF3 开发集 + G-FACTORY 开发集，归档的 `long-best` 配置）中的 400 次键驱动发射，用生产代码从强制起点逐一重放。
result_en: Killed on all three criteria: a minimum-energy inflection point existed for only 40/334 = 12.0 % of triggered launches (needed ≥ 50 %), 0/177 failed launches were converted (needed ≥ 8 %), and 151/157 = 96.2 % of productive ones were kept (needed ≥ 97 %). Only 9/220 starts were truly stiff: stiffness belongs to the coordinate, not the start. Descriptive U/call ×0.933 [0.917, 0.946]; option off.
result_zh: 三项判据均未过：仅 12.0 % 的触发发射有最低能拐点（需 ≥ 50 %），失败发射转化 0/177（需 ≥ 8 %），成功发射保留 96.2 %（需 ≥ 97 %）。僵硬属于坐标而非起点。外推 U/调用 0.933 [0.917, 0.946]；选项关闭。

idea_en: A second searcher with a different flashlight rechecks the spots the first one came back from empty-handed, and goes home once the finds no longer pay for the batteries. `--more` (preset `long-more-auto`) leaves the default search unchanged, then re-walks failed launches from the same start with the other engine under an adaptive Beta-posterior stopping rule, and extends the 120-launch cap to 150 while new saddles keep appearing.
idea_zh: 第一个搜索者空手而归的地方，换一支手电再照一遍，收获抵不上电池钱就收工。`--more`（预设 `long-more-auto`）先跑不变的默认搜索，再用另一种引擎从同一起点重走失败的发射，按自适应 Beta 后验规则停止；仍在出新鞍点时把 120 次发射上限延到 150。
systems_en: Development: 78 IS (36 GF3 dev, 33 G-FACTORY dev, 9 G-FACTORY-2 dev), one command each, vs `long-best-auto`, with `--complete` as a frontier anchor. Confirmation: 78 confirmation-only IS, namely 36 zeolites (15 sealed G-FACTORY, ethanol/H-MWW from G5, 20 sealed G-FACTORY-2) and 42 sealed G-FACTORY-2 metals.
systems_zh: 开发集 78 个初态（GF3 开发集 36、G-FACTORY 开发集 33、G-FACTORY-2 开发集 9），每个一条命令，对照 `long-best-auto`，并以 `--complete` 作前沿锚点。确认集 78 个仅用于确认的初态：36 个分子筛（G-FACTORY 封存 15、G5 的乙醇/H-MWW、G-FACTORY-2 封存 20）与 42 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存金属。
result_en: Confirmation: saddles per command ×1.089 [1.056, 1.127] (5.49 vs 5.04) at U/call 1.004 [0.985, 1.026]; no IS found fewer; wall time 1.1×. Development agreed (×1.089, U/call 0.993), and its exchange rate (−0.078) beat `--complete` (−0.819). But 40 % of the confirmation gain was reorientations without bond changes and U_ads/call was 0.973, so it shipped as opt-in `--more` in v0.76.0, not as default.
result_zh: 确认集：每条命令鞍点 1.089 倍 [1.056, 1.127]，U/调用 1.004 [0.985, 1.026]，无初态少找；开发集一致。但确认增益 40 % 是无键变化的取向翻转，故作为可选 `--more` 随 v0.76.0 发布，非默认。

name_en: Metal network default and --ask skip list
name_zh: 金属网络默认与跳过名单
idea_en: Choose the vehicle by terrain: take the more economical car on metal roads and keep the old one elsewhere. Reaction-network commands without `--preset` now use `long-best-auto` (Sella engine) when the root IS is a metal surface and Sella is installed, and `long-best` otherwise. A second pre-registered check asked whether `--ask` should stop skipping bond coordinates that historically never yielded saddles.
idea_zh: 按路况选车：金属路面换更省油的车，其他照旧。网络命令不写 `--preset` 时，根初态为金属表面且装了 Sella 就用 `long-best-auto`，否则仍用 `long-best`。另一项预注册检验：`--ask` 是否应不再跳过历史上从未产出鞍点的键坐标。
systems_en: Network test (confirmation): 20 sealed G-FACTORY-2 metal roots, depth-2 networks with budget 3, `long-best-auto` vs `long-best`; development replication on 14 metal roots from round 143 (6 GF3 dev + 8 G-FACTORY dev). Skip-list test: 225 development questions on 69 IS (36 GF3 dev + 33 G-FACTORY dev).
systems_zh: 网络检验（确认）：20 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存金属根初态，深度 2、预算 3 的网络，`long-best-auto` 对 `long-best`；开发集复制：第 143 轮的 14 个金属根（GF3 开发集 6 + G-FACTORY 开发集 8）。跳过名单检验：69 个开发集初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY 开发集 33）上的 225 个问题。
result_en: Networks: saddles per force call 1.240× [1.173, 1.329], p < 0.00025, with about the same saddle count (342 vs 344) for 20 % fewer calls (599k → 480k); adsorbate and plausible-saddle guards 1.236× and 1.240×; development replication 1.256×. Became the metal network default in v0.78.0. Skip list: switching it off changed only 4.4 % of answers, none to a same-class event, at 24 % more calls; `--ask` unchanged.
result_zh: 金属网络：鞍点/调用 1.240 倍 [1.173, 1.329]，p < 0.00025，鞍点数相当、调用少 20 %，v0.78.0 起设为默认。跳过名单：关掉后仅 4.4 % 的答案改变且无一是所问键类事件，调用多 24 %，`--ask` 不变。

name_en: Final release verified like a user (RELEASE-CANDIDATE)
name_zh: 最终发布：像用户一样验证
idea_en: A last pre-flight check done from a passenger seat: board as a newcomer, follow only the printed instructions, and confirm the plane flies exactly as on the test flight. Every command in the README and guides was run in a fresh install, default engines and exact Hessians were checked, search results were regression-tested against the grand-final release, and the reproduction subset was rerun in a clean room.
idea_zh: 像起飞前坐在乘客座位上做最后一遍检查：以新人身份登机，只照印好的说明操作，并确认飞机飞得和试飞时一模一样。在全新安装中逐条执行 README 与各指南中的命令，核对默认引擎与精确 Hessian，把搜索结果与总决赛版本做回归比对，并在净室中重跑复现子集。
systems_en: 121 documented commands; default searches on the user-guide examples acetylene+2H/Pd(111) and two methanol/H-CHA; regression on 6 GF3 dev IS (CO+H/Rh(111), CO+O/Pd(100), CO2+2H/Cu(211), water/H-FER, formaldehyde+methanol/H-CHA, water/H-MOR) × {default, `long-best`}; the 10-session reproduction subset (3 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS, CH3/Ni(111), water/H-FAU).
systems_zh: 121 条文档命令；用户指南示例乙炔+2H/Pd(111) 与两个甲醇/H-CHA 上的默认搜索；6 个 GF3 开发集初态（CO+H/Rh(111)、CO+O/Pd(100)、CO2+2H/Cu(211)、水/H-FER、甲醛+甲醇/H-CHA、水/H-MOR）×｛默认、`long-best`｝的回归；10 个会话的复现子集（3 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存初态、CH3/Ni(111)、水/H-FAU）。
result_en: All four checks passed. Of 121 documented commands, 113 passed, 2 were documented refusals, 2 passed after a doc fix and 4 `salloc` lines were replaced by a lease. A fresh install used exact Hessians and Sella by default (29/29 metal walks on Sella). Regression: 12/12 sessions bit-identical to the GF6 release. Clean-room reproduction: 10/10. Three real bugs fixed with tests; released as final v0.78.1.
result_zh: 121 条文档命令：113 条通过、2 条为预期拒绝、2 条改文档后通过、4 条 `salloc` 改用租约；新装环境默认用精确 Hessian 与 Sella；回归 12/12 逐位相同；净室复现 10/10。修复 3 个缺陷，发布最终版 v0.78.1。

name_zh: 构建第四个密封测试集（GFACTORY4-BUILD）
idea_en: Like an exam board writing a fresh sealed paper, with question types never set before, ahead of the next final. Molecule templates (ASE g2/RDKit, screened in the gas phase with NEP89) were placed on new metal facets and zeolite frameworks: TS-first cases got a target elementary step built in and certified, IS-first cases were built with `adsorb`, and a pre-registered stratified hash split dev from sealed IS.
idea_zh: 像考试委员会在总决赛前出一套题型全新的密封试卷。用 ASE g2/RDKit 分子模板（先经 NEP89 气相筛查）在新晶面和新骨架上搭建体系：TS 优先的体系内置目标基元步并认证其鞍点，IS 优先的体系用 `adsorb` 构建；按预注册的分层哈希规则划分开发集与密封集。
systems_en: 84 qualified IS: 61 TS-first (43 metal, 18 zeolite) + 23 IS-first (14 metal, 9 zeolite). 14 new metal surfaces (fcc(331) Rh/Ni/Ir, fcc(531) Rh/Ni, the new fcc(210) facet of Pt/Pd/Rh/Cu, Au(110), Co(0001), Co(10-10), Cu3Pt(111), a Pt/Cu(111) single-atom alloy) and 10 new zeolite frameworks (AFX, LEV, RTH, MFS, ITH, STF, MAZ; GME, HEU, IFR IS-first only). First sulfur, nitrogen, aromatic and C4 chemistry (e.g. H2S, NH3 + O, HCN + H, benzene, pyridine, butanols). Split 12 dev / 72 sealed (pool P1, kept for GF7); only a one-seed smoke test on 8 dev IS.
systems_zh: 84 个合格初态：61 个 TS 优先（金属 43、分子筛 18）+ 23 个 IS 优先（金属 14、分子筛 9）。14 个新金属表面（fcc(331) Rh/Ni/Ir、fcc(531) Rh/Ni、新晶面 fcc(210) Pt/Pd/Rh/Cu、Au(110)、Co(0001)、Co(10-10)、Cu3Pt(111)、Pt/Cu(111) 单原子合金）和 10 个新分子筛骨架（AFX、LEV、RTH、MFS、ITH、STF、MAZ；GME、HEU、IFR 仅 IS 优先）。首次引入含硫、含氮、芳烃和 C4 化学（如 H2S、NH3 + O、HCN + H、苯、吡啶、丁醇）。划分 12 个开发 / 72 个密封（P1 池，留给 GF7）；只在 8 个开发初态上做了单种子冒烟测试。
result_en: TS-first qualification 136/1,284 = 10.6 % [9.0, 12.4], the same as G-FACTORY-3 (ratio 1.01). A plausibility review removed seven chemistries outright, e.g. hydrazine (NEP89 N–N bond 0.068 Å too short) and C4 alkene protonation (free carbocations). All 84 certificates re-read cleanly under the five v0.78.1 long-* presets and the smoke test ran 8/8; the sealed part stayed untouched for GF7.
result_zh: TS 优先合格率 136/1,284 = 10.6 % [9.0, 12.4]，与 G-FACTORY-3 持平（比值 1.01）。审查剔除 7 种不合理化学（如肼：NEP89 的 N–N 键短 0.068 Å）。冒烟 8/8 正常，密封部分留给 GF7。

name_en: Valley-floor walks from the initial state (GE-START)
name_zh: 沿梯度极值谷底线出发（GE-START）
idea_en: A hiker heading up a curving valley to a pass follows the valley floor around the bends instead of climbing straight up the wall. After the bond-drive session, GE-START walked from the initial state in both directions along gradient-extremal curves (Hg = λg) of the two softest adsorbate modes until exactly verified negative curvature appeared, then handed over to the session's saddle engine, aiming at rotations and site hops no bond drive reaches.
idea_zh: 沿弯曲山谷去找山口，应顺着谷底绕弯走，而不是直着爬上谷壁。键驱动会话结束后，GE-START 从初态出发，沿吸附物最软的两个模的梯度极值曲线（Hg = λg，“谷底线”）向两侧行走，直到出现经精确检验的负曲率，再交给会话原有的鞍点搜索器；目标是键驱动到不了的转动和位点跳跃。
systems_en: v1 pilot on the 36-IS GF3 dev set (metals and zeolites); v2 development on 42 dev metal IS (G-FACTORY 30, G-FACTORY-2 8, G-FACTORY-3 4); v3 confirmation on the C1 metals: 57 IS (52 sealed G-FACTORY + 5 G5), one seed. Reference `long-best-auto` (Sella on metals).
systems_zh: v1 试点：GF3 开发集 36 个初态（金属与分子筛）；v2 开发：42 个开发金属初态（G-FACTORY 30、G-FACTORY-2 8、G-FACTORY-3 4）；v3 确认：C1 中的金属 57 个初态（G-FACTORY 密封 52 + G5 5），单种子。参照预设 `long-best-auto`（金属上用 Sella）。
result_en: Confirmation of v3 on C1 metals: +14.7 % saddles per search (U 218 → 250, p 0.00075) but U/call 0.996× [0.958, 1.043], non-inferiority not shown (p 0.095); v1 pilot and v2 development (0.928×) failed. The 32 new saddles, all ≤ 1.5 eV (mostly site hops), cost 1,100 calls each versus 1,068 per saddle for the reference. More saddles at the same price; later bundled into the `--more` preset.
result_zh: v3 在 C1 金属上确认：U/调用 0.996 [0.958, 1.043]，非劣未确证（p 0.095）；每次搜索鞍点 +14.7 %（p 0.00075），新增 32 个全 ≤ 1.5 eV。多给鞍点、效率持平；后并入 `--more` 预设。

name_en: Copying bystander-atom displacements to other sites (SPECTATOR-TEMPLATE-SCAN)
