name_zh: 旁观原子位移模板扫描（SPECTATOR-TEMPLATE-SCAN）
idea_en: A mover who got a sofa through one doorway by shifting the furniture around it pre-arranges the furniture the same way at an identical doorway down the hall. After a saddle was found, its bystander-atom displacement field was mapped (Kabsch + ICP alignment) onto the same-signature bond coordinate at another site, and a relaxed scan started there, with the field applied at once ('initial') or ramped in with scan progress ('ramp').
idea_zh: 搬家工人把沙发挤过一扇门时挪开了周围家具，到走廊里同样的另一扇门前，先把家具照样摆好。找到鞍点后，把其中旁观原子的位移场（Kabsch + ICP 对齐）映射到另一位点上签名相同的键坐标，再从那里做弛豫扫描；位移场或一次放入（initial），或随扫描进度逐级加入（ramp）。
systems_en: H0 only: template scans run as continuations of 78 archived `long-best-auto` sessions on DEV IS (GF3 dev set 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33 + G-FACTORY-2 dev 9; 57 metal and 21 zeolite IS judged separately). Both schedules were killed there, so there were no development or confirmation runs.
systems_zh: 仅做 H0：在 78 个开发初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY 开发 33 + G-FACTORY-2 开发 9；金属 57、分子筛 21，分别判定）的归档 `long-best-auto` 会话上续跑模板扫描。两种进度表都在此被淘汰，未做开发与确认。
result_en: Conversion of template launches into new saddles: metals 6.6 % (initial) / 8.6 % (ramp), zeolites 3.2 % / 5.6 %, below the 10 % kill threshold; a new metal saddle cost 2,438 / 2,295 calls versus 1,369 per saddle in the sessions. Descriptive metal U/call 0.945× [0.926, 0.965] / 0.942× [0.915, 0.974]. Scan tops moved 0.2–0.7 Å, yet walkers mostly fell back to the known saddle.
result_zh: 转化率：金属 6.6 % / 8.6 %（initial / ramp），分子筛 3.2 % / 5.6 %，低于 10 % 门槛；金属 U/调用 0.945 / 0.942 [0.915, 0.974]。顶点虽移 0.2–0.7 Å，行走仍落回已知鞍点。

name_en: Scan-tangent initial mode for the walker (SCAN-TANGENT-MODE)
idea_en: A climber reaching a ridge judges the way across from the last few steps actually taken, not from the compass bearing set at the trailhead. With `search_initial_mode=tangent`, the walker (Sella on metals, dimer on zeolites) starts along the relaxed scan's last path step, x_top − x_top−1, instead of the driven bond direction: a zero-call guess of the lowest mode that already contains the relaxation of the surrounding atoms.
idea_zh: 登山者翻越山脊时，看的是自己最后几步实际走的方向，而不是出发时定的罗盘方位。行走器（金属上 Sella、分子筛上 dimer）改沿弛豫扫描自身的最后一步 x_top − x_top−1 起步，而非被驱动的键方向：零调用，且已包含周围原子的弛豫。
systems_en: Paired replay of 2,358 archived walker launches on 78 DEV IS; development on the 85 DEV-A IS (GF3 dev set 36, G-FACTORY dev 33, G-FACTORY-2 dev 9, G-FACTORY-3 dev 7); confirmation on C3 = 77 IS (53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 24 IS-first; 49 metal, 28 zeolite), one session per IS per arm. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 先在 78 个开发初态上配对回放 2,358 次归档行走发射；开发集为 DEV-A 85 个初态（GF3 开发集 36、G-FACTORY 开发 33、G-FACTORY-2 开发 9、G-FACTORY-3 开发 7）；确认池 C3 = 77 个初态（G-FACTORY-3 密封 53 + IS 优先 24；金属 49、分子筛 28），每个初态每臂一次会话。参照预设 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation on C3: U/call 1.091× [1.036, 1.151], p 0.001; U per ionic step 1.086× [1.032, 1.145]; U_ads/call 1.052. Saddles fell 2.4 % (510 → 498) while calls fell 10.5 %: Sella's first eigensolve dropped from 24.8 to 15.5 calls per walk. The gain is cheaper failed walks, not more saddles (development 1.048× [0.993, 1.100]). Entered the v0.80 default `long-best-auto-80`.
result_zh: C3 确认：U/调用 1.091 [1.036, 1.151]，p 0.001；U/离子步 1.086。鞍点 −2.4 %，调用 −10.5 %：收益来自失败行走变便宜，而非多找鞍点。进入 v0.80 默认 `long-best-auto-80`。

name_en: 2D ridge maps and an H-transfer gate (RIDGE-2D-DRIVES)
idea_en: A guide who sketched a small 2D map around every pass found it too costly, but kept one rule: if the trail has climbed far without ever cresting a ridge, turn back. On metal (Sella) sessions, `drive_transfer_gate=2.0` skips the walker when an H-transfer forming scan ends without crossing a ridge and its top lies ≥ 2.0 eV above the start; 81 % of such tops had no transfer saddle.
idea_zh: 向导本想在每个山口旁先画一张二维小图，结果太贵；只留下一条经验：爬得很高仍没翻过山脊，就掉头。在金属（Sella）会话中，`drive_transfer_gate=2.0` 在氢转移成键扫描未越过脊、且顶点比起点高 ≥ 2.0 eV 时跳过行走；这类顶点 81 % 没有转移鞍点。
systems_en: 2D-map pilot on 32 IS of the GF3 dev set; gate development on 49 DEV metal IS (GF3 metals 19 + G-FACTORY dev 30); confirmation on the C1 metals: 57 IS (52 sealed G-FACTORY + 5 G5), one session per IS per arm. Zeolites (dimer engine) are untouched. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 二维图试点：GF3 开发集中 32 个初态；转移门开发：49 个开发金属初态（GF3 金属 19 + G-FACTORY 开发 30）；确认：C1 中的金属 57 个初态（G-FACTORY 密封 52 + G5 5），每个初态每臂一次会话。分子筛（dimer 引擎）不受影响。参照预设 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Gate confirmation on C1 metals: U/call 1.018× [1.012, 1.026], p < 0.00025; U per ionic step 1.036× [1.019, 1.058]; U −1.4 % (217 → 214, all on one IS); development 1.063×. The 2D-map seed had been killed in the pilot (0.747× [0.699, 0.796], calls +31.5 %). A small confirmed saving; later dropped from all presets (prime suspect for saddle losses on C2/C3 metals; crashed in rescue stages).
result_zh: 转移门 C1 金属确认：U/调用 1.018 [1.012, 1.026]，p < 0.00025；U/离子步 1.036；U −1.4 %。二维图种子在试点被淘汰（0.747）。收益小；后因疑致 C2/C3 金属丢鞍点、救援阶段崩溃，移出所有预设。

name_en: Ranking coordinates by expected saddles per call (SIGNATURE-THOMPSON-ORDER)
name_zh: 按每调用期望鞍点排序坐标（SIGNATURE-THOMPSON-ORDER）
idea_en: A prospector with a fixed budget digs first where similar ground has paid best per hour, and goes home once the best untried spot promises less than half the usual rate. Bond coordinates were ranked by a calibrated hierarchical estimate of new saddles per expected force call for their chemical signature, with a Dinkelbach-index stop at 0.5 × the family-average efficiency (`drive_order_model=h160-v1`, `drive_order_stop=0.5`); the seed Thompson/Gittins ordering alone gave no gain.
idea_zh: 预算有限的探矿者先挖回报率最高的地点，等最好的剩余地点也不到平均回报一半时就收工。按化学签名的分层校准模型，以“每次期望调用的新鞍点数”给键坐标排序，再用 Dinkelbach 指数停止（低于家族平均效率 0.5 倍即停）；种子 Thompson/Gittins 排序本身无益。
systems_en: Zero-call replay prediction, then development on 78 DEV IS (GF3 dev set 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33 + G-FACTORY-2 dev 9) with leave-family-out calibration tables; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal, 20 zeolite), one session per IS per arm. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 先做零调用回放预测，再在 78 个开发初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY 开发 33 + G-FACTORY-2 开发 9）上开发，校准表按留一家族方式构建；确认池 C2 = G-FACTORY-2 密封 62 个初态（金属 42、分子筛 20），每个初态每臂一次会话。参照预设 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation on C2: U/call 1.054× [1.003, 1.100], p 0.0175; U_ads/call 1.070; calls ×0.908, but U −4.3 % (324 → 310; metals −7.3 %, zeolites +3.3 %) and U per ionic step 1.026 (not significant). Development 1.056× [1.020, 1.095]. Cheaper but loses saddles on metals; with a related price stop, it ended sessions too early on GF7's new chemistry (U −12 %) and stayed out of the default.

idea_en: A surveyor who measured the slope at every stake can sketch where the crest lies between two stakes without walking back. Each relaxed-scan stage already records the constraint force μ = dE/dξ; a Hermite cubic through the stage energies and these slopes located the true maximum between stages, and the walker started there at zero extra calls (or after a short relaxation). Pivots started from the next stage or along the scan tangent.
idea_zh: 测量员在每根标桩处都量过坡度，不必折返就能估出两桩之间坡顶的位置。弛豫扫描每一级本就算出约束力 μ = dE/dξ（以往被丢弃）；用各级能量和 μ 做 Hermite 三次插值，定出两级之间的真顶点，行走器从那里零调用起步（或先短程弛豫）；转向方案改从下一级或沿扫描切线起步。
systems_en: Paired replay only: 2,358 archived walker launches from 78 DEV IS (GF3 dev set 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33 + G-FACTORY-2 dev 9), re-run from the new starting points. Every idea was killed at this stage and the planned exploratory sessions were not run, so there was no development or confirmation.
systems_zh: 仅做配对回放：78 个开发初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY 开发 33 + G-FACTORY-2 开发 9）上的 2,358 次归档行走发射，从新起点重跑。所有方案都在这一阶段被淘汰，计划中的探索性会话未运行，因此没有开发与确认。
result_en: Hermite start: saddles-per-call ratio 1.007× [0.965, 1.054], p 0.39, keeping 93.0 % of productive launches (rule ≥ 95 %); +relax 0.981×; next-stage start 0.927× (kept 69.1 %); tangent start 1.086× [0.984, 1.210], p 0.050 but kept 83.0 % (< 85 %). All killed. The discrete scan top already sits mid-slide in a negative-curvature region; success depends on the start direction, not the exact maximum (median move 0.022 Å).
result_zh: Hermite 起点：每调用产出比 1.007 [0.965, 1.054]，p 0.39，保留率 93.0 %（需 ≥ 95 %）；+弛豫、下一级起步更差；切线起步 1.086，p 0.050，但保留率 83.0 %。全部淘汰：成败在起步方向，不在精确顶点。

name_en: Adaptive scan steps from the constraint force (ADAPTIVE-SCAN-STEPS)
name_zh: 由约束力控制扫描步长（ADAPTIVE-SCAN-STEPS）
idea_en: Instead of placing stakes at fixed intervals up a slope, a surveyor reads the gradient and jumps to where it should reach zero. On bond-forming scans, a secant/Newton step on the constraint force μ = dE/dξ placed the next stage on the predicted ridge, skipping distant stages (grid variant) or landing on the root (Newton variant), with an overshoot guard and re-insertion of skipped stages after a ridge crossing; bond-breaking scans were unchanged.
idea_zh: 测量员不再按固定间距打桩，而是读出坡度，直接跳到坡度应降为零之处。在成键扫描中，用约束力 μ = dE/dξ 的割线/Newton 步把下一级放到预测的脊上：网格版跳过远处的级，Newton 版直接落在根上；设越界保护，越过脊后补回被跳过的级；断键扫描不变。
systems_en: Zero-session NEP replay of scan stages from archived DEV sessions (69 IS, 2 seeds) to screen variants; development on 69 DEV IS (GF3 dev set 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33), 2 seeds; confirmation on C1 = 73 IS (67 sealed G-FACTORY + 6 G5), 2 seeds. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 先用归档开发会话（69 个初态、2 个种子）的扫描级做零会话 NEP 回放来筛选变体；开发：69 个开发初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY 开发 33），2 个种子；确认：C1 = 73 个初态（G-FACTORY 密封 67 + G5 6），2 个种子。参照预设 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation of the Newton form-only variant on C1: U/call 0.993× [0.936, 1.059], p 0.58 (development 1.031×); U −5.4 % (573 → 542); U per ionic step 0.903× [0.847, 0.968]. Scan calls fell 36 %, but the new starting points more often led to saddles not connected to the initial state (metals 11.5 % → 15.6 %). No gain; options stay off.
result_zh: Newton 成键限定版 C1 确认：U/调用 0.993 [0.936, 1.059]，p 0.58（开发集 1.031）；U −5.4 %；U/离子步 0.903。扫描调用少 36 %，但新起点更常落到与初态不连通的鞍点。无收益，未采用。

name_zh: 跨金属边的位点跳跃生成器（SITE-HOP-GENERATOR）
idea_en: A marble in an egg carton reaches the next cup by rolling over the shared rim, not by being pulled toward the tip of a bump as default drives do. After the bond phase, each adsorbate atom touching ≥ 2 metal atoms got a relaxed scan along the hand-over coordinate r(b,L) − r(b,R) across a shared metal edge into a neighbouring site (≤ 3 per atom, HOP2), and Sella started from the scan top.
idea_zh: 蛋托里的弹珠要去邻格，应滚过共用的矮边，而不是像默认驱动那样被拉向某个凸尖。键阶段之后，对与 ≥ 2 个金属原子接触的吸附物原子，沿交接坐标 r(b,L) − r(b,R) 做弛豫扫描，越过共用金属边进入相邻位点（每原子 ≤ 3 个，HOP2），再从扫描顶点启动 Sella。
systems_en: Metals only. Full-hop pilot and HOP2 development on 49 DEV metal IS (GF3 metals 19 + G-FACTORY dev metals 30), development with 2 seeds; confirmation on the C2 metals: 42 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (including fcc(110), fcc(311), bcc and hcp facets), one seed. Reference `long-best-auto` (Sella on metals).
systems_zh: 仅金属。全跳跃试点与 HOP2 开发：49 个开发金属初态（GF3 金属 19 + G-FACTORY 开发金属 30），开发用 2 个种子；确认：C2 中的金属，即 G-FACTORY-2 密封 42 个初态（含 fcc(110)、fcc(311)、bcc、hcp 晶面），单种子。参照预设 `long-best-auto`（金属上用 Sella）。
result_en: Confirmation on C2 metals: U/call 0.996× [0.973, 1.018], p 0.64; U(≤1.5)/call 1.004× [0.977, 1.033]; U +5.2 % (232 → 244) with no IS losing saddles. Development had passed (U(≤1.5)/call 1.055× [1.006, 1.115], p 0.012; U/call 1.033×); the full-hop pilot was killed. More saddles at the same price as `--more`, no efficiency gain; later bundled into the `--more` preset.
result_zh: C2 金属确认：U/调用 0.996 [0.973, 1.018]，p 0.64；U(≤1.5)/调用 1.004；U +5.2 %（232 → 244），没有初态变少。开发曾通过，确认未过：多给鞍点但效率无增益；后并入 `--more` 预设。

name_en: Proton relays, then a double-protonation prune (PROTON-RELAY-GENERATOR)
name_zh: 质子接力与双质子化剪枝（PROTON-RELAY-GENERATOR）
idea_en: A relay team passes the baton runner to runner; here the baton stopped after the first hand-off, and the post-mortem found runners repeatedly passing a baton to a teammate whose hands were already full. The seed pushed two proton-transfer coordinates in step along hydrogen-bond chains; the kept change (`drive_proton_prune`) skips driving a neutral adsorbate O–H proton onto a framework oxygen while the framework still holds its acid proton.
idea_zh: 接力赛一棒传一棒；可在这个势能面上，棒传了第一棒就停下，复盘还发现队员总把棒递给两手已满的队友。种子方法沿氢键链同步推动两个质子转移坐标；保留下来的改动（`drive_proton_prune`）是：骨架仍带着酸性质子时，不再驱动中性吸附物 O–H 上的质子转到骨架氧上。
systems_en: Zeolites only. Relay pilot (one seed) on the 15 of 24 DEV zeolite IS that have hydrogen-bond chains; prune development on all 24 DEV zeolites (GF3 dev set 17, G-FACTORY dev 3, G-FACTORY-2 dev 1, G-FACTORY-3 dev 3), 2 seeds; confirmation on the 13 water-bearing C3 zeolites (12 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 1 IS-first), 2 seeds. Reference `long-best-auto` (dimer on zeolites).
systems_zh: 仅分子筛。接力试点（单种子）：24 个开发分子筛初态中有氢键链的 15 个；剪枝开发：全部 24 个开发分子筛（GF3 开发集 17、G-FACTORY 开发 3、G-FACTORY-2 开发 1、G-FACTORY-3 开发 3），2 个种子；确认：C3 中 13 个含水分子筛初态（G-FACTORY-3 密封 12 + IS 优先 1），2 个种子。参照预设 `long-best-auto`（分子筛上用 dimer）。
result_en: Relay seed: 84 launches, 0 new saddles (on NEP89 the relay is stepwise). Prune on all 24 dev zeolites: 1.003× [0.958, 1.050], p 0.418, failed. Water-bearing subgroup, frozen before confirmation, on C3: U/call 1.180× [1.071, 1.314], p < 0.00025; U +2.2 % (136 → 139), calls −13.4 %; but plausible saddles 88 → 82. Shipped in the v0.80 default as `drive_proton_prune=water`.
result_zh: 接力种子无新鞍点；全体开发分子筛 1.003，未过。含水亚组 C3 确认：U/调用 1.180 [1.071, 1.314]，p < 0.00025；U +2.2 %，调用 −13.4 %，合理鞍点 88 → 82。以 water 取值进入 v0.80 默认。

idea_en: A prospector who has struck gold on one stretch of river moves the neighbouring claims, likely to tap the same vein, to the back of the queue. In each session, bond coordinates whose atoms had already moved strongly in a found saddle (≥ 1.0 Å at the TS or ≥ 1.5 Å in the product) got half queue weight (NOVS), none skipped; a looser arm (NOV) used 0.5/0.8 Å and weight 1/3.
idea_zh: 淘金者在一段河床淘到金子后，会把可能挖到同一条矿脉的邻近矿点排到队尾。本轮在会话内把“已覆盖”键坐标的排队权重减半（NOVS）：其原子在已找到的鞍点中明显移动过（过渡态处 ≥ 1.0 Å 或产物中 ≥ 1.5 Å），但不跳过任何坐标；NOV 臂阈值更松、权重 1/3。
systems_en: All 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal-surface, 24 zeolite; GF3 dev 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33 + G-FACTORY-2 dev 9 + G-FACTORY-3 dev 7), one session per arm, 1 seed, reference `long-best-auto`, after a zero-call replay of DEV archives that screened 20 variants. The planned C1 confirmation (67 sealed G-FACTORY + 6 G5 IS) was not run.
systems_zh: 全部 85 个 DEV-A 初态（61 个金属表面、24 个分子筛；GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33 + G-FACTORY-2 dev 9 + G-FACTORY-3 dev 7），每臂 1 次会话、1 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto`；此前用 DEV 存档做 0 次调用回放，筛过 20 个变体。原定的 C1 确认（G-FACTORY sealed 67 + G5 6）未运行。
result_en: Development (85 DEV-A IS): NOVS U/call 1.0085× [0.9907, 1.0275], one-sided p 0.18, U 473 vs 475 (−0.4 %); NOV 1.0044× [0.9775, 1.0303]. The kill rule (≥ 1.02, p ≤ 0.10) fired, so no confirmation. Duplicates cost only 2–5 % of calls, metal sessions drive every coordinate anyway, and pre-drive novelty signals reached AUC 0.57–0.65 where ≥ 0.8 is needed for a 5 % gain.
result_zh: 开发（85 个初态）：NOVS 的 U/调用 1.0085 倍 [0.9907, 1.0275]，p 0.18，U 473 对 475，按规则淘汰，未做确认。重复鞍点只占 2–5 % 调用，驱动前信号 AUC 仅 0.57–0.65，排序难有收益。

idea_en: A locksmith who has pushed and pulled every lever also tries twisting the knobs, starting with those that turn most easily. After the bond-stretch phase, sessions drove dihedral rotations and bond-angle bends, ordered softest first by initial-state Hessian stiffness k = 1/(aᵀH⁻¹a), and released the walker from each scan top. The selected arm TOR-S drove only rotors with scan tops ≤ 1.0 eV.
idea_zh: 锁匠把每根拨杆都推拉过一遍后，再去拧旋钮，先拧最好转的。本轮在键伸缩阶段之后继续驱动二面角转子和键角弯曲，按初态 Hessian 刚度 k = 1/(aᵀH⁻¹a) 由软到硬排序，并从每条扫描的顶点放出行走器。选中的 TOR-S 臂只驱动扫描顶点 ≤ 1.0 eV 的转子。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces + zeolites), one session per IS, each compared with its own bond-only prefix; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal on new hosts such as hcp(0001), fcc(110) and bcc, plus 20 zeolite), 1 seed, reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 初态（金属表面 + 分子筛）上筛选，每个初态 1 次会话，与同一会话只含键坐标的前段比较；确认在 C2 = G-FACTORY-2 sealed 62 个初态（42 个 hcp(0001)、fcc(110)、bcc 等新载体上的金属体系 + 20 个分子筛）上进行，1 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (C2, 62 IS): TOR-S U/call 0.992× [0.982, 1.005], one-sided p 0.893; U 326 → 331 (+1.5 %), 4 of the 5 extra saddles without bond change (median barrier 0.042 eV), at 2,698 calls each versus 1,776 on average. Development: pre-registered RULE-A 0.946× [0.927, 0.961]. On zeolites 72 % of rotor walks aborted on positive curvature; bends cost about 8,700 calls per new saddle.
result_zh: 确认（C2，62 个初态）：TOR-S 的 U/调用 0.992 倍 [0.982, 1.005]，p 0.893；U 326 → 331（+1.5 %），新增 5 个鞍点中 4 个无键变化。分子筛上 72 % 的转子行走因正曲率中止。无收益。

idea_en: Leaning hard on a wall, a sideways step feels like falling, though no valley is there. When a forming-bond scan hit the covalent floor with energy still rising, the constraint force faked a sideways negative curvature of size κ ≈ |dE/dr|/r. κ was estimated free from the last two scan stages; walks from steep walls were skipped (STOP2: κ > 2 eV/Å² on metals) or restarted from a gentler stage (BACK).
idea_zh: 用力靠在墙上的人往旁边一挪就像要摔倒，其实旁边没有山谷。成键扫描已到共价距离下限而能量仍在上升（“撞墙”）时，约束力会制造侧向伪负曲率 κ ≈ |dE/dr|/r。本轮用最后两级扫描零调用估计 κ，跳过陡墙上的行走（STOP2），或退回较缓的扫描级再出发（BACK）。
systems_en: Development on 61 DEV-A metal-surface IS × 2 seeds; confirmation on the C3 metal subset, 49 IS (35 sealed G-FACTORY-3 metals + 14 IS-first metals; 47 ran, 2 were refused) × 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：61 个 DEV-A 金属表面初态 × 2 个种子；确认：C3 金属子集 49 个初态（G-FACTORY-3 sealed 金属 35 + IS-first 金属 14；47 个运行，2 个被拒）× 2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Development: STOP2 U/call 1.056× [1.030, 1.086] with U −2.2 %; BACK05 1.041× [1.005, 1.084]. Confirmation (C3 metals): STOP2 U/call 1.022× [0.992, 1.058], p 0.086, not significant, while U fell 505 → 451 (−10.7 %); U/ionic step 1.076× [1.039, 1.128]. On large adsorbates and stepped surfaces skipped walls still yielded 11 % new saddles (3.2 % in development). Options stay off.
result_zh: 开发：STOP2 的 U/调用 1.056 倍。确认（C3 金属）：1.022 倍 [0.992, 1.058]，p 0.086，不显著；U 505 → 451（−10.7 %）。大吸附物和台阶面上被跳过的“墙”仍有 11 % 出新鞍点。选项默认关闭。

name_zh: 原子转移的键长差驱动（DIFFERENCE-COORDINATE-DRIVES）
idea_en: To watch a hand-over, follow the bucket passing from one hand to the next, not just one hand reaching out. For atom-transfer triples (donor a, moving atom m, acceptor p) the forming-bond drive was replaced by the difference coordinate ξ = d(a,m) − d(m,p), which breaks one bond while forming the other; arm MODE kept the single-bond scan but started the walker along ξ, and DIFF2 revised the triple selection.
idea_zh: 看传水桶，要看桶从一只手交到另一只手，而不是只看一只手伸出去。对原子转移三元组（供体 a、迁移原子 m、受体 p），把成键驱动换成键长差坐标 ξ = d(a,m) − d(m,p)，同时断键和成键；MODE 臂仍做单键扫描，只让行走器沿 ξ 出发；DIFF2 改了三元组选择规则。
systems_en: Zero-call archive analysis and a Hessian-only visibility check of DEV-A transfer saddles; pilot on 12 DEV-A IS × 4 arms; MODE on all 85 DEV-A IS; DIFF2 on 70 completed of the 73 non-pilot DEV-A IS; one session per IS and arm, 1 seed, reference `long-best-auto`. The planned C1 confirmation was skipped.
systems_zh: 先做零调用存档分析和只算 Hessian 的可见性分析（DEV-A 转移鞍点）；试点：12 个 DEV-A 初态 × 4 臂；MODE 在全部 85 个 DEV-A 初态上检验；DIFF2 在试点外 73 个初态中完成的 70 个上检验；每初态每臂 1 次会话、1 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto`。原定的 C1 确认未做。
result_en: ξ made 62–87 % of zeolite transfer saddles visible (single bond 11–25 %), yet the pilot killed DIFF (0.974×) and DIFF_U (0.954×): replaced launches yielded 7.3 % vs 11.6 %. MODE: 0.992× [0.961, 1.022]. DIFF2 (70 IS): U/call 1.056× [1.002, 1.113], P 0.022, but U −6 %: finding fewer saddles stopped sessions earlier, and at equal U it trailed REF with a lower dry-stop threshold (0.935× [0.891, 0.986], P 0.0065).
result_zh: 试点淘汰 DIFF（0.974 倍）与 DIFF_U（0.954 倍）；MODE 0.992 倍。DIFF2 的 U/调用 1.056 倍 [1.002, 1.113]，但 U −6 %：少找鞍点使会话早停；同 U 下不如调低停止阈值的参照（0.935 倍）。

idea_en: Having opened one door, a locksmith tries the same key on identical doors down the corridor, adjusting it to each lock first. Round 148's site transplant copies a found saddle's displacement to chemically equivalent sites of the same IS; this round tried to make each copy cheaper with a hyperplane relaxation (STH) or an extra exact-Hessian Newton step (STN), then skipped copies whose start force exceeded 0.2 eV/Å (STHG).
idea_zh: 锁匠打开一扇门后，拿同一把钥匙去试走廊里同款的门，按每把锁稍作调整。第 148 轮的位点移植把鞍点位移复制到同一初态的化学等价位点；本轮想用超平面弛豫（STH）或加一步精确 Hessian 牛顿步（STN）让移植更省，后改为跳过起点力 > 0.2 eV/Å 的移植（STHG）。
systems_en: 61 DEV-A metal-surface IS for the pilot and for the force-gate pivot (1 seed each); confirmation on the 42 metal IS of C2 (sealed G-FACTORY-2: new hosts such as hcp(0001), fcc(110), bcc), 1 seed, three arms: `long-best-auto`, plain transplant (ST) and STHG.
systems_zh: 预实验与力门控转向检验各用 61 个 DEV-A 金属表面初态（各 1 个种子）；确认在 C2 的 42 个金属初态（G-FACTORY-2 sealed：hcp(0001)、fcc(110)、bcc 等新载体）上进行，1 个种子，三臂：`long-best-auto`、普通移植 ST 和 STHG。
result_en: Pilot: calls per new transplanted saddle were 1.051× (STH) and 1.275× (STN) those of plain copies, failing the ≤ 0.85× gate; 82 % of copies find no new saddle from any start. Confirmation (42 C2 metals): STHG vs ST U/call 1.017× [0.985, 1.048], p 0.153; versus `long-best-auto` 0.982× [0.969, 0.997], below the default, with U_ads/call 0.978 failing its guard. The gate blocked 77 % of copies on new facets.
result_zh: 试点：STH、STN 每个新鞍点调用为普通移植的 1.051、1.275 倍。确认（C2 金属）：STHG 对 ST 的 U/调用 1.017 倍，p 0.153；对 `long-best-auto` 0.982 倍 [0.969, 0.997]，不如默认。

name_zh: 高斯过程代理势预行走（GP-DIMER）
idea_en: A hiker sketches a local contour map from a few altimeter readings, walks on the sketch, checks the real altitude once and redraws. A Gaussian-process surrogate on about ten atoms around the driven bond (the rest following by initial-state Hessian linear response) carried the early walk, checked each move with one NEP89 call, then handed position and negative-curvature mode to the regular optimiser; the pivot ran it before Sella on metals.
idea_zh: 登山者凭几次高度计读数画一张局部等高线草图，在草图上走，再实测一次高度并重画。本轮在被驱动键周围约 10 个原子上建高斯过程代理势，其余原子按初态 Hessian 线性跟随；早期行走在代理势上完成，每步用一次 NEP89 调用核验并重拟合，再交给常规优化器。
systems_en: Pilot on 45 DEV-A IS (metals and zeolites), 12 launches each; metal pivot (GP before Sella) on the other 40 DEV-A metal IS, full sessions; confirmation on the C3 metal subset, 47 IS (sealed G-FACTORY-3 and IS-first metals; 2 more refused), one session each; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 试点：45 个 DEV-A 初态（金属与分子筛），每个 12 次发射；金属转向（GP 先于 Sella）：另外 40 个 DEV-A 金属初态，完整会话；确认：C3 金属子集 47 个初态（G-FACTORY-3 sealed 与 IS-first 的金属，另 2 个被拒），各 1 次会话；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Pilot failed: on zeolites walks used 0.67× the calls but found 0.65× the saddles; metals saved nothing. Metal pivot in development: 1.112× [1.014, 1.237], p 0.016, U +18 %. Confirmation (47 C3 metals): U/call 0.935× [0.868, 1.014], p 0.945; U 251 → 226 (−10 %); U_ads/call 0.945. On new hosts (high-index steps, alloys, hcp(10-10)) 59 % of GP pre-walks fell back, so the gain did not carry over.

idea_en: Rather than buy a pricier compass, a climber aims the first reading using the base-camp survey he already has. Exact NEP89 Hessian-vector products cost 1.4–1.9 force-call equivalents, so exact dimer rotation was dropped; instead the initial-state Hessian seeded Sella's start-up Davidson eigensolver with the compliant direction v₀ = H_IS⁻¹a (a: drive direction; S, `sella_start_seed=compliant`) and preconditioned the validation TS-mode solve (T, `lean_mode_solver=davidson`).
idea_zh: 与其买更贵的指南针，不如借营地的测绘图对准首次读数。精确 Hessian-向量积每次约合 1.4–1.9 次力调用，故不做精确二聚体转动；改用初态精确 Hessian 给 Sella 起步提供柔顺方向 v₀ = H_IS⁻¹a（S 臂），并给验证阶段的模求解做预条件（T 臂）。
systems_en: Development on 69 DEV-A IS (GF3 dev 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33 + G-FACTORY-2 dev 9, minus 9 MFI; 57 metal, 12 zeolite), 1 seed; confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS, 1 seed; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：69 个 DEV-A 初态（GF3 开发集 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33 + G-FACTORY-2 dev 9，去掉 9 个 MFI；金属 57、分子筛 12），1 个种子；确认：C1 = G-FACTORY sealed 67 + G5 6 个初态，1 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (C1, 73 IS): S+T U/call 1.033× [0.998, 1.073], p 0.032, missing the Holm threshold 0.025; T alone 1.012× [0.994, 1.033], p 0.103; U −0.7 %, calls per launch −3.9 %. Validation mode-solve calls fell 75 % and Davidson calls per metal Sella walk 32 %. Development: S+T 1.066× [1.017, 1.118]. The compliant seed later joined the v0.80 default `long-best-auto-80`.
result_zh: 确认（C1）：S+T 的 U/调用 1.033 倍 [0.998, 1.073]，p 0.032，未过 Holm 校正；U −0.7 %，验证求模调用 −75 %。开发 1.066 倍。柔顺种子后并入 v0.80 默认 `long-best-auto-80`。

idea_en: A hiker in fog lengthens his stride but takes it back whenever the ground does not behave as the slope promised. Dimer translation steps of up to 0.2 Å were accepted only if they passed an Armijo backtracking test on the Gould–Ortner–Packwood saddle merit function (`dimer_linesearch="merit"`, arm LS2); preconditioning the whole walk with the initial-state Hessian was also tested.
idea_zh: 雾中登山者把步子迈大，但只要脚下地形不像坡度预示的那样，就把这一步收回。度量二聚体的平移步（上限 0.2 Å）须通过 Gould–Ortner–Packwood 鞍点价值函数上的 Armijo 回溯检验才被接受（LS2 臂）；另外检验了用初态 Hessian 给整条行走做预条件。
systems_en: Paired replay of 240 archived walks (12 per IS on 20 DEV-A zeolite IS) to pick the arm; development on all 24 DEV-A zeolite IS (GF3 17, G-FACTORY dev 3, G-FACTORY-2 dev 1, G-FACTORY-3 dev 3) × 2 seeds, 23 analysed after one unfinished session, plus a metal smoke test; reference `long-best-auto`. The C2 confirmation was not run.
systems_zh: 先成对回放 240 条存档行走（20 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态，各 12 条）选臂；开发：全部 24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态（GF3 17、G-FACTORY dev 3、G-FACTORY-2 dev 1、G-FACTORY-3 dev 3）× 2 个种子，因一个会话未完成实际分析 23 个，另做一个金属冒烟检验；参照 `long-best-auto`。C2 确认未运行。
result_en: Replay: LS2 walks used 0.909× the calls. In sessions, 2,488 same-start launch pairs used 0.934× the search calls but found 429 new saddles vs 439: cheaper walks, same destinations. Development (23 zeolite IS × 2 seeds): U/call 0.995× [0.952, 1.039], p 0.57; U −3.2 %, calls −2.8 %, U/ionic step 0.985. Gate failed, no confirmation. Whole-walk Hessian preconditioning cost 1.132× the calls.
result_zh: 回放：LS2 行走调用 0.909 倍；2,488 对同起点发射调用 0.934 倍，新鞍点 429 对 439。开发（23 个分子筛）：U/调用 0.995 倍 [0.952, 1.039]，p 0.57，未过门槛。全程预条件使调用增至 1.132 倍。

idea_en: A blind walker climbing out of a hollow plants his cane where his next foot will land, so each tap doubles as a step. The seed, a shrinking dimer length, was pointless (the 1 mÅ probe is already accurate to 0.2 %); the pivot ALL placed the probe image at the next centre during uphill escapes and reused its force (LEAP), converged the first rotation (WARM) and fixed an ASE curvature quirk (FIX).
idea_zh: 盲人爬出洼地时把手杖点在下一步要落脚处，这一下探路就顶了一步。原想法（收缩二聚体）无意义：1 mÅ 探针误差仅 0.2 %。转向后的 ALL：上坡逃逸时把探针点在下一个中心并复用其力（LEAP），首步转动做到收敛（WARM），并修正 ASE 大角度转动后的曲率误报（FIX）。
systems_en: Exact-Hessian length physics on 286 DEV-A zeolite configurations; development on all 24 DEV-A zeolite IS × 2 seeds × 6 arms (288 sessions) plus a metal no-change check; confirmation on the C3 zeolite subset, 28 IS (18 sealed G-FACTORY-3 zeolites + 10 IS-first zeolites) × 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 用精确 Hessian 在 286 个 DEV-A 分子筛构型上测量探针长度的影响；开发：全部 24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态 × 2 个种子 × 6 臂（288 次会话），另做金属不变性检查；确认：C3 分子筛子集 28 个初态（G-FACTORY-3 sealed 分子筛 18 + IS-first 分子筛 10）× 2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (28 C3 zeolites × 2 seeds): ALL U/call 1.060× [1.005, 1.109], p 0.0195; U +2.8 %, calls −3.0 %; U_ads/call 1.064, U/ionic step 1.044. Seed arm in development: 0.994× [0.948, 1.034]. Gains sit on large zeolites; metals are untouched. In the v0.80 synthesis the stacked candidate kept only 0.867× [0.757, 0.990] of zeolite saddles, so ALL stayed opt-in.
result_zh: 确认（C3 的 28 个分子筛 × 2 个种子）：ALL 的 U/调用 1.060 倍 [1.005, 1.109]，p 0.0195；U +2.8 %。收益集中在大分子筛，金属不变。v0.80 综合轮中叠加后分子筛鞍点降到 0.867 倍，故仍为可选项。

name_en: Re-aiming the dimer at convex alarms (KAPPA-GATED-TRANSLATION)
idea_en: When a blind hiker's cane says 'bottom of a bowl', he trudges uphill, yet about nine times in ten he is on a saddle-shaped slope with the cane misaimed. Isosurface curvature κ proved useless as a gate (positive at 95–99 % of zeolite walker steps); instead, when the dimer curvature turned non-negative, `search_gate` measured the lowest curvature once with 6 Lanczos products and, if below −0.1 eV/Å², switched to that mode.
idea_zh: 盲人登山者的手杖说“这是碗底”时，他只能硬往上爬；可约九成的时候他站在鞍形山坡上，只是手杖指错了方向。新选项 `search_gate` 在二聚体曲率刚变为非负时，用 6 次 Lanczos 积测一次最低曲率，若低于 −0.1 eV/Å² 就换到该方向继续爬。
systems_en: Exact-Hessian instrumentation and pilots on the 24 DEV-A zeolite IS (1 seed); development on the same 24 IS × 2 seeds; confirmation on the 16 zeolite IS of C1 (15 sealed G-FACTORY + 1 G5) × 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto` (metals use Sella, so the gate cannot act there).
systems_zh: 在 24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态上做精确 Hessian 仪器化分析与试点（1 个种子）；开发：同 24 个初态 × 2 个种子；确认：C1 的 16 个分子筛初态（G-FACTORY sealed 15 + G5 1）× 2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`（金属走 Sella，该选项不起作用）。
result_en: Development (24 zeolite IS × 2 seeds): U/call 1.050× [0.996, 1.099], p 0.034, U +27 %. Confirmation (16 C1 zeolites × 2 seeds): U/call 1.005× [0.949, 1.063], p 0.44, not confirmed; U +19.7 %, U_ads/call 0.945 failing its guard; 10 of the 27 extra saddles were reorientations without bond change. As a yield option it later shipped in `--more` (`long-more-auto-79`/`-80`).
result_zh: 开发：U/调用 1.050 倍，U +27 %。确认（C1 分子筛 × 2 个种子）：1.005 倍 [0.949, 1.063]，p 0.44，未确认；U +19.7 %，U_ads/调用 0.945 未过护栏。作为多找鞍点选项进入 `--more` 预设。

idea_en: The dimer is a blindfolded hiker who feels the slope with a two-tipped cane and spends most of his effort turning it to find the way up. This hiker instead buys a curvature map at the top of the bond scan and strides by Newton steps, updating the map as he goes. On zeolite launches, an exact NEP89 Hessian at the scan top seeded a restricted-step P-RFO walker with Bofill updates and dimer fallback.
idea_zh: dimer 像蒙眼登山者用双头手杖探路，大半力气花在转动手杖找方向；本轮让他在键扫描顶点买一张曲率地图，按牛顿步大步走、边走边修正。具体：在分子筛发射的扫描顶点算一次精确 NEP89 Hessian，驱动带 Bofill 更新的受限步 P-RFO 行走器，失败时退回 dimer。
systems_en: Paired NEP89 replay of archived zeolite launches from the 21 zeolite IS in the 78-IS development archive (GF3 dev + G-FACTORY/G-FACTORY-2 dev): 207 random launches (IS-weighted) plus 49 validated ones, five arms, 1,280 tasks. Reference `long-best-auto`. The planned dev sessions (2 seeds) and the C2 confirmation were never run.
systems_zh: 成对 NEP89 回放 78 初态开发档案中 21 个分子筛初态（GF3 开发集 + G-FACTORY/G-FACTORY-2 开发集）的归档发射：207 次随机发射（按初态加权）+ 49 次已验证发射，5 臂共 1,280 个任务；参照 `long-best-auto`。计划中的开发会话（2 个种子）与 C2 确认均未运行。
result_en: Pre-registered replay gate failed for all four arms. Seed walker QNX: U/call 0.828× [0.626, 0.969], 36 % fewer saddles (U_ads −42 %); even with a free Hessian only 1.064×. QNT 1.017× but U 0.606×. Scan tops are high-index points (97 % have a negative eigenvalue, 73 % at least two) whose best negative mode overlaps the driven bond only 0.35 (median); the dimer's bond-direction start is the useful prior.
result_zh: 回放闸门淘汰全部四臂：种子臂 QNX 的 U/调用 0.828 倍 [0.626, 0.969]，鞍点 −36 %；Hessian 免费也仅 1.064 倍。扫描顶点多为高指标点（73 % 有 ≥ 2 个负本征值），最佳负模与驱动键重叠中位仅 0.35。

name_zh: 反应子空间行走、骨架绝热松弛（SCHUR-SUBSPACE-WALK）
idea_en: Picture the zeolite framework as spectators on springs: when the guest molecule moves they lean along predictably, so the climber plans steps only for the reacting atoms and lets the springs follow. The dimer walker's L-BFGS metric used the exact IS Hessian with its reactive Schur-complement block set to a scalar, the framework beyond 4–5 Å relaxed by Newton linear response each step, and the start mode was 'dressed' with that response.
idea_zh: 把分子筛骨架看成装着弹簧的观众：客体分子一动，他们就可预测地跟着倾斜，所以登山者只需为反应原子规划步子。具体：dimer 行走的 L-BFGS 度量取精确初态 Hessian，反应区 Schur 补块换成标量；4–5 Å 外的骨架每步按牛顿线性响应松弛；起始模也“穿上”这一响应。
systems_en: Three pre-registered paired NEP89 replays of disjoint archived zeolite launches from the 78-IS development archive (GF3 dev + G-FACTORY/G-FACTORY-2 dev zeolites): 285 launches (21 IS), 196 (20 IS) and 118 (10 MFI/FER IS, tail-metric fix). Reference `long-best-auto`; metal IS use Sella and are unaffected. Sessions and the C3 confirmation were not run.
systems_zh: 三次预注册的成对 NEP89 回放，取 78 初态开发档案中分子筛（GF3 开发集 + G-FACTORY/G-FACTORY-2 开发集）互不相交的归档发射：285 次（21 个初态）、196 次（20 个初态）、118 次（10 个 MFI/FER 初态，尾段度量修正）。参照 `long-best-auto`，金属初态用 Sella、不受影响。会话与 C3 确认未运行。
result_en: All six variants were killed (P = distinct saddles per call vs reference, in replay). Original SW4: P 0.591 [0.451, 0.716]; best calibrated SWP4: 0.863 [0.705, 0.987], launches 17 % cheaper but 29 % fewer distinct saddles; dressed start only: 0.936 [0.860, 1.010]; positive-definite tail-metric fix: 0.936 [0.864, 0.995]. Insight: IS-Hessian linear response explains 77–89 % of framework displacement at the TS.
result_zh: 六个变体回放全部淘汰（P = 每调用不同鞍点之比）：最佳 SWP4 P 0.863 [0.705, 0.987]，发射便宜 17 % 但不同鞍点 −29 %；原版 SW4 0.591。收获：初态 Hessian 线性响应解释过渡态处骨架位移的 77–89 %。

name_zh: 风险模型提前停止行走器（STEP-HAZARD-STOP）
idea_en: Like a mountain guide who, at every step, estimates the chance this climb still reaches a pass and what it will still cost, and turns back once going on is worth less than the team's usual rate of finding passes. Per-engine logistic hazard models predicted, from step-by-step signals, the probability of a new certified saddle and the remaining calls; a Dinkelbach rule stopped the walker when that ratio fell below the session's saddles-per-call rate.
idea_zh: 像向导每走一步都估算“这趟还能登上山口的概率”和“还得花多少”，一旦继续的价值低于全队平时找到山口的速率就掉头。具体：每种引擎一个逻辑回归风险模型，用逐步信号预测找到新认证鞍点的概率和剩余力调用，按 Dinkelbach 规则在两者之比低于会话每调用鞍点率时停止行走。
systems_en: Traces from one `long-best-auto` pilot session on each of the 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal surfaces with Sella, 24 zeolites with dimer; 70 chemical families), evaluated offline by nested 10-fold leave-family-out cross-validation. The paired dev test and the C1 confirmation (67 sealed G-FACTORY + 6 G5 IS) were not run.
systems_zh: 85 个 DEV-A 初态（61 个金属表面用 Sella，24 个分子筛用 dimer；70 个化学家族）各一次 `long-best-auto` 试点会话的轨迹，离线做嵌套 10 折整族留出交叉验证。成对开发检验与 C1 确认（67 个 G-FACTORY 封存 + 6 个 G5 初态）未运行。
result_en: Offline gate failed. With geometric signals: U/call 1.077× [1.052, 1.105], p < 0.00025, but U 0.968× [0.937, 0.991] and 3.4 % of validated launches stopped (limits: U ≥ 0.98, ≤ 2 %). All 15 lost saddles involved the adsorbate, mostly dry ethanol dimer in H-MFI. Trade-off ≈ +2.4 % U/call per 1 % U given up. Dimer mode rotation is a real failure signal (AUC 0.67–0.69); energy is not.
result_zh: 离线闸门未过：加几何信号 U/调用 1.077 倍 [1.052, 1.105]，p < 0.00025，但 U 0.968 倍（需 0.98），误停 3.4 % 已验证发射（限 2 %），丢的鞍点都涉及吸附物。每放弃 1 % U 约换 2.4 % U/调用。

name_zh: 行走器参数贝叶斯优化（WALKER-KNOB-BO）
idea_en: Like tuning a car's suspension separately for mountain roads and city streets: a Bayesian optimiser tries a few settings, fits a smooth response surface and picks the next most informative setting. Gaussian-process optimisation tuned four walker knobs per family (metal Sella: gamma, initial trust radius, trust growth, curvature patience; zeolite dimer: maximum step, rotation angle, search radius, patience), 19 configurations per family in two rungs.
idea_zh: 像分别为山路和城市道路调汽车悬挂：贝叶斯优化器试几组设置、拟合响应面，再挑最值得试的下一组。具体：用高斯过程按体系族各调 4 个旋钮（金属 Sella：gamma、初始信赖半径、半径增长率、正曲率耐心；分子筛 dimer：最大步长、旋转角、搜索半径、耐心），每族 19 个配置。
systems_en: All 85 DEV-A IS, one `long-best-auto` session per configuration per IS. Tuning: 49 metal IS (GF3 dev 19 + G-FACTORY dev 30) and 13 zeolite IS (CHA, FAU, MOR, FER, MTT). Held-out families: 12 new-host metal IS (fcc(311)/(331)/(110), Os/Re(0001), bcc Mo(211)) and 11 large zeolites (MFI, LTL, MTW). The C2 confirmation was not run.
systems_zh: 全部 85 个 DEV-A 初态，每个配置每个初态一次 `long-best-auto` 会话。调参：49 个金属初态（GF3 开发集 19 + G-FACTORY 开发集 30）和 13 个分子筛初态（CHA、FAU、MOR、FER、MTT）；留出族：12 个新载体金属初态（fcc(311)/(331)/(110)、Os/Re(0001)、bcc Mo(211)）和 11 个大分子筛（MFI、LTL、MTW）。C2 确认未运行。
result_en: No setting kept U while reaching 1.02×. Best U-keeping dev picks: metal trust growth 1.15, U/call 1.037× [0.987, 1.085]; zeolite max step 0.06 Å, 1.034× [0.970, 1.099]. Pure-efficiency picks only trade saddles for calls: held-out zeolites 1.238× [1.106, 1.337] at U 0.826, held-out metals 1.061× [0.906, 1.209] at U 0.820. The defaults sit mid-way on a flat trade-off line.
result_zh: 没有设置能既保住鞍点数又达到 1.02 倍。保住 U 的最佳开发值：金属信赖半径增长 1.15，U/调用 1.037 倍 [0.987, 1.085]；分子筛最大步长 0.06 Å，1.034 倍。纯效率设置只是拿鞍点换调用，默认值位于平坦权衡线中段。

name_en: Restart from a failed walker's point (FAILED-WALK-TRANSFER)
name_zh: 从失败行走者的落脚点起步（FAILED-WALK-TRANSFER）
idea_en: Like a second scout who, instead of starting at the trailhead, begins where an earlier scout gave up on a nearby ridge, at the spot that felt most like a pass. A later launch sharing an adsorbate atom with an earlier failed walker started its own bond walk at that walker's most-negative-curvature point (or smallest-force negative-curvature point): replacing its own scan (REPLACE), added after its own failure (ADD), or chosen by curvature (SWITCH).
idea_zh: 像第二名侦察兵不从山脚出发，而是从附近一位已放弃的侦察兵最像山口的地方找起。具体：后续发射若与先前失败的行走者共享吸附物原子，就沿自己的键从该行走者曲率最负的点（或力最小的负曲率点）起步；策略：替代自身扫描（REPLACE）、自身失败后追加（ADD）、按曲率择优（SWITCH）。
systems_en: Zero-call analysis of the 78-IS development archive, then a paired NEP89 probe on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites): one `long-best-auto` session per IS with a recorder, 1,027 receiving launches and 1,940 transfer walks. Dev sessions and the C3 confirmation were not run (kill rule).
systems_zh: 先对 78 初态开发档案做零调用分析，再在 85 个 DEV-A 初态（金属表面与分子筛）上做成对 NEP89 探针：每个初态一次带记录器的 `long-best-auto` 会话，1,027 次接收发射、1,940 次转移行走。开发会话与 C3 确认按淘汰规则未运行。
result_en: Probe killed every policy. Replacing the start: U/call 0.825× [0.769, 0.884], U −32 %. Extra walk: 0.906× [0.881, 0.929], U +6.5 % at about 5,200 calls per new saddle (2.7× the session average). Curvature switch: 0.995× (rarely triggers). 84 % of launches share atoms with a failed walker, yet at the transfer point the receiver's bond is rarely soft (negative curvature 0.6 % vs 11.7 % at its scan top).
result_zh: 探针淘汰全部策略：替代起点 U/调用 0.825 倍 [0.769, 0.884]，U −32 %；追加行走 0.906 倍，U +6.5 %，但每个新鞍点约 5,200 次调用；按曲率切换 0.995 倍。转移点上接收者的键很少变软（负曲率 0.6 %）。

name_en: Hand failing dimer walks to Sella (MIDWALK-SELLA-HANDOFF)
name_zh: 失败行走中途交给 Sella（MIDWALK-SELLA-HANDOFF）
idea_en: Like a relay in which a struggling runner passes the baton to a stronger teammate, but rewound to the moment the first runner was closest to the finish rather than where he stumbled. When a zeolite dimer walk aborted on positive curvature or left its 4 Å sphere, Sella (IS-Hessian start, dimer mode as first guess) continued from the failure point (MWC) or from the walk's most saddle-like iterate (MWB: negative curvature, smallest force).
idea_zh: 像接力赛里体力不支的选手把棒交给更强的队友，但交棒点退回到他离终点最近的那一刻。具体：分子筛 dimer 行走因正曲率中止或越出 4 Å 球，由 Sella（初态 Hessian、以 dimer 模为初猜）接手，起点为失败点（MWC）或最像鞍点的迭代点（MWB：负曲率且力最小）。
systems_en: Dev: the 24 DEV-A zeolite IS × 1 session. Confirmation: C1's zeolite subset, 15 sealed G-FACTORY zeolite IS + 1 G5 IS (ethanol in H-MWW), × 2 sessions. Reference `long-best-auto`; metal IS run Sella and are unaffected.
systems_zh: 开发：24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态 × 1 次会话。确认：C1 的分子筛子集，即 15 个 G-FACTORY 封存分子筛初态 + 1 个 G5 初态（H-MWW 中的乙醇），× 2 次会话。参照 `long-best-auto`；金属初态用 Sella，不受影响。
result_en: Confirmation (C1 zeolites): the rewind arm MWB found 21.1 % more saddles (U ×1.211 [1.063, 1.364], p 0.001) but U/call 0.945× [0.879, 1.007], costing 0.26 % U/call per +1 % U versus 0.08 % for `--more`, so it failed the 'more saddles' price rule. Dev: hand-over at the failure point 0.888×. Rewinding yields 4× more new saddles per hand-over; sphere-exit hand-overs almost never pay.
result_zh: C1 分子筛确认：回退臂 MWB 鞍点 +21.1 %（p 0.001），但 U/调用 0.945 倍 [0.879, 1.007]；每多 1 % U 付 0.26 % U/调用（--more 仅 0.08 %），未过价格规则。开发：原地交接 0.888 倍。

name_zh: 停滞时精确 Hessian 分诊（STALL-EXACT-KICK）
idea_en: Like calling in a surveyor when a hiker keeps circling: one precise survey tells whether a single pass is nearby (then jump towards it) or not (then go home). When a walker stalled (best force not halved in 20 steps, below 0.3 eV/Å), one exact NEP89 Hessian was computed: without exactly one negative eigenvalue the launch ended; with one, the walker was kicked along the exact lowest mode, or Sella received the exact Hessian.
idea_zh: 像登山者原地打转时请测量员精确测绘一次：附近恰有一个山口就跳过去，否则收队。具体：行走停滞（20 步内最佳力未减半且低于 0.3 eV/Å）时算一次精确 Hessian；负本征值不是恰好一个就结束发射，否则沿精确最低模做 P-RFO 跳，Sella 则改用精确 Hessian。
systems_en: 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal surfaces, 24 zeolites) × 1 session per arm: reference `long-best-auto`, observe-only, and kick. The C2 confirmation (62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS) was not run after the dev kill.
systems_zh: 85 个 DEV-A 初态（61 个金属表面、24 个分子筛），每臂 1 次会话：参照 `long-best-auto`、只观察、踢。开发淘汰后未运行 C2 确认（62 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存初态）。
result_en: Dev kill on the primary metric (no confirmation): U/call 1.010× [0.973, 1.049], p 0.287 (gate 1.03); U −8.4 %, mostly zeolite saddles above 1.5 eV. Strong secondaries: U per ionic step 1.131× [1.091, 1.174], U(≤1.5)/call 1.087× [1.028, 1.151], core-seconds per saddle −6.5 %. The gain comes from ending hopeless launches, not from the kick. Later shipped in the opt-in `long-ionic-auto` preset (v0.80).
result_zh: 主指标开发淘汰：U/调用 1.010 倍 [0.973, 1.049]，p 0.287，U −8.4 %；但 U/离子步 1.131 倍、U(≤1.5)/调用 1.087 倍，收益来自及早结束无望发射。后进入可选预设 long-ionic-auto。

name_zh: 下坡验证 L-BFGS 调优（QUENCH-OPTIMIZER-SHOOTOUT）
idea_en: Like a walker descending into a valley with a stride sized for steep rock walls, who creeps across soft, gentle slopes; the fix is to size each stride from the slope just felt. The downhill-validation L-BFGS replaced ASE's fixed initial inverse Hessian (1/70) by Shanno–Phua scaling from the last measured curvature, doubled the per-atom step cap to 0.1 Å (0.05 Å for half-step rechecks) and made restart steps 7× longer, for non-metal IS only.
idea_zh: 像按陡壁定步幅的下山者，到平缓软坡只能慢慢挪；改为按刚感到的坡度定步长。具体：下坡验证的 L-BFGS 不用 ASE 固定初始逆 Hessian（1/70），改按最近实测曲率做 Shanno–Phua 缩放，单原子步长上限加倍至 0.1 Å，重启步长增至 7 倍；仅限非金属初态。
systems_en: Optimizer shootout and all-IS gate on 606 launches from 54 development IS (metals failed); the non-metal pivot was checked on 155 fresh zeolite launches. Dev: the 24 DEV-A zeolite IS × 2 seeds. Confirmation: C3's zeolite subset, 28 IS (18 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 10 IS-first) × 2 seeds. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 优化器对比与全初态闸门：54 个开发初态的 606 次发射（金属未过）；转向非金属后在 155 次新分子筛发射上复核。开发：24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态 × 2 个种子。确认：C3 的分子筛子集 28 个初态（18 个 G-FACTORY-3 封存 + 10 个 IS-first）× 2 个种子。参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmed on C3 zeolites: U/call 1.080× [1.043, 1.112], p < 1/4000; U +1.8 %; U per ionic step 1.22×; descent calls 0.74×; 2–4 % of zeolite launch verdicts change. Dev: 1.102× [1.063, 1.137]. On metals it lost validated launches, hence the non-metal scope; FIRE needed 2.2× the calls. Entered the v0.80 default preset.
result_zh: C3 分子筛确认：U/调用 1.080 倍 [1.043, 1.112]，p < 1/4000，U +1.8 %，U/离子步 1.22 倍；开发集 1.102 倍。金属上会丢已验证发射，故限非金属；FIRE 需 2.2 倍调用。并入 v0.80 默认预设。

name_en: Newton-licence stop near known minima (BASIN-CERTIFICATE-STOP → NEWTON-LICENCE)
name_zh: 已知极小附近的牛顿许可停止（BASIN-CERTIFICATE-STOP → NEWTON-LICENCE）
idea_en: Like a walker heading home who stops once the home valley's map shows one jump would land almost on the doorstep. A provable basin certificate was too weak (it certified only the last 0.5–1.5 meV). Instead, a descent toward a known minimum (IS or product) stops once a Newton step with that minimum's exact Hessian lands on it to within 40 % of the step (ΔE < 0.05 eV, each atom < 0.5 Å).
idea_zh: 像回家的人凭自家山谷地图判断“一跳就几乎到门口”便停步。可证明盆地证书太弱（只认证最后 0.5–1.5 meV），改为：向已知极小（初态或产物）下降时，若用其精确 Hessian 算的牛顿步落点距极小不足步长的 40 %（ΔE < 0.05 eV，各原子 < 0.5 Å），即停。
systems_en: Audit on 431 held-out development launches; paired dev replay of the 78-IS development archive (one session each); one confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY + 6 G5 IS (metal surfaces and zeolites) × 1 seed × 2 arms. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 在 431 次留出开发发射上审计；在 78 初态开发档案上做成对开发回放（每初态一次会话）；在 C1 = 67 个 G-FACTORY 封存 + 6 个 G5 初态（金属表面与分子筛）上做一次确认，1 个种子 × 2 臂。参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmed on C1: U/call 1.0146× [1.007, 1.021], p 0.001 (metals 1.024×, zeolites 1.006×); U per ionic step 1.035×; U 288 → 287 from one IS with pre-existing numerical divergence; 72/73 pairs identical. About 29 calls saved per validated metal launch; audit 0 flips in 431 launches. Dev replay 1.0099×. A small, nearly decision-identical saving that entered the v0.80 default.
result_zh: C1 确认：U/调用 1.0146 倍 [1.007, 1.021]，p 0.001；U 288 → 287 源于一个初态的既有数值差异，73 对中 72 对完全相同；已验证金属发射每次约省 29 次调用。收益小、几乎不改判定，并入 v0.80 默认预设。

name_en: Recheck descents merge into the main path (RECHECK-MERGE)
idea_en: Like a second walker sent down the same slope as a cross-check: once he steps onto the trail the first walker took, he accepts where that trail ends. The half-step recheck descent stops and adopts the main descent's endpoint once it stays within 0.015 Å of the main path for two consecutive points, is within 0.2 eV of the endpoint energy, and the main path ahead has no flat stretch (fmax < 0.03 eV/Å).
idea_zh: 像派第二个人沿同一坡下山复核：他一踏上第一个人走过的路，就直接接受那条路的终点。具体：验证中的半步复查下降，一旦连续两点距主下降路径 0.015 Å 以内、能量与其终点相差 0.2 eV 以内、且主路径前方没有平台段（fmax < 0.03 eV/Å），就停止并采用主下降的终点。
systems_en: Rule designed on 467 archived launches; independent audit on 689 launches (1,272 recheck sides); dev on the 78-IS development archive × 1 seed; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (new hosts such as hcp(0001), fcc(110) and bcc surfaces, plus zeolites) × 1 seed × 2 arms. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 在 467 次归档发射上设计规则；在独立的 689 次发射（1,272 条复查侧）上审计；开发：78 初态开发档案 × 1 个种子；确认：C2 = 62 个 G-FACTORY-2 封存初态（hcp(0001)、fcc(110)、bcc 等新载体及分子筛）× 1 个种子 × 2 臂。参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmed on C2: U/call 1.028× [1.024, 1.033], p < 0.00025, with 62/62 pairs identical and 0 validation flips (U 328 = 328); U per ionic step 1.055×; 47 fewer calls per saddle (1,722 → 1,675). Dev: 1.024× [1.020, 1.030]; audit 0 flips. A pure saving, though core-seconds fell only 0.8 % because the merge check costs CPU. Entered the v0.80 default.
result_zh: C2 确认：U/调用 1.028 倍 [1.024, 1.033]，p < 0.00025，62/62 对相同、0 个验证翻转；每个鞍点少 47 次力调用。开发集 1.024 倍。纯节省，但合并检测耗 CPU，核秒只少 0.8 %。并入 v0.80 默认预设。

name_zh: 下降路径记忆“管道停止”（QUENCH-PATH-MEMO）
idea_en: A hiker who has already walked down into a valley can stop once a new descent joins the remembered trail just above the floor. The software kept a session memory of descent paths: a new endpoint descent that stayed inside a thin tube (0.05–0.3 Å) around a recorded path, within a small energy margin above that path's minimum, would be declared to end in that minimum.
idea_zh: 走过一次山谷的人，新的下山路一旦并入记忆中的老路、离谷底只差一点高度，就不必再走到底。本轮在会话中记录端点下降路径：新的下降若持续落在某条已记录路径周围的细管道内（0.05–0.3 Å），能量又只比该路径的极小点高出一个小阈值，就直接判定它终止于该极小点。
systems_en: Audit-only test on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), 1 seed, reference long-best-auto: 85 sessions, 932,877 force calls and 2,858 audited descents; 810 rule variants were scored by simulation. No real-stop runs and no confirmation pool.
systems_zh: 仅做审计：85 个 DEV-A 开发初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 1 个种子，参照 long-best-auto；共 85 个会话、932,877 次力调用、2,858 条被审计的下降，用模拟为 810 个规则变体打分。没有真实停止运行，也没有确认池。
result_en: No variant combined zero verdict flips with ≥ 2 % savings. The only zero-flip family (IS paths, 0.05 Å tube) gave simulated U/call 1.0033× [1.0015, 1.0056] on DEV-A, below the 2 % kill line; wider rules reached 1.0456–1.0895× but flipped 8–25 verdicts. On flat valley floors the endpoint depends on optimiser state, so the rechecks (11–13 % of calls) are not redundant. Killed.
result_zh: 唯一判决不变的规则（0.05 Å 管道）在 DEV-A 上模拟 U/调用 1.0033 倍 [1.0015, 1.0056]，低于 2 % 终止线；更宽者达 1.0456–1.0895 倍，但翻转 8–25 个判决。平坦谷底的终点取决于优化器状态，复核不多余。

idea_en: Near the bottom of a valley, instead of shuffling the last metres in small steps, look once at the shape of the floor and jump to the lowest point. When the L-BFGS endpoint descent reached its slow tail (fmax ≤ 0.01 eV/Å), one exact Hessian was computed and Newton steps finished the descent to fmax 5e-4, rolling back bit-identically on failure; pivot arms reused the IS Hessian instead.
idea_zh: 快到谷底时，与其小步挪完最后几米，不如看一眼谷底的形状直接跳到最低点。端点 L-BFGS 下降进入慢尾段（fmax ≤ 0.01 eV/Å）后，算一次精确 Hessian，用牛顿步收敛到 fmax 5e-4，失败则逐位回滚；转向后的臂改用初态 Hessian 做弦迭代。
systems_en: Replay of an archived long-best-auto reference run on 78 DEV IS (GF3 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33 + G-FACTORY-2 dev 9; metal surfaces and zeolites), in which 822 launches reached the endpoint descent. The first screen stopped after 234 zeolite tasks; the pivot screen replayed 475 launches. No sessions, no confirmation.
systems_zh: 重放存档的 long-best-auto 参照运行：78 个开发初态（GF3 36 + G-FACTORY 开发 33 + G-FACTORY-2 开发 9；金属表面与分子筛），822 个发射进入端点下降。首轮筛选做完 234 个分子筛任务即停，转向后重放 475 个发射。未跑会话，未做确认。
result_en: Replay only. First screen: the Newton finish (N1) kept every verdict but lost calls, projected U/call 0.9885× [0.9821, 0.9959]. Pivot: exact Newton without step halving (P1) 1.0035× [0.9996, 1.0071], p 0.039, but flipped 3 of 475 verdicts; IS-Hessian chord arms 0.9860/0.9896. The L-BFGS tail below fmax 0.01 costs only 0.9–1.6 Hessian-equivalents, so a Hessian-based finish cannot pay. All arms killed.
result_zh: 仅重放：牛顿收尾 N1 投影 U/调用 0.9885 倍 [0.9821, 0.9959]；转向臂 P1 为 1.0035 倍，但翻转 3/475 个判决。fmax 0.01 以下的尾段只值 0.9–1.6 个 Hessian，精确收尾无利可图。终止。

name_en: Mode relay from Sella to validator (REFINE-REORDER → MODE-RELAY)
idea_en: In a relay the runner hands over the baton; nobody re-runs the last lap. The seed idea (exact Newton refine with an early exact TS Hessian) cost more than the existing Krylov–Newton refine. The pivot: when Sella has already converged a candidate, skip the redundant refine and pass Sella's lowest mode to the validator, which then needs 1 rotation instead of 6; the exact-Hessian certificate still checks the mode.
idea_zh: 接力赛只需交棒，下一棒不必把上一圈再跑一遍。原设想（提前算精确过渡态 Hessian 做牛顿精修）比现有精修更贵。转向后：Sella 已收敛的候选跳过多余的精修，把 Sella 自己的最低模交给验证器，验证器只需 1 次而非 6 次转动；精确 Hessian 证书仍核对该模。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), 1 seed; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal + 20 zeolite), 2 seeds, with the metal stratum as primary test (a post-hoc hypothesis frozen before C2 was opened). Reference long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 开发初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 1 个种子上筛选；在 C2 = 62 个密封 G-FACTORY-2 初态（42 金属 + 20 分子筛）× 2 个种子上确认，主检验为金属分层（开发后提出、打开 C2 前冻结的假设）。参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: C2 metals (42 IS): U/call 1.038× [1.017, 1.062], p < 0.00025; all 62 C2 IS 1.029× [1.011, 1.050]; zeolites 1.017, not significant. The pre-registered DEV-A test was inconclusive (1.025, Holm p 0.15). Metal saddles +1.3 % (467 vs 461), U per ionic step unchanged. Entered the v0.80 default long-best-auto-80.

name_en: When to stop walking and start refining (HANDOFF-THRESHOLD)
idea_en: A hiker nearing a pass must decide when to stop striding and switch to careful, measured final steps. Two changes were tested: skip the Newton–Krylov refine for candidates that Sella had already converged, and on large zeolites hand the dimer walk over earlier to a Krylov P-RFO saddle-optimiser tail.
idea_zh: 接近山口的登山者要决定何时停止大步走、改为谨慎的最后几步。本轮测试两项改动：Sella 已收敛的候选跳过 Newton–Krylov 精修确认；大分子筛上让 dimer 行走更早交给 Krylov P-RFO 鞍点优化尾段。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), 2 seeds; confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 IS + 24 IS-first IS (75 runnable; two O+H IS were refused by both arms), 2 seeds, against the shared long-best-auto reference.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 开发初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子上筛选；在 C3 = 53 个密封 G-FACTORY-3 初态 + 24 个 IS-first 初态（75 个可运行，两个 O+H 初态两臂都被拒）× 2 个种子上确认，对照共享的 long-best-auto 参照。
result_en: C3: U/call 0.994× [0.974, 1.014], p = 0.70, saddles 1005 vs 1001; skip-only part 1.003× [0.988, 1.016], p = 0.35; Krylov tail on large zeolites 0.986 (half of such tails stalled on soft modes). The DEV-A pass (1.012×, p = 0.047) came from knife-edge verdict flips that did not replicate. Sella's endgame is already superlinear; only ~0.8–1 % of calls are reliably saved.
result_zh: C3：U/调用 0.994 倍 [0.974, 1.014]，p = 0.70；大分子筛 Krylov 尾段 0.986，半数卡在软模上。DEV-A 的通过源于未复现的临界判决翻转。Sella 末段本已超线性，跳过精修只能稳定省约 0.8–1 % 调用。

idea_en: If the first step off a pass along the compass bearing leads uphill, the valley is curved; bend the first step to follow it. When the straight ±0.12 Å start along the saddle mode was rejected as not downhill, validation retried once from a curved second-order (exact-Hessian, IRC-like) start; the IRC2ND arm skipped the retry for half-step-recheck disagreements. This re-tested a round-96 idea on v0.78.1.
idea_zh: 从山口笔直迈出的第一步若是上坡，说明山谷是弯的，应顺着弯道迈步。沿鞍点模 ±0.12 Å 的直线起点被判为“非下坡”时，验证改从弯曲的二阶（精确 Hessian、类 IRC）起点重试一次；IRC2ND 臂对半步复查不一致者不重试。本轮在 v0.78.1 上复测第 96 轮的想法。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), 2 seeds; confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS (73 IS: 57 metal, 16 zeolite), 2 seeds; reference long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 开发初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子上筛选；在 C1 = 67 个密封 G-FACTORY 初态 + 6 个 G5 初态（73 个：57 金属、16 分子筛）× 2 个种子上确认；参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: C1: IRC2ND U/call 1.012× [0.997, 1.030], p = 0.062, not significant; saddles +4.1 % (591 vs 568). Zeolites 1.051, metals 1.008, where most rescues were mere reorientations. Each rescued saddle cost about 774 calls. DEV-A 1.016× (p = 0.079). The effect is too small to confirm; a zeolite-only follow-up (round 271) later went into the opt-in v0.81 preset long-best-auto-81.
result_zh: C1：U/调用 1.012 倍 [0.997, 1.030]，p = 0.062，不显著；鞍点 +4.1 %，但每救回一个约花 774 次调用；分子筛 1.051，金属 1.008。仅分子筛版（第 271 轮）进入可选预设 long-best-auto-81。

name_en: Secant curvature for endpoint descents (QUENCH-ANATOMY → SECANT-QG)
name_zh: 端点下降的割线初始曲率（QUENCH-ANATOMY → SECANT-QG）
idea_en: A walker who assumes every valley is narrow takes timid steps even on a broad, flat floor. Long endpoint descents are soft-mode descents (rotors, surface sliding, framework breathing): 84–95 % of the product-tail motion lies in modes ≤ 0.2 eV/Å², yet ASE L-BFGS starts from a fixed curvature of 70 eV/Å². Once fmax ≤ 0.05 eV/Å with no recent nonconvex reset, the initial curvature is now taken from the last step's secant (s·y/y·y).
idea_zh: 以为山谷都很窄的人，在宽平的谷底也只敢迈小步。端点下降尾段 84–95 % 的位移在 ≤ 0.2 eV/Å² 的软模上（转子、表面滑移、骨架呼吸），而 ASE L-BFGS 固定假设曲率 70 eV/Å²。fmax ≤ 0.05 后改用上一步的割线 s·y/y·y 设初始曲率。
systems_en: Archive anatomy and screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), 1 seed; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal + 20 zeolite), 1 seed, paired with long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 存档解剖并在 85 个 DEV-A 开发初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 1 个种子上筛选；在 C2 = 62 个密封 G-FACTORY-2 初态（42 金属 + 20 分子筛）× 1 个种子上与 long-best-auto 配对确认。
result_en: C2: U/call 1.063× [1.050, 1.078], p < 0.00025; U/ionic step 1.129×; saddles ×1.009 (328 vs 325); metals 1.069, zeolites 1.051. DEV-A 1.065× [1.048, 1.083]. The pre-registered always-on secant rule lost 1.4–4.5 % of validated candidates. Later cross-pool audits gave 1.050/1.044, among the most stable effects; entered the v0.80 default long-best-auto-80.

idea_en: Walk down the side of a pass that faces home; if you end up elsewhere, the far side, facing away, will hardly lead home either. Disconnected candidates (18–21 % of calls) are mostly the intended reaction in a neighbour of the IS. Validation descends the IS-facing side first and, if it misses the IS while the TS mode clearly points at the IS, rejects the candidate without descending the other side.
idea_zh: 从山口朝家的一侧下山却到了别处，那么背向家的另一侧也几乎不可能通回家。断连候选（占 18–21 % 的调用）多半是同一类反应发生在初态的“邻居”（位点或构象变体）上。验证先下降指向初态的一侧；若没回到初态、而过渡态模又明确指向初态，就直接判为断连，不再下降另一侧。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), 2 seeds; confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 IS + 24 IS-first IS (75 runnable), 2 seeds; reference long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 开发初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子上筛选；在 C3 = 53 个密封 G-FACTORY-3 初态 + 24 个 IS-first 初态（75 个可运行）× 2 个种子上确认；参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: C3: U/call 1.025× [1.019, 1.031], p < 0.00025; U/ionic step 1.056×; but saddles 0.993× (1,039 → 1,032), because the orientation gate erred 4 times on stepped or kinked metals and one zeolite. DEV-A 1.036× [1.029, 1.044] with identical U (945). A stricter gate (0.5) lost nothing on all data; a guarded version later entered the opt-in zeolite stack and v0.81 presets.
result_zh: C3：U/调用 1.025 倍 [1.019, 1.031]，p < 0.00025；每离子步 1.056 倍；但鞍点 0.993 倍，取向判据错判 4 次（多在台阶等金属表面）。阈值提到 0.5 则零损失；带护栏的版本后来进入可选的 v0.81 预设。

idea_en: A forager leaves a berry bush once each new berry costs far more effort than average. Previously a session stopped only when all bonds were driven or after 25 fruitless launches in a row. Now, before each launch, a posterior (per-signature success rates, this IS's productivity, the session's cost per launch) prices the remaining queue in calls per new saddle; the session stops above P = 7000, a little over 3× the average price.
idea_zh: 每摘一颗浆果的代价远超平均时，觅食者就该换地方。以前会话只在拉完所有键或连续 25 次发射一无所获时才停。现在每次发射前，用后验（同类键的成功率、本初态的产出、本会话每次发射的成本）估计剩余队列“每个新鞍点要多少次调用”，超过 P = 7000（略高于平均价格的 3 倍）就停。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), 2 seeds; confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS (73 IS: 57 metal, 16 zeolite), 2 seeds, with an in-pool long-best-auto reference.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 开发初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子上筛选；在 C1 = 67 个密封 G-FACTORY 初态 + 6 个 G5 初态（73 个：57 金属、16 分子筛）× 2 个种子上确认，参照为池内 long-best-auto。
result_en: C1: U/call 1.083× [1.030, 1.155], p < 0.00025; U/ionic step 1.078×; but saddles 0.974× (−2.6 %; zeolites −7.6 %, mostly artefact-flagged). DEV-A 1.038× [1.018, 1.069]. A trade: +3.2 % U/call per 1 % of saddles lost. GF7 traced a 12.3 % per-search saddle shortfall of the v0.79 candidate default to this stop on new chemistry; kept only in the optional preset long-best-auto-79.
result_zh: C1：U/调用 1.083 倍 [1.030, 1.155]，p < 0.00025；但鞍点 −2.6 %。GF7 中含它的预设每次搜索少 12.3 % 鞍点（在新化学上停得过早），故未进 v0.80 默认，只留在可选预设 long-best-auto-79。

name_en: Best-value bonds first, with a call budget (ANYTIME-ORDER-BUDGET)
name_zh: 性价比优先排序与调用预算（ANYTIME-ORDER-BUDGET）
idea_en: A prospector short of time digs first where the expected gold per hour is highest. --anytime orders bond-drive launches by expected new saddles per expected call (frozen DEV success rates by local chemical environment, divided by per-bond-type cost; Smith's ratio rule); the bonds driven and the validation are unchanged. --budget N caps a search at N calls and stops when the remaining budget cannot pay for a typical successful launch.
idea_zh: 时间有限的淘金者先挖“每小时预期出金最多”的地块。--anytime 按“每次调用的预期新鞍点数”给键驱动发射排序（开发集上冻结的分化学环境成功率除以键型成本），要拉的键和验证不变；--budget N 把搜索限制在 N 次调用内，剩余预算不够一次典型成功发射就停。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), 2 seeds; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal + 20 zeolite), 2 seeds, against an in-pool long-best-auto reference.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 开发初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子上筛选；在 C2 = 62 个密封 G-FACTORY-2 初态（42 金属 + 20 分子筛）× 2 个种子上确认，参照为池内 long-best-auto。
result_en: C2 anytime metric A(5k), the area under the saddles-versus-calls curve up to 5,000 calls: 1.199× [1.088, 1.338], p < 0.00025; saddles found by 2k/5k/10k calls 1.22/1.14/1.02×; the 3rd and 5th saddle arrive with 15 % and 17 % fewer calls. Full sessions unchanged (U 1.003×, U/call 1.013×). Metals 1.26, zeolites not significant (1.04). DEV-A 1.115×. Shipped as opt-in modes.

name_zh: 多样化的独立重复搜索（DIVERSIFIED-SECOND-RUN）
idea_en: A second expedition that follows the same trails finds the same passes; starting from different trailheads finds new ones. The default search is deterministic: the seed only breaks ties, so reseeded runs restart every launch from identical points. Run K changes the scan protocol (K = 2: MONO-STAGE scan; K ≥ 3: seeded scan jitter), moving starts by 0.1–0.3 Å so that launches that failed in run 1 get a fresh chance.
idea_zh: 第二支探险队走老路只会找到老山口，换个起点才有新山口。默认搜索是确定性的：种子只决定并列坐标的先后，重新播种时发射起点完全相同。第 K 次运行改换扫描协议（K = 2 用 MONO-STAGE 扫描，K ≥ 3 用种子化抖动），起点移动 0.1–0.3 Å，让首轮失败的发射重来。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites); confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 IS + 22 runnable IS-first IS (75 IS: 47 metal, 28 zeolite), comparing unions of K = 2 and K = 4 runs with reseeded repeats of long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 开发初态（金属表面与分子筛）上筛选；在 C3 = 53 个密封 G-FACTORY-3 初态 + 22 个可运行的 IS-first 初态（75 个：47 金属、28 分子筛）上确认，比较 K = 2 与 K = 4 次运行的并集和重新播种的 long-best-auto 重复运行。
result_en: C3: union of 2 diversified runs, U/call 1.277× [1.219, 1.340] versus 2 reseeded runs (saddles +23.4 %, 653 vs 529); 4 runs 1.454× [1.384, 1.528] (+42.8 %, 787 vs 551); both p < 0.00025. Each single run is no worse (0.98–1.03×). DEV-A 1.290/1.452. Opt-in via --rerun K --diversify. Round 289 later found the K ≥ 3 seeded jitter moved starts by only 0.06–0.08 Å.

name_zh: 金属会话前的 Sella 预热（SELLA-PREFIX-METALS）
idea_en: Before the systematic bond-by-bond survey, a hiker makes a few quick scrambles straight up the gentlest slope beside camp; they almost always reach the same low, nearby passes. On metal surfaces, the `long-best-auto` bond session was preceded by one (PFX1) or up to five (PFX5) plain Sella launches from starts displaced 0.10 Å from the initial state, sharing the session's memory of saddles already found.
idea_zh: 逐键勘察之前，登山者先顺着营地旁最缓的坡快爬几趟，几乎总是到达附近同几个低矮垭口。在金属表面上，`long-best-auto` 键驱动会话之前先做 1 次（PFX1）或至多 5 次（PFX5）普通 Sella 发射，起点离初态 0.10 Å，并与会话共享已找到鞍点的记忆。
systems_en: 61 metal-surface IS from DEV-A (the GF3 metals plus the metal development members of G-FACTORY, G-FACTORY-2 and G-FACTORY-3), 2 seeds, three arms (reference `long-best-auto`, PFX1, PFX5), 366 runs. Both arms failed the development rule, so the planned C1 confirmation on 57 metal IS was not run.
systems_zh: DEV-A 中 61 个金属表面初态（GF3 金属体系及 G-FACTORY、G-FACTORY-2、G-FACTORY-3 开发集中的金属体系）× 2 个种子，三臂（参照 `long-best-auto`、PFX1、PFX5）共 366 次运行；两臂均未通过开发规则，原定在 C1 的 57 个金属初态上的确认未进行。
result_en: Development: PFX1 U/call 0.981× [0.966, 0.997] (U +3.5 %); PFX5 0.918× [0.889, 0.945] (U +7.6 %). The extra saddles were mostly site hops and rotations (80 % with barriers < 0.1 eV), costing 2,201–3,180 calls each against a session average of 1,400. Options stay off. Side finding: plain Sella FAIR spent 20.5 % of its metal calls re-validating known saddles, which later prompted a stronger baseline.
result_zh: 开发集：PFX1 U/调用 0.981 倍 [0.966, 0.997]，U +3.5 %；PFX5 0.918 倍，U +7.6 %。新增鞍点多为能垒 < 0.1 eV 的跳位、转动，每个耗 2,201–3,180 次调用（平均 1,400）。选项默认关闭。

name_en: Dimer second walk for H–metal drives (METAL-ENGINE-SPLIT)
name_zh: H–金属驱动的 dimer 补走（METAL-ENGINE-SPLIT）
idea_en: Two guides with different techniques: the quick one (Sella) leads; the second (the dimer) retraces a trail only where the first gave up early on one terrain, pushing an H atom toward a metal atom it is not yet bonded to. On metals, when Sella failed cheaply on such an H→metal forming drive (positive-curvature abort, or hitting its sphere, leash or progress limit), a dimer immediately re-walked the same start (3.25 Å trust sphere).
idea_zh: 两位向导：快的（Sella）领路；只当他在“把 H 推向未成键金属原子”的路上早早放弃，另一位（dimer）才重走一遍。金属上 H→金属成键驱动的 Sella 行走若低成本失败（正曲率中止，或触及球、缰绳、进度限制），立即用 dimer 从同一起点重走（3.25 Å 信赖球）。
systems_en: Development on the 61 metal-surface IS of DEV-A, 2 seeds (244 runs); confirmation on the 42 metal IS of C2 (sealed G-FACTORY-2), 2 seeds (168 runs). Reference preset `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 的 61 个金属表面初态 × 2 个种子（244 次运行）；确认：C2（G-FACTORY-2 封存集）中的 42 个金属初态 × 2 个种子（168 次运行）；参照预设 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (C2 metals): U/call 0.983× [0.961, 1.005], p = 0.94, U +6.1 % (461 → 489): the pre-registered test failed. Development: 1.027× [0.993, 1.068], U +12.2 %. The retry never lowered the saddle count on any of 103 IS, but on C2's larger adsorbates most dimer re-walks also wandered off. A plain per-class engine split was worth only about +1.7 %. Kept as an opt-in option.
result_zh: 确认（C2 金属）：U/调用 0.983 倍 [0.961, 1.005]，p = 0.94，U +6.1 %（461 → 489），预注册确认失败；开发集 1.027 倍。103 个初态无一减少鞍点，但 C2 吸附物更大，dimer 重走多半走远。仅作可选。

name_en: Per-system knob tuning from zero-cost features (FAMILY-AUTO-TUNE)
idea_en: Instead of handing every expedition the same rule book, a planner reads the trailhead sign (host family, system size, adsorbate) and decides how long to search, how far to roam and how patient to be. A policy mapped zero-call initial-state features to six `long-best-auto` knobs (dry-spell stop, launch cap, trust radius, per-atom Sella sphere, positive-curvature patience, Sella progress stop), fitted by a net-value rule and scored in a replay simulator.
idea_zh: 不给每支队伍同一本手册，而是先读登山口的牌子（宿主、体系大小、吸附物），再定搜多久、走多远、多有耐心。由初态零调用特征为每个体系选 `long-best-auto` 的六个旋钮（干旱停止、发射上限、信赖半径、Sella 单原子球、正曲率耐心、进度停止），用回放存档的模拟器评估。
systems_en: A zero-call simulator (“world”) built from `long-best-auto` runs on all 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds with relaxed limits and extended traces (fidelity versus the real reference: U 1.002, calls 1.013), scored by leave-one-host-family-out validation; one exploratory NEP check on DEV-A. The planned C3 confirmation was not run.
systems_zh: 零调用模拟器（“世界”）：在 DEV-A 全部 85 个初态 × 2 个种子上以放宽限制、扩展轨迹运行 `long-best-auto` 构建（与真实参照比 U 1.002、调用 1.013），留一宿主族验证；另在 DEV-A 上做一次探索性 NEP 检验。原定 C3 确认未进行。
result_en: Simulated, leave-one-family-out: global policy U/call 1.027× with U 0.976; per-family 1.041× (U 0.943); policy tree 1.068× (U 0.917). None kept U ≥ 0.98, so the kill rule ended the round before NEP tests. Best knobs proved trajectory-specific (|ρ| ≤ 0.44 with all features); held-out MFI and CHA lost 22–30 % of saddles. An exploratory global retune measured 1.028× [1.010, 1.048] on NEP; logged only.
result_zh: 留一族模拟：全局策略 U/调用 1.027 倍、U 0.976；每族 1.041 倍、U 0.943；策略树 1.068 倍、U 0.917，均未守住 U ≥ 0.98，按杀伤规则终止。最优旋钮随轨迹而变，难由特征预测。探索性全局重调 1.028 倍，仅记录。

idea_en: Near the valley floor, instead of shuffling in ever smaller steps, the walker measures the exact shape of the bowl once and strides straight to the bottom. About 70 % of ionic steps go into validation descents, where product-side L-BFGS grinds through the last few meV; at product-side fmax ≤ 0.05 eV/Å one exact NEP89 Hessian (no ionic steps) became the L-BFGS initial inverse Hessian, and the half-step product recheck reused it.
idea_zh: 快到谷底时不再碎步挪动，而是量一次碗形，径直走到底。约 70 % 离子步用于验证下降，产物侧 L-BFGS 在最后几 meV 反复磨；新选项在 fmax ≤ 0.05 eV/Å 时算一个精确 NEP89 Hessian（不计离子步）作其初始逆 Hessian，半步复核也沿用。
systems_en: Development on DEV-A (85 IS, 1 seed; 80 IS with all arms complete after a storage-quota crash); confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS (73 IS), 1 seed. Reference preset `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 85 个初态 × 1 个种子（存储配额事故后 80 个初态各臂齐全）；确认：C1 = G-FACTORY 封存 67 个 + G5 6 个，共 73 个初态 × 1 个种子；参照预设 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (C1): U per ionic step 1.152× [1.102, 1.193], p < 0.00025, the round's target metric; U/call 1.010× [0.974, 1.036], within the 2 % rule. Cost: 2.8 % fewer saddles per search, IS with ≥ 1 saddle 70 → 68, and about 2 % of validation verdicts flipped (all toward rejection on C1). Development: 1.180× per ionic step, 1.043× per call. Shipped in the opt-in `long-ionic-auto` preset (v0.80).

idea_en: A second search party enters only rooms nobody has entered, or rooms where the first searcher tripped at the door, instead of re-searching the whole house. `--complete` re-walks every coordinate from cached scan tops with the other walker, though same-walker repeats yield only 0.10–0.24× the first-pass rate; the focused step walked only never-walked coordinates and those whose first walk failed with a scan top ≤ 1 eV, skipping the rest at zero calls.
idea_zh: 第二支搜索队不重搜整栋房子，只进没人进过的房间，或前一位在门口绊倒处。`--complete` 第二步用另一种行走器从缓存扫描顶重走每个坐标，同类重走产率仅为首遍的 0.10–0.24 倍；聚焦版只走从未走过的坐标和首次行走失败且扫描顶 ≤ 1 eV 的坐标，其余 0 调用跳过。
systems_en: Development on DEV-A (85 IS: 61 metal, 24 non-metal); confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (290 sessions). Reference `--complete`; prices are computed against one default `long-best-auto` search and compared with `--more`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 85 个初态（61 个金属、24 个非金属）；确认：C2 = G-FACTORY-2 封存 62 个初态，共 290 个会话。参照为 `--complete`，价格相对一次默认 `long-best-auto` 搜索计算，并与 `--more` 比较。
result_en: Confirmation (C2), against one default search: focused step U +10.2 % at U/call 0.931× [0.895, 0.967], price −0.68 (% U/call per +1 % U); `--complete` U +22.5 % at 0.760×, price −1.07. The pre-registered price advantage, +0.39 [−0.14, 0.81], p = 0.053, missed significance, and `--more` (U +8.3 % at 0.994×) dominated. Development had passed (+0.48, p = 0.0008). No default change.

idea_en: A climbing club keeps one shared logbook: routes that failed twice for earlier teams are tried last, and a team heads home after three more fruitless tries of those routes. In a batch of related initial states (grouped by host family and adsorbate formula, cheapest first), later members reordered bond drives by a batch-adjusted prior, deferred bond signatures tried at least twice without a saddle, and stopped after three dry deferred launches.
idea_zh: 登山俱乐部共用一本日志：前面队伍两次都没走通的路线放到最后，只剩这类路线又连空三次就收工。在一批相关初态（按宿主类别与吸附物分子式分组，便宜者先算）中，后算的成员按批内修正的先验重排键驱动，推迟已试 ≥ 2 次仍无鞍点的签名，连续 3 次推迟发射无果即停。
systems_en: Development: 58 DEV-A IS in 17 multi-member groups (40 metal, 18 zeolite), 2 seeds. Confirmation: multi-member groups of C3 (sealed G-FACTORY-3 + IS-first set), 54 IS; the single confirmatory test used the 36 metal IS × 2 seeds, zeolites descriptive only. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 中 17 个多成员组的 58 个初态（金属 40、分子筛 18）× 2 个种子。确认：C3（G-FACTORY-3 封存集 + IS-first 集）的多成员组共 54 个初态，唯一确认检验为其中 36 个金属初态 × 2 个种子，分子筛仅作描述；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (C3 metals): batch U/call 1.058× [1.015, 1.102], p = 0.0025, but U fell 11.5 %, failing the pre-registered U ≥ 0.95 guard, so inconclusive. C3 zeolites lost 24 % of saddles for a non-significant 1.088×; saddles ≤ 1.5 eV were kept (C3 count 0.987×). Losses concentrated in one group, where the cheapest, least reactive Cu members defined 'dead' bonds for Pd. Opt-in `batch --transfer` only.
result_zh: 确认（C3 金属）：批 U/调用 1.058 倍 [1.015, 1.102]，p = 0.0025，但 U −11.5 %，未过 U ≥ 0.95 护栏，判为不确定；分子筛 U −24 %。损失集中于一组：最不活泼的 Cu 成员替 Pd 定义了“死键”。

idea_en: A prospector quits after 12 empty pans instead of 25, but only at a claim that has never shown gold or at a seam that paid well and then went quiet; elsewhere the patient rule stays. The dry-spell stop (25 consecutive launches without a new saddle) dropped to 12 for sessions with no saddle yet and for 'spent' metal sessions (≥ 0.6 saddles per 1,000 calls, then quiet); zeolite sessions kept 25.
idea_zh: 淘金者只在两种地方把“连空 25 盘才收工”改成 12 盘：从没见过金子的矿点，和曾经高产、如今沉寂的矿脉。干旱期停止（连续 25 次发射无新鞍点）对尚无鞍点的会话和“已采尽”的金属会话（≥ 0.6 个鞍点/千次调用后沉寂）缩短为 12 次；分子筛保持 25 次。
systems_en: Development on all 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds, scored as exact prefixes of the reference sessions; confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS, 2 seeds (292 sessions). Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 全部 85 个初态 × 2 个种子，按参照会话的精确前缀记账；确认：C1 = G-FACTORY 封存 67 个 + G5 6 个，共 73 个初态 × 2 个种子（292 个会话）；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (C1, primary seed): U/call 1.000× [0.998, 1.004], p = 0.373 (both seeds 1.002×), U 283 → 282: no detectable gain. Development: 1.017× [1.005, 1.036], p < 0.00025. The rule fired in only 5 of 146 C1 sessions, since those metal sessions are short (about 15 launches). Zeolite stopping proved already near-optimal: searching longer costs about twice the calls per saddle.
result_zh: 确认（C1，主种子）：U/调用 1.000 倍 [0.998, 1.004]，p = 0.373，无收益；开发集 1.017 倍 [1.005, 1.036]。C1 金属会话很短（约 15 次发射），146 个会话中规则只触发 5 次。分子筛现行停止已近最优。

name_en: Following the scan branch through its fold (FOLD-CONTINUATION)
idea_en: Where the trail doubles back at a hairpin, don't leap across to a different trail; follow the same one around the bend. A relaxed bond scan can snap to another branch at a fold; the option traced the scan's own constrained-minimum curve by pseudo-arclength continuation through the fold to the point where the bond's constraint force vanishes, which is guaranteed to be a first-order saddle, then handed it to Sella or the dimer.
idea_zh: 山路在发夹弯处折回时，不跳到另一条路上，而是沿同一条路绕过弯道。松弛键扫描在折点处可能跳到另一分支；新选项用伪弧长延拓沿扫描自身的约束极小曲线穿过折点，走到键约束力为零之处（必定是一阶鞍点），再交给 Sella 或 dimer。
systems_en: Pre-registered pilot on all 85 DEV-A IS, 1 seed, against the shared `long-best-auto` reference. The kill rule fired, so the second development seed and the C2 confirmation were not run.
systems_zh: 预注册试点：DEV-A 全部 85 个初态 × 1 个种子，对照共享的 `long-best-auto` 参照；杀伤规则触发，第二个开发种子与 C2 确认均未进行。
result_en: Pilot: the continuation reached a saddle in only 18.5 % of gated launches (102/552), below the pre-registered 20 % kill threshold. U/call 0.976× [0.965, 0.987] (0.979× as charged), U 0.967×. Where both arms converged, the existing walker already reached the same saddle in 84 % of cases (78/93); two-thirds of scan tops lay too far from the curve, and the missing saddles sit on other branches.
result_zh: 试点：延拓只在 18.5 %（102/552）的放行发射中到达鞍点，低于 20 % 杀伤线；U/调用 0.976 倍 [0.965, 0.987]，U 0.967 倍。现有行走器 84 % 已落到同一鞍点；三分之二的扫描顶离曲线太远，漏掉的鞍点在别的分支上。

name_en: Guess products first, then connect them (PRODUCT-ENUMERATION-DOUBLE-ENDED)
idea_en: Pick likely destinations first, then look for the pass leading to each. After the normal session, the option guessed products (an H moved to another O/N/C acceptor within 3.5 Å, or a metal-bound atom hopped to a neighbouring site), relaxed each with a few dozen calls, kept new minima ordered by reaction energy, and started the session's walker from the top of an initial-state→product IDPP path (variants: NEB, or a relaxed scan).
idea_zh: 先在地图上挑出目的地，再找通往每处的垭口。常规会话结束后先猜产物（把 H 挪到 3.5 Å 内另一个 O/N/C 受体上，或把金属上的吸附原子挪到相邻位），各用几十次力调用松弛，按反应能排序保留新极小，再从初态→产物 IDPP 路径最高点启动原行走器（变体：NEB、松弛扫描）。
systems_en: Two pre-registered pilots on 12 DEV-A IS (6 zeolites: CHA, FAU, FER, MOR; 6 metal surfaces: Ru, Rh, Ni, Pt, Pd, Cu), 1 seed, against `long-best-auto`. Kill rules stopped the full 85-IS development run and the C3 confirmation.
systems_zh: 两个预注册试点：DEV-A 中 12 个初态（6 个分子筛：CHA、FAU、FER、MOR；6 个金属表面：Ru、Rh、Ni、Pt、Pd、Cu）× 1 个种子，对照 `long-best-auto`；杀伤规则触发，85 个初态的开发运行与 C3 确认均未进行。
result_en: Pilot: U +11.7 % but U/call 0.877× [0.802, 0.928]; each new saddle cost 4,475 calls, 2.33× the session average, which triggered the kill rule. The relaxed-scan variant did worse: 0.839× [0.753, 0.895], 4.15× the average. The new saddles were fully complementary (all 9 outside the two-seed reference union, 2 never seen in the programme), but only about 8 % of launches succeeded.
result_zh: 试点：U +11.7 %，但 U/调用 0.877 倍 [0.802, 0.928]；每个新鞍点耗 4,475 次调用，为会话平均的 2.33 倍，触发终止规则；松弛扫描变体更差（0.839 倍）。新鞍点全在参照之外，2 个全项目首见；但发射成功率约 8 %。

name_en: Skip mirror-image drives after a validated saddle (SYMMETRY-REDUCTION)
idea_en: In a house with mirror-image rooms, once the left room has given up its find, nobody searches the right one; if the left search failed, the right room is still searched. When an adsorbate sits symmetrically, a bond drive whose mirror counterpart had already landed on a validated saddle (which the matcher would merge anyway) was skipped at zero calls; image launches after failures still ran, because tiny asymmetries make them useful reruns.
idea_zh: 房子里有一对镜像房间：左间已找到东西，就不再搜右间；左间没找到，右间照搜。吸附物对称时，若某键驱动的镜像坐标已落到经验证的鞍点（计数时本会合并），该驱动 0 调用跳过；镜像失败时照常驱动，因为微小的不对称让这次重跑偶有收获。
systems_en: Symmetric subsets (small adsorbates such as CH3, CH2, CH, NH2/NH3 and H2O on metal surfaces): 14 of the 85 DEV-A IS × 6 seeds (84 paired sessions) for development; 20 of the 73 C1 IS (all sealed G-FACTORY metals) × 4 seeds (80 paired sessions) for confirmation. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 对称子集（金属表面上的 CH3、CH2、CH、NH2/NH3、H2O 等小吸附物）：开发用 DEV-A 85 个初态中的 14 个 × 6 个种子（84 对会话）；确认用 C1 73 个初态中的 20 个（均为 G-FACTORY 封存金属体系）× 4 个种子（80 对会话）；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (symmetric C1 subset): U/call 1.090× [1.048, 1.147], p < 0.00025, with identical U in all 80 paired sessions; U/ionic step 1.040×. Development: 1.048× [1.024, 1.077] (84/84 identical). Driving only one coordinate per orbit (ORBIT) reached 1.274× but lost 4.6–12.3 % of saddles. Gain over all IS is about 0.2–1 %; `drive_symmetry_prune=validated` entered the v0.80 default `long-best-auto-80`.
result_zh: 确认（C1 对称子集）：U/调用 1.090 倍 [1.048, 1.147]，p < 0.00025，80 对会话 U 全部相同。若每轨道只驱动一个，1.274 倍但丢 4.6–12.3 % 鞍点。全体初态增益约 0.2–1 %，并入 v0.80 默认预设。

idea_en: Hand the climber a crib sheet: 'when this kind of bond breaks or forms, the neighbouring atoms usually swing like this.' A library of 27 reaction classes (metal element generalised), learned from known saddles, stored the typical transition-state mode including spectator-atom motion; at each bond-scan top the walker started along this template plus half the bare bond direction instead of the bond alone, at no extra force calls.
idea_zh: 给登山者一张“经验卡”：这类键断裂或生成时，周围原子通常这样一起摆动。从已知鞍点按反应类别（金属元素泛化，共 27 类）学习过渡态负曲率模模板，含旁观原子运动；在每个键扫描顶点，行走器的起始方向由单纯的键方向改为模板加 0.5 倍键方向，不额外花力调用。
systems_en: Pre-registered H0 on 240 bond-scan tops from DEV-A; descriptive paired sessions on all 85 DEV-A IS (GF3 36 + G-FACTORY dev 33 + G-FACTORY-2 dev 9 + G-FACTORY-3 dev 7; metal surfaces and zeolites) × 2 seeds, reference `long-best-auto`. Confirmation on C2 (62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS) was not run.
systems_zh: 预注册 H0：DEV-A 上 240 个键扫描顶点；描述性配对会话：全部 85 个 DEV-A 初态（GF3 36 + G-FACTORY 开发 33 + G-FACTORY-2 开发 9 + G-FACTORY-3 开发 7，金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto`。C2（G-FACTORY-2 封存 62 个初态）确认未运行。
result_en: Pre-registered H0 failed: overlap with the walker's true lowest mode improved by only +0.0246 (rule ≥ 0.03). Descriptive DEV-A sessions: U/call 1.013× [0.972, 1.056], p = 0.26, short of the confirmation bar; U +11.7 %, almost all from zeolites (+20.5 %, U/call 1.039). Templates do predict the TS mode across systems, but not where the TS is. Option off by default.
result_zh: 预注册 H0 未过：与真实最低模重叠仅增 +0.0246（需 ≥ 0.03）。DEV-A 描述性会话：U/调用 1.013 倍 [0.972, 1.056]，p = 0.26；U +11.7 %，几乎全来自分子筛。模板能预测过渡态的模式，而非位置。选项关闭。

idea_en: A hiker who pushes in a randomly chosen direction, piling sand behind each step so he cannot slide back, until he tips over a ridge. After a normal `long-best-auto` session, an optional stochastic-surface-walking phase pushed along 'atom pair + random thermal wiggle of the adsorbate', stacking Gaussian bias hills and relaxing after each; once the true energy turned down, the highest point and path tangent went to the session's own walker.
idea_zh: 像登山者朝随机方向推进，每走一步就在身后堆沙防止滑回，直到翻过山脊。`long-best-auto` 会话后追加可选的随机表面行走（SSW）阶段：沿“推一对原子 + 吸附物随机热振动”方向逐个堆叠高斯偏置并松弛，真实能量一下降，就把最高点和路径切线交给会话自己的行走器。
systems_en: Pilot (arm choice) on the 36 GF3 IS (original development systems plus generations 3 and 4), 1 seed; DEV test on the other 49 DEV-A IS (G-FACTORY dev 33, G-FACTORY-2 dev 9, G-FACTORY-3 dev 7; 42 metal, 7 zeolite) × 2 seeds = 98 paired runs against the shared `long-best-auto` reference. C3 confirmation not run.
systems_zh: 试点（选臂）：GF3 的 36 个初态（早期开发体系 + 第 3、4 代），1 个种子；DEV 检验：其余 49 个 DEV-A 初态（G-FACTORY 开发 33、G-FACTORY-2 开发 9、G-FACTORY-3 开发 7；42 个金属、7 个分子筛）× 2 个种子 = 98 对运行，对照共享 `long-best-auto` 参照。C3 确认未运行。
result_en: DEV: U +5.6 % but U/call 0.964× [0.945, 0.981]. Phase efficiency relative to the session, M = 0.589 [0.395, 0.782], stayed below the 0.67 bar; a new saddle cost 2,665 calls vs the session's 1,569. All 23 new saddles were plausible adsorbate saddles (mostly metal site hops and C–H/N–H breaks), 14 found by no reference-preset run: complementary, not cheaper. No confirmation.
result_zh: DEV：U +5.6 %，但 U/调用 0.964 倍 [0.945, 0.981]；相对效率 M = 0.589（门槛 0.67），每个新鞍点 2,665 次调用（会话 1,569）。23 个新鞍点均合理，14 个参照预设从未找到：互补但不更便宜。未做确认。

idea_en: Flood the valley until the water spills over its lowest rim, as metadynamics does. After the session, each adsorbate atom's coordination number towards substrate or adsorbate partners was pushed up or down in relaxed stages (zero-temperature flooding along a collective bond-order variable), and the walker was launched where the energy turned down; tested after `long-best-auto` and `long-lowbarrier-auto`, aiming at low-barrier saddles.
idea_zh: 像元动力学那样往山谷里灌水，等水从最低山口溢出。会话后，把每个吸附原子对衬底或吸附物的配位数逐级升降并松弛（沿集体键级变量的零温填充），在能量开始下降处放出行走器；接在 `long-best-auto` 与 `long-lowbarrier-auto` 之后，专找低能垒鞍点。
systems_en: NEP pilot (kill rule) on 8 DEV-A IS, 1 seed: CH dissociation on Pt(111), CO+H on Rh(111), formate on Cu(111), CH3 on Ni(111), and water or methanol proton transfer in H-CHA, H-FAU (2) and H-MOR. Zero-call replays on archived GF3 runs (3 seeds) and shared DEV-A `long-lowbarrier-auto` runs. The DEV test (77 IS × 2 seeds) and C1 confirmation were never reached.
