systems_zh: NEP 先导（杀伤规则）：8 个 DEV-A 初态 × 1 个种子——Pt(111) 上 CH 解离、Rh(111) 上 CO+H、Cu(111) 上甲酸根、Ni(111) 上 CH3，以及 H-CHA、H-FAU（2 个）、H-MOR 中水或甲醇的质子转移。另在存档 GF3 运行（3 个种子）与共享 DEV-A `long-lowbarrier-auto` 运行上做零调用回放。DEV 检验（77 个初态 × 2 个种子）与 C1 确认均未触发。
result_en: The pre-registered kill rule fired for both arms: the flood phase found new low-barrier saddles at only 0.17 and 0.25 of the session's per-call rate (bar 0.8). Pilot U(≤1.5)/call 0.903× [0.853, 0.937] vs `long-best-auto` and 0.932× [0.895, 0.962] vs `long-lowbarrier-auto`, with 2 and 1 extra saddles. Bond drives already act as pairwise flooding; 57 % of floods never crossed a ridge.
result_zh: 两臂均触发杀伤规则：填充阶段每调用的低能垒新鞍点仅为会话 0.17 与 0.25 倍（门槛 0.8）。先导 U(≤1.5)/调用对 `long-best-auto` 0.903 倍 [0.853, 0.937]。键驱动本已是成对填充；57 % 的填充未越脊。

name_zh: 随机起点方向的贝叶斯选择（DIRECTION-BAYESOPT）
idea_en: A prospector who marks every spot already dug, and what each dig cost, then picks the next site least like any earlier one. For multi-start Sella, a kernel 'Chinese-restaurant' model on the sphere of start directions scored 64 candidate directions per launch by cost-aware expected improvement, and the launch went along the one least similar to earlier launches, at no extra force calls.
idea_zh: 像淘金者记下每个挖过的地点和花费，下一锹专挑与以往最不像的地方。对多起点 Sella，在起始方向球面上建立核“中国餐馆过程”模型，每次发射前用代价感知的期望改进给 64 个候选方向打分，沿与以往发射最不相似的方向出发，不额外花力调用。
systems_en: DEV test on all 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds (SELLA-FAIR multi-start Sella with vs without the new direction rule); confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS × 2 seeds. A second comparison appended a random-start Sella phase after `long-best-auto` on DEV-A (149 complete pairs, 77 IS; not confirmed).
systems_zh: DEV 检验：全部 85 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子（SELLA-FAIR 多起点 Sella，有/无新方向规则）；确认：C2 = G-FACTORY-2 封存 62 个初态 × 2 个种子。另一对比较在 `long-best-auto` 之后追加随机起点 Sella 阶段（DEV-A，149 对完整配对、77 个初态，未确认）。
result_en: DEV: U/call 1.253× [1.124, 1.405] over SELLA-FAIR, but the C2 confirmation gave 1.060× [0.946, 1.183], p = 0.148, not significant (U +9.8 %, U/ionic step 1.103×, U per core-second 0.795×). Not repeating bond axes helps (69 % of random launches repeated one), but pure novelty pushed over half the launches into low-yield directions. As a phase after `long-best-auto` it was far costlier than `--more`.
result_zh: 开发集对 SELLA-FAIR U/调用 1.253 倍 [1.124, 1.405]；C2 确认 1.060 倍 [0.946, 1.183]，p = 0.148，不显著。不重复键轴有用，但只求新颖使过半发射落入低产方向；作补漏阶段远不如 `--more`。

idea_en: Find the passes on a cheap cardboard model of the mountains, then slowly morph the model into the real terrain and follow each pass as it moves. A zero-call bond-index model (hydrogens hand over between partners; heavy atoms tethered by the IS Hessian) was searched for saddles, which were continued to NEP89 by one jump or a predictor–corrector path. Pivot DH1 instead seeded Sella's initial Hessian with one model negative-curvature direction.
idea_zh: 先在便宜的“纸板山”上找山口，再把它逐渐变形为真实地形，跟住每个山口。零调用的键指数模型（氢在伙伴间交接，重原子由初态 Hessian 拴住）给出鞍点，再一步跳跃或沿预测–校正路径延拓到 NEP89。转向 DH1：只把一个模型负曲率方向播种进 Sella 初始 Hessian。
systems_en: Zero-call census check on the 36 GF3 IS; homotopy pilot on 12 GF3 IS, 1 seed; Hessian-seeding pilots on 16 DEV-A metal IS; DH1 dev test on all 61 DEV-A metal IS (GF3 19, G-FACTORY dev 30, G-FACTORY-2 dev 8, G-FACTORY-3 dev 4), 1 seed, reference `long-best-auto`. C3 confirmation not run.
systems_zh: 零调用普查检验：GF3 的 36 个初态；同伦先导：12 个 GF3 初态，1 个种子；Hessian 播种先导：16 个 DEV-A 金属初态；DH1 开发检验：全部 61 个 DEV-A 金属初态（GF3 19、G-FACTORY 开发 30、G-FACTORY-2 开发 8、G-FACTORY-3 开发 4），1 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto`。C3 确认未运行。
result_en: Homotopy phase: U/call 0.893× [0.832, 0.951] (jump) and 0.899× (path); each new saddle cost 4,954 calls, 2.7× the reference average. Continuation paths mostly folded (41 %), landed on index-2 saddles (26 %) or re-found known saddles (24 %). Full model Hessian: 0.854×. DH1: 1.030× [0.989, 1.069], p = 0.072, inconclusive; a later re-test (round 257) did not replicate it.

name_en: Smoothed-surface walk, then extra dimer rotations (SMOOTHED-PES-WALK)
name_zh: 平滑势面行走与正曲率补转（SMOOTHED-PES-WALK）
idea_en: Sand down the trail's small bumps before walking it: the walker first ran on a Gaussian-smoothed NEP89 surface (σ 0.05/0.10 Å, every sample charged) or with the potential's short-range (ZBL) switching kink smoothed. Pivot: like a blindfolded climber whose probe reports 'convex', turn the probe again before stepping — up to K extra full dimer rotations at positive-curvature steps, because such aborts mostly came from the dimer losing a fast-turning lowest mode.
idea_zh: 先把山路的小坑小包磨平再走：行走器在高斯平滑的 NEP89 势面上走（σ 0.05/0.10 Å，样本全计费），或把 ZBL 切换折点磨平。转向：正曲率中止多因 dimer 跟丢快速转向的最低模，于是像蒙眼登山者探针报“凸”时先多转几次——在正曲率步上至多补做 K 次完整转动。
systems_en: Seed screened by paired replay of 524 archived DEV-A launches; pivot replayed on 191 launches from 20 zeolite IS. Dev sessions on the 24 non-metal DEV-A IS (zeolites: GF3 17, G-FACTORY dev 3, G-FACTORY-2 dev 1, G-FACTORY-3 dev 3) × 2 seeds; confirmation on the 16 zeolite IS of C1 (15 sealed G-FACTORY + G5 ethanol/H-MWW) × 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 种子方案：对 524 次存档 DEV-A 发射做配对重放；转向方案：在 20 个分子筛初态的 191 次发射上重放。开发会话：24 个非金属 DEV-A 初态（分子筛：GF3 17、G-FACTORY 开发 3、G-FACTORY-2 开发 1、G-FACTORY-3 开发 3）× 2 个种子；确认：C1 中 16 个分子筛初态（15 个 G-FACTORY 封存 + G5 乙醇/H-MWW）× 2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Smoothing was killed in replay (start-mode ratio R = 0.39/0.20/0.75/0.76 vs a 1.03 bar; rescue yield 3–5 %). Up to three extra rotations (PROT3) passed dev, U/call 1.053× [1.009, 1.096], p = 0.0107, but failed C1 confirmation: 0.992× [0.920, 1.054], p = 0.60, with U_ads/call 0.876 below its guard; the extra saddles were mostly adsorbate reorientations. Options off.
result_zh: 平滑在重放中被淘汰。补转 ≤3 次（PROT3）开发通过：U/调用 1.053 倍 [1.009, 1.096]；C1 确认失败：0.992 倍 [0.920, 1.054]，p = 0.60，U_ads/调用 0.876 未过护栏，新增多为吸附物取向变化。

idea_en: Guess where the pass lies from how the ground curves under your tent: measure not only slope and curvature at camp but how the curvature itself changes. After the session, 55 force calls (central differences) gave third- and fourth-order derivatives along up to six of the softest adsorbate modes at the IS; saddles of the resulting quartic model became forced starting points for the session's Sella walker on metals.
idea_zh: 从帐篷脚下地面的弯法推测山口在哪：不只量坡度和曲率，还量曲率本身怎样变化。会话结束后，在初态处用 55 次力调用（中心差分）求沿至多 6 个最软吸附物模式的三、四阶导数，拼成四次模型，把模型鞍点作为强制起点交给会话自己的 Sella 行走器（金属）。
systems_en: Zero-session screen on 78 archived DEV-A sessions (which restricted it to metals); DEV test on the 61 metal DEV-A IS × 2 seeds; opt-in confirmation on the 42 metal IS of C2 (sealed G-FACTORY-2) × 2 seeds, reference = the same run's `long-best-auto` prefix.
systems_zh: 零会话筛选：78 个存档 DEV-A 会话（选定只用于金属）；DEV 检验：61 个金属 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子；可选项确认：C2（G-FACTORY-2 封存）中 42 个金属初态 × 2 个种子，参照为同一运行的 `long-best-auto` 前缀。
result_en: DEV: U +10.7 %; U/call 1.028× [0.997, 1.065] vs the shared reference but 1.020× [0.989, 1.056], p = 0.116, vs the same run's prefix, and U_ads/call 0.977 missed its guard: failed. C2: U +4.3 %, U/call 1.006× [0.988, 1.027], p = 0.29, not confirmed. True energies at predicted points were about twice the model's; new saddles were very-low-barrier hops and rotations on metals.
result_zh: C2：U +4.3 %，U/调用 1.006 倍 [0.988, 1.027]，p = 0.29，未确认；开发集对同运行前缀 1.020 倍 [0.989, 1.056]，p = 0.116。预测点真实能量约为模型的两倍；新鞍点多为金属上极低能垒跳位与转动。

idea_en: A hiker who notes every fork on the way up, then goes back later to try the other trail. During each relaxed bond scan, a free sensor (the curvature seen by the relaxation steps, zero calls) flagged where the constrained curvature turned negative; after the session, the scan was restarted from the mirror point on the other branch (free or exact-Hessian direction) and a walker launched from its new top.
idea_zh: 像登山者沿途记下每个岔路口，事后再回去走另一条。每次键长松弛扫描中，用免费传感器（松弛步看到的曲率，0 次调用）标出约束曲率变负的分支点；会话结束后从分支点的镜像点进入另一支（免费方向或精确 Hessian 方向），继续扫描到新顶点再放出行走器。
systems_en: Pilot (kill rule) on 24 DEV-A IS, 1 seed: 12 metal (e.g. methoxy/Cu(111), formic acid and ethylene glycol/Pt(111), CH3/Ni(111), NH3+H/Ru(0001)) and 12 zeolite (H-CHA, H-FAU, H-FER, H-MOR, MTT); reference = each run's own bond-scan prefix. Knowledge arms traced 129 missed saddles from the GF3 census. Dev (85 IS × 2 seeds) and C3 confirmation not run.
systems_zh: 先导（杀伤规则）：24 个 DEV-A 初态 × 1 个种子——12 个金属（如 Cu(111) 上甲氧基、Pt(111) 上甲酸与乙二醇、Ni(111) 上 CH3、Ru(0001) 上 NH3+H）与 12 个分子筛（H-CHA、H-FAU、H-FER、H-MOR、MTT），参照为同一运行的键扫描前缀。知识臂追溯 GF3 普查中漏掉的 129 个鞍点。DEV（85 × 2）与 C3 确认未运行。
result_en: Both arms failed the kill rule: only 5.9 % / 4.3 % of branch launches found a new saddle (bar 15 %), at 6.3k / 8.3k calls per new saddle; U/call 0.986× [0.976, 0.994] (free) and 0.980× [0.968, 0.989] (exact), U +0.66 %. The free sensor was never wrong but caught only 1.6 % of instabilities. Key diagnosis: 65 % of missed saddles start from another near-degenerate IS conformation.
result_zh: 两臂均未过杀伤规则：分支发射仅 5.9 % / 4.3 % 找到新鞍点（门槛 15 %）；U/调用 0.986 倍 [0.976, 0.994]（免费臂）。免费传感器从不误报，但只抓到 1.6 % 的不稳定。诊断：65 % 的漏检鞍点源自另一个近简并初态构象。

name_zh: 分子筛伪影化学预过滤（ARTIFACT-PREFILTER）
idea_en: A prospector who learns to recognise fool's gold by its look before digging it out. In zeolites NEP89 readily yields saddles to chemically dubious products (siloxane protonation, double protonation). The opt-in mode never drives a C–H hydrogen onto acid-free framework oxygen, and after each bond scan extrapolates the top half a step: if that geometry already matches an artefact rule, the launch stops, paying only for the scan.
idea_zh: 像淘金者学会凭外观认出“愚人金”，不再费力挖出来。NEP89 在分子筛中很容易走出化学上可疑的产物（硅氧烷质子化、双质子化）。新可选模式不再把 C–H 上的氢推向无酸位的骨架氧；每次键扫描后把顶点沿扫描方向外推半步，若已符合伪影规则就停止该次发射，只付扫描的调用。
systems_en: Dev on DEV24 = the 24 zeolite IS of DEV-A (GF3 17, G-FACTORY dev 3, G-FACTORY-2 dev 1, G-FACTORY-3 dev 3) × 2 seeds; confirmation on C1-Z = 15 sealed G-FACTORY zeolite IS + the G5 ethanol/H-MWW IS × 2 seeds. Three arms: default `long-best-auto`, `--plausible` screening, and `--strict-plausible`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV24 = DEV-A 中的 24 个分子筛初态（GF3 17、G-FACTORY 开发 3、G-FACTORY-2 开发 1、G-FACTORY-3 开发 3）× 2 个种子；确认：C1-Z = 15 个 G-FACTORY 封存分子筛初态 + G5 的乙醇/H-MWW × 2 个种子。三组：默认 `long-best-auto`、`--plausible` 筛查、`--strict-plausible`。
result_en: Confirmed on C1-Z: unflagged (artefact-free) saddles per call 1.148× [1.065, 1.231], p = 0.001, vs `--plausible`, and 1.678× vs default `long-best-auto`; clean saddles 56 vs 57. Total U drops 43 % vs default because artefacts are no longer found (all-saddle U/call 0.972). Misses concerted proton shuttles in water clusters. Merged as opt-in `--strict-plausible`; defaults unchanged.
result_zh: C1-Z 确认：无伪影鞍点/调用对 `--plausible` 1.148 倍 [1.065, 1.231]，p = 0.001，数量 57→56；总 U 比默认少 43 %（不再出伪影）。漏掉水团簇质子穿梭。可选 `--strict-plausible`。

idea_en: Climb with most of the scaffolding bolted down, then release it with one spring-like adjustment before the last stretch. In zeolites, framework atoms farther than R (4 or 5 Å) from the adsorbate were frozen during the dimer climb, relaxed in one harmonic step using the exact IS Hessian, and the walk finished in full space. Variant MROT kept the geometry free but confined only the dimer's mode to the active region.
idea_zh: 像攀爬时先把大部分脚手架固定住，近顶时用一次“弹簧式”调整放开，再走完最后一段。分子筛中 dimer 爬坡时冻结离吸附物 R（4 或 5 Å）以外的骨架原子，用初态精确 Hessian 一步谐性释放，再在全空间收尾；变体 MROT 几何不冻结，只把 dimer 模式限于活性区。
systems_en: All 24 zeolite IS of DEV-A (GF3 17, G-FACTORY dev 3, G-FACTORY-2 dev 1, G-FACTORY-3 dev 3): pilot of 24-launch short sessions, 1 seed, 4 arms; dev sessions × 2 seeds for the two survivors, reference `long-best-auto`. Metal surfaces use Sella and are unaffected. Confirmation on the C2 zeolite subset not run.
systems_zh: 全部 24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态（GF3 17、G-FACTORY 开发 3、G-FACTORY-2 开发 1、G-FACTORY-3 开发 3）：先导为每个初态 24 次发射的短会话，1 个种子、4 个臂；两个存活变体再做 2 个种子的开发会话，参照 `long-best-auto`。金属表面走 Sella，不受影响。C2 分子筛子集确认未运行。
result_en: The pilot removed the 5 Å frozen shell (short-session U/call 0.954). Dev U/call: 4 Å frozen shell 0.980× [0.947, 1.016], p = 0.86, U −3.5 %; 5 Å mode restriction 1.010× [0.980, 1.036], p = 0.25; neither reached the 1.03 bar, so no confirmation. Freezing did not shorten the climb (median 23 vs 23 steps) or reduce rotations; strain built up in the frozen atoms instead. Options off.
result_zh: 先导淘汰 5 Å 冻结。开发：4 Å 冻结 U/调用 0.980 倍 [0.947, 1.016]，p = 0.86；5 Å 模式限制 1.010 倍 [0.980, 1.036]，p = 0.25；均未达 1.03 门槛。冻结没缩短爬坡，应变反在远处累积。

name_zh: 大分子筛的 Sella 收尾（SELLA-TAIL-RETUNE）
idea_en: A long-distance driver hands the wheel to a parking specialist for the last few metres, but the rule allowed this only for small cars. In zeolites the cheap dimer walker hands the final approach to a saddle to Sella only when 3N ≤ 469; this round raised that limit (`search_tail_engine_max_dimension`) to 2000 and added `sella_lean_check`, which reuses eigenvalues already computed to save CPU.
idea_zh: 长途司机快到终点时把方向盘交给泊车专家停最后几米，但规则只允许小车这样交接。分子筛上，dimer 行走器只在 3N ≤ 469 时把逼近鞍点的最后一段交给 Sella；本轮把上限提到 2000，并新增复用已算本征值以省 CPU 的 `sella_lean_check`。
systems_en: Development on the 24 DEV-A zeolite IS (early Z/X systems and their network nodes, N3, N4 and G-FACTORY 1–3 dev zeolites; 12 above and 12 below the old size limit), 2 seeds; confirmation on the 16 C3 zeolite IS with 3N > 469 (10 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 6 IS-first; frameworks such as EUO, MEL, LTL, ISV, STI), 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 全部 24 个分子筛初态（早期 Z/X 体系及其网络节点、N3、N4 与 G-FACTORY 1–3 开发分子筛；旧上限以上、以下各 12 个），2 个种子；确认：C3 中 3N > 469 的 16 个分子筛初态（10 个 G-FACTORY-3 密封 + 6 个 IS-first，框架如 EUO、MEL、LTL、ISV、STI），2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (16 large C3 zeolites): U/call 1.140× [1.103, 1.175], p < 0.00025; U +9.8 %, U/ionic step 1.072, U_ads/call 1.142. Development (DEV zeolites): 1.090×. Price: 1.66× CPU core-seconds per saddle from Sella's dense linear algebra. `sella_lean_check` kept decisions identical and cut session CPU by 10–18 %. The 2000 limit later shipped in the zeolite stack of the opt-in `long-best-auto-81-fullstack-optin` preset.
result_zh: C3 中 16 个大分子筛确认：U/调用 1.140 倍 [1.103, 1.175]，p < 0.00025，U +9.8 %；但每鞍点 CPU 时间 ×1.66（`sella_lean_check` 省 10–18 %）。后进入 v0.81 可选全栈预设。

idea_en: A detective questions suspects in order of their role in the gang (boss, courier, bystander) rather than how close they stand, and stops once the rest are unlikely to talk. For zeolites, each bond coordinate got a prior yield from its atoms' roles in the H-bond network (acid proton, O–H or C–H hydrogen; Al-adjacent, framework or adsorbate oxygen); drives followed that order and a Bayesian remaining-yield rule ended the session (τ = 0.75).
idea_zh: 侦探按嫌疑人在团伙里的角色（头目、跑腿、路人）而非站位远近排审讯顺序，剩下的人不太可能开口就收工。分子筛上，键坐标的先验产出由原子在氢键网络中的角色决定（酸性质子、O–H 或 C–H 的 H；Al 旁 O、骨架 O、吸附物 O），据此排序驱动，并用贝叶斯剩余产出规则停止。
systems_en: Prior table fitted on 21 DEV-A zeolite IS; development on all 24 DEV-A zeolite IS (21 in-sample), 2 seeds; confirmation on the C1 zeolite subset: 15 sealed G-FACTORY zeolite IS + the G5 ethanol/H-MWW IS, 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`. Metals are untouched by design.
systems_zh: 先验表用 21 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态拟合；开发：全部 24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态（21 个属样本内），2 个种子；确认：C1 的分子筛子集（15 个 G-FACTORY 密封分子筛 + G5 的乙醇/H-MWW），2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。金属按设计不受影响。
result_en: Confirmation (C1 zeolites): U/call 1.172× [1.113, 1.252], p < 0.00025; U/ionic step 1.130; but U −9.1 % (132 → 120), with 7 of the 8 lost saddles flagged as artefacts or doubtful. Development: 1.072× [1.015, 1.135]. Geometric H-bond-strength priors failed. The role prior later entered the v0.80 default; the yield stop was dropped because it ended sessions too early on new chemistry.
result_zh: 确认（C1 分子筛）：U/调用 1.172 倍 [1.113, 1.252]，p < 0.00025；但 U −9.1 %（丢失的 8 个中 7 个带伪影或可疑标记）。几何氢键强度先验无效。角色先验后进入 v0.80 默认；产出停止因在新化学上过早收工被去掉。

idea_en: In a bucket brigade everyone passes a bucket at the same moment. Along hydrogen-bond chains in zeolite clusters (water or alcohol linking an acid site), one extra launch per chain after the normal session pushed all protons forward together (summed, synchronous or ridge starts on q = Σ[r(D–H) − r(H···A)]) to look for concerted multi-proton transfer saddles.
idea_zh: 像救火队传水桶，所有人同时把桶递给下一位。在分子筛氢键簇（水或醇连接酸位）的质子接力链上，常规会话结束后每条链加一次发射，把所有质子一起推向受体（求和、同步或山脊三种起点，坐标 q = Σ[r(D–H) − r(H···A)]），寻找协同多质子转移鞍点。
systems_en: Pilot on the 13 DEV-A zeolite IS with proton-relay chains: methanol pairs in H-CHA and ethanol pairs (dry and wet) in H-MFI with their network nodes, water in H-FAU, H-FER, H-MOR, CHA and MOR, propanols in LTL and MTW; 20 chains × 3 start modes = 60 launches, scored against the union of 4 presets × 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 试点：13 个含质子接力链的 DEV-A 分子筛初态（H-CHA 中甲醇对、H-MFI 中乙醇对（干/湿）及其网络节点；H-FAU、H-FER、H-MOR、CHA、MOR 中的水；LTL、MTW 中的丙醇），20 条链 × 3 种起点 = 60 次发射，对照 4 个预设 × 2 个种子的并集；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: The pre-registered kill rule fired at the pilot: 0 new IS-connected saddles from 60 launches. Projected U/call 0.986× [0.980, 0.991] (sum), 0.979 (sync), 0.977 (ridge); U unchanged. On NEP89 the H3O+/ROH2+ ion pairs are minima, so relays are stepwise and synchronous starts slide to second-step saddles not connected to the IS; the two IS-connected concerted shuttles were already found by single bond drives.
result_zh: 试点即触发杀死规则：60 次发射新增 0 个初态连通鞍点；外推 U/调用 0.986 倍 [0.980, 0.991]，U 不变。NEP89 上 H3O+/ROH2+ 离子对是极小，接力是分步的；连通初态的两个协同穿梭早被单键驱动找到。

idea_en: Testing a door only by pushing never shows that it opens by pulling. The default search only compresses a guest's H-bonds (the proton-transfer direction), so a post-session migration phase stretched each guest H-bond once and slid each guest along its softest centre-of-mass direction from the IS Hessian, with Sella climbing from the scan top; a dimer-walker version failed the pilot.
idea_zh: 只推不拉，永远发现不了向外开的门。默认搜索只会压缩客体分子的氢键（质子转移方向）；本轮在会话后加一个迁移阶段：把每个客体氢键拉伸一次，并让每个客体沿初态 Hessian 给出的最软质心方向滑动，再由 Sella 从扫描顶点爬坡；dimer 行走版本在试点被淘汰。
systems_en: Pilot and development on the 24 DEV-A zeolite IS, 2 seeds; confirmation on the C3 zeolite subset: 18 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 10 IS-first zeolite IS, 2 seeds. Reference: the same `long-lowbarrier-auto` session before the migration phase; main metric U(≤1.5)/call.
systems_zh: 试点与开发：24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态，2 个种子；确认：C3 分子筛子集（18 个 G-FACTORY-3 密封 + 10 个 IS-first），2 个种子。参照：同一 `long-lowbarrier-auto` 会话在迁移阶段之前的部分；主指标 U(≤1.5)/调用。
result_en: Confirmation: U(≤1.5)/call 1.070× [1.019, 1.122], p = 0.0022; U 219 → 259, U/ionic step 1.065, calls +10.5 %. Every added saddle is a migration or reorientation without bond change; adsorbate-involving saddles stayed at 173, so the U_ads/call guard failed (0.905). Kept opt-in; the v0.79 low-barrier preset chose the variant without migration.
result_zh: 确认：U(≤1.5)/调用 1.070 倍 [1.019, 1.122]，p = 0.0022；U 219 → 259，调用 +10.5 %。新增的全是无键变化的迁移或转向，U_ads 不变，U_ads/调用 护栏失败（0.905）。仅作可选项，未进入预设。

name_en: Energy maps for concerted ionic steps (CONCERTED-IONIC-MAPS)
name_zh: 协同离子型步骤能量图（CONCERTED-IONIC-MAPS）
idea_en: Before paving a road over a pass, a surveyor checks that the pass exists. On NEP89, two-distance relaxed energy maps (bond-forming versus bond-breaking distance) were drawn for textbook ionic zeolite steps (SN2 alkylation, E2 dehydration, alkene protonation, protolytic cracking) to see whether concerted saddles exist at all before writing a generator for them.
idea_zh: 在山口修路之前，测量员先确认山口是否存在。本轮在 NEP89 上为教科书式离子型分子筛步骤（S_N2 烷基化、E2 脱水、烯烃质子化、质子化裂化）绘制二维弛豫能量图（成键距离 × 断键距离），先确认协同鞍点是否存在，再决定是否为它们写生成器。
systems_en: 8 DEV-A zeolite IS: two methanol and propene in H-CHA, methanol in H-FAU, ethanol, methanol + ethene and n-butane in H-MFI, 2-propanol in LTL, 1-propanol in MTW. 15 maps (3 controls + 12 ionic steps), 17,740 constrained relaxations, about 850,000 NEP calls; no confirmation pool.
systems_zh: 8 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态：H-CHA 中的两个甲醇与丙烯、H-FAU 中的甲醇、H-MFI 中的乙醇、甲醇 + 乙烯与正丁烷、LTL 中的 2-丙醇、MTW 中的 1-丙醇。共 15 张图（3 张对照 + 12 个离子型步骤），17,740 次约束弛豫，约 85 万次 NEP 调用；无确认池。
result_en: 0 of 12 ionic steps has a concerted saddle on NEP89: every lowest route passes a certified intermediate (free CH3/C2H5/C3H7 fragments, or a carbonium ion that is a TS in DFT), and alkoxides lie above free fragments in 5 of 7 pairs, the reverse of DFT. Controls recovered 3/3 known saddles. Side test (re-relaxing spiky scans): 0.649× [0.395, 0.797] saddles/call. A limit of the potential, not the search.
result_zh: NEP89 上 12 个离子型步骤无一有协同鞍点：最低路线均经认证中间体（自由烷基或碳正离子，后者在 DFT 中是过渡态）；5/7 对中烷氧基高于自由碎片，与 DFT 相反。对照均找回。旁支重弛豫尖刺：每调用鞍点 0.649 倍 [0.395, 0.797]。

idea_en: A climber reaches a pass but has kicked a few loose rocks on the way, so the path down leads into another valley; the fix puts the rocks back and checks again. When a zeolite saddle failed the downhill test (not connected to the IS), atoms outside the reaction core that had moved more than 0.3 Å were reset to their IS positions, then the saddle was refined and validated unchanged.
idea_zh: 登山者到了山口，但途中踢动了几块石头，下山便走进了别的山谷；修复办法是把石头放回原处再核对一次。分子筛鞍点若下坡验证不连回初态，就把反应核心以外、位移超过 0.3 Å 的旁观原子复位到初态位置，再按原规则精修与验证。
systems_en: Zero-call analysis and replay of 490 archived disconnected launches from 48 DEV-A zeolite sessions (24 IS × 2 seeds) of `long-best-auto`; the planned DEV sessions and the C2 zeolite confirmation were not run after the kill rule fired.
systems_zh: 零调用分析，并回放 `long-best-auto` 在 48 个 DEV-A 分子筛会话（24 个初态 × 2 个种子）中存档的 490 次不连通发射；杀死规则触发后，原定的 DEV 会话测试与 C2 分子筛确认均未运行。
result_en: Killed at replay: 417 restarts gave 11 new saddles, 19,327 calls per new saddle versus 2,482 on average; projected U/call 0.870× [0.835, 0.902], U +2.3 %. Disconnected launches take 22.2 % of zeolite launch calls, but at the saddle the spectator's original position is not a local minimum in 94 % of cases (it springs back), so usually no connected version exists.
result_zh: 回放即触发杀死规则：417 次重启得 11 个新鞍点，每个耗 19,327 次调用（平均 2,482）；外推 U/调用 0.870 倍 [0.835, 0.902]，U +2.3 %。鞍点处旁观原子的原位置 94 % 不是极小（会弹回），通常不存在连通版本。

name_zh: 台阶位点先验→锚定跳过（STEP-KINK-PRIORS）
idea_en: Reordering a to-do list is pointless if you always finish it; crossing off the jobs that never pay is what saves time. A step-site (GCN-weighted) coordinate order changed nothing because metal sessions drive every coordinate anyway, so the round pivoted to `drive_anchor_skip`: on metal surfaces, skip bond-formation drives between two adsorbate atoms that both lack metal contact.
idea_zh: 清单上的事若总要全部做完，调整顺序毫无意义；划掉从不见效的事才省时间。按台阶位点配位（GCN）给坐标排序无效，因为金属会话本来就驱动所有坐标；于是改做 `drive_anchor_skip`：在金属表面上，两端吸附原子都不接触金属的成键驱动直接跳过。
systems_en: Zero-call replay and development on the 61 DEV-A metal IS (2 seeds); confirmation on the C3 metal subset: 35 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 14 IS-first metal IS (47 runnable), 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto` (Sella on metals).
systems_zh: 零调用回放与开发：61 个 DEV-A 金属初态（2 个种子）；确认：C3 金属子集（35 个 G-FACTORY-3 密封 + 14 个 IS-first 金属初态，47 个可运行），2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`（金属上用 Sella）。
result_en: Seed order: 1.0018× in replay, killed. Anchor skip, confirmation: U/call 1.071× [1.034, 1.106], p < 0.00025; U_ads/call 1.083, U/ionic step 1.077, but U −9.9 % (494 → 445; intramolecular H shifts in organics lost). Development: 1.141× [1.091, 1.190]. Kept as an opt-in option.
result_zh: 种子排序回放 1.0018 倍，被杀。锚定跳过确认：U/调用 1.071 倍 [1.034, 1.106]，p < 0.00025，U_ads/调用 1.083，但 U −9.9 %（丢失有机物分子内 H 迁移）。开发集 1.141 倍。保留为可选项。

idea_en: The default walker on metals is a dog on a 2.2 Å leash, so it can never follow a surface atom popping out, whose transition states lie 2.4–2.8 Å away. Revisiting a round-82 idea with exact certificates, a substrate pass pulled exposed metal atoms near the adsorbate away from the atom beneath and released an unleashed walker at the scan top; the pivot DRY-SWITCH switched to this pass after 8 fruitless launches.
idea_zh: 金属上默认行走器像拴着 2.2 Å 绳的狗，追不上从表面顶出的金属原子（其过渡态在 2.4–2.8 Å 外）。本轮用精确证书复测第 82 轮思路：把吸附物旁的外露金属原子从下方原子处拉起，在扫描顶点放出不拴绳的行走器；转向版 DRY-SWITCH 在 8 次无果发射后改做这一步。
systems_en: Census and development on the 61 DEV-A metal IS (one seed each); confirmation on the C1 metal subset: 57 IS (sealed G-FACTORY metals + G5 metals), 2 seeds; reference: the same `long-best-auto` session before the substrate pass.
systems_zh: 普查与开发：61 个 DEV-A 金属初态（各用 1 个种子）；确认：C1 金属子集 57 个初态（G-FACTORY 密封金属 + G5 金属），2 个种子；参照：同一 `long-best-auto` 会话在基底阶段之前的部分。
result_en: Development add-on: 0.985× [0.920, 1.054], failed. DRY-SWITCH confirmation on C1: U/call 0.900× [0.846, 0.956], p = 0.9995, failed. Substrate saddles are real (none in 680 default DEV runs; 176 on C1) and U rose 436 → 631, but U_ads/call fell to 0.655 and about half the substrate saddles are near-degenerate lattice images. Not adopted.
result_zh: DRY-SWITCH 在 C1 确认失败：U/调用 0.900 倍 [0.846, 0.956]，p = 0.9995；开发集附加阶段 0.985 倍。找到 176 个默认找不到的基底鞍点，U 436 → 631，但 U_ads/调用 仅 0.655。

idea_en: To bring two dancers together you walk both towards each other, rather than grabbing one hand of each and pulling until their arms stretch. When a scan forms a bond between two separate co-adsorbates (Langmuir–Hinshelwood coupling), the new predictor `drive_couple_predictor=rigid` translates both fragments rigidly along the bond line, the lighter one moving more, so the scan top is not a strain spike; it costs no extra calls.
idea_zh: 要让两位舞者靠拢，应让两人整体走近，而不是各拽一只手拉到手臂绷直。扫描在两个独立共吸附物间成键（LH 偶联）时，`drive_couple_predictor=rigid` 把两个碎片沿成键线整体平移（轻者多走），扫描顶点不再是应变尖峰，且不加力调用。
systems_en: Forced replay of 77 coupling coordinates and development on the 26 DEV-A metal IS with two co-adsorbates (early Pt(111) networks, N3/N4 and G-FACTORY 1–3 dev cases), 2 seeds; confirmation on 21 sealed G-FACTORY-2 metal co-adsorbate IS (C2), 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 强制回放 77 个偶联坐标，并在 26 个含两个共吸附物的 DEV-A 金属初态（早期 Pt(111) 网络、N3/N4 与 G-FACTORY 1–3 开发体系）上开发，2 个种子；确认：C2 中 21 个 G-FACTORY-2 密封金属共吸附初态，2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Development: U/call 1.031× [1.008, 1.056], p = 0.003, U 269 → 279. Confirmation (C2): 1.018× [0.981, 1.050], p = 0.157, not significant. Chemically, the target LH steps (CO + O, CxHy + H, OH + OH, HCO formation) were found on 18/20 instead of 13/20 IS (sign test p = 0.0625). Dimer-walker and spike-refine variants were killed at replay. Not adopted.

name_zh: 金属上从最佳迭代点起步（METAL-ABORT-ANATOMY）
idea_en: A sprinter who starts from a stumble instead of the blocks often falls. Failed metal Sella launches began at the last step of an oscillating Barzilai–Borwein stage relaxation, an overshoot well above the stage minimum; Sella's first step released the strain and lost the negative mode. Now the walker starts from the lowest iterate of the stage and the scan top is picked by those best iterates (scan unchanged, no extra calls).
idea_zh: 短跑选手从踉跄中而非起跑器上出发，往往会摔倒。金属上失败的 Sella 发射，起点是振荡的 Barzilai–Borwein 阶段弛豫的最后一步（过冲点）；Sella 第一步释放应变便丢掉负曲率模。现改从该阶段能量最低的迭代点出发，扫描顶点也按最佳迭代点选（扫描不变，不加调用）。
systems_en: Zero-call replay of 2,215 archived DEV-A metal Sella launches; development on the 61 DEV-A metal IS, 2 seeds; confirmation on the C3 metal subset: 35 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 14 IS-first metal IS, 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 零调用回放 2,215 次存档的 DEV-A 金属 Sella 发射；开发：61 个 DEV-A 金属初态，2 个种子；确认：C3 金属子集（35 个 G-FACTORY-3 密封 + 14 个 IS-first 金属初态），2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: Confirmation (C3 metals): U/call 1.054× [1.020, 1.097], p < 0.00025, with more saddles: U +10.5 % (493 → 545); U_ads/call 1.061, U/ionic step 1.038. Development: 1.066× [1.016, 1.122]. In the replay, positive-curvature aborts on moved starts fell by 45–53 %. Entered the v0.80 default preset `long-best-auto-80`.
result_zh: 确认（C3 金属）：U/调用 1.054 倍 [1.020, 1.097]，p < 0.00025，U +10.5 %，每离子步 1.038 倍。回放中正曲率中止减少 45–53 %。进入 v0.80 默认预设 `long-best-auto-80`。

idea_en: A climber winched up a slope can unclip as soon as the ground starts to round over: he is already on the shoulder of the pass and can walk the rest himself. On metal surfaces the relaxed bond scan now stops at the first stage where the energy still rises but the profile has turned concave (the Hessian already has exactly one negative eigenvalue) and Sella starts from there (`drive_concave_start=0.02`).
idea_zh: 被绞盘拉上山坡的登山者，一旦坡势开始变缓就可以解开绳索：他已站在山口的肩部，余下的路可以自己走。金属表面上，松弛键扫描在能量仍在上升、但剖面曲率已转负（Hessian 恰有一个负本征值）的第一级就停下，由此启动 Sella（`drive_concave_start=0.02`）。
systems_en: Metal surfaces only (Sella engine), reference `long-best-auto`. Development on 61 DEV-A metal IS (GF3 plus G-FACTORY, -2 and -3 dev systems), 2 seeds; confirmation on the C1 metal subset, 57 IS (52 sealed G-FACTORY + 5 G5), 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 仅金属表面（Sella 引擎），参照 `long-best-auto`。开发：DEV-A 中 61 个金属初态（GF3 与 G-FACTORY、-2、-3 开发集），2 个种子；确认：C1 金属子集 57 个初态（G-FACTORY 封存 52 + G5 5），2 个种子。
result_en: Seed idea (displaced Sella probe) failed on DEV: U/call 0.909 [0.879, 0.946]. Concave start, confirmed on C1 metals: U/call 1.053× [1.008, 1.100], p = 0.012; U_ads/call 1.048; U +0.9 %, calls −4.2 %, 15–19 % fewer scan calls per launch (DEV 1.078×). Small but real; not carried into the release because on top of a later start package (r279) it gave only 1.028× (n.s.) with U −4.4 %.
result_zh: 种子方案在开发集失败（0.909 倍）。负曲率起步经 C1 金属确认：U/调用 1.053 倍 [1.008, 1.100]，p = 0.012；U +0.9 %，调用 −4.2 %。增益小而真实；叠加 r279 组合后仅 1.028 倍（不显著），未发布。

name_en: Retuned leashes for metal Sella walkers (METAL-RADIUS-LEASH-RETUNE)
name_zh: 金属 Sella 拴绳重调
idea_en: A dog walker let the dogs run free while recording every step, then replayed the recordings to pick the best leash: long enough to reach distant passes, short enough to stop aimless wandering. On metals, Sella walkers lost the 4 Å trust sphere, stop once any atom moves 1.8 Å from the IS (was 2.2 Å), tolerate 25 instead of 15 positive-curvature steps, and are stopped by a 45/80/110-step progress ladder.
idea_zh: 遛狗人先放开狗并记下每一步，再回放记录挑出最合适的拴绳：够长，能走到远处山口；够短，不致乱逛。金属上的 Sella 游走取消 4 Å 信任球，任一原子离初态超过 1.8 Å 即停（原 2.2 Å），正曲率容忍由 15 步增至 25 步，并加 45/80/110 步进度阶梯。
systems_en: Metal surfaces (Sella walkers), reference `long-best-auto`. Pilot and screening on 61 DEV-A metal IS, 2 seeds: one loosened, fully traced arm was replayed at zero calls for thousands of tighter limit sets, and the top 3 were run for real. Confirmation on the 42 metal IS of C2 (sealed G-FACTORY-2), 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 金属表面上的 Sella 游走者，参照 `long-best-auto`。先导与筛选：DEV-A 的 61 个金属初态，2 个种子（一个放宽限制并逐步记录的臂供零调用回放数千组更紧的限制，最优 3 组再真实运行）；确认：C2（G-FACTORY-2 封存集）的 42 个金属初态，2 个种子。
result_en: C2 metals: U/call 1.060× [1.029, 1.090], p < 0.00025; U(≤1.5)/call 1.080; U/ionic step 1.120; U −1.3 % at −6.9 % calls (21 high-barrier saddles needing >1.8 Å travel lost); whole-C2 projection 1.033× [1.008, 1.059]. About half of positive-curvature aborts were walkers sliding back to IS energy. Confirmed with a small saddle cost; the limits entered `long-best-auto-80`, the v0.80 default.
result_zh: C2 金属：U/调用 1.060 倍 [1.029, 1.090]，p < 0.00025；U −1.3 %，调用 −6.9 %（丢 21 个需走 >1.8 Å 的高能垒鞍点）。确认；限值进入 v0.80 默认预设 `long-best-auto-80`。

name_zh: 合金上的元素分辨先验
idea_en: A prospector given a geology guide for each metal finds that he digs every hole on the claim anyway, so the guide only changes the order. Seed idea: element- and d-band-resolved coordinate priors for metals and alloys; zero-call analysis showed no leverage. Pivot: widen the window in which adsorbate–metal bonds may be driven to form (3.5 Å → 4.3 Å, `drive_form_metal_cutoff`) so more hopping moves are tried.
idea_zh: 探矿者拿到按金属分类的地质指南，却发现每个坑反正都得挖，指南只改顺序。种子方案：按元素/d 带分辨金属与合金的坐标先验，零调用分析表明无益。转向：可驱动成键的吸附物–金属距离窗口由 3.5 Å 放宽到 4.3 Å（`drive_form_metal_cutoff`），多试跳位。
systems_en: Metal surfaces, reference `long-best-auto`. Zero-call analysis and a pilot on 61 DEV-A metal IS (1 seed); held-out confirmation on 47 C3 metal IS: 35 sealed G-FACTORY-3 metals including Pt3Ni(111), CuPd(110) and NiAu(111) alloys, plus 12 IS-first metal systems, 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 金属表面，参照 `long-best-auto`。零调用分析与 DEV-A 61 个金属初态上的先导（1 个种子）；留出确认：C3 的 47 个金属初态（G-FACTORY-3 封存金属 35 个，含 Pt3Ni(111)、CuPd(110)、NiAu(111) 合金，另加 12 个 IS-first 金属体系），2 个种子。
result_en: Priors: 83–92 % of metal sessions drive every candidate bond anyway, re-ordering changes U/call by ≤1.1 %, and element identity adds almost no transferable signal (AUC 0.58 vs 0.587 for the current table). Wider window: DEV pilot 0.828×; C3 metals U/call 0.886× [0.836, 0.938], alloys 0.843×, although U +22 %. More hops, but bought expensively (−0.51 % U/call per +1 % U).
result_zh: 先验：83–92 % 的金属会话本就驱动全部候选键，重排只改变 U/调用 ≤1.1 %，元素信号几乎不可迁移。放宽窗口：C3 金属 U/调用 0.886 倍 [0.836, 0.938]，合金 0.843 倍；U 虽 +22 %，但代价过高。阴性。

name_zh: 偕位墙：不驱动三元环闭合
idea_en: A matchmaker stops introducing two people who already share a best friend: those meetings take a lot of effort and rarely lead anywhere new. Seed idea: a 'break and hand over' drive passing an H atom to the nearest metal atom. Pivot that worked: on metal surfaces, never drive bond formation between two adsorbate atoms that share a bonded neighbour (closing a three-membered ring such as H–C–H), `drive_geminal_wall`.
idea_zh: 媒人不再撮合已有共同好友的两人：这种见面费力，又很少带来新东西。种子方案是“断键并交接”驱动，把 H 原子交给最近的金属原子。奏效的转向：金属表面上，不再驱动共享同一成键邻居的两个吸附物原子成键（即闭合 H–C–H 这类三元环），选项 `drive_geminal_wall`。
systems_en: Metal surfaces, reference `long-best-auto`. Pilot on 23 DEV scission IS; screening on 61 DEV-A metal IS, 2 seeds; confirmation on the C1 metal subset, 57 IS (sealed G-FACTORY metals + G5 metals), 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 金属表面，参照 `long-best-auto`。先导：23 个开发集断键初态；筛选：DEV-A 的 61 个金属初态，2 个种子；确认：C1 金属子集 57 个初态（G-FACTORY 封存金属 + G5 金属），2 个种子。
result_en: Hand-over seed: pilot killed (U_ads/call 0.888); guarded version neutral on DEV (0.985 [0.956, 1.011]). Geminal wall, C1 metals: U_ads/call 1.037× [1.020, 1.056], p < 0.00025; U/call 1.039 [1.022, 1.058]; U ×0.977 (10 high-barrier saddles lost, median 1.74 eV), calls ×0.941; DEV 1.115×. Such ring-closing launches took 16.8 % of DEV metal calls for 5.9 % of saddles. Confirmed; not ported (overlaps r258).
result_zh: 交接方案先导即淘汰。偕位墙经 C1 金属确认：U_ads/调用 1.037 倍 [1.020, 1.056]，p < 0.00025（U/调用 1.039）；U ×0.977（丢 10 个高能垒鞍点），调用 ×0.941。因与 r258 重叠而未移植。

name_zh: 子节点继承父节点的失败坐标
idea_en: A child searching a house its parent already searched skips the drawers the parent found empty, provided nothing around them was moved. In network mode, where product minima are searched again as new starting states, a child node now skips at zero calls any bond coordinate whose parent launches all failed if both atoms keep the same bonded neighbours (`network_inherit_failures=failed`); the saved budget expands more child nodes.
idea_zh: 孩子搜查父母搜过的房子，只要周围没被动过，就跳过父母查过是空的抽屉。网络模式把产物极小点当作新初态再搜索；若父节点某键坐标的发射全失败且两端原子成键邻居不变，子节点即零调用跳过（`network_inherit_failures=failed`），省下的预算用于展开更多子节点。
systems_en: Reaction networks (depth 2, budget 3) with the network default presets (`long-best-auto` on metal roots, `long-best` on zeolite roots). Development on 45 DEV-A roots (36 metal + 9 zeolite; GF3 and G-FACTORY dev), 1 seed; confirmation on all 62 C2 roots (sealed G-FACTORY-2: 42 metal + 20 zeolite), 1 seed.
systems_zh: 反应网络（深度 2、预算 3），网络默认预设（金属根 `long-best-auto`，分子筛根 `long-best`）。开发：DEV-A 中 45 个根（36 金属 + 9 分子筛；GF3 与 G-FACTORY 开发集），1 个种子；确认：C2 全部 62 个根（G-FACTORY-2 封存：42 金属 + 20 分子筛），1 个种子。
result_en: Seed idea (mapping symmetry-equivalent children) was worth only 0.6–1.4 % of network calls. Pivot, C2 confirmation: network saddles per call 1.083× [1.055, 1.109], p < 0.00025; per ionic step 1.066; saddles 1,003 → 1,075 (+7.2 %) at ×0.989 calls, 238 vs 210 nodes expanded; metals 1.101, zeolites 1.045. Confirmed, kept opt-in; a stricter metal-only blend with r230 later shipped in the opt-in `network-81` preset.
result_zh: 种子方案（对称映射）仅省 0.6–1.4 % 调用。C2 确认：网络鞍点/调用 1.083 倍 [1.055, 1.109]，p < 0.00025；鞍点 1,003 → 1,075，调用略减。可选；与 r230 合并的金属版后进入 `network-81`。

name_en: Child sessions reuse parent failure verdicts (NETWORK-REVERSE-REUSE)
name_zh: 子会话继承父会话的失败判定
idea_en: A new tenant inherits the old tenant's list of keys that opened nothing and spends the saved time on other rooms. With a network budget, a child session never drives a bond coordinate its parent drove without finding any saddle, regardless of neighbours (`network_inherit_skip=all`); such launches succeeded only ~8 % of the time at ~2× the cost per saddle, and the budget re-spends the saved calls on more child nodes.
idea_zh: 新房客接手前任的“打不开任何门的钥匙”清单，不再试它们，把省下的时间花在别的房间。设网络预算时，子会话不再驱动父会话驱动过却没找到鞍点的键坐标，不论邻居是否变化（`network_inherit_skip=all`）；这类发射成功率仅约 8 %，省下的调用用于展开更多子节点。
systems_en: Budgeted reaction networks (depth 2, budget 3; `long-best-auto` on metal roots, `long-best` on zeolite roots). Development on 22 DEV-A roots (16 metal + 6 zeolite, from GEN3, GEN4 and G-FACTORY, -2, -3 dev), 1 seed; confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 24 IS-first roots (2 O+H roots rejected by the presets), 1 seed.
systems_zh: 带预算的反应网络（深度 2、预算 3；金属根 `long-best-auto`，分子筛根 `long-best`）。开发：DEV-A 中 22 个根（16 金属 + 6 分子筛，来自 GEN3、GEN4 与 G-FACTORY/-2/-3 开发集），1 个种子；确认：C3 = G-FACTORY-3 封存 53 + IS-first 24 个根（2 个 O+H 根被预设拒绝），1 个种子。
result_en: C3 confirmation: network saddles per call 1.1885× [1.136, 1.242], p < 0.00025; adsorbate saddles/call 1.199, plausible 1.122, per ionic step 1.136; saddles 1,446 → 1,637 (+13.2 %) at ×0.953 calls; metals 1.216, zeolites 1.186, but extra zeolite saddles were mostly artefact-flagged. Without the budget, ~18 % fewer saddles. DEV 1.292×. Confirmed for budgeted networks; kept opt-in (a metal-only variant later shipped in `network-81`).
result_zh: C3 确认：网络鞍点/调用 1.1885 倍 [1.136, 1.242]，p < 0.00025；鞍点 1,446 → 1,637（+13.2 %），调用 ×0.953；分子筛的增量多带伪影标记。不设预算则鞍点少约 18 %。适用于带预算网络，保持可选。

name_zh: 动力学网络子会话剪枝
idea_en: A survey team mapping passes below a height limit reuses the parent camp's note that a distant ridge is too high, and measures every height limit from base camp rather than from its own tent. In kinetic (1.5 eV window) networks a child skips coordinates outside the parent→child event region whose parent scan top exceeded the cap by >0.2 eV (`--inherit-skips 0.2`), and post-search caps are referenced to the root IS (`--post-cap-root`).
idea_zh: 勘测限高内山口的队伍沿用父营地“远山脊太高”的记录，限高都从大本营量起。1.5 eV 动力学网络中，子会话跳过父→子事件区外、父扫描顶高出上限 >0.2 eV 的坐标（`--inherit-skips 0.2`），事后能垒上限改以根初态为准（`--post-cap-root`）。
systems_en: Kinetic networks with `long-lowbarrier` (depth 2, 1.5 eV window). Zero-call analysis of 60 archived networks on 20 DEV roots; development on 36 DEV-A roots (those 20 + 9 G-FACTORY-2 dev + 7 G-FACTORY-3 dev), 1 seed; confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY + 6 G5 roots, 1 seed.
systems_zh: 动力学网络，`long-lowbarrier`（深度 2、1.5 eV 窗口）。零调用分析：20 个开发根上的 60 个存档网络；开发：DEV-A 中 36 个根（上述 20 个 + G-FACTORY-2 开发 9 + G-FACTORY-3 开发 7），1 个种子；确认：C1 = G-FACTORY 封存 67 + G5 6 个根，1 个种子。
result_en: Children use 72–77 % of calls yet are as productive per call as the root, so pruning whole children does not pay. C1 confirmation: low-barrier network saddles per call 1.035× [1.015, 1.057], p < 0.00025; per ionic step 1.046; low-barrier saddles 836 → 839 at −3.0 % calls (DEV 1.082×). Inherited skips were 85 % correct; wrong ones cost 8 saddles on crowded metal surfaces. Confirmed; opt-in.
result_zh: 子会话占 72–77 % 调用，但每调用产出不输根会话，整枝剪掉不划算。C1 确认：低能垒网络鞍点/调用 1.035 倍 [1.015, 1.057]，p < 0.00025；低能垒鞍点 836 → 839，调用 −3.0 %。继承跳过 85 % 判对。可选。

name_zh: 跨体系发射产率经验库
idea_en: Instead of an old pocket guide drawn from eight trips, the climber gets a guidebook compiled from 85 recent expeditions that lists how often each kind of route led to a new pass. An offline library of launch success rates by chemical signature (metals collapsed to M), fitted on exact-era DEV sessions, replaced the 8-system class prior as the base rate of the greedy bond-drive order (`drive_signature_library`).
idea_zh: 登山者不再用 8 次旅行写成的旧指南，改用 85 次近期远征汇编的手册，记下每类路线通向新山口的频率。用开发集会话离线统计、按化学签名（金属记为 M）汇总的发射成功率库，取代 8 体系类别先验，作为贪心键驱动顺序的基础概率（`drive_signature_library`）。
systems_en: Reference `long-best-auto`. Development only: 85 DEV-A IS (GF3 plus G-FACTORY, -2 and -3 dev; 61 metal + 24 zeolite), 2 seeds, with leave-reaction-family-out and leave-IS-out libraries. The C2 confirmation was not run because the dev gate failed.
systems_zh: 参照 `long-best-auto`。只做开发检验：DEV-A 85 个初态（GF3 与 G-FACTORY、-2、-3 开发集；61 金属 + 24 分子筛），2 个种子；库按“留出反应族”和“留出单个初态”两种方式构建。开发门槛未过，C2 确认未运行。
result_en: DEV: U/call 1.012× [0.971, 1.049], p = 0.249 (related-systems library 1.017, p = 0.135); U/ionic step 1.002; gate missed, no confirmation. Why: 52 % of calls sit in sessions that drive every coordinate, where order is irrelevant; a perfect order would give 1.238×, but no static or post-scan feature predicts launch success beyond AUC ~0.69, and the library over-rates coordinates the session had already demoted.
result_zh: 开发集：U/调用 1.012 倍 [0.971, 1.049]，p = 0.249（相关体系版 1.017）；未过门槛，未确认。原因：52 % 的调用所在会话会驱动全部坐标，顺序无关；完美顺序可达 1.238 倍，但静态与扫描后特征 AUC 至多约 0.69。

name_en: Calibrated launch-yield model for bond order (GLOBAL-YIELD-MODEL)
idea_en: An odds-maker prices each horse from its recent form instead of a table of eight old races. The search now ranks untried bonds with a calibrated logistic model fitted on DEV data only (bond type, chemical signature with metals collapsed to M, distance ratio, coordination) instead of the 8-system class table (`drive_prior_model=r233-v1`); held-out AUC 0.72–0.74 versus 0.60–0.64.
idea_zh: 赔率师按马的近期状态定赔率，不再查只记 8 场旧赛的表。搜索改用仅在开发集拟合的校准逻辑回归（键类型、化学签名、距离比、配位）为未试键排序，取代 8 体系类别表（`drive_prior_model=r233-v1`）；留出 AUC 0.72–0.74，旧表 0.60–0.64。
systems_en: Reference `long-best-auto`. Development on 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal + 24 zeolite), 2 seeds; single confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 24 IS-first IS (2 O+H IS rejected by all bond-drive presets, so 75 run), 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 参照 `long-best-auto`。开发：DEV-A 85 个初态（61 金属 + 24 分子筛），2 个种子；唯一一次确认：C3 = G-FACTORY-3 封存 53 + IS-first 24 个初态（2 个 O+H 初态被所有键驱动预设拒绝，实跑 75 个），2 个种子。
result_en: Pre-registered DEV tests failed: model order plus a 20-launch dry stop gave U/call 1.047 [1.015, 1.077] but U −3.4 % (guard failed); order alone U/call 0.997. The model front-loads hits, then the dry stop ends sessions sooner. Post-hoc C3 test at a 3,000-call budget: U/call 1.063× [0.994, 1.137], one-sided p = 0.037, marginal; full-session C3 1.036 (descriptive). Useful only for call-budgeted searches; opt-in.
result_zh: 预注册开发检验失败：模型排序加“20 次空发射即停”，U/调用 1.047，但 U −3.4 %，护栏未过。事后 C3（限 3,000 调用）：U/调用 1.063 倍 [0.994, 1.137]，单侧 p = 0.037，勉强显著。仅适合限预算搜索，可选。

idea_en: A doctor reads the cheap X-ray first and cancels the costly operation when the picture says it will find nothing. A post-scan gate scores each scanned launch from what the scan already shows (energy-profile shape, top geometry, earlier outcomes in the session) and skips walks unlikely to yield a new saddle. Post-scan work on failed walks used 42.2 % of all calls; the seed rule had to be monotone and ≥99 % precise.
idea_zh: 医生先看便宜的 X 光片，若显示手术几乎肯定一无所获，就取消昂贵的手术。扫描后门控只用扫描已给出的信息（能量剖面形状、顶点几何、本会话先前成败）给每次已扫描的发射打分，跳过不太可能得到新鞍点的游走。失败游走的扫描后调用占全部调用的 42.2 %；原定规则须单调且精度 ≥99 %。
systems_en: Reference `long-best-auto`. Deep dive on 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds (170 sessions, 5,117 walked launches) with leave-host-family-out replays; single confirmation as a frozen zero-call replay of the archived C1 sessions (67 sealed G-FACTORY + 6 G5 IS, 2 seeds); plus live engineering runs of the `gbm-v1` gate on DEV.
systems_zh: 参照 `long-best-auto`。深挖：DEV-A 85 个初态 × 2 个种子（170 个会话、5,117 次游走发射），按宿主族留出回放；唯一一次确认：对 C1 存档会话（G-FACTORY 封存 67 + G5 6 个初态，2 个种子）做冻结规则的零调用回放；另在 DEV 上实跑 `gbm-v1` 门做工程检验。
result_en: No monotone gate reached ≥99 % precision on DEV, so the seed gate was never run live. C1 frozen replay: seed rule U/call 0.9955× [0.984, 1.006], p = 0.76, U −2.1 %, precision 0.778; negative. Side model `gbm-v1`: 1.0165× [1.0066, 1.0263], p = 0.0013, U −0.7 %, needs live confirmation. An identical failed scan succeeds 3.9 % of the time elsewhere on metals, so 99 % precision is impossible.

name_zh: 鞍点丰富度账本与停止
idea_en: A berry picker logs each bush type's yield, picks the best types first, and leaves once untried bushes promise under a fifth of the usual rate. Because an IS's total saddle count proved unpredictable beforehand (leave-one-out Spearman 0.48–0.54), sessions kept a ledger of new saddles and calls per launch for each bond-coordinate class, scaled by IS productivity, to reorder drives and stop when untried coordinates promised under 20 % of the family-average yield per call.
idea_zh: 采浆果的人给每种灌木记账：先采高产的，余下的预期不到平均产量五分之一就走。初态鞍点总数无法预知（留一 Spearman 0.48–0.54），故会话按键坐标类别记账（每次发射的新鞍点与调用，按初态产率缩放），据此重排驱动，未试坐标预期每调用产出低于同族平均 20 % 即停。
systems_en: Zero-call analysis and screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces + zeolites) × 2 seeds with two-fold cross-fitting; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS × 2 seeds. Reference preset long-best-auto (the CLI default).
systems_zh: 零调用分析与筛选：DEV-A 85 个初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子，二折交叉拟合；确认：C2 = G-FACTORY-2 的 62 个留出初态 × 2 个种子。参照预设 long-best-auto（CLI 默认）。
result_en: C2: STOP-ONLY U/call 1.0485× [1.023, 1.077], p < 0.00025, with 2.9 % fewer saddles; LEDGER (order + stop) 1.075× [1.018, 1.135] but U −5.7 %, failing the U guard. At equal U both fell below simply shortening the 25-launch dry-spell stop (−3.4 % [−6.8, +0.5] and −4.1 % [−10.5, +4.2]); the DEV edge did not replicate. Options stay off.
result_zh: C2：仅停止 U/调用 1.0485 倍 [1.023, 1.077]，p < 0.00025，鞍点少 2.9 %；账本排序+停止 1.075 倍，但 U −5.7 %，护栏未过。同 U 下两者都不如直接缩短干旱期停止（−3.4 %、−4.1 %）。不采纳。

idea_en: A birdwatcher compiling a species list skips a second robin, moves on to unseen species, and goes home when only robins remain. The default does the opposite: once one C–H bond of a CH3 yields a saddle, its chemically identical siblings jump to the queue front. Two new options defer siblings while other untried coordinates remain and end the session when only siblings are left, targeting distinct adsorbate reaction classes (K_chem) per call.
idea_zh: 观鸟者编名录：拍过一只知更鸟就去找没见过的鸟，只剩知更鸟时回家。默认搜索恰好相反：CH3 上一根 C–H 出了鞍点，化学等同的另两根立刻排到队首。新选项让这些“兄弟”坐标让位于其他未试坐标，只剩兄弟时结束会话，目标是每调用的不同吸附物反应类别数（K_chem）。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds; confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 IS + 22 runnable IS-first IS (two O+H IS were refused by both arms), i.e. 75 IS × 2 seeds. Reference long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 筛选：DEV-A 85 个初态 × 2 个种子；确认：C3 = G-FACTORY-3 留出 53 个 + IS-first 可运行 22 个（两个 O+H 初态两臂均拒绝），共 75 个初态 × 2 个种子。参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: C3: distinct reaction classes per call 1.201× [1.127, 1.277], p < 0.00025; at equal cost 1.090× [1.041, 1.146]; 95.4 % of classes retained. The price is saddle count: U −21 % (1,001 → 787), U/call 0.989× [0.947, 1.026]. Class gain +5 % on metals, +29 % in zeolites. Confirmed as an opt-in quick reaction-class survey, not a default.

idea_en: A hiker's step log showed 69 % of the 1,013 ionic steps per saddle spent walking back down to check the route and 31 % climbing, some of it circling just below the pass. New option sella_stall_window = 60 stops a Sella walk that has reached fmax < 0.1 eV/Å once its best force has not halved over the last 60 steps, instead of hovering up to the 300-step cap.
idea_zh: 登山者记步数：每个鞍点 1,013 个离子步，69 % 用于下山核对（验证下降），31 % 用于爬坡，有时在山口下打转。sella_stall_window = 60：Sella 行走到过 fmax < 0.1 后，若最近 60 步最好力未减半即停，不再耗满 300 步上限。
systems_en: Pilot on 30 DEV-A IS; development on the 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds and on its 61 metal-surface IS × 2; confirmation on the C1 metal subset: 57 IS (52 sealed G-FACTORY metals + 5 G5 metals) × 2 seeds. Reference long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 试点：DEV-A 中 30 个初态；开发：DEV-A 85 个初态 × 2 个种子（及其中 61 个金属表面初态 × 2）；确认：C1 金属子集 57 个初态（G-FACTORY 留出金属 52 个 + G5 金属 5 个）× 2 个种子。参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: C1 metals: U per ionic step 1.042× [1.022, 1.063], p < 0.00025; U/call 1.019× [1.009, 1.030]; core-seconds per saddle 0.947×; U 437 → 434 (−0.7 %). DEV metals 1.029× [1.017, 1.043]. Negative side results: a larger walker step cap (0.2/0.3 Å) lost 32 % of zeolite saddles; Sella delta0 0.2 lost 6 % on metals. The stall stop later shipped in long-best-auto-81 and long-more-auto-81.

idea_en: A compass needle that swings slowly settles at once if you first show it a rough map of north. In zeolite sessions dimer rotations ate 22.4 % of all calls (2.58 calls per walker step). P-ROT preconditions the Davidson-type rotation with the exact IS Hessian the session already stores (zero extra calls), so the dimer finds the lowest mode about 7× faster; COMBO adds a 6° lazy-rotation threshold and an image-A skip.
idea_zh: 摆得慢的罗盘针，给它一张大致方位图就能很快停稳。分子筛会话里 dimer 转动占全部调用的 22.4 %。P-ROT 用会话已存的初态精确 Hessian 给 Davidson 式转动做预条件（零额外调用），最低模收敛快约 7 倍；COMBO 再加 6° 懒转动阈值与跳过像 A。
systems_en: Zeolites only (long-best-auto uses Sella on metals): H0 test on 120 archived scan tops; development on the 24 DEV-A zeolite IS × 2 seeds (arms LZ6, SKIP, PROT, COMBO); confirmation on the 20 zeolite IS of C2 (sealed G-FACTORY-2) × 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 只作用于分子筛（long-best-auto 在金属表面用 Sella）：先在 120 个存档扫描顶点上做 H0 检验；开发：DEV-A 中 24 个分子筛初态 × 2 个种子（LZ6、SKIP、PROT、COMBO 四臂）；确认：C2（G-FACTORY-2 留出）中 20 个分子筛初态 × 2 个种子。
result_en: C2 zeolites: COMBO U/call 1.087× [1.006, 1.167], p 0.018; U per ionic step 1.109×; U(≤1.5)/call 1.258×. But U_ads/call fell to 0.884× [0.793, 0.970] (U 187 → 179, reorientation saddles 6 → 38): the faster rotation locks onto the true lowest mode, often a molecular reorientation. Failed the adoption guard; opt-in only. An ASE rotation-flip bug was found; fixing it was neutral (1.001×).
result_zh: C2 分子筛：COMBO U/调用 1.087 倍 [1.006, 1.167]，p 0.018。但 U_ads/调用 0.884 倍 [0.793, 0.970]，重取向鞍点 6 → 38：转动更快锁定真正的最低模，常是分子转向。未过采纳护栏，仅作可选。

idea_en: Like a clerk who re-added every receipt once per ledger column: the compiled exact NEP89 Hessian recomputed each neighbour's 3×3 second-derivative block for every column, 60–70 % of kernel time. A new JAX kernel adds each block once, giving the same Hessian (relative difference ≤ 1.8e-15) for a median 18 instead of 42 force-call equivalents; fast-validation mode keeps the old kernel for the IS Hessian and uses the new one for saddle certificates.
idea_zh: 像会计每记一列账都把收据重加一遍：精确 Hessian 的编译内核对每一列重算每个近邻的 3×3 二阶导数块，占 60–70 % 时间。新 JAX 内核每块只加一次，结果相同，价格中位从 42 降到 18 个力调用当量；fast-validation 只在证书中用新内核。
systems_en: Development on the 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds; confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 IS + 22 runnable IS-first IS, × 2 seeds (150 paired runs). Reference long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 85 个初态 × 2 个种子；确认：C3 = G-FACTORY-3 留出 53 个 + IS-first 可运行 22 个初态，× 2 个种子（150 对运行）。参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: C3 (fast-validation): 150/150 runs decision-identical; U/call 1.0214× [1.0187, 1.0242], p < 0.00025; U and U per ionic step unchanged. DEV 1.028× (167/170 identical, the reproducibility floor). Using the new kernel everywhere changed IS-Hessian-driven walks: 1.013× [0.993, 1.031], not confirmed. Hessian price median 42 → 18 call equivalents (2.2×). fast-validation became part of the -80 presets (v0.80 default).
result_zh: C3（fast-validation）：150/150 次运行决策相同；U/调用 1.0214 倍 [1.0187, 1.0242]，p < 0.00025，U 不变。全用新内核会改变行走（1.013 倍，未确认）。该模式进入 -80 默认预设。

idea_en: A surveyor returning to the same valley finds most readings already in yesterday's notebook. Within one session exact repeats were only 0.393 % of calls, so in-session deduplication was dropped; but a second same-preset session on the same IS repeats 88.8 % of the first session's force calls bit for bit. The opt-in evaluation_store serves those from disk, while search decisions still count them as calls, so results stay identical.
idea_zh: 测量员第二天回到同一山谷，大部分读数昨天的笔记里都有。会话内逐位重复的构型只占调用的 0.393 %，会话内去重作罢；但同一初态、同一预设的第二次会话有 88.8 % 的力调用与第一次逐位相同。可选的 evaluation_store 从磁盘读取它们，决策仍按调用计，结果不变。
systems_en: Repeat census on the 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds (170 long-best-auto sessions); confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS (73 IS), with one seed's sessions writing the store and the other seed's sessions reading it.
systems_zh: 重复普查：DEV-A 85 个初态 × 2 个种子（170 次 long-best-auto 会话）；确认：C1 = G-FACTORY 留出 67 个 + G5 6 个，共 73 个初态，一个种子的会话写入存储，另一个种子的会话读取。
result_en: C1: union of the two seeds U/call 1.752× [1.716, 1.783], p 0.00025; the reading session alone 6.39× [5.06, 8.14], with 2.2× fewer core-seconds; U unchanged (287 = 287), 146/146 sessions decision-identical. In-session cache only 1.0051× [1.0034, 1.0072]. A workflow feature for repeated or follow-up runs (e.g. --more after the default); it does nothing for a single search. Opt-in, not merged.
result_zh: C1：两种子并集 U/调用 1.752 倍 [1.716, 1.783]，p 0.00025；第二次会话单独 6.39 倍；U 不变（287 = 287），146/146 次会话决策相同。会话内缓存仅 1.0051 倍。属重复/后续运行的工作流功能，未合并。

name_en: Dimer rescue for the default preset (RESCUE-FOR-AUTO)
name_zh: 给默认预设加救援重走
idea_en: Send a second climber in different boots up the routes where the first gave up just below a low pass. long-best-auto has no rescue phase; a census of 4,806 re-walks on DEV picked, per family, a metal-only rule: failed Sella walks whose scan-top energy was ≤ 1 eV are re-walked with the dimer, started along the relaxed scan's own tangent, within a budget of 0.5× the session's calls.
idea_zh: 让换了鞋的第二位登山者重走在低山口下放弃的路线。long-best-auto 原本没有救援；DEV 上普查 4,806 次重走后选出规则：只在金属表面，对扫描顶能量 ≤ 1 eV 而失败的 Sella 行走，用 dimer 沿松弛扫描的切线重走，预算为会话调用的 0.5 倍。
systems_en: Census on the 85 DEV-A IS (1 seed, 4,806 re-walks); development check on the 61 DEV-A metal-surface IS × 2 seeds; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal, 20 zeolite), one session per arm. Reference long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 普查：DEV-A 85 个初态（1 个种子，4,806 次重走）；开发检查：DEV-A 中 61 个金属表面初态 × 2 个种子；确认：C2 = G-FACTORY-2 留出 62 个初态（42 个金属、20 个分子筛），每臂 1 次会话。参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: DEV metals looked promising: U/call 1.024× [1.000, 1.050], U +8.3 %. On C2, U per search rose 4.0 % (1.040× [1.017, 1.067]) but U/call fell to 0.9725× [0.951, 0.993], a price of −0.68 % per +1 % U (target better than −0.3; --more −0.09). Re-walk success fell from 19 % (DEV) to 6 %; the DEV edge looks like a winner's curse among 36 candidate rules. Not adopted.
result_zh: C2：U +4.0 %，但 U/调用 0.9725 倍 [0.951, 0.993]，每多 1 % U 价格 −0.68（目标优于 −0.3）。重走成功率 19 % → 6 %；DEV 上的 1.024 倍似为 36 条候选规则中的赢家诅咒。未采纳。

name_zh: 分子筛键变化门控 Sella
idea_en: Hire the specialist guide only where the rock already shows a crack, and recall him if he wanders home. Round 127's zeolite split mostly added reorientations, and 29 % of its Sella walks ended in the IS bond graph. Now Sella gets a launch only if the scan top shows an adsorbate bond change; a zero-call guard stops it after 5 steps back in IS bonding, and the dimer re-walks from the same start.
idea_zh: 只在岩壁已现裂缝处请专业向导，他往回走就叫回来。第 127 轮分子筛拆分多出的多是重取向，其 Sella 行走 29 % 停在初态键图。新规则：扫描顶已有吸附物键变化才交给 Sella；零调用护栏在 Sella 连续 5 步回到初态成键时叫停，由 dimer 从同一起点重走。
systems_en: Zeolites only. Zero-call anatomy of an archived round-127 run (20 DEV-A zeolites); arm selection on the 24 DEV-A zeolite IS × 1 seed; confirmation on 28 C3 zeolites (18 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 10 IS-first) × 2 seeds. Reference long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 只针对分子筛。零调用解剖第 127 轮存档运行（DEV-A 中 20 个分子筛）；在 DEV-A 的 24 个分子筛初态 × 1 个种子上选臂；确认：C3 中 28 个分子筛（G-FACTORY-3 留出 18 个 + IS-first 10 个）× 2 个种子。参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: C3 zeolites: U_ads/call 1.118× [1.057, 1.178] and U/call 1.114× [1.055, 1.174], p < 0.00025; U +16.8 %, reorientations unchanged (10 = 10). But the extra saddles are mostly 1.5–3 eV radical or H-atom channels: U(≤1.5)/call 1.016×, unflagged saddles per call 0.902× [0.812, 0.994], and saddles per core-second 0.627× (Sella's dense algebra). Confirmed, opt-in only.
result_zh: C3 分子筛：U/调用 1.114 倍 [1.055, 1.174]，U_ads/调用 1.118 倍，p < 0.00025。但新增多为 1.5–3 eV 自由基/H 原子通道：无标记鞍点每调用 0.902 倍，每核·秒鞍点 0.627 倍。仅作可选。

name_en: Skip the second descent on metals (SKIP2M)
name_zh: 金属上省去第二侧下降
idea_en: If the downhill trail pointing toward camp misses it, the one pointing away will not reach camp either, so skip walking it. The validator descends the IS-ward side of a candidate first; on metal surfaces, among 228 validated DEV launches the IS was never on the second side (zeolites: 15 of 251). quench_second_skip = metal declares a metal candidate disconnected when the first side misses the IS, skipping the second descent.
idea_zh: 朝营地的下山路到不了营地，背向营地的那条也不会到，不必走。验证器先沿朝初态一侧下降；金属表面上 DEV 228 个验证通过的发射里，初态从未在第二侧（分子筛 15/251）。quench_second_skip = metal：金属候选第一侧不是初态即判不连通，省去第二侧。
systems_en: Zero-call trace analysis on the 85 DEV-A IS (shared reference runs, 2 seeds, plus a 1-seed trace batch); development check on the 61 DEV-A metal-surface IS × 2 seeds; confirmation on the C1 metal subset: 57 IS (52 sealed G-FACTORY metals + 5 G5 metals) × 2 seeds. Reference long-best-auto.
systems_zh: 零调用 trace 分析：DEV-A 85 个初态（共享参照运行 2 个种子，另有 1 个种子的 trace 批次）；开发检查：DEV-A 61 个金属表面初态 × 2 个种子；确认：C1 金属子集 57 个初态（G-FACTORY 留出金属 52 个 + G5 金属 5 个）× 2 个种子。参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: C1 metals: U/call 1.030× [1.020, 1.041], p < 0.00025; U per ionic step 1.063×; saddle sets identical in 114/114 runs. DEV metals 1.046× (122/122 identical); whole C1 about 1.016×. The original idea, a refit of round 28's learned disconnection screen, saved only 0.6–0.9 % of calls. Only for Sella-on-metal presets (dimer-based long-best had 2 counterexamples); quench_second_skip = metal entered the -80 presets.

name_zh: 热启动的第二顶点重扫
idea_en: When a trail over the first ridge dead-ends, keep walking from your last bookmark to the next ridge instead of restarting from the valley. After re-pricing the post-session phases (the completion pass costs 8.1k calls per extra saddle), the branch rescan was rebuilt warm: the bond scan's last stage is stored, and on metals, for coordinates whose walk aborted on positive curvature, the scan continues to a second apex and searches there, recomputing nothing.
idea_zh: 山脊后的路走不通时，从书签处接着走到下一道山脊，而不是回山谷重来。先给会话后各阶段在精确时代重新定价，再把分支重扫改为热启动：保存键扫描最后一级；在金属表面上，对行走因正曲率中止的坐标从那里继续扫到第二个顶点并搜索，不重算扫描点。
systems_en: Pricing on the 85 DEV-A IS (long-best-auto sessions followed by each phase, paired with the shared reference runs, 2 seeds); development on the 61 DEV-A metal-surface IS × 2 seeds; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal, 20 zeolite) × 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 定价：DEV-A 85 个初态（long-best-auto 会话后接各阶段，与共享参照运行配对，2 个种子）；开发：DEV-A 61 个金属表面初态 × 2 个种子；确认：C2 = G-FACTORY-2 留出 62 个初态（42 个金属、20 个分子筛）× 2 个种子。
result_en: Exact-era prices (% U/call per +1 % U): completion −2.20, probe −1.46, branch −0.72, all worse than --more (−0.08). Warm rescans on C2: U per search 1.037× [1.016, 1.063] at U/call 1.001× [0.988, 1.016]; price +0.03, but the pre-registered test missed (p = 0.31). Descriptively, --more plus warm rescans gave +11.0 % saddles at −0.080. Inconclusive; merged later as a default-off option.

name_zh: 低能垒行走者的爬升上限（LOWBARRIER-2）
idea_en: A hiker who only wants low passes turns back once the trail has taken him 1.5 eV above his starting point: a pass found beyond that would almost never be low enough. In the low-barrier preset `long-lowbarrier-auto` (saddles ≤ 1.5 eV only), each walker compares its energy with its launch point (the scan top) at every iteration and ends the launch after climbing more than 1.5 eV, at no extra force calls.
idea_zh: 只找低山口的登山者，比出发点高出 1.5 eV 就掉头：再往上的山口几乎都超出窗口。在只要能垒 ≤ 1.5 eV 鞍点的预设 `long-lowbarrier-auto` 中，行走者每步把自身能量与发射起点（扫描顶点）比较，爬升超过 1.5 eV 即结束发射，不额外花力调用。
systems_en: Development: 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces + zeolites) × 2 seeds. Confirmation under a frozen protocol: C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 IS + 22 runnable IS-first IS (2 O–H IS are refused by all bond-drive presets and count as zero) = 75 IS × 2 seeds; reference `long-lowbarrier-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 85 个初态（金属表面 + 分子筛）× 2 个种子。确认（冻结协议）：C3 = G-FACTORY-3 密封初态 53 个 + 可运行的 IS-first 初态 22 个（另 2 个 O–H 初态被所有键驱动预设拒绝，按 0 计）= 75 个初态 × 2 个种子；参照 `long-lowbarrier-auto`。
result_en: C3 confirmation: U(≤1.5)/call 1.135× [1.099, 1.171], p < 0.00025 (zeolites 1.199×, metals 1.051×); U/ionic step 1.172× [1.128, 1.219]; U_ads/call 1.130×; U −1.8 %. DEV: 1.134× [1.096, 1.173]. The ceiling mostly cuts futile zeolite climbs (34–37 % of walking calls). Against Sella FAIR on the same IS: 1.77× (descriptive). Adopted in `long-lowbarrier-auto-79` and the v0.80 `--max-barrier` default.

name_en: Fastest route to the first saddle (FIRST-SADDLE-SPEED)
idea_en: A prospector short on time digs first where he expects the most gold per hour of digging. Until three saddles were found, bond drives were launched in order of predicted success per force call (Smith's index p/c): success came from a zero-call logistic model on bond class, distance ratio and exact initial-state-Hessian bond stiffness, cost from the class's typical launch cost.
idea_zh: 时间有限的淘金者先挖“每小时预期出金最多”的地方。在找到前 3 个鞍点之前，键驱动按每次力调用的预测成功率（Smith 指数 p/c）排序发射：成功率来自零调用逻辑回归（键类别、距离比、初态精确 Hessian 的键刚度），成本取该键类的典型发射调用数。
systems_en: Development: 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces + zeolites) × 2 seeds. Confirmation: C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS = 73 IS × 2 seeds, with its own in-pool reference runs of `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 85 个初态（金属表面 + 分子筛）× 2 个种子。确认：C1 = G-FACTORY 密封初态 67 个 + G5 初态 6 个 = 73 个初态 × 2 个种子，池内同时运行参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C1 confirmation failed: force calls to the first certified saddle 0.951× [0.840, 1.065], p 0.80 (reference/candidate, so >1 means faster); third saddle 1.071× [1.005, 1.145]; whole-session U/call 1.000×. DEV had promised 1.187× [1.077, 1.304]. C1 states were built from known transition states, so the old order already tried the target bond first (49 % success); the model preferred cheap metal–adsorbate hops (23 %).
result_zh: C1 确认未通过：到首个认证鞍点的力调用之比 0.951 [0.840, 1.065]，p 0.80（>1 为更快；DEV 曾为 1.187）。C1 初态由已知过渡态构建，原顺序本就先试目标键（成功 49 %），模型却先试便宜的吸附物跳位（23 %）。

idea_en: Asked for the lowest pass, a guide ranks routes by sketched heights and stops once every unchecked route looks higher than his best; the sketches run high, so he sometimes stops too early. `explore --ask` (lowest barrier for one bond class) uses the lower neighbour of each scan top to order launches and certify the stop, with a 0.10 eV margin, and skips refining walked saddles more than 0.01 eV above the current best.
idea_zh: 向导找最低山口时按草图高度给路线排队，未探路线都比已知最低山口高就收工；但草图偏高，有时收工过早。`explore --ask`（问某键类的最低能垒）改用扫描顶点两侧较低的相邻点排序并出具停止证书（裕度 0.10 eV），且不再精修比当前最佳高 0.01 eV 以上的结果。
systems_en: Development: 232 bond-class questions on 80 of the 85 DEV-A IS. Confirmation: C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (new hosts such as hcp(0001), fcc(110), bcc), 464 questions, of which 216 on 60 IS could be scored; reference = the previous `--ask` default on `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 85 个初态中的 80 个，共 232 个键类问题。确认：C2 = G-FACTORY-2 密封初态 62 个（hcp(0001)、fcc(110)、bcc 等新基底），464 个问题，其中 60 个初态上的 216 个可评分；参照为原 `--ask` 默认（基于 `long-best-auto`）。
result_en: C2 confirmation: correct answers 93.1 % vs 88.0 %, a gain of +0.051 [0.018, 0.087], p 0.0015 (12 wins, 1 loss), at 1.002× [0.978, 1.025] the force calls. DEV: +0.034. One question costs 12–14 % of a full session, whose own answer is right only 75 % of the time on C2. Became the `--ask` default (neighbour bound, margin 0.1, prune 0.01) in v0.79.

name_zh: 吸附构型系综共享记忆（ENSEMBLE-IS-SEARCH）
idea_en: Prospectors working sister valleys share one notebook, so nobody re-digs a vein a colleague has already mapped. `dimer-explore adsorb` builds up to four adsorption configurations of a molecule; these are now searched lowest-energy first, and later members skip every molecule-level bond class that already produced new chemistry (chem mode) or any saddle (saddle mode, the confirmed arm), using a zero-call ensemble memory (`--ensemble-memory`, off by default).
idea_zh: 淘金者在相邻山谷共用一本笔记，同伴挖过的矿脉不再重挖。`adsorb` 为一个分子生成至多 4 个吸附构型；现按能量由低到高搜索，后面的构型跳过前面已出过新化学（chem）或任何鞍点（saddle，即确认臂）的分子层面键类（`--ensemble-memory`，默认关闭）。
systems_en: Development: 50 self-built ensembles (18 molecule + substrate inputs from GEN3/GEN4 systems and 32 G-FACTORY dev states), 45 with several members. Confirmation: 75 ensembles built from C3 (53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 24 IS-first IS, 2 O+H states excluded), 268 members; the 71 multi-member ensembles were tested against searching every member with `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：自建 50 个系综（18 个取自 GEN3/GEN4 体系的分子 + 基底输入，32 个 G-FACTORY 开发初态），其中 45 个含多个构型。确认：由 C3（G-FACTORY-3 密封 53 个 + IS-first 24 个，排除 2 个 O+H）构建 75 个系综、268 个构型，检验其中 71 个多构型系综；参照为对每个构型完整运行 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C3 confirmation (saddle mode): distinct chemistry per force call 1.516× [1.433, 1.613], Holm p 0.0005; 1.094× [1.042, 1.151] versus spending the same calls on fewer members; 88 % of the reference chemistry retained. The cost: saddle U/call 0.848× [0.816, 0.883] and 51 % fewer saddles per search. Shipped as an opt-in mode for 'which reactions can this molecule do', not a default.
result_zh: C3（saddle 模式）：每次力调用的不同化学 1.516 倍 [1.433, 1.613]，Holm p 0.0005；同等调用下胜过少搜构型（1.094 倍）；保留参照 88 % 的化学。代价：鞍点 U/调用 0.848 倍。可选模式，不进默认。

idea_en: Bond drives tug one pair of atoms at a time, like moving a table by one leg; an artificial-force tow-rope drags a whole group. After a normal `long-best-auto` session, a Maeda-weighted artificial force (ramped 1–4 eV/Å) lifted adsorbate units off the metal, pushed two together, split one, or pushed one toward a nearby metal atom; each path top was relaxed at fixed fragment distance and handed to the walker (≤ 5 launches).
idea_zh: 键驱动一次只拉一对原子，像拽桌腿挪桌子；人工力则给整组原子套绳拖动。在常规 `long-best-auto` 会话之后，用 Maeda 加权的人工力（1–4 eV/Å 递增）把吸附物单元从金属上提起、两两合并、拆开或推向邻近金属原子；路径顶点在固定碎片距离上弛豫后交给行走者。
systems_en: Development: 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds. Confirmation under a frozen protocol: C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS = 73 IS × 2 seeds; the reference is the same run's `long-best-auto` session before the AFIR phase.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 85 个初态 × 2 个种子。确认（冻结协议）：C1 = G-FACTORY 密封初态 67 个 + G5 初态 6 个 = 73 个初态 × 2 个种子；参照为同一运行在 AFIR 阶段之前的 `long-best-auto` 会话。
result_en: C1: saddles per search 1.060× [1.030, 1.097], p < 0.00025 (confirmed), but U/call 0.985× [0.964, 1.008], so per-call non-inferiority was not shown. All 34 new saddles lay outside the two-seed union of `long-best-auto`, and 20 changed no drivable bond; the main source was lifting groups off the metal. Cost: 1,872 calls per new saddle vs 1,476 per saddle in the session.
result_zh: C1：每次搜索鞍点 1.060 倍 [1.030, 1.097]，p < 0.00025（确认）；U/调用 0.985 倍 [0.964, 1.008]，未证明不劣。34 个新鞍点均在默认预设两种子并集之外，主要来自把吸附物从金属上拉开。

name_en: Newton trajectories and scan-top polish revisited (NT-DRIVES-REVISIT)
name_zh: 牛顿轨迹与扫描顶点打磨重访（NT-DRIVES-REVISIT）
idea_en: Two ways to start a climb better: follow the path along which the slope keeps pointing the same way (a Newton trajectory, which leads over a pass), and tidy up base camp before setting off. NTLIMIT re-drove forming-bond scans still climbing at their last step along a hyperplane Newton trajectory whitened by the exact initial-state Hessian; POLISH spent up to 10 extra force calls relaxing each scan top on its iso-distance surface before launch.
idea_zh: 两种起步改进：沿“坡向始终不变”的路线走（牛顿轨迹会经过山口），以及出发前先把营地收拾好。NTLIMIT 对最后一步仍在爬升的成键扫描，改沿用初态精确 Hessian 白化的超平面牛顿轨迹重新驱动；POLISH 在发射前花至多 10 次力调用，把扫描顶点在等距离面上再弛豫。
systems_en: DEV-A only: 85 IS (metal surfaces + zeolites) × 2 seeds × 3 arms in one pool, reference `long-best-auto`; POLISH was also tested on the low-barrier preset `long-lowbarrier-auto`. No confirmation, because no arm passed the pre-registered development rules.
systems_zh: 仅 DEV-A：85 个初态（金属表面 + 分子筛）× 2 个种子 × 3 个臂，同池运行，参照 `long-best-auto`；POLISH 另在低能垒预设 `long-lowbarrier-auto` 上测试。无臂通过预注册开发规则，未做确认。
result_en: DEV: NTLIMIT U/call 0.934× [0.902, 0.964]; POLISH 0.981× [0.932, 1.031], p 0.77; POLISH on the low-barrier preset U(≤1.5)/call 0.992× [0.937, 1.049]. Polishing only reshuffles outcomes: of 5,259 paired launches, 217 succeeded only with it and 210 only without. Newton trajectories cross a ridge 87 % of the time, but mostly sliding or rotation ridges. Distance scans remain the right geometry.
result_zh: DEV：NTLIMIT U/调用 0.934 倍 [0.902, 0.964]；POLISH 0.981 倍 [0.932, 1.031]，p 0.77，均未过开发规则。打磨只是洗牌（217 次发射变成功、210 次变失败）；牛顿轨迹多越过滑移/转动脊。

idea_en: Calling back a scout who is heading for an already-mapped pass saves effort, if one can tell early where he is going. Capture was widened: walkers are also compared with symmetric images and same-element relabellings of known saddles, failed candidates become capture targets, and an earlier, wider capture layer is added. A trace recorder logged each walker's distance to known saddles, so every rule could be replayed at zero force calls.
idea_zh: 队员若正走向团队已测绘过的山口，越早叫回越省力——前提是能及早看出他要去哪。本轮放宽“捕获”：也比对已知鞍点的对称像与同元素重标号，把验证失败的候选列为捕获目标，并加一层更早、更宽的捕获；轨迹记录仪记下每步到已知鞍点的距离，用零力调用回放评估每条规则。
systems_en: DEV-A: 85 IS × 2 seeds re-run with the trace recorder (170 sessions, 5,632 launches); 288 capture rules replayed at zero calls, then a small NEP implementation check on the 11 most favourable IS × 2 seeds. No confirmation: the pre-registered kill rule fired.
systems_zh: DEV-A：85 个初态 × 2 个种子带轨迹记录重跑（170 个会话、5,632 次发射）；零调用回放 288 条捕获规则，再在最有利的 11 个初态 × 2 个种子上做 NEP 实现检查。预注册淘汰规则触发，未做确认。
result_en: Duplicate launches cost 3.61 % of calls, and re-validation waste is already zero (11.5–20.5 % in Sella FAIR). The best safe rule saved 9.8 % of addressable duplicate calls (0.20 % of all), below the 25 % threshold: predicted U/call 1.0020× [1.0015, 1.0027]. Duplicate walkers reach 0.3 Å of their target only after a median 75 % of their walk, and some new-saddle walks pass as close to known ones.
result_zh: 重复发射占 3.61 % 调用，重复验证浪费已为 0。最好的安全规则只省可寻址重复调用的 9.8 %（全部的 0.20 %），低于 25 % 门槛；预测 U/调用 1.0020 倍 [1.0015, 1.0027]。重复行走者中位走完 75 % 才接近目标。

name_en: Cheaper saddle refinement and mode hand-over (KRYLOV-NEWTON-DEEP-DIVE)
name_zh: 更省的鞍点精修与负模交接（KRYLOV-NEWTON-DEEP-DIVE）
idea_en: Re-sanding a part that is already smooth wastes effort, and handing the inspector a blurry arrow makes him re-aim again and again. The Krylov–Newton refine step now first checks convergence (Sella hands over candidates already converged to fmax 1e-5), then sharpens the negative-curvature mode with an initial-state-Hessian-preconditioned Davidson iteration (~4.8 calls), so the validator usually accepts at its first check instead of hitting its 6-rotation cap (74 % before).
idea_zh: 工件已磨光还再磨是浪费；递给质检员的箭头模糊，他就得反复重新瞄准。精修现先检查是否已收敛（Sella 交来的候选多已收敛），再用初态 Hessian 预条件的 Davidson 迭代（约 4.8 次力调用）磨准负曲率方向，验证器多能一次通过（此前 74 % 要转满 6 次）。
systems_en: Development: 85 DEV-A IS; one seed chose among five arms, the other seed tested the winner (KPFS). Confirmation under a frozen protocol: C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS = 73 IS × 2 seeds (292 runs); reference `long-best-auto`, where 71 % of refined candidates come from Sella.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 85 个初态，一个种子用于从五个臂中选出 KPFS，另一个种子用于检验。确认（冻结协议）：C1 = G-FACTORY 密封初态 67 个 + G5 初态 6 个 = 73 个初态 × 2 个种子（292 次运行）；参照 `long-best-auto`，其中 71 % 的精修候选来自 Sella。
result_en: C1: U/call 1.0115× [0.9907, 1.0339], p 0.150, not confirmed, although the DEV test seed gave 1.035× [1.014, 1.056], p 0.0003. The solid part: runs with identical decisions (74–82 %) used 1.3–1.6 % fewer calls and found exactly the same saddles; the rest diverged, adding noise. Not merged; the related round-187 'skip converged candidates' option entered the presets instead.
result_zh: C1：U/调用 1.0115 倍 [0.9907, 1.0339]，p 0.150，未确认（DEV 曾为 1.035 倍）。可靠部分：决策完全相同的运行（74–82 %）少用 1.3–1.6 % 调用，鞍点不变。未合并；第 187 轮的同类选项进入了预设。

name_en: Retuning the zeolite walker's Hessian metric (INITIALIZATION-METRIC-DEEP-DIVE)
idea_en: Near the pass, the climber switches to a map drawn from his own valley's curvature, the initial-state Hessian; the questions were which map, how smoothed, and when to switch. In large zeolites (3N > 469) the dimer walker adopts this metric once it reaches negative curvature with fmax ≤ 0.05. Replays compared floors and shifts on soft modes, a geometric Exp preconditioner, the metric for the whole walk, and earlier or step-length-based switch-on.
idea_zh: 临近山口，登山者改用按本山谷曲率（初态 Hessian）画的地图；问题是哪张图、平滑多少、何时换。大分子筛（3N > 469）的 dimer 行走者在负曲率且 fmax ≤ 0.05 时锁定该度量。回放比较：软模下限与平移、几何 Exp 预条件子、全程用度量、更早或按步长切换。
systems_en: Paired NEP replay of all 2,902 archived walks from the shared `long-best-auto` DEV-A runs on its 24 zeolite IS × 2 seeds (12 of them large: MFI, LTL, MTW, FER), each walk re-run under every arm. No arm passed the kill rule, so session tests and the C2 confirmation were not run.
systems_zh: 配对 NEP 行走回放：共享 `long-best-auto` DEV-A 运行中 24 个分子筛初态 × 2 个种子的全部 2,902 次存档行走（其中 12 个大体系初态：MFI、LTL、MTW、FER），每个臂逐一重跑。无臂通过淘汰规则，未做会话测试与 C2 确认。
result_en: No arm passed. Large-zeolite walker calls vs reference (lower is better): no tail metric 1.433× [1.374, 1.505]; Exp preconditioner 1.376×; stronger floors or shifts 1.025–1.098×; earlier switch-on (fmax 0.1) 0.940× [0.921, 0.955], but the saddle-identity proxy fell to 0.974 (guard 0.98). The initial-state-Hessian metric is the most valuable part of this walker and already near-optimal.
result_zh: 无臂通过。大分子筛行走调用（越低越好）：去掉尾段度量 1.433 倍；提前切换（fmax 0.1）0.940 倍 [0.921, 0.955]，但鞍点代理仅 0.974（护栏 0.98）。初态 Hessian 度量是该行走者最有价值的部件，已近最优。

name_en: Leaner Sella internals on metal surfaces (SELLA-ADAPTER-DEEP-DIVE)
name_zh: 精简 Sella 内部运算（SELLA-ADAPTER-DEEP-DIVE）
idea_en: An assistant who solves the same equation twice at every step, and keeps doing arithmetic on furniture bolted to the floor, wastes time. On metal surfaces, FAST removed Sella's duplicate 3N eigendecomposition and an all-zero constraint projection at each step; FREE ran Sella on the free atoms only, leaving out fixed slab layers; CAP limited the initial Davidson to 10 Hessian-vector products. FREECAP combined all three.
idea_zh: 助手每步把同一道方程解两遍，还对钉死的家具做运算。金属表面上，FAST 去掉 Sella 每步重复的 3N 矩阵分解和对零约束 Hessian 的投影；FREE 只对可动原子运算；CAP 把初始 Davidson 限为 10 个 Hessian-向量积；FREECAP 三者合用。
systems_en: Development: the 61 DEV-A IS where `long-best-auto` walks with Sella (metal surfaces) × 2 seeds × 5 arms. Confirmation under a frozen protocol on C3 metals: 35 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 12 IS-first metal IS (2 refused O–H IS count as zero) = 47 IS × 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A 中 `long-best-auto` 用 Sella 行走的 61 个金属表面初态 × 2 个种子 × 5 个臂。确认（冻结协议）：C3 金属部分 = G-FACTORY-3 密封 35 个 + IS-first 金属 12 个（2 个被拒的 O–H 初态按 0 计）= 47 个初态 × 2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C3 metals: FREECAP U/call 1.045× [1.006, 1.086], p 0.012, with core-seconds per saddle down by a factor 1.365, but 5.5 % fewer saddles and 11 % fewer below 1.5 eV. FAST alone kept identical saddle sets (94/94; DEV 122/122) and cut core-seconds per saddle by a factor 1.132 [1.120, 1.144]. FAST and the Davidson cap went into the v0.79 presets and the v0.80 default; FREE stayed opt-in.
result_zh: C3 金属：FREECAP U/调用 1.045 倍 [1.006, 1.086]，p 0.012，但鞍点少 5.5 %。FAST 单独：鞍点集合完全相同，每鞍点核秒降为 1/1.132。FAST 与 Davidson 上限进入 v0.80 默认。

idea_en: Like a sealed exam paper opened only once: 72 initial states that no earlier round had touched, on 23 new hosts carrying new sulfur, nitrogen, aromatic and C4 alcohol/ether chemistry. Eleven frozen methods (four campaign-3 candidate presets, three v0.78.1 presets and four fair baselines tuned on DEV) each ran twice per state, with the default-switch rules and guards hashed before unsealing. No search code changed.
idea_zh: 像一张只拆封一次的密封考卷：23 个新宿主上 72 个从未用过的初态，含硫、含氮、芳香与 C4 醇醚等新化学。11 种冻结方法（4 个第三阶段候选预设、3 个 v0.78.1 预设、4 个按开发集调好的公平基线）各跑 2 次；默认切换规则与护栏开封前已哈希冻结，搜索代码不变。
systems_en: Sealed pool P1 of G-FACTORY-4: 72 IS on 23 hosts. Metals 47 (34 TS-first + 13 IS-first), e.g. Au(110), Co(0001), Cu3Pt(111), Ir(331), Pt(210); zeolites 25 (18 TS-first + 7 IS-first), e.g. AFX, HEU, LEV, MAZ, RTH, STF. 11 methods × 72 IS × 2 seeds = 1,584 runs, none missing; statistics by host-block bootstrap.
systems_zh: G-FACTORY-4 密封池 P1：23 个宿主上的 72 个初态。金属 47 个（TS-first 34 + IS-first 13），如 Au(110)、Co(0001)、Cu3Pt(111)、Ir(331)、Pt(210)；分子筛 25 个（TS-first 18 + IS-first 7），如 AFX、HEU、LEV、MAZ、RTH、STF。11 种方法 × 72 个初态 × 2 个种子 = 1,584 次运行，无缺失；按宿主分块自助法统计。
result_en: `long-best-auto-79` vs v0.78.1 `long-best-auto`: U/call 1.310× [1.233, 1.397], U/ionic step 1.453× [1.379, 1.537]; vs Sella FAIR-PLUS 1.614× [1.293, 2.095]. But U/search 0.877× [0.808, 0.957] failed the 0.97 guard (the price and topology-yield stops ended sessions too early on new chemistry), so the default was not switched. v0.78.1 vs FAIR-PLUS: 1.232× [0.950, 1.643], not significant.
result_zh: long-best-auto-79 对 v0.78.1 默认：U/调用 1.310 倍 [1.233, 1.397]，对 FAIR-PLUS 1.614 倍；但 U/搜索 0.877 倍，未过 0.97 护栏（两个停止规则在新化学上收手过早），默认不切换。

name_zh: 加强版公平 Sella 基线（SELLA-FAIR-PLUS）
idea_en: Like a prospector who keeps re-digging holes he has already emptied: plain Sella FAIR spent 34.4 % of its calls on launches that ended at already-known candidates, and over half of those repeats came from the same bond start. FAIR-PLUS adds only existing, chemistry-free bookkeeping: it excludes known candidates, remembers used start directions, aborts walks captured by a known saddle, and runs at most 6 launches, stopping after 3 dry ones.
idea_zh: 像总回到已挖空的坑里重挖的淘金者：原版 Sella FAIR 34.4 % 的力调用花在终点为已知候选的发射上，过半重复出自同一键起点。FAIR-PLUS 只加现成、与化学无关的记账：排除已知候选、记住用过的起点方向、被已知鞍点捕获即中止，最多 6 次发射、连续 3 次落空即停。
systems_en: Working point chosen on a grid over 76 DEV-A IS (nine MFI IS left out for wall-clock reasons), then DEV-A 85 IS (61 metal + 24 zeolite) × 2 new seeds; pre-registered confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS × 2 seeds. Arms: Sella FAIR (frozen in round 135), Sella FAIR-PLUS and `long-best-auto` from the shared reference runs.
systems_zh: 先在 76 个 DEV-A 初态（因耗时去掉 9 个 MFI）上用网格选工作点，再在 DEV-A 85 个初态（金属 61 + 分子筛 24）× 2 个新种子上复测；预注册确认用 C2 = G-FACTORY-2 密封 62 个初态 × 2 个种子。对比臂：第 135 轮冻结的 Sella FAIR、Sella FAIR-PLUS，以及共享参照中的 long-best-auto。
result_en: Confirmation on C2: FAIR-PLUS vs FAIR U/call 1.629× [1.457, 1.810], p < 0.00025 (DEV 1.599×), though each run finds only 0.80× as many saddles. Against it, `long-best-auto` reaches 1.188× [0.946, 1.510], p = 0.069, not significant (metals 0.90×, zeolites 1.73×), versus 1.93× against old FAIR. Frozen as the new fair baseline; GF6's 1.529× headline implies only 0.94× [0.80, 1.13] against it.
result_zh: C2 确认：FAIR-PLUS 对 FAIR 的 U/调用 1.629 倍 [1.457, 1.810]，但每运行鞍点只有其 0.80 倍。long-best-auto 对它仅 1.188 倍（不显著；对旧 FAIR 为 1.93 倍）。冻结为新的公平基线。

name_en: Hydrogen-mode seed in Sella's Hessian, retested (DH1-RETEST)
idea_en: Like telling a hiker a rumour about where the pass lies before the first step. A zero-call bond-order model for mobile hydrogen predicts a negative-curvature direction that is planted as the one negative-curvature mode of Sella's starting exact initial-state Hessian; the round re-ran round 209's version (DH1) on new seeds and added DH1P, which seeds only the driven hydrogen.
idea_zh: 像出发前告诉登山者一个关于山口方向的传闻。用零调用的移动氢键级模型预测负曲率方向，把它作为唯一的负曲率模写进 Sella 起步用的初态精确 Hessian；本轮在新种子上复测第 209 轮的 DH1，并新增只对被驱动氢播种的 DH1P。
systems_en: Screening on the 61 metal IS of DEV-A (19 from the GF3 dev set, 30 G-FACTORY dev, 8 G-FACTORY-2 dev, 4 G-FACTORY-3 dev) × 2 new seeds; confirmation on the metal part of C3: 47 IS (35 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 12 IS-first), 1 seed. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 筛选：DEV-A 中 61 个金属初态（GF3 开发集 19、G-FACTORY 开发 30、G-FACTORY-2 开发 8、G-FACTORY-3 开发 4）× 2 个新种子；确认：C3 的金属部分 47 个初态（G-FACTORY-3 密封 35 + IS-first 12），1 个种子。参照 long-best-auto。
result_en: Confirmation on C3 metals, DH1P: U/call 0.987× [0.948, 1.038], p = 0.70 (U +3.7 %, calls +5.0 %). On DEV, DH1 gave 1.014× [0.976, 1.051] and DH1P 1.031× (Holm p = 0.047). About 30 % of seeded launches changed outcome, roughly symmetrically. Lesson: new seeds on the same metal IS reproduce almost the same saddles, so replication needs new IS. Option stays off.
result_zh: C3 金属确认（DH1P）：U/调用 0.987 倍 [0.948, 1.038]，p = 0.70；开发集 DH1P 1.031 倍。约 30 % 的播种发射结局改变，增减大致对称。金属上换种子几乎重现同批鞍点，复测须换新初态。选项保持关闭。

name_en: Skip unanchored H–H drives on metals (HH-SKIP-CONFIRM)
name_zh: 金属上跳过无锚定 H–H 驱动（HH-SKIP-CONFIRM）
idea_en: Like a door that has never opened: stop knocking on it. On metals, drives that push two hydrogens together while neither touches the surface never produced an H2-formation saddle on DEV; their scans climb to about 3.6 eV without crossing a ridge, yet took 7.3 % of calls. The option skips only these drives, a narrow version of round 221's anchor skip, which had lost 9.9 % of saddles.
idea_zh: 像一扇从没开过的门，就别再敲了。在金属上，把两个都不与表面成键的氢推到一起的驱动，在开发集上从未产生 H2 生成鞍点；扫描爬到约 3.6 eV 也越不过脊，却占 7.3 % 的力调用。该选项只跳过这类驱动，是第 221 轮锚定跳过（丢 9.9 % 鞍点）的窄版。
systems_en: Screening on the 61 metal IS of DEV-A × 2 seeds (matching a zero-call replay); confirmation on the metal part of C1: 57 IS (52 sealed G-FACTORY metals + 5 G5 metals) × 2 seeds. Reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 筛选：DEV-A 中 61 个金属初态 × 2 个种子（与零调用重放一致）；确认：C1 的金属部分 57 个初态（G-FACTORY 密封金属 52 + G5 金属 5）× 2 个种子。参照 long-best-auto。
