result_en: Confirmation on C1 metals: U/call 1.026× [1.014, 1.038], p < 0.00025, with U 432 vs 436 (−0.9 %); adsorbate and plausible saddles per call also 1.026×. DEV gave 1.069× [1.045, 1.095]. Significant with all guards passed, but below the round's own pre-registered 1.03 bar, so inconclusive. The gain tracks the call share of these drives (7.3 % on DEV, 3.7 % on C1). Left opt-in.
result_zh: C1 金属确认：U/调用 1.026 倍 [1.014, 1.038]，U 432 对 436；开发集 1.069 倍。显著且护栏全过，但未达本轮预注册的 1.03 门槛，判为不确定；收益随这类驱动的调用占比（7.3 % → 3.7 %）缩小。保留为可选项。

name_en: Learned TS templates as zeolite start directions (ZEOLITE-TEMPLATE-START)
name_zh: 分子筛起始方向的过渡态模板（ZEOLITE-TEMPLATE-START）
idea_en: At a fork, the first step decides which pass you reach. Zeolite bond-forming scans top out on steep walls and the dimer turns only once per step, so its start direction decides which soft mode it locks onto. The walker now starts along a transition-mode template learned from DEV saddles of the same reaction class, used only on forming drives and never toward bond types that are NEP89 artefacts (H–Si/Al, O–O formation).
idea_zh: 岔路口的第一步决定走向哪个山口。分子筛成键扫描的顶端是陡墙，dimer 每步只转一次，起始方向决定它锁定哪个软模。现在行走器沿从开发集同类鞍点学来的过渡模式模板出发；只用于成键驱动，且不指向 NEP89 必然出假象的键型（H–Si/Al、O–O 成键）。
systems_en: Screening on the 24 zeolite IS of DEV-A × 2 new seeds, with template libraries that leave out each IS's own chemistry family and host family; confirmation on the zeolite part of C2: 20 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS × 2 seeds. Reference `long-best-auto` (metric dimer on zeolites).
systems_zh: 筛选：DEV-A 中 24 个分子筛初态 × 2 个新种子，模板库排除该初态自身的化学族与宿主族；确认：C2 的分子筛部分（G-FACTORY-2 密封 20 个初态）× 2 个种子。参照 long-best-auto（分子筛上为度量 dimer）。
result_en: Confirmation on C2 zeolites: U 1.155× [1.062, 1.250], p = 0.001 (187 → 216 saddles), mostly proton transfers onto framework oxygen; but U/call only 1.038× [0.987, 1.105], p = 0.078, so the efficiency hypothesis failed (plausible saddles per call 1.058×). An opt-in yield option for zeolites, not an efficiency gain; later reused in an opt-in campaign-4 recipe.
result_zh: C2 分子筛确认：U 1.155 倍 [1.062, 1.250]，p = 0.001（187 → 216），多为质子转移到骨架氧；但 U/调用仅 1.038 倍 [0.987, 1.105]，效率假设未成立。作为分子筛可选增产项，后被第四阶段可选组合采用。

name_en: Stacking campaign-3 options into frozen presets (SYNTHESIS-3)
name_zh: 第三阶段选项叠加与冻结（SYNTHESIS-3）
idea_en: Like a chef assembling four set menus from tested dishes before the critics arrive. Options from 38 campaign-3 rounds were ported into the main code, default off and bit-identical when off; a pre-registered DEV stack screen then froze four presets as v0.79.0 for grand final 7: `long-best-auto-79`, `long-more-auto-79`, `long-ionic-auto` and `long-lowbarrier-auto-79`. v0.79.1 added two decision-identical call savers, default off; the CLI default did not change.
idea_zh: 像主厨在评审到来前用试过的菜拼出四份套餐。第三阶段 38 轮的选项移植进主代码，默认关闭且关闭时逐位不变；按预注册规则在开发集上叠加筛选，冻结四个预设为 v0.79.0 供 GF7 使用。v0.79.1 另加两个不改决策的省调用开关（默认关闭）；命令行默认不变。
systems_en: DEV-A: 85 IS (61 metal + 24 zeolite) × 2 seeds, paired with the shared reference runs; 3,154 valid runs, plus a 10-IS check of the two call savers. This was a screen only; grand final 7 and round 261 were the confirmations.
systems_zh: DEV-A：85 个初态（金属 61 + 分子筛 24）× 2 个种子，与共享参照运行配对，共 3,154 个有效运行；另用 10 个初态检查两个省调用开关。仅为筛选，确认见 GF7 与第 261 轮。
result_en: DEV screen, not a confirmation: `long-best-auto-79` vs `long-best-auto` U/call 1.395× [1.306, 1.508] at U/search 0.994×; `long-more-auto-79` 1.274× per call with 1.135× saddles per search; `long-ionic-auto` 1.908× per ionic step; the low-barrier preset 1.401× in U(≤1.5)/call. The call savers left decisions identical (U/call ×1.11–1.19). Frozen as v0.79.0; the default switch came in round 261.
result_zh: 开发集筛选（非确认）：long-best-auto-79 对 v0.78.1 默认 U/调用 1.395 倍 [1.306, 1.508]，U/搜索 0.994；more 版 1.274 倍，ionic 版每离子步 1.908 倍，低能垒版 1.401 倍。

name_zh: 新命令行默认的预注册确认（DEFAULT-SWITCH-CONFIRM）
idea_en: Like keeping the lighter boots but dropping the habit of turning back early. Grand final 7 showed `long-best-auto-79` was cheaper per saddle but quit too soon, so three frozen candidates were tested against v0.78.1 `long-best-auto` on all 210 confirmation-pool IS under pre-registered rules: NS79 (`long-best-auto-79` without the price stop and topology-yield stop), E1 (the old default plus a shared efficiency group) and `long-more-auto-79`.
idea_zh: 像留下更轻的登山靴，但改掉过早折返的习惯。GF7 中候选预设更省调用却收手过早；于是按预注册规则，在 210 个确认池初态上以 v0.78.1 默认为参照比较三个冻结候选：NS79（-79 预设去掉两条停止规则）、E1（旧默认加共享效率组）与 long-more-auto-79。
systems_en: All 210 confirmation-pool IS × 2 seeds (420 runs per arm): C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY + 6 G5; C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2; C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 22 IS-first (two O+H IS excluded). This was the last pre-registered use of these pools.
systems_zh: 全部 210 个确认池初态 × 2 个种子（每臂 420 个运行）：C1 = G-FACTORY 密封 67 + G5 6；C2 = G-FACTORY-2 密封 62；C3 = G-FACTORY-3 密封 53 + IS-first 22（排除两个 O+H 初态）。这是这些池最后一次预注册使用。
result_en: All three arms passed Holm and all guards. NS79: U/call 1.364× [1.314, 1.415] at U/search 1.006× [0.957, 1.054], restoring the saddles GF7 lost; 1.496× per ionic step; metals 1.403×, zeolites 1.292×. It became the new default, shipped as `long-best-auto-80`. `long-more-auto-79`: 1.241× [1.197, 1.287] with 1.203× saddles per search, succeeding `--more`; E1 1.286×. Likely optimistic from selection; zeolite U/search 0.949, n.s.
result_zh: 三臂均过 Holm 与护栏。NS79：U/调用 1.364 倍 [1.314, 1.415]，U/搜索 1.006，成为新默认 long-best-auto-80；long-more-auto-79 1.241 倍，接替 --more。或因选择偏差偏乐观。

idea_en: Like changing a restaurant's house menu without changing any dish that regulars order by name. The default became `long-best-auto-80` = NS79 plus two decision-identical call savers: a faster exact-Hessian kernel for certificates (round 239) and, on metals, skipping the second downhill side once the IS-facing side has missed the IS (round 243). `--more` and `--max-barrier` map to the matching -80 presets; old preset names keep byte-identical configurations.
idea_zh: 像换掉餐厅的招牌套餐，但熟客点名的菜一点不变。默认改为 long-best-auto-80：NS79 加两个不改决策的省调用开关——证书用更快的精确 Hessian 内核；金属上朝初态一侧下降未回初态即跳过第二侧。--more 等选项也换成 -80 预设；旧预设逐字节不变。
systems_en: Development IS only, 1 seed: 9 IS from the G-FACTORY dev, G-FACTORY-3 dev and generation-3 sets (e.g. HCO formation on Au(211), CO oxidation on Pt(100), methanol proton transfer in FAU, water proton transfer in MOR), forming 10 identity pairs (6 for the default, 2 for each other preset), plus the full test suite.
systems_zh: 仅用开发初态、1 个种子：取自 G-FACTORY 开发集、G-FACTORY-3 开发集与第三代集的 9 个初态（如 Au(211) 上 HCO 生成、Pt(100) 上 CO 氧化、FAU 中甲醇质子转移、MOR 中水质子转移），组成 10 个一致性配对（默认 6 对，其余两个预设各 2 对），外加完整测试套件。
result_en: All 10 pairs were decision-identical, with bit-identical TS geometries. Against their frozen sources, calls fell to ×0.934 for `long-best-auto-80` (U/call ×1.071, vs NS79), ×0.949 for the `--more` preset and ×0.972 for the `--max-barrier` preset. 1,580 tests passed, 0 failed; ruff and mypy clean. v0.80.0 released; the default's efficiency evidence remains round 261's 1.364×.
result_zh: 10 对全部决策一致，过渡态几何逐位相同。新默认对 NS79：力调用 ×0.934，U/调用 ×1.071；另两个预设力调用 ×0.949、×0.972。1,580 项测试全部通过。发布 v0.80.0，默认的效率依据仍是第 261 轮的 1.364 倍。

idea_en: A numbered page left blank in the lab notebook. name_zh: 只重掷失败的成键尝试（IN-SESSION-REROLL）
idea_en: A climber turned back on a few routes retries only those, once each, from a trailhead a few steps away, starting with the failure types most likely to succeed second time. After the main search (and `--more` re-walks), failed bond-formation launches with scan tops ≤ 2 eV were re-run once each from a fresh single-stage scan whose top lies 0.3–0.6 Å away, within 0.5× the session's calls (`explore --reroll`, default off).
idea_zh: 好比登山者几条路线被挡回：只把它们各重试一次，起点挪开几步，先试最易二次成功的失败类型。主搜索（及 `--more` 重走）后，扫描顶 ≤ 2 eV 的失败成键发射各用单级扫描换到相距 0.3–0.6 Å 的新起点重掷一次，调用上限为会话的一半（`--reroll`，默认关闭）。
systems_en: Screening on the 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal surfaces, 24 zeolites), 1 seed. Confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS (57 metal, 16 non-metal), 1 seed; reference: one `long-best-auto` search, compared with `--more` and `--complete`.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 初态（61 个金属表面、24 个分子筛）上用 1 个种子筛选；在 C1（67 个封存 G-FACTORY 初态 + 6 个 G5 初态；57 个金属、16 个非金属）上用 1 个种子确认。参照为一次 `long-best-auto` 搜索，并与 `--more`、`--complete` 比较。
result_en: C1, `--more --reroll` vs one `long-best-auto` search: U 1.216× [1.163, 1.274] at U/call 0.889× [0.857, 0.923]; +37 saddles over `--more` [+25, +50], p < 0.00025. Each 1 % more saddles cost 0.51 % of U/call, versus 0.97 % for `--complete` (p 0.0085); at equal calls 1.23× the saddles of `--complete`. `--reroll` alone: price edge not significant (p 0.096). Opt-in more-saddles mode, in no shipped preset.
result_zh: C1：`--more --reroll` U/调用 0.889 倍 [0.857, 0.923]，U 1.216 倍，比 `--more` 多 37 个鞍点；每多 1 % 鞍点损 0.51 % 效率（`--complete` 0.97 %）。可选的多鞍点模式。

idea_en: Shove a sled straight off a pass into a curving gully and it hits the wall and stops, although the valley floor is right there. In zeolites, when the straight ±0.12 Å nudge along the saddle's lowest mode went uphill on one side (a non-downhill rejection), the exact Hessian at the saddle is used to build a second-order start that follows the path's curvature, and the saddle is re-validated once; metal sessions are unchanged.
idea_zh: 好比把雪橇从山口笔直推进一条弯沟：它会撞上沟壁停住，尽管谷底就在旁边。在分子筛上，若沿鞍点最低模式直线推 ±0.12 Å 的起点有一侧上坡（判为“非下坡”而拒绝），就用鞍点处的精确 Hessian 构造顺着路径弯曲的二阶起点，再验证一次；金属会话不变。
systems_en: Audit: an independent fine-step descent re-checked round 189's 44 archived zeolite rescues. Screening: 24 DEV-A zeolite IS × 2 new seeds, plus 6 DEV-A metal IS × 2 seeds as an identity check. Confirmation: the 20 zeolite IS of C2 (sealed G-FACTORY-2), 4 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 审计：用独立的细步下降复核第 189 轮存档的 44 个分子筛救回鞍点。筛选：24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态 × 2 个新种子，另以 6 个 DEV-A 金属初态 × 2 个种子检查结果不变。确认：C2（封存 G-FACTORY-2）中的 20 个分子筛初态，4 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C2 zeolites: U/call 1.030× [1.003, 1.072], p = 0.014; U +6.1 % (377 → 400); U_ads/call 1.032. DEV zeolites: 1.042× [1.018, 1.064]. Diluted over all of C2: 1.006 (p 0.075). Independent descent confirmed all 105 rescued saddles; 3 of the 5 rescued on C2 are acid-site proton transfers. Small but real gain; joined the SAFE4 package of `long-best-auto-81`.
result_zh: C2 分子筛：U/调用 1.030 倍 [1.003, 1.072]，p = 0.014；U +6.1 %。DEV 分子筛 1.042 倍；全 C2 稀释为 1.006。105 个救回鞍点均经独立下降确认。收益小而真实，后并入 v0.81 的 SAFE4 包。

name_zh: 分子筛游走者限制重调（GLOBAL-RETUNE-CONFIRM）
idea_en: In a maze of narrow corridors, keep the dog on a shorter leash but wait longer before calling it back from a dead end. Round 197 retuned four walker limits at once (1.028× in-sample); this round split that gain by family and kept only the zeolite half: on non-metal IS the walker's trust sphere shrank from 4.0 to 3.5 Å and its patience under positive curvature rose from 15 to 20 steps.
idea_zh: 好比在窄巷迷宫里遛狗：绳子收短，但狗钻进死胡同时多等一会儿再唤回。第 197 轮一次重调了四个游走者限制（样本内 1.028 倍）；本轮按体系族拆分这份收益，只保留分子筛那一半：非金属初态上游走者的信任球由 4.0 Å 缩到 3.5 Å，正曲率下的耐心由 15 步增到 20 步。
systems_en: Zero-call re-analysis of round 197's DEV-A runs (85 IS × 2 seeds) split the effect into metals and zeolites. Confirmation on the 28 non-metal IS of C3 (18 sealed G-FACTORY-3 zeolite IS, e.g. ERI, EUO, MEL, and 10 IS-first zeolite IS, e.g. AEI, LTA, MWW), 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 对第 197 轮 DEV-A 运行（85 个初态 × 2 个种子）做零调用再分析，把效应拆成金属与分子筛两部分。确认：C3 中全部 28 个非金属初态（18 个封存 G-FACTORY-3 分子筛初态，如 ERI、EUO、MEL；10 个 IS-first 分子筛初态，如 AEI、LTA、MWW），2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C3 non-metal IS: U/call 1.025× [0.997, 1.053], one-sided p 0.0405; U 0.992×; U/ionic step 1.046×; projected over all of C3, 1.017× [0.996, 1.039]. The metal half (DEV 1.008×, p 0.29) was dropped. A narrow pass of the frozen criteria, real but small (per-IS Wilcoxon p 0.14). The zeolite limits joined the SAFE4 package of `long-best-auto-81`.
result_zh: C3 非金属初态：U/调用 1.025 倍 [0.997, 1.053]，单侧 p 0.0405；U 0.992 倍；U/离子步 1.046 倍。金属一半在 DEV 上被舍弃（1.008 倍）。勉强过关，效应真实但小；后并入 v0.81 的 SAFE4 包。

name_en: Start walkers from the best iterate (BEST-ITERATE-ALL)
name_zh: 行走器从最低迭代点出发（BEST-ITERATE-ALL）
idea_en: Photograph a ball rolling in a bowl when a timer rings and it is often halfway up the far wall; launching from that snapshot starts from a strained spot. Each bond-scan level relaxes for at most 10 Barzilai–Borwein steps and often ends on such an overshoot. This round started dimer walkers from the top level's lowest-energy iterate instead of its last step, optionally aimed along the line from the previous level's best iterate (tangent).
idea_zh: 好比定时给碗里滚动的小球拍照：铃响时它常在对面坡上半途，从此处出发即从受力大的点出发。键扫描每级最多 10 步 Barzilai–Borwein 松弛，常以这种过冲收尾；本轮让 dimer 行走器改从顶级的最低能量迭代点出发，并可沿上一级最佳点到该点的连线（切线）定初始方向。
systems_en: Replay of 4,788 archived DEV-A dimer launches (mechanism, no new runs). Screening: 24 DEV-A zeolite IS under `long-best-auto` and 61 DEV-A metal IS under `long-best`, 2 seeds each. Confirmation: the 57 metal IS of C1 (52 sealed G-FACTORY + 5 G5), 2 seeds, against `long-best`.
systems_zh: 机理分析：重放 4,788 次存档的 DEV-A dimer 发射（不新跑）。筛选：24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态（`long-best-auto`）与 61 个 DEV-A 金属初态（`long-best`），各 2 个种子。确认：C1 中 57 个金属初态（52 个封存 G-FACTORY + 5 个 G5），2 个种子，参照 `long-best`。
result_en: Zeolites (main hypothesis) failed on DEV: 1.018× [0.970, 1.065], p 0.22; with tangent 1.098× but U −4.7 %; most moved starts were still short of the ridge, and the dimer's capped 0.1 Å steps already ease strain. Metals under `long-best`, C1: U/call 1.050× [0.999, 1.105], one-sided p 0.029; U +0.4 %; U_ads/call 1.063. Default off; suggested only as a `long-best` override.
result_zh: 分子筛主假设 DEV 未过：1.018 倍 [0.970, 1.065]。`long-best` 金属 C1 确认：U/调用 1.050 倍 [0.999, 1.105]，单侧 p 0.029，U +0.4 %。默认关闭，仅建议用于 `long-best`。

idea_en: A prospector quits once each new nugget from the remaining claims is expected to cost more than his price. Round 192's price stop estimated, before each bond launch, the expected force calls per new saddle over the remaining coordinates (per-coordinate priors plus the session's luck) and stopped above P = 7,000. This round raised the price to P = 9,000 (picked on DEV) and 10,000, aiming to lose almost no saddles.
idea_zh: 好比淘金者：剩余矿点上每块新金子的预期成本一超过心理价位就收工。第 192 轮的价格停止在每次键发射前，按各坐标先验与本次会话运气，估计剩余坐标上每个新鞍点的预期力调用数，超过 P = 7000 即停；本轮把 P 提到 9000（DEV 选出）与 10000，力求几乎不丢鞍点。
systems_en: Zero-call exact replay of 170 DEV-A reference runs (85 IS × 2 seeds) to choose P by a pre-registered rule. Confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (42 metal IS, including hcp, bcc, fcc(110) and (311) facets; 20 IS in seven zeolite frameworks), 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 对 170 个 DEV-A 参照运行（85 个初态 × 2 个种子）做零调用精确重放，按预注册规则选 P。确认：C2 = 62 个封存 G-FACTORY-2 初态（42 个金属，晶面含 hcp、bcc、fcc(110) 与 (311)；20 个分属七种分子筛），2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C2: P = 9,000 gave U/call 1.045× [1.021, 1.072], p = 0.00025, but U 0.974× (−2.6 %); P = 10,000 gave 1.037× [1.015, 1.061] at U 0.980×. Both missed the pre-registered U ≥ 0.99 guard. All 17 lost saddles were on metals, 15 of them unflagged and 15 ≤ 1.5 eV, cut from the last 3–12 launches; the price model underestimated their success rate about 3×.
result_zh: C2：P = 9000 时 U/调用 1.045 倍 [1.021, 1.072]，但 U −2.6 %；P = 10000：1.037 倍，U −2.0 %，均未达 U ≥ 0.99。17 个丢失鞍点全在金属上，多为低势垒鞍点；模型低估其成功率约 3 倍。

name_en: Yield-ordered launches with a price stop (ORDER-AND-STOP)
name_zh: 按产率排序发射+价格停止（ORDER-AND-STOP）
idea_en: A prospector works the richest-looking claims first and quits once the remaining ones are expected to cost more per nugget than a set price. Two existing opt-in options were combined: launches ordered by expected new saddles per force call (`drive_order_index=ypc-v1`, from r193) and a session stop once the predicted calls per new saddle of the remaining queue exceed P = 7000 (`session_price_stop`, from r192).
idea_zh: 像淘金者先挖最有希望的矿点，等剩下矿点每块金子的预期成本超过定价就收工。本轮合用两个已有的默认关闭选项：按“每次力调用的期望新鞍点”给发射排序（r193 的 ypc-v1），并在剩余队列每个新鞍点的预计力调用超过 P = 7000 时停止会话（r192 的价格停止）。
systems_en: Development check on DEV-A (85 IS: metal surfaces and zeolites, 2 seeds), where a frozen rule picked P = 7000; confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 IS + 24 IS-first IS (77 IS, 2 seeds; 2 refused IS scored U = 0), reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: DEV-A 开发集 85 个初态（金属表面与分子筛，2 个种子）上按冻结规则选出 P = 7000；确认池 C3 = G-FACTORY-3 封存 53 + IS-first 24（共 77 个初态，2 个种子；2 个被拒初态记 U = 0），参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C3: U/call 1.139× [1.091, 1.193], p < 0.00025; 1.089× [1.054, 1.124] over the price stop alone; U/ionic step 1.108. DEV: 1.088× [1.048, 1.139] at U 0.997. But U fell to 0.962× (metals 0.925, zeolites 0.998), failing the 0.97 guard: yield tables learned on DEV did not transfer to new metal hosts. Negative; a post-hoc P = 10,000 (C3 1.080×, U 1.006) became the r285 follow-up.

idea_en: Like re-cooking prize-winning recipes, ingredient for ingredient, in two kitchens where they were never judged. Ten options already confirmed on one held-out pool were re-run with their frozen settings on the two C pools where they had never been confirmed, paired with the shared `long-best-auto` reference: one pre-registered test per option and pool, 20 tests with Holm correction.
idea_zh: 像把评过奖的菜谱一样不改地拿到两个从未评过它的厨房再做一遍。十个已在某个留出池确认过的选项，按冻结设置在各自从未确认过的另外两个 C 池上重跑，与共享 `long-best-auto` 参照配对；每个选项×池一个预注册检验，共 20 个，Holm 校正。
systems_en: No development screening. Each option ran on the two pools it had not been confirmed on, among C1 (67 sealed G-FACTORY + 6 G5 IS), C2 (62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS) and C3 (53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 24 IS-first IS); metal-only options used the metal subsets; 2 seeds, 2,344 sessions.
systems_zh: 无开发筛选。每个选项在 C1（G-FACTORY 封存 67 + G5 6）、C2（G-FACTORY-2 封存 62）、C3（G-FACTORY-3 封存 53 + IS-first 24）中它未确认过的两个池上运行；只作用于金属的选项只用金属子集；2 个种子，共 2,344 个会话。
result_en: All 20 option-pool ratios were above 1 and 12/20 passed Holm and guards, but gains shrank to a median 0.68× of the source claims. Generalised in both pools: secant start curvature (C1 1.050, C3 1.044), recheck merge (C1 1.034, C3 1.022), product Hessian (U/ionic step 1.173, 1.180), price stop (1.068, 1.044; U −3.5 %). Warning: the transfer gate cut U by 7.2 %/10.1 % on C2/C3 metals.
result_zh: 20 个比值全 > 1，12/20 过 Holm 与护栏，但效应中位缩至源值的 0.68 倍。割线初始曲率（C1 1.050、C3 1.044）、复核汇合、产物 Hessian、价格停止两池推广；转移闸门使 C2/C3 金属 U −7.2 %/−10.1 %。

name_zh: 安全的单侧不连通判定（ONE-SIDED-SAFE）
idea_en: Checking whether a pass leads home means walking down both sides. If the side clearly facing home ends elsewhere, the far side will too, so skip it, unless the pass is closer to a look-alike of home with identical H atoms swapped (a turned CH3 rotor), where the compass misleads. Technically: one-sided 'disconnected' verdicts when the negative mode clearly points to the IS (|cos| ≥ 0.5; metals: sign only), plus this permutation guard.
idea_zh: 判断山口是否通向家，要两侧都下山走一遍。若明显朝家的一侧走下去不是家，另一侧也不会是，可省掉；除非山口离“相同 H 原子互换后的家”（转过的 CH3 转子）更近，此时罗盘会误导。验证器在负模明确指向初态（|cos| ≥ 0.5，金属只看符号）且过置换护栏时，只降一侧即判不连通。
systems_en: Zero-call replay of round-191 DEV pairs, then DEV-A (85 IS, metal surfaces + zeolites, 2 seeds); confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (new hosts such as hcp(0001), fcc(110), bcc), 2 seeds, against `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: 先在第 191 轮 DEV 记录上零调用回放，再在 DEV-A 85 个初态（金属表面与分子筛，2 个种子）上测试；确认池 C2 = G-FACTORY-2 封存 62 个初态（hcp(0001)、fcc(110)、bcc 等新宿主），2 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C2, permutation-guarded arm: U/call 1.036× [1.028, 1.044], p < 0.00025 (metals 1.045; U/ionic step 1.071×); plain |cos| ≥ 0.5 arm 1.021× [1.017, 1.027]. U 648 = 648 with 0 decision flips; DEV 1.029 (U 946 = 946). A zero-loss saving; the guard blocked 68 verdicts here, none of which would have lost a saddle. Later shipped in `long-best-auto-81` as part of the SAFE4 package.
result_zh: C2 置换护栏臂：U/调用 1.036 倍 [1.028, 1.044]，p < 0.00025，U/离子步 1.071 倍；U 648 = 648，0 个判定翻转；DEV 1.029。零丢失，后随 SAFE4 进入 `long-best-auto-81`。

idea_en: A factory bought four separately approved upgrades for its final-inspection line: do they add up or get in each other's way? The downhill-validation pipeline combined r190 secant start curvature, r198 one exact product-side Hessian, r187 mode relay (the walker's lowest mode is reused and refinement skipped when already converged) and r184 recheck merge; a 16-cell factorial on DEV chose the stack by a frozen rule.
idea_zh: 像工厂给出厂检验线分别买了四项验收过的升级，要看它们能叠加还是互相掣肘。下坡验证流水线合并 r190 割线初始曲率、r198 产物侧一次精确 Hessian、r187 模式接力（复用行走器最低模，已收敛则跳过精修）与 r184 复核汇合；DEV 上 16 格析因按冻结规则选栈。
systems_en: DEV-A 16-cell factorial: 85 IS (metal surfaces + zeolites) × 2 seeds, 2,720 sessions; confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 24 IS-first IS (75 run, 2 refused IS scored U = 0), 2 seeds, reference `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: DEV-A 16 格析因：85 个初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子，共 2,720 个会话；确认池 C3 = G-FACTORY-3 封存 53 + IS-first 24（实跑 75 个，2 个被拒初态记 U = 0），2 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: The rule chose S11 = r190 + r187 + r184 (DEV 1.112× [1.086, 1.146]); r198 duplicated r190's job and flipped 3.5–5.2 % of verdicts, losing high-barrier saddles. C3: U/call 1.085× [1.066, 1.106], p < 0.00025; U/ionic step 1.152× [1.130, 1.177]; U 0.997. Ionic variant without mode relay: U/ionic 1.157 [1.139, 1.178]. All three parts are in the v0.80 default `long-best-auto-80`.

name_zh: 金属 Sella 行走器四件套（METAL-WALKER-STACK）
idea_en: Four upgrades for one mountain guide: a better starting point, a shorter leash, a better first heading and a hand-off of the final compass reading. On metal surfaces the Sella walker started from the lowest-energy scan iterate (r224), used the D1 limits (1.8 Å atom sphere, progress ladder; r226), the scan-tangent initial mode (r158) and the mode relay (r187); all 16 combinations were screened.
idea_zh: 给同一位向导四样升级：更好的出发点、更短的牵绳、更准的初始方向、把罗盘读数直接交给验收员。金属表面 Sella 行走器改从扫描每级的最低能量迭代点出发（r224），用 D1 限制（原子球 1.8 Å、进度阶梯；r226）、扫描切线初始模（r158）与模式接力（r187）。
systems_en: DEV screen on the 61 metal-surface IS of DEV-A × 2 seeds, full 2⁴ factorial plus an anchor variant (17 arms); confirmation on the 57 metal-surface IS of C1 (52 sealed G-FACTORY + 5 G5) × 2 seeds, against `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: DEV-A 中 61 个金属表面初态 × 2 个种子，完整 2⁴ 析因加一个锚点变体（17 臂）；确认池为 C1 中 57 个金属表面初态（G-FACTORY 封存 52 + G5 5）× 2 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C1 metals: U/call 1.168× [1.101, 1.229], p < 0.00025; U +5.7 % (436 → 461) with 9.5 % fewer calls; U/ionic step 1.126×; U_ads/call 1.172. DEV winner 1.252× [1.181, 1.332]; the four gains nearly multiplied. Adding the r225 concave start gave 1.028× (n.s.) at U −4.4 %, so it was not stacked. All four parts are in the v0.80 default `long-best-auto-80`.
result_zh: C1 金属：U/调用 1.168 倍 [1.101, 1.229]，p < 0.00025；U +5.7 %，力调用 −9.5 %；U/离子步 1.126 倍。四项收益近乎相乘；再叠 r225 凹形起点不显著且 U −4.4 %。四项均在 v0.80 默认中。

name_zh: 决策不变的 CPU 节省叠加（CPU-STACK）
idea_en: A clerk who stops re-copying unchanged ledgers and keeps a notebook of past lookups finishes the same paperwork faster, every entry identical. On top of r254's `sella_fast_linalg`, three new opt-in options were stacked: `cpu_fast_state` (bit-exact fast state checks; unchanged species not re-sent to NEP), `cpu_session_memo` (per-session caches of pair lists, tail preconditioner, Minkowski reductions) and `checkpoint_compact` (smaller checkpoint files, whose rewrite cost grows with the square of the launch count).
idea_zh: 像文员不再重抄没变的账本、把查过的记在小本上，同样文书更快办完、一笔不差。在 r254 快速线性代数之上叠加三个默认关闭新选项：逐位一致的状态比较快路径（未变元素不重发 NEP）、会话内缓存（配对表、尾段预条件、Minkowski 约化）、紧凑检查点（重写代价随发射数平方增长）。
systems_en: Reference `long-best-auto` with the Sella tail allowed up to 3N = 2000 (where CPU cost is largest). DEV-A 85 IS (metal surfaces + zeolites); confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS × 2 seeds on pinned cores, so core-seconds are comparable.
systems_zh: 参照 `long-best-auto` + Sella 尾段上限 3N = 2000（CPU 代价最大）。DEV-A 85 个初态（金属表面与分子筛）；确认池 C2 = G-FACTORY-2 封存 62 个初态 × 2 个种子，单核钉扎以便比较核·秒。
result_en: Metric: core-seconds per saddle (lower is better). C2: STACK/REF 0.755× [0.737, 0.778], p < 0.00025; the new options saved 8.4 % on top of `sella_fast_linalg` (0.916× [0.908, 0.924]), which alone gave 0.824×. All 124/124 paired C2 sessions were decision- and bit-identical (U 652 = 652); DEV 0.721×. Caching NEP results was worthless (0.4–0.6 % repeats). Options stayed opt-in.
result_zh: 每鞍点核·秒（越低越好）：C2 上 STACK/REF 0.755 倍 [0.737, 0.778]，p < 0.00025；新选项在快速线性代数（单独 0.824 倍）之上再省 8.4 %。124/124 对会话决策且逐位相同。选项保持默认关闭。

name_en: Triage of all untested campaign ideas (IDEA-TRIAGE)
idea_en: Like an editor sorting a slush pile of 1,220 proposals: merge duplicates, discard those already disproved, and pre-test the rest on archived data before spending money. Every idea from 120 finished labs went into one ledger, grouped into 46 clusters; the most promising were replayed at zero force calls on archived DEV sessions to rank the next campaign's plan.
idea_zh: 像编辑整理 1,220 份投稿：合并重复、剔除已被否定的，花钱前先用存档数据预审其余的。把 120 个已完成实验室的全部想法登记成一本账、归为 46 个簇，并在存档的 DEV 会话上做零力调用回放，为下一战役的计划排序。
systems_en: No new runs: zero-call replays of archived shared DEV-A reference sessions (85 IS × 2 seeds, `long-best-auto`; low-barrier and `--more` ideas replayed on their own presets). No C-pool data read, no NEP calls.
systems_zh: 无新运行：在共享 DEV-A 参照会话存档（85 个初态 × 2 个种子，`long-best-auto`；低势垒与 `--more` 类想法用对应预设）上零调用回放；不读任何 C 池数据，不调用 NEP。
result_en: 46 clusters covered 1,194 of 1,220 records. Replays rated 7 ideas dominated and supported R3 HOT-METAL, which stops a metal session after a dry spell when recent scan tops are high (metal 1.0486× [1.0207, 1.0794], U −1.5 %; pooled 1.0139×). DEV gains shrink on confirmation (median retention 0.698 of the log gain; 26/35 passed), matching r276. Top plan items were low-barrier-preset follow-ups.
result_zh: 46 个簇覆盖 1,194/1,220 条记录；回放判 7 个想法被支配，支持 R3 HOT-METAL（金属会话干涸且近期扫描顶偏高时停止）：金属 1.0486 倍，U −1.5 %。DEV 收益到确认池中位保留 0.698，与 r276 一致。

idea_en: Like a page number skipped in a lab notebook: records are sparse, and no lab, brief, registry entry or report exists for round 282. Among campaign 3's extra rounds this number was never assigned to an experiment (282, 287 and 288 are all absent), so there is no algorithm idea to describe.
idea_zh: 像实验记录本里跳过的一个页码：记录稀少，第 282 轮没有实验室、任务说明、登记条目或报告。战役 3 的追加轮次中这个编号从未分配给实验（282、287、288 均空缺），因此没有可描述的算法想法。
systems_en: None: records are sparse and no test systems are recorded under this round number.
systems_zh: 无：记录稀少，此轮号下没有任何测试体系记录。
result_en: No result: records are sparse, and no runs, ratios or verdict exist for round 282. The neighbouring rounds 281 and 283 hold the idea triage and the zeolite option stack.
result_zh: 无结果：记录稀少，第 282 轮没有运行、比值或结论；相邻的第 281、283 轮分别是想法盘点与分子筛选项叠加。

idea_en: A cave guide (the dimer) hands over to a stronger climber (Sella) even in large caves, takes a quick fresh compass reading whenever the ground suddenly feels like a bowl, and the descent checks are streamlined. Zeolite sessions stacked the Sella tail up to 3N = 2000 (r215), a Lanczos relapse gate (r174), Shanno-scaled descents (r182), one-sided verdicts at 0.5 (r191) and recheck merge (r184).
idea_zh: 像洞穴向导（dimer）在大洞里也把最后一段交给更强的攀登者（Sella），脚下突然像碗底时快速重看罗盘，下山核查也被精简。分子筛会话叠加：Sella 尾段放宽到 3N = 2000（r215）、Lanczos 回落闸门（r174）、Shanno 尺度下降、单侧判定与复核汇合。
systems_en: DEV screen on the 24 zeolite IS of DEV-A × 2 seeds, 5 arms; confirmation on the 20 zeolite IS of C2 (sealed G-FACTORY-2) × 2 seeds, against `long-best-auto`.
systems_zh: DEV-A 中 24 个分子筛初态 × 2 个种子、5 组筛选；确认池为 C2（G-FACTORY-2 封存）中 20 个分子筛初态 × 2 个种子，参照 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: DEV screen: tail alone 1.053× but U 0.977 (failed); full stack TGW 1.305× [1.212, 1.396] chosen. C2 zeolites: U/call 1.123× [1.073, 1.195], p < 0.00025; U +6.4 %; U/ionic step 1.270×. Cost: core-seconds per saddle ×1.41 (×1.91 for 3N > 469). Tail and gate fix different failures. Later shipped in the opt-in `long-best-auto-81-fullstack-optin` and `zeolite-stack-81` presets.

name_en: Learned post-scan walk gate, live test (GBM-GATE-CONFIRM)
name_zh: 学习型扫描后游走闸门确认（GBM-GATE-CONFIRM）
idea_en: A bouncer trained on last season's crowd decides from a quick look who is worth letting in. After each bond scan, the frozen r234 gradient-boosted model (`postscan_gate=gbm-v1`) scored the walk from 30 zero-cost scan-shape and geometry features as expected new saddles per force call and skipped walks below a family threshold; skips counted as dry launches. This was its first live NEP test on an unseen pool.
idea_zh: 像按上季人群训练出来的门卫，扫一眼就决定放不放人。每次键扫描后，冻结的第 234 轮梯度提升模型 gbm-v1 用 30 个零调用的扫描形状与几何特征估计这次游走“每次力调用的期望新鞍点”，低于体系族阈值就不走，跳过的发射记为干涸。本轮是它首次在未见过的池上做真实 NEP 确认。
systems_en: Zero-call leave-one-host-family-out check on DEV-A (85 IS, metal surfaces + zeolites); live confirmation on C3 = 53 sealed G-FACTORY-3 + 22 IS-first IS (75 run; 2 refused IS not run) × 2 seeds, against an in-pool `long-best-auto` reference.
systems_zh: DEV-A 85 个初态（金属表面与分子筛）上零调用的留一宿主族检验；真实确认在 C3 = G-FACTORY-3 封存 53 + IS-first 22（实跑 75 个，2 个被拒初态未跑）× 2 个种子上进行，参照同池 `long-best-auto`。
result_en: C3: U/call 1.0199× [1.0086, 1.0312], p = 0.0010; U/ionic step 1.033; guards passed, but U 978 vs 1,001 (0.977 < 0.99 rule). Metals lost 4.5 % of saddles, mostly low-barrier H/C transfers: larger adsorbates shifted the features and metal skips rose to 13.2 % (5.9 % on DEV). A low-top guard replay still gave U 0.985. Negative; left default-off.

name_en: Yield-ordered session with a price stop (ORDER-STOP-10K)
name_zh: 按收益排序 + 价格停止（ORDER-STOP-10K）
idea_en: A prospector works the richest claims first and quits once the next nugget looks too expensive. Bond-coordinate drives were launched in order of expected new saddles per expected force call (the r193 order), and from the fifth launch on the session ended once the predicted cost of one more saddle from the remaining coordinates exceeded 10,000 force calls (the r192 price stop), a price fixed before the test.
idea_zh: 像淘金者先挖最富的矿点，一旦下一粒金子显得太贵就收工。键坐标驱动按“每次期望力调用可得的期望新鞍点数”排序发射（r193 排序）；从第 5 次发射起，若剩余坐标再找一个鞍点的预测代价超过预先固定的 10,000 次力调用，会话即停止（r192 价格停止）。
systems_en: Screening by zero-call replay of archived runs on the 85 DEV-A IS (GF3 development set plus G-FACTORY 1–3 development IS; metal surfaces and zeolites) × 2 seeds. Pre-registered confirmation on C1 = 67 sealed G-FACTORY IS + 6 G5 IS (73 IS: 57 metal, 16 zeolite) × 2 seeds against same-pool `long-best-auto` runs (the v0.78.1 default); the price-stop-only and shortened dry-spell-stop arms were evaluated by exact replay.
systems_zh: 筛选：85 个 DEV-A 初态（GF3 开发集 + G-FACTORY 1–3 开发初态；金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子，对存档运行做零调用回放。预注册确认：C1 = G-FACTORY 封存 67 + G5 6（73 个初态：金属 57、分子筛 16）× 2 个种子，对照同池自跑的 `long-best-auto`（v0.78.1 默认）；“只用价格停止”和“缩短的连续无收获即停”两个对照臂用精确回放评估。
result_en: C1 confirmation: U/call 1.094× [1.044, 1.144], p < 0.00025; 1.064× over the price stop alone and 1.073× over a dry-spell stop shortened to 23 empty launches, all significant after Holm; U/ionic step 1.064×; 9.6 % fewer calls. But 562 vs 568 saddles (U 0.9894 < 0.99 guard): negative by one saddle under the frozen rule. Lost: late H–metal bonds in NH3 dissociation, late methanol proton transfers in MFI/CHA.

name_en: Stacked skip rules for metal drives (SKIP-STACK)
name_zh: 金属驱动统一跳过分类器（SKIP-STACK）
idea_en: Staple separately approved 'don't bother' notes into one checklist. One switch stacked earlier confirmed skip rules for metal-surface bond drives: skip hydrogen–hydrogen bond formations (r258), prune exact-symmetry duplicates (r204) and, in a second variant, also skip hydrogen transfers already more than 2 eV uphill (r159 transfer gate). Skipped drives no longer counted toward the stop-after-N-empty-launches rule.
idea_zh: 把几张分别批准过的“别费劲”便条订成一份清单。一个开关叠加已确认的金属表面键驱动跳过规则：不驱动 H–H 成键（r258），剪掉严格对称的重复坐标（r204）；第二个变体还跳过已上坡 2 eV 以上的氢转移（r159 转移闸门）。被跳过的驱动不再计入“连续 N 次无收获即停”。
systems_en: Metal-surface IS only, reference `long-best-auto` (the v0.78.1 default, Sella walker on metals). Zero-call replay screen and DEV runs on the 61 metal IS of DEV-A × 2 seeds; pre-registered confirmation on the metal subset of C2 (42 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS) × 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 只用金属表面初态，参照 `long-best-auto`（v0.78.1 默认，金属上用 Sella 行走）。零调用回放初筛与 DEV 运行：DEV-A 中 61 个金属初态 × 2 个种子；预注册确认：C2 的金属子集（G-FACTORY-2 封存 42 个初态）× 2 个种子。
result_en: C2 metals, transfer-gate variant: U/call 1.104× [1.068, 1.138], p < 0.00025, but U 423/461 = 0.918, below the 0.98 budget; the H–H + symmetry variant gave 1.087× at U 0.952. The rules overlap (64–70 % of transfer-gate triggers were already-skipped H–H drives), so savings were double-counted while losses added up; 8 of 11 saddles lost to the H–H rule were ≤ 0.25 eV rotations. Only symmetry pruning lost nothing.
result_zh: C2 金属，闸门变体：U/调用 1.104 倍 [1.068, 1.138]，p < 0.00025，但 U 0.918（423/461），未过 0.98 预算；H–H+对称变体 1.087，U 0.952。规则重叠使节省重复计算、损失相加；仅对称剪枝无损。

idea_en: A numbered page left blank in the lab notebook: no experiment is recorded under round 287. There is no brief, registry entry, lab record or report for this number, and campaign 3's follow-up series jumps from round 286 to round 289, so the number appears to have gone unused.
idea_zh: 像实验记录本里编了号却空着的一页：第 287 轮没有任何实验记录，没有任务说明、登记条目、实验室记录或报告；第三期的后续轮次从第 286 轮直接跳到第 289 轮，这个编号看来未被使用。

name_zh: 分散起点的协调多次重跑（RERUN-STRATIFIED）
idea_en: Send search parties 2–4 off at 120° to one another instead of from almost the same doorstep. For runs 2–4 on one initial state, bond scans used the short mono-stage relaxation and each walker start got a 0.05 eV soft-mode kick along fixed, seed-independent directions at 0°, 120° and 240° on one circle; the median closest distance between start points per coordinate rose from 0.03–0.05 Å (round 194's design) to 0.22–0.24 Å.
idea_zh: 让第 2–4 支搜索队彼此成 120° 出发，而非挤在门口。同一初态第 2–4 次运行改用单级键扫描，行走起点加 0.05 eV 软模“踢”，方向固定为圆上与种子无关的 0°/120°/240°；同坐标起点最近距离中位数由 0.03–0.05 Å 增至 0.22–0.24 Å。
systems_en: Unions of K independent runs per IS with reference preset `long-best-auto`, compared with round 194's design D4 (plain run + mono-stage run + two seeded-jitter runs). DEV: 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), one session per IS and arm; confirmation on C2 = 62 sealed G-FACTORY-2 IS (metals and zeolites), 7 arms × 62 = 434 sessions.
systems_zh: 每个初态取 K 次独立运行的鞍点并集，参照预设 `long-best-auto`，对照第 194 轮的 D4 设计（普通运行 + 单级扫描运行 + 两次种子抖动运行）。DEV：85 个 DEV-A 初态（金属表面与分子筛），每臂每初态一次会话；确认：C2 = G-FACTORY-2 封存 62 个初态（金属与分子筛），7 臂 × 62 = 434 次会话。
result_en: C2 confirmation, union of 4 runs vs round 194's D4: U/call 1.083× [1.037, 1.129], p < 0.00025 (Holm); 480 vs 452 saddles (+6.2 %) at 0.981× the calls; metals 1.103×, zeolites 1.075×; per ionic step 1.026× (not significant). Two runs gave no gain (1.008× [0.966, 1.054], p = 0.365): the benefit comes from runs 3–4. DEV 1.099×. Confirmed as an opt-in, not merged.

name_en: New metal and alloy test set (GF5M-BUILD)
idea_en: Write a fresh, sealed exam on surfaces no search algorithm has seen. Initial states were built on 31 distinct hosts: single-atom alloys, fcc(221) steps, vacancies, bcc W/Fe(211), Mo(100), Re(10-10) and Ni3Ga(111). Some started from a constructed and certified reference reaction (TS-first), others from simply adsorbing a molecule (IS-first); a fixed hash then split them into two confirmation pools and a sealed final-exam set.
idea_zh: 像新出一套从未公开的考卷。在 31 个不同金属宿主（单原子合金、台阶、空位、bcc(211)、Mo、Re 与 Ni3Ga）上构建初态：部分先构造并认证参考反应（TS-first），部分只吸附分子（IS-first）；再按固定哈希分为两个确认池和一个封存终测集。
systems_en: 110 new IS (75 TS-first + 35 IS-first) on 31 hosts: single-atom alloys on (111) 59, fcc(221) steps 29, (111) vacancies 8, bcc(211) W/Fe 6, Ni3Ga(111) 4, Re(10-10) 3, Mo(100) 1. TS-first reaction groups include CH3CN+H, HCN+H, S+H, SH+H, phenoxy+H, pyridyl+H, CH3+S and NH3+O; IS-first guests include thiophene, methanethiol, pyrrole and toluene. Split P2 36 / P3 38 / S5 36; no saddle searches were run on them.
systems_zh: 110 个新初态（TS-first 75 + IS-first 35），31 个宿主：(111) 单原子合金 59、fcc(221) 台阶 29、(111) 空位 8、bcc(211) W/Fe 6、Ni3Ga(111) 4、Re(10-10) 3、Mo(100) 1。TS-first 反应组如 CH3CN+H、HCN+H、S+H、SH+H、苯氧基+H、吡啶基+H、CH3+S、NH3+O；IS-first 客体如噻吩、甲硫醇、吡咯、甲苯。划分 P2 36 / P3 38 / S5 36；未在这些初态上做鞍点搜索。
result_en: Set built: 110 IS (P2 36 / P3 38 / S5 36). TS-first construction qualified 170 of 1,008 candidates; IS-first qualified 85. Every IS passed an exact NEP89 Hessian minimum check, and each TS-first reference was re-certified with exactly one negative mode and connection to both ends. CuAu and PdZn hosts (NEP89 lattice deviation > 5 %) and N2H4 were excluded. No efficiency ratio applies.
result_zh: 建成 110 个初态（P2 36 / P3 38 / S5 36）。TS-first 合格 170/1,008，IS-first 合格 85；均通过 NEP89 精确 Hessian 极小值检查。排除 CuAu、PdZn（晶格偏差 > 5 %）与 N2H4。

idea_en: A second sealed exam, this time set inside unfamiliar pores. Initial states were built in 18 zeolite frameworks never used before in the programme: for some, an acid-site reaction was constructed and its transition state certified first (TS-first); for others a guest molecule was simply adsorbed (IS-first). A fixed hash then split them into two confirmation pools and a sealed final-exam set.
idea_zh: 第二套封存考题，这次出在陌生的孔道里。在本项目从未用过的 18 种分子筛骨架中构建初态：一部分先构造酸位反应并认证其过渡态（TS-first），一部分只把客体分子吸附进去（IS-first）；再用固定哈希分成两个确认池和一个封存终测集。
systems_en: 70 new IS (50 TS-first + 20 IS-first) in 18 frameworks: AEL, AFI, AFR, AST, ATO, ATS, BPH, CFI, GIS, MEI, SFG, SFO, SGT, STT, UFI, UTL, VFI, ZON. TS-first: acid-site proton transfer to THF, n-, sec-, tert- and iso-butanol, benzyl alcohol and diethyl ether, plus three 1-butanol dehydration steps; IS-first guests: alkenes 6, aromatics 6, co-adsorbed 5, oxygenates 3. Split P2 27 / P3 25 / S5 18; no saddle searches were run on them.
systems_zh: 70 个新初态（TS-first 50 + IS-first 20），18 种骨架：AEL、AFI、AFR、AST、ATO、ATS、BPH、CFI、GIS、MEI、SFG、SFO、SGT、STT、UFI、UTL、VFI、ZON。TS-first：酸位向 THF、正/仲/叔/异丁醇、苄醇和乙醚的质子转移，另有 3 个 1-丁醇脱水步骤；IS-first 客体：烯烃 6、芳烃 6、共吸附 5、含氧化合物 3。划分 P2 27 / P3 25 / S5 18；未做鞍点搜索。
result_en: Set built: 70 IS (P2 27 / P3 25 / S5 18). TS-first qualification 65/739 candidates (8.80 %, Wilson [7.0 %, 11.1 %]); IS-first 39/54. All 18 frameworks passed relaxation and none had been used before. Butene protonation (0/144) and methanol + ethylene methylation (0/59) yielded no qualified targets. NEP89 forward barriers of the chosen steps: 0.218–1.981 eV (median 0.696). No efficiency ratio applies.
result_zh: 建成 70 个初态（P2 27 / P3 25 / S5 18）。TS-first 合格 65/739，IS-first 39/54；丁烯质子化（0/144）与甲醇–乙烯甲基化（0/59）无一合格。正向能垒 0.218–1.981 eV（中位 0.696）。

name_en: Shared reference runs for v0.80 presets (SHARED-REF-80)
idea_en: Lay down one common yardstick that every later experiment measures against. The four v0.80 presets were run unmodified with 2 seeds on every campaign-4 pool, with Hessian charges repriced on one common scale per system, so later rounds could compare against shared reference runs instead of re-running their own. Reproduction was checked by rerunning pre-listed cases with an independently built package.
idea_zh: 先铺一把公用的尺子，之后每轮实验都拿它来量。未经修改的 v0.80 四个预设在第四期的每个测试池上各跑 2 个种子，Hessian 费用按体系统一复价；后续轮次可直接对照这些共享参照，不必各自重跑。并用独立构建的安装包重跑预先列出的案例，检验可复现性。
systems_en: 507 IS: DEV-A 85, DEV-B 224 (C1 + C2 + C3 + 12 G-FACTORY-4 development IS), P1 72 (sealed G-FACTORY-4), P2 63 and P3 63 (G-FACTORY-5M/5P splits). Presets `long-best-auto-80` (default), `long-more-auto-80`, `long-lowbarrier-auto-80` and `long-best`, 2 seeds each: 4,056 runs, 16 refused because 2 IS-first inputs had no drivable bond.
systems_zh: 507 个初态：DEV-A 85、DEV-B 224（C1 + C2 + C3 + G-FACTORY-4 开发 12）、P1 72（G-FACTORY-4 封存）、P2 63 与 P3 63（G-FACTORY-5M/5P 划分）。预设 `long-best-auto-80`（默认）、`long-more-auto-80`、`long-lowbarrier-auto-80`、`long-best`，各 2 个种子：共 4,056 次运行，其中 16 次因 2 个 IS-first 初态没有可驱动的键而被拒绝。
result_en: Coverage complete apart from the 16 refusals; an independent rebuild reproduced the saddle sets in 10/10 reruns and the launch sequence in 8/10. Default cost on DEV-A: search 35.38 %, validation quench 31.57 %, proposal 25.95 %. On P1 the default found 1,181 saddles at 0.641 per 1,000 calls (1.402 per 1,000 ionic steps); `long-best` 1,288 at 0.478 (0.967). Service round, no candidate.
result_zh: 除 16 次拒绝外全部覆盖；独立构建包重跑 10/10 鞍点集合一致、8/10 发射序列一致。P1 上默认预设得 1,181 个鞍点，每千次力调用 0.641 个（每千离子步 1.402）；`long-best` 1,288 个、0.478（0.967）。

idea_en: An itemised receipt for every force call the new default spends. Diagnostic counters (off by default, decisions unchanged) recorded per attempt how many calls went to bond scans, dimer rotation and translation, Sella, downhill validation and Hessians, and how each attempt ended. The breakdown sets upper bounds on what any future saving can gain; two quick cost-cutting ideas were prescreened against it.
idea_zh: 给新默认预设花掉的每一次力调用开一张明细小票。诊断计数器（默认关闭，不改变任何决策）逐次尝试记录力调用花在键扫描、dimer 旋转与平移、Sella、下坡验证和 Hessian 上的份额，以及每次尝试的结局；据此给未来各类节省定出上限，并顺带预筛了两个省调用的想法。
systems_en: All 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal, 24 zeolite) with the v0.80 default `long-best-auto-80`, 1 seed, 2,842 attempts; plus an exploratory paired comparison of the v0.80 default with the old `long-best-auto` (v0.78.1) configuration run from the same source, 85 IS × 2 seeds. No confirmation pool was used.
systems_zh: 全部 85 个 DEV-A 初态（金属 61、分子筛 24），v0.80 默认 `long-best-auto-80`，1 个种子，共 2,842 次尝试；另做探索性配对比较：同一源码下 v0.80 默认与旧 `long-best-auto`（v0.78.1）配置，85 个初态 × 2 个种子。未使用确认池。
result_en: Default on DEV-A: 487 saddles from 732,621 calls; shares: walker 33.94 %, quench 29.63 %, scan 24.90 %; 17.56 % came after the last new saddle. Versus the old configuration: U/call 1.325× [1.247, 1.412], p < 0.00025, U/ionic step 1.478×, but zeolite saddles −3.64 % (two-seed union −8.27 %). Killed: stopping after 20 rather than 25 empty launches (1.067×, U −7.60 %) and an index-two witness (0.0090 % of cost).

name_zh: DFT 当量成本与缓存复用（DFT-COST）
idea_en: Translate the bill into the currency a DFT user pays. A tool replaced each exact Hessian's NEP charge with 3·N_free (forward differences) or 6·N_free (central) force calls for N_free free atoms: a cost model, not measured SCF time. The round then tested the first DFT-aware variant: a second search of the same initial state reuses the exact initial-state Hessian already paid for instead of recomputing it.
idea_zh: 把账单换成 DFT 用户实际支付的货币。新工具把每个精确 Hessian 的计费改为 3N（前向差分）或 6N（中心差分）次力调用（N 为可动原子数），是成本模型而非实测 SCF 时间。随后测试首个面向 DFT 的变体：同一初态第二次搜索复用已付费的初态精确 Hessian。
systems_en: DEV survey of the v0.80 presets in DFT-equivalent calls: 85 DEV-A IS, 1 seed (descriptive). Hessian reuse: 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds (340 sessions) and a 4-seed amortisation test on DEV-A, then confirmation on P1 = 72 sealed G-FACTORY-4 IS × 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto-80` (v0.80 default).
systems_zh: DEV 普查：85 个 DEV-A 初态、1 个种子，按 DFT 当量调用为 v0.80 各预设计价（描述性）。Hessian 复用：85 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子（340 次会话）及 DEV-A 上的 4 种子摊销测试，再在 P1 = G-FACTORY-4 封存 72 个初态 × 2 个种子上确认；参照 `long-best-auto-80`（v0.80 默认）。
result_en: P1 confirmation of the reuse: U/call 1.00041× [0.99940, 1.00119], p = 0.1792, U 1,209 → 1,209; forward-DFT 1.00318× [1.00013, 1.00611], but metals 0.99481. On DEV a cache hit from another compute node differed by 2.13×10⁻¹⁴ and shifted one ionic step, triggering the strict identity kill: negative. A host-fenced version stayed inconclusive; r296 later confirmed a hash-attested successor. The DFT-equivalent accounting became the standard cost metric.
result_zh: P1 确认：U/调用 1.00041 倍 [0.99940, 1.00119]，p = 0.1792，U 1,209 不变。跨节点缓存差 2.13×10⁻¹⁴ 即多 1 个离子步，触发严格一致性淘汰，判阴性；r296 确认改进版。DFT 当量计价成为标准。

idea_en: Like checking a mountain pass by poking the ground in a few directions: an unpoked direction may still lead downhill, so a few pokes can rule a pass out but never certify it. The round tried to certify exactly one negative Hessian eigenvalue from a few Hessian-vector products (Ritz shadow, Schur bound, locality), proved by counterexample that this can never accept, then reused the dimer rotation's Ritz block to schedule the exact check earlier.
idea_zh: 像只在几个方向踩一踩就判断是否真山口：没踩到的方向仍可能向下，少量探测只能否定、不能确认。本轮试图仅用少量 Hessian-向量积（Ritz 影子、Schur 界、局域性）认证“恰一个负本征值”，以反例证明无法据此接受；随后改为复用转动中已有的 Ritz 块，提前安排精确检查。
systems_en: Zero-call replay of 80 archived transition-state certificates from 68 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites); pilot of the early-check pivot on 12 DEV-A IS (6 metal, 6 zeolite), 1 seed, up to 8 launches each.
systems_zh: 零调用回放 68 个 DEV-A 初态（金属表面与分子筛）的 80 个存档过渡态证书；提前检查转向在 12 个 DEV-A 初态（6 金属、6 分子筛）上试点，1 个种子，每个至多 8 次发射。
result_en: No reliable Hessian-free acceptance. On archived certificates the Ritz shadow decided only 16/80 cases (16/16 agreement, Wilson lower bound 85.5 % vs 99.5 % needed); a perfect early rejector would save at most 0.771 % of certificate cost. Early-check pilot: 0 triggers, U 29→29, U per DFT-equivalent call 0.99981× [0.99859, 1.00096], p = 0.6718. Killed.
result_zh: Ritz 影子仅判定 16/80 个存档证书（Wilson 下界 85.5%，需 99.5%），不能据此接受。提前检查试点 0 次触发：U 29→29，U/DFT 当量调用 0.99981 [0.99859, 1.00096]，p=0.6718。淘汰。

name_en: Partial Hessian, then cached IS Hessian (PARTIAL-HESSIAN-SELLA)
idea_en: First idea: survey only the reaction centre in detail and treat the rest of the system as a spring net. The Sella/dimer starting Hessian was built from reaction-centre columns plus a positive-definite spring background. When that failed, the fallback was simpler: if the same initial state had already been surveyed in an earlier paid session, reuse that exact IS Hessian (hash-checked) instead of recomputing it, leaving every search decision unchanged.
idea_zh: 先只把反应中心精细“测绘”，其余部分当作弹簧网：Sella/二聚体的起始 Hessian 由反应中心列加正定弹簧背景拼成。失败后改用更朴素的办法：同一初态若在之前付费的会话中已算过精确 Hessian，经哈希核验后直接复用而不重算，所有搜索决策不变。
systems_en: 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites), 1 seed for the partial model and 2 seeds for the reuse pivot; confirmation on P3 = 63 IS (38 metal from G-FACTORY-5M, 25 porous hosts from G-FACTORY-5P), 2 seeds plus one paid source session per IS.
systems_zh: 85 个 DEV-A 初态（金属表面与分子筛）：部分 Hessian 用 1 个种子，复用转向用 2 个种子；在 P3 共 63 个初态（G-FACTORY-5M 的 38 个金属、G-FACTORY-5P 的 25 个多孔主体）上确认，2 个种子，另为每个初态付费运行一次源会话。
result_en: Partial Hessian failed on DEV-A (U/call 0.9392× [0.9055, 0.9734]) and was killed. Hessian reuse was confirmed on P3: U per DFT-equivalent call 1.01803× [1.01554, 1.02141], p < 0.00025; U/call 1.00685×; U 1010→1010 with 126/126 decisions bit-identical. A small saving at no loss, offered only as an opt-in multi-session template, not in a preset.
result_zh: 部分 Hessian 在 DEV-A 失败（U/调用 0.9392）。初态 Hessian 复用经 P3 确认：U/DFT 当量调用 1.01803 [1.01554, 1.02141]，p<0.00025；U 1010→1010，决策逐位一致。仅作可选模板。

name_zh: 低势垒预设的预条件转动
idea_en: Give the dimer glasses ground from the initial-state Hessian so it spots the softest direction quickly – but the softest direction is not always the bond being broken or formed. In `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`, non-metal dimer rotation used the IS-Hessian preconditioner, a lazy 6° rotation threshold and skipped rotation images (COMBO), optionally confined to a 60° cone around the scan tangent (ANCHOR); pivots added a soft bias toward the driven bond.
idea_zh: 给二聚体戴上用初态 Hessian 磨的“眼镜”，更快看清最软方向——但最软方向未必是要断或成的那根键。低势垒预设中，非金属转动改用初态 Hessian 预条件，加 6° 惰性转动与像点跳过（COMBO），或限于扫描切线 60° 锥内（ANCHOR）；转向臂则对驱动键加软偏置。
systems_en: 24 zeolite DEV-A IS, 2 seeds, for screening and pivots; 66 DEV-B zeolite IS (sealed G-FACTORY 1–3, IS-first, G5 and G-FACTORY-4 dev), 1 seed, as a diagnostic; reference `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`. No confirmation pool was opened.
systems_zh: 24 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态 × 2 个种子用于筛选和转向；66 个 DEV-B 分子筛初态（G-FACTORY 1–3 封存集、IS-first、G5 与 G-FACTORY-4 开发集）× 1 个种子作诊断；参照 `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`，未开确认池。
result_en: On DEV-A, COMBO raised low-barrier saddles per call to 1.212× [1.119, 1.331], but adsorbate-involving low-barrier saddles per call fell to 0.849×, failing the 0.95 guard; the gain was bond-unchanged saddles. Pivots failed too. On 66 DEV-B zeolites COMBO gave U(≤1.5)/call 0.992× [0.920, 1.066] and U_ads/call 0.847×. Killed; no confirmation.
result_zh: DEV-A 上 COMBO 的 U(≤1.5)/调用 1.212 [1.119, 1.331]，但吸附物参与的鞍点/调用仅 0.849（护栏 0.95），增益来自成键不变者。66 个 DEV-B 分子筛上为 0.992 [0.920, 1.066]。淘汰。

idea_en: To see where a pass leads, roll a ball down each side; near the valley floor, switch from cautious steps to an exact local map and finish in a few moves. In `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`, the product-side validation descent switched to exact-Hessian steps once forces fell below 0.05 eV/Å (main plus recheck path, or main only); LATE-P switched at 0.01, and LAZYMAP computed recheck-path distances only when the energy window was open.
idea_zh: 想知道山口通向哪里，就让小球从两侧滚下；快到谷底时改用精确地图几步到位。低势垒预设中，产物侧验证下降在力低于 0.05 eV/Å 时改用精确 Hessian 步（主路径或连同复核路径）；LATE-P 改在 0.01 切换；LAZYMAP 仅在能量窗口打开时计算复核路径距离。
systems_en: 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds for the main arms; all 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS (metal surfaces and zeolites) × 2 seeds for LATE-P; LAZYMAP audited on 85 DEV-A IS; reference `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`. No confirmation pool was opened.
systems_zh: 主臂用 85 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子；LATE-P 用全部 309 个 DEV-A + DEV-B 初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子；LAZYMAP 在 85 个 DEV-A 初态上审计；参照 `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`，未开确认池。
result_en: On DEV-A the product-side switch gave U(≤1.5)/call 1.04385× [1.01314, 1.07415] (main+recheck) and 1.02940× (main only), below the 1.06 gate; over 309 IS, 1.040× [1.026, 1.055] with U −0.5 %. LATE-P: 1.01865× [1.00921, 1.02866] (gate 1.03), U per DFT-equivalent call 0.90040×. LAZYMAP kept saddles identical but sped up a step worth 0.231 % of core time. All killed.
result_zh: 产物侧切换：DEV-A 上 U(≤1.5)/调用 1.04385，未达 1.06 门槛；309 个初态上 1.040 [1.026, 1.055]，U −0.5%。LATE-P 为 1.01865（门槛 1.03）。LAZYMAP 无实际收益。全部淘汰。

name_en: Over-cap drive memory for low-barrier search (LB-SKIPS)
idea_en: A hiker who wants only low passes keeps a notebook: once two separate climbs of the same kind of route have gone over the height limit, similar routes nearby are skipped. In `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`, after two atom-disjoint real scans of a bond-drive type exceeded the energy cap, later locally overlapping drives of that type were skipped (not counted as dry runs); global, valence and metal-anchor variants were also screened.
idea_zh: 只找低山口的登山者记笔记：同类路线若已有两次互不相干的攀登超过限高，附近的同类路线就不再去爬。低势垒预设中，某类键驱动有两次原子不相交的真实扫描超过能量上限后，与之局部重叠的同类驱动直接跳过（不计为空跑）；还筛选了全局、价态与金属锚定等变体。
systems_en: Zero-call replay of earlier DEV-A runs; 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds, then all 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS × 2 seeds; confirmation on P3 = 63 IS (38 metal, 25 porous-host), 2 seeds; reference `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`.
systems_zh: 先零调用回放早期 DEV-A 运行；再用 85 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子、全部 309 个 DEV-A + DEV-B 初态 × 2 个种子；在 P3 共 63 个初态（38 金属、25 多孔主体）× 2 个种子上确认；参照 `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`。
result_en: Confirmed on P3: U(≤1.5)/call 1.040× [1.021, 1.060], p < 0.00025; U 466→470, two-seed union 243→243, U per DFT-equivalent call 1.032×. Cruder global/local memories gained more per call but lost 7.11–11.15 % of saddles and were killed. Shipped in the opt-in `long-lowbarrier-auto-81`, which ranked first in GF8 with 1.686 saddles per 1,000 ionic steps.
result_zh: P3 确认：U(≤1.5)/调用 1.040 [1.021, 1.060]，p<0.00025；U 466→470。更粗的全局/局部记忆鞍点少 7.11–11.15%，淘汰。进入可选预设 `long-lowbarrier-auto-81`（GF8 第一）。

name_en: Zeolite relapse gate and Sella tail (ZEO-TGW-80)
name_zh: 分子筛闸门与 Sella 尾段
idea_en: A climber in fog who suddenly feels flat ground probes a few more directions before giving up, and near the pass hands over to a precise guide. For zeolites, when dimer curvature relapsed to non-negative, up to six finite-difference Hessian-vector products (Lanczos) looked for a remaining negative mode; Sella's RS-PRFO finishing tail was allowed up to 3N = 2000 instead of 469; and clearly disconnected candidates could be rejected after one downhill side.
idea_zh: 雾中登山者忽觉脚下变平，先多探几个方向再放弃；近山口时交给精确的向导。分子筛中二聚体曲率回升为非负时，用至多 6 次有限差分 Hessian-向量积（Lanczos）找负模；Sella RS-PRFO 收尾的 3N 上限由 469 提到 2000；明显不连通的候选只降一侧即拒绝。
systems_en: 70 non-metal DEV IS (24 DEV-A + 46 DEV-B zeolites), 1 seed, five arms including a 2×2 test of endpoint L-BFGS scaling; confirmation on P1 = 25 sealed G-FACTORY-4 zeolite IS from 9 frameworks (mostly large cells), 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto-80`.
systems_zh: 70 个非金属 DEV 初态（24 个 DEV-A + 46 个 DEV-B 分子筛）× 1 个种子，五臂（含端点 L-BFGS 初始缩放的 2×2 对照）；在 P1 中 25 个封存的 G-FACTORY-4 分子筛初态（9 种骨架，多为大晶胞）× 2 个种子上确认；参照 `long-best-auto-80`。
result_en: Confirmed on P1 zeolites: U/call 1.180× [1.122, 1.244], p < 0.00025; U +18.5 % (599→710), two-seed union +16.4 %, U/ionic step 1.109×, U per DFT-equivalent call 1.103×. Costs: core-seconds per saddle ×1.297, and some reference saddles were missed. Became the zeolite component of opt-in `zeolite-stack-81` and `long-best-auto-81-fullstack-optin`; later audit (r348) 1.202×.
result_zh: P1 分子筛确认：U/调用 1.180 [1.122, 1.244]，p<0.00025；U +18.5%（599→710）。代价：每鞍点核秒 ×1.297，并漏掉部分参照鞍点。成为可选预设 `zeolite-stack-81` 的组件；后续审计 1.202。

name_zh: 驱动锚定的预条件转动
idea_en: Like a compass needle that swings to the softest slope while you want the path along the bond you just pushed: if the needle's swing plane cannot reach that direction, swap in a plane that contains it. After each bond drive, the IS-Hessian-preconditioned dimer rotation was steered toward a 45° cone around the drive; when its plane missed the cone, a plane containing the drive direction was used, with best-iterate tangent starts (RESCUE-BIT).
idea_zh: 像罗盘指针总偏向最软的坡，而你要走的是刚推过的那根键的方向：指针的摆动平面若够不到它，就换一张包含该方向的平面。键驱动后，初态 Hessian 预条件的二聚体转动被引向驱动方向的 45° 锥；平面够不到锥时改用包含驱动方向的平面，并配合最佳迭代切线起步（RESCUE-BIT）。
systems_en: 24 non-metal DEV-A IS (zeolites), 2 seeds, plus 8 Ag/Au G-FACTORY dev IS as a metal-safety check; 64 DEV-B non-metal IS, 2 seeds, as a robustness check; single confirmation on 27 P2 zeolite IS from G-FACTORY-5P, 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto-80`.
systems_zh: 24 个 DEV-A 非金属（分子筛）初态 × 2 个种子，另以 8 个 Ag/Au 的 G-FACTORY 开发初态检查金属安全；64 个 DEV-B 非金属初态 × 2 个种子作稳健性检查；唯一确认用 G-FACTORY-5P 中 27 个 P2 分子筛初态 × 2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto-80`。
result_en: P2 zeolites: U/call 1.057× [0.998, 1.114], one-sided p = 0.030; U +5.0 % (663→696), U/ionic step 1.118×, U per DFT-equivalent call 1.027× [0.990, 1.063] (not significant). On DEV-A, saddles fell 5.15 % and adsorbate-involving saddles 14.0 %; DEV-B U_ads/call was 0.97998 and metals lost saddles. Off by default; zeolite-only opt-in template.
result_zh: P2 分子筛弱确认：U/调用 1.057 [0.998, 1.114]，单侧 p=0.030；U +5.0%（663→696），U/离子步 1.118。DEV-A 上鞍点少 5.15%、吸附物参与鞍点少 14.0%，金属亦减少。默认关闭，仅为分子筛可选模板。

idea_en: Prospectors in one family: if the parent already dug at a spot and found nothing, a child whose ground there looks the same skips it and spends the budget elsewhere. In depth-2 reaction networks (products become new IS), a child inherits the parent's failed bond drives only where the first-shell bond graph is unchanged; the confirmed variant (`network_inherit_policy=metal-local`) does this on metal roots only, keeping existing exact-certificate reuse.
idea_zh: 像一家人轮流找矿：父辈在某处挖过一无所获，孩子若在同一处看到相同的地层，就跳过它，把预算花在别处。在深度 2 的反应网络（产物成为新初态）中，子初态只在第一壳层键图未变处继承父节点失败的键驱动；确认的 `metal-local` 变体仅对金属根启用。
systems_en: Depth-2 networks (budget 3) from DEV-A roots: 24 roots (12 metal, 12 non-metal) × 2 seeds, then 20 and 12 fresh roots for two pivots, 1 seed; confirmation on all 38 metal roots of P3 (G-FACTORY-5M), 1 seed; reference networks with `long-best-auto-80`.
systems_zh: 从 DEV-A 根构建深度 2、预算 3 的网络：24 个根（12 金属、12 非金属）× 2 个种子，两次转向再各用 20 与 12 个新根 × 1 个种子；在 P3（G-FACTORY-5M）全部 38 个金属根 × 1 个种子上确认；参照为 `long-best-auto-80` 网络。
result_en: Metal-only inheritance confirmed on P3: network saddles per call 1.162× [1.103, 1.226], p < 0.00025; N 737→843 (+14.4 %), per ionic step 1.099×, per DFT-equivalent call 1.136×. The all-family rule failed a non-metal guard (0.95993) and the aggressive `metal-all` cut N by 12.6 %. Not lossless (103 reference-only saddles); shipped as opt-in `network-81`.
result_zh: 仅金属局部继承经 P3 确认：网络鞍点/调用 1.162 [1.103, 1.226]，p<0.00025；鞍点 737→843。全族规则未过非金属护栏，`metal-all` 使鞍点少 12.6%。非无损；以可选预设 `network-81` 发布。

idea_en: Small time-savers for a mountain hike – re-check a doubtful descent from a curved start, stay closer to camp, skip walking down a side already shown to be a dead end, abandon a stalled climb – each tested alone, then packed together. Eight off-by-default options were screened; the final SAFE4 bundle combined a non-metal curved-endpoint recheck, a smaller non-metal search sphere (more patience), guarded one-sided rejection and a Sella 60-step stall stop.
idea_zh: 登山的省时小招：可疑的下坡从弯曲起点再验一次、别离营地太远、已知死路的一侧不走到底、久无进展就放弃——先逐个检验再打包。本轮筛选 8 个默认关闭选项，最终 SAFE4 为：非金属弯曲端点复验、更小的非金属搜索球（放宽耐心）、带护栏的单侧拒绝、Sella 60 步停滞即停。
systems_en: 85 DEV-A IS, 1 seed, for single-option screening; all 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS (219 metal, 90 non-metal) for leave-one-out and the SAFE4 re-test; confirmation on P1 = 72 sealed G-FACTORY-4 IS (47 metal, 25 non-metal), 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto-80`.
systems_zh: 85 个 DEV-A 初态 × 1 个种子逐项筛选；全部 309 个 DEV-A + DEV-B 初态（219 金属、90 非金属）做留一检验和 SAFE4 复测；在 P1 共 72 个封存的 G-FACTORY-4 初态（47 金属、25 非金属）× 2 个种子上确认；参照 `long-best-auto-80`。
result_en: Confirmed on P1: U/call 1.040× [1.022, 1.061], p < 0.00025; U +3.2 % (1181→1219), U/ionic step 1.059×, U per DFT-equivalent call 1.012× [0.999, 1.025]. Gains came from non-metals (1.078×); metals were neutral. The original five-option bundle failed metal guards. SAFE4 became `long-best-auto-81`, which GF8 measured at 1.062× per call over `long-best-auto-80`.

name_en: More saddles at a lower price (MORE-80)
idea_en: To find more mountain passes, borrow a starting heading from similar valleys mapped before, or re-walk a failed route with a different scan, rather than just walking longer. Against `long-more-auto-80` (`--more`), the round tested metal-only extension (MORE-METAL), class-template start modes for zeolite drives (TEMPLATE-ALL/FP), selective re-scans of failed bond-forming drives (RR, PC-METAL, ND-METAL) and four coordinated re-runs (K4).
idea_zh: 想多找山口，不只靠走得更久：可借用相似山谷的起步方向，或换种扫描重走失败路线。以 `--more` 为参照，测试仅金属延长、分子筛键驱动的类模板起始模（TEMPLATE-ALL/FP）、失败成键驱动的选择性重扫（RR、PC-METAL、ND-METAL）及四次协同重跑（K4）。
systems_en: H0 screens on 12 DEV-A IS (6 metal, 6 other), 12 non-metal DEV-A/DEV-B IS and 20 further DEV-A metal IS, 1 seed each; decisive test on all 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS (219 metal, 90 other), 1 seed; references `long-more-auto-80` and `long-best-auto-80`. P2 was not opened.
systems_zh: H0 筛选：12 个 DEV-A 初态（6 金属、6 其他）、12 个 DEV-A/B 非金属初态和另 20 个 DEV-A 金属初态，各 1 个种子；决定性检验用全部 309 个 DEV-A + DEV-B 初态（219 金属、90 其他）× 1 个种子；参照 `long-more-auto-80` 与 `long-best-auto-80`，未开 P2。
result_en: Template starts on all 309 DEV IS: U/call 0.990× [0.969, 1.010], U +4.8 % (2070→2170), U per DFT-equivalent call 0.990× – more saddles but not cheaper; the small-sample 1.152× did not transfer. Metal-only `--more`: 1.0096× but −4.2 % non-metal saddles. Metal rerolls added no new saddles; K4 gave 0.423×. Negative; nothing adopted.
result_zh: 309 个 DEV 初态上模板起步：U/调用 0.990 [0.969, 1.010]，U +4.8%（2070→2170），鞍点更多但不更省；小样本 H0 的 1.152 未迁移。仅金属 `--more` 使非金属鞍点少 4.2%；金属重掷未增鞍点。阴性。

idea_en: A hiker keeps every contour map bought on the trip and, at each new trailhead, pulls out the one drawn nearest to it. Exact Hessians computed earlier in a session were stored, and the nearest one became Sella's starting Hessian (a second arm also preconditioned the dimer); a pivot refreshed a stored or initial-state Hessian with a safeguarded Bofill secant update from gradients already computed, for metal Sella runs only.
idea_zh: 徒步者留着旅途中买过的每张地形图，到新登山口就取出最近的那张。会话中已算的精确 Hessian 存成图库，取最近一张作 Sella 初始 Hessian（另一臂也作二聚体预条件）；转向方案用已算梯度对存档或初态 Hessian 做带保护的 Bofill 割线更新，仅用于金属。
systems_en: Zero-call check on archived sessions; 8-IS GF3 pilot (4 metal: Cu(111), Pt(111); 4 zeolite: H-MFI, H-CHA) × 2 seeds, four arms; secant DEV on 10 GEN3/GEN4 IS (6 metal, 4 nonmetal) × 2 seeds; post-kill replication on 49 DEV-A factory IS (F1 dev 33, F2 dev 9, F3 dev 7; 42 metal) × 2 seeds × 3 arms. Reference `long-best-auto-80`; no confirmation pool opened.
systems_zh: 零调用存档检查；GF3 的 8 个初态试点（Cu(111)、Pt(111) 表面 4 个，H-MFI、H-CHA 分子筛 4 个）× 2 种子、四臂；割线 DEV 用 GEN3/GEN4 的 10 个初态（6 金属、4 非金属）× 2 种子；杀线后用 49 个 DEV-A 工厂初态（F1 dev 33、F2 dev 9、F3 dev 7，42 个金属）× 2 种子 × 3 臂复现。参照 `long-best-auto-80`，未开确认池。
result_en: 8-IS pilot, nearest-atlas Sella: U/call 0.993× [0.961, 1.001], p = 0.922; only 2.67% of launches used a stored matrix and metal guards failed. Secant DEV: 0.971× [0.914, 1.006], U 102→98. Post-kill 49-IS replication: 1.027× [0.987, 1.077], p = 0.10, not a confirmation. Stored Hessians rarely lie near new saddles; options left off.

idea_en: After reaching a pass, a hiker walks down both sides to see which valleys it joins, taking long strides where the pass says the ground is gentle and short ones where it is steep. The two validation descents from each candidate saddle were preconditioned with a bounded metric from the saddle's own Hessian (absolute eigenvalues), later from already computed Ritz modes; the strict connectivity check was unchanged.
idea_zh: 登上山口后要沿两侧下山，看它连着哪两个山谷；按山口处的地形定步幅：缓处大步、陡处小步。对每个候选鞍点的两次验证下降，用该鞍点自身 Hessian（特征值取绝对值）构造有界度量作预条件，后续转向改用已有的 Ritz 模；严格连通性判据不变。
systems_en: Three successive 12-IS DEV-A screens (the first 6 metal + 6 nonmetal); DEV of the mode-sign variant on the remaining 49 DEV-A IS × 1 seed; tail, metal-only and Ritz variants screened on 16–24 IS from the retired sealed G-FACTORY-2/3 sets. Reference `long-best-auto-80`; held-out pool P1 never opened.
systems_zh: 三轮 H0 各用 12 个 DEV-A 初态（首轮金属、非金属各 6）；模式符号变体进入 DEV，用其余 49 个 DEV-A 初态 × 1 种子；尾段、仅金属与 Ritz 变体在已退役的 G-FACTORY-2/3 封存集中各取 16–24 个初态筛选。参照 `long-best-auto-80`，未打开留出池 P1。
result_en: On a 12-IS screen the full saddle-Hessian metric cut quench calls 57.9%, but U fell 14.4% and 18.3% of validation verdicts changed. Mode-sign variant, DEV: U/call 1.006× [0.967, 1.044], p = 0.3648, U 247→251; nonmetal verdict flips 3.17% (> 3% gate). Tail, metal-only and Ritz variants: 0.994–1.044× on screens, none passing all gates. No gain.
result_zh: 12 初态筛选：完整鞍点 Hessian 度量减淬火力调用 57.9%，但 U 降 14.4%。模式符号变体 DEV：U/调用 1.006 倍 [0.967, 1.044]，p=0.3648，U 247→251，非金属翻转 3.17% 超门槛。无收益。

name_en: Ridge walk from the scan bracket (SCAN-BRACKET-RIDGE)
idea_en: Two scouts straddle the ridge a failed climb crossed, check that their slopes drain to different valleys, close in to pin the ridge and follow its crest down to the pass. For failed bond drives, the scan points around the first energy drop were relaxed to confirm different basins, bisected up to three times and walked down the ridge before Sella or the dimer restarted; strict validation unchanged.
idea_zh: 两名侦察员分站在失败攀爬越过的山脊两侧，确认各自山坡流向不同山谷，再相向逼近夹住脊线，沿脊下行到山口。键驱动失败时，取首次能量下降两侧的扫描点分别弛豫以确认分属不同盆地，最多二分三次，再沿投影梯度在脊上下降，然后重启 Sella 或二聚体；严格验证不变。
systems_en: H0 on the 36 GF3 IS; main test (DEV) on all 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds, plus guarded side-test and fast/slow comparisons on DEV-A; two further screens, one on 24 nonmetal DEV-B IS (G-FACTORY sealed, G-FACTORY-2/3, IS-first, G5). Reference `long-best-auto-80`; held-out pool P2 not read.
systems_zh: H0 用 GF3 的 36 个初态；主检验（DEV）用全部 85 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 种子，带保护侧检验与快/慢对照也在 DEV-A 上；另两次筛选，其一用 24 个非金属 DEV-B 初态（G-FACTORY 封存、G-FACTORY-2/3、IS-first、G5）。参照 `long-best-auto-80`，未读取留出池 P2。
result_en: DEV: U/call 0.816× [0.784, 0.842], p = 1.000; U 968→978 (+1.0%). 1,008 ridge retries gave only 8 direct new saddles; side tests took 93.4% of retry calls, about 32,204 calls per net extra saddle. A faster side test beat the slow ridge by 1.028× (gate 1.03) but stayed at 0.841× of the reference. Rescue costs far exceed gains.
result_zh: DEV：U/调用 0.816 倍 [0.784, 0.842]，U 968→978。1,008 次脊线重试只直接新增 8 个鞍点，侧检验占其力调用 93.4%。快速侧检验较慢版 1.028 倍（门槛 1.03），较参照仍仅 0.841 倍。得不偿失。

idea_en: A hiker wants to skip trails that lead to passes already in the logbook, but such repeat climbs proved to be only about 3% of the budget; so the logbook check itself was made cheaper: a quick map glance first, a full comparison only when a known pass is near. Each walker step got a geometric pre-check, and the full mode check against known saddles ran only when one might be re-met.
idea_zh: 登山者本想跳过通往日志中已有山口的路线，但这类重复攀登只占预算约 3%；于是改为让查日志本身更省：先扫一眼地图，已知山口就在附近时才细对。每步行走先做几何预检，只有可能重遇已知鞍点时才做完整的模式比对（捕获）。
systems_en: Zero-call replay of archived sessions for the original predictor; capture rule: 16-IS pilot, then full DEV on all 85 DEV-A + 224 DEV-B IS × 2 seeds (614 paired sessions), plus an equivalence check against every-step capture on 93 IS. Reference `long-best-auto-80`.
systems_zh: 原预测器只做零调用的存档回放；替代捕获规则先在 16 个初态试点，再在全部 85 个 DEV-A 与 224 个 DEV-B 初态 × 2 种子上做完整 DEV（614 对会话），另在 93 个初态上与逐步捕获做等价检验。参照 `long-best-auto-80`。
result_en: Original predictor stopped: repeat launches cost only 2.989% of calls (stop rule 5%), oracle ceiling 1.0143×. Capture rule DEV: U/call 1.004× [1.0025, 1.0059], p < 0.00025, U 3350→3350, saddle sets identical in 614/614 sessions; U per DFT-equivalent call 0.997×. A real but tiny gain, far below the 1.03 gate; left off.
result_zh: 原预测器终止：重复发射仅占力调用 2.989%（停止线 5%）。捕获规则 DEV：U/调用 1.004 倍 [1.0025, 1.0059]，p<0.00025，U 3350→3350，614/614 会话鞍点集合相同。收益真实但远低于 1.03 门槛。

idea_en: A climber who has tried every route from one campsite walks a short, mapped path to a neighbouring campsite and scans from there, but any pass found must still connect to the original camp. After each session the adsorbate was nudged along its two softest modes and relaxed; nearby low-energy conformers joined to the initial state by a verified low barrier became extra scan starts, with strict validation against the original.
idea_zh: 登山者在一个营地试遍所有路线后，沿一条已勘明的短路走到邻近营地再扫描，但找到的山口仍须连回原营地。会话后沿吸附物最软的两个模推动再弛豫；能量相近、且经已验证低势垒通道连回初态的构象成为新扫描起点，新鞍点仍对原初态严格验证。
systems_en: Zero-call audit of an earlier census (33 saddles reached from low-energy alternative minima); H0 on 24 DEV-A IS (12 metal surfaces, 12 zeolites) × 1 seed. Reference `long-best-auto-80`.
systems_zh: 先对早期普查中来自低能替代极小的 33 个鞍点做零调用审计；H0 用 24 个 DEV-A 初态（12 个金属表面、12 个分子筛）× 1 种子。参照 `long-best-auto-80`。
result_en: Audit: 28 of 33 census saddles from low-energy alternative minima were already connected to the initial state. H0: U/call 0.974× [0.960, 0.982], U 148→148, calls +2.69%; of 96 soft-mode nudges 29 fell back to the initial state and only 2 reached a conformer with a verified link, giving 5 extra launches and no new saddle. Killed at H0.
result_zh: 审计：普查中来自低能替代极小的 33 个鞍点有 28 个本已与初态相连。H0：U/调用 0.974 倍 [0.960, 0.982]，U 148→148，力调用 +2.69%；96 次软模推动仅 2 次得到有验证通道的构象，无新鞍点。H0 即终止。

idea_en: Hammond's rule says a pass lies closer to the higher valley, so the climber picked his start from altitude readings; when those guesses failed to bring him closer, the team settled for not re-reading the altimeter at a spot already measured. Hammond/Marcus-type rules shifted the walker's start point or mode along the bond scan; the final pivot reused the stored energy and forces whenever the walker requested exactly the scan-start geometry.
idea_zh: Hammond 规则说山口更靠近较高的山谷，登山者便按高度读数推算起点；推算没能让他更接近山口，团队退而只求已量过的地点不再重读高度计。用 Hammond/Marcus 类规则沿键扫描移动行走起点或初始模；最终转向在行走请求与扫描起点完全相同的构型时，直接复用已算的能量和力。
systems_en: Zero-call H0 on 3,602 archived launches (GF3 and factory dev); path-start pilot on 24 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds; mode, sibling and bond-forming pilots and the force-memo DEV each on their own 24 DEV-B IS (G-FACTORY sealed, G-FACTORY-2/3, IS-first, G5); memo confirmed on P2 = 63 G-FACTORY-5M/5P IS × 2 seeds (252 sessions). Reference `long-best-auto-80`.
systems_zh: 零调用 H0 用 3,602 条存档发射（GF3 与工厂 dev）；路径起点试点用 24 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 种子；模式、同类起点、成键混合三个试点和力缓存 DEV 各用一组 24 个 DEV-B 初态（G-FACTORY 封存、G-FACTORY-2/3、IS-first、G5）；力缓存在 P2（63 个 G-FACTORY-5M/5P 初态 × 2 种子，252 会话）上确认。参照 `long-best-auto-80`。
result_en: Marcus start placed the walker farther from the true saddle (distance ratio 1.029×); path, mode, sibling and bond-forming starts gave 0.968–1.009×. Force memo, P2 confirmation: U/call 0.999× [0.997, 1.000], p = 0.907, U 1144→1144; it saved 3,487 calls, but calibration and compile costs raised total calls by 2,181, and 2/126 records differed by up to 3.38×10⁻¹⁴, failing the identity gate.
result_zh: Marcus 起点离鞍点更远（距离比 1.029）；其余起点 0.968–1.009 倍。力缓存 P2 确认：U/调用 0.999 倍 [0.997, 1.000]，U 1144→1144；省 3,487 次力调用但总量反增 2,181，且未过逐位一致门槛。

idea_en: A climber hanging from a rope at the top of a bond scan feels both the slope and the rope's pull. The first idea subtracted the rope's pull from the felt curvature; the pivot let him shuffle along the ledge until the sideways pull eased before letting go. The scan-top Hessian was corrected by the bordered-Lagrangian term P(H−μC)P; the pivot took one guarded constrained Cauchy step at fixed bond length (nonmetals only).
idea_zh: 键扫描顶端的登山者吊在绳上，同时感到坡度和绳的拉力。第一个想法从感到的曲率中扣除绳的作用；转向方案让他松手前沿岩架挪到侧向拉力更小处。用加边拉格朗日项 P(H−μC)P 修正扫描顶 Hessian；转向方案在固定键长下走一步带保护的约束 Cauchy 步（仅非金属）后再起步。
systems_en: LAGR-2D: H0 on 16 GF3 IS and an 8-IS GF3 pilot; POLISH: H0 on 8 G-FACTORY dev IS, then DEV on 24 nonmetal + 4 metal-sentinel DEV-A IS × 2 seeds (112 sessions); later filter screens on 13 further IS. Reference `long-best-auto-80`; held-out pool P3 not read.
systems_zh: LAGR-2D：H0 用 16 个 GF3 初态，另做 8 个 GF3 初态试点；POLISH：H0 用 8 个 G-FACTORY dev 初态，DEV 用 24 个非金属加 4 个金属哨兵 DEV-A 初态 × 2 种子（112 会话）；后续过滤器在另 13 个初态上筛选。参照 `long-best-auto-80`，未读取留出池 P3。
result_en: Bordered-Lagrangian start: median mode-overlap gain 0.0000 (gate +0.03); 8-IS pilot 0.9335× [0.8245, 0.9650], U −8.1%. POLISH DEV (nonmetal): U/call 0.976× [0.933, 1.024], p = 0.8415, U 473→457 (−3.4%), U_ads/call 0.958. Polishing cut the residual force by 73% yet sent walks into other basins; later filters also failed.
result_zh: 拉格朗日起点：模式重叠中位增益 0.0000（门槛 +0.03），试点 0.9335 倍。POLISH 非金属 DEV：U/调用 0.976 倍 [0.933, 1.024]，U 473→457（−3.4%）。残余力降 73%，行走却转入其他盆地。

idea_en: A prospector pans the tailings of abandoned climbs: on each failed route he marks the flattest spot where the ground still curved like a pass and polishes it briefly to see whether a real pass hides there. From each failed walk one low-force point with negative curvature was refined by Newton–Krylov steps preconditioned with the initial-state Hessian (at most 50 calls), later by Sella, then strictly validated against the initial state.
idea_zh: 淘金者翻检失败攀登留下的尾矿：在每条失败路线上标出最平缓、地形却仍像山口般弯曲的点，稍加打磨，看是否藏着真山口。从每条失败行走取一个低力、负曲率点，用初态 Hessian 预条件的 Newton–Krylov 精修（至多 50 次力调用），后改用 Sella，再对初态严格验证。
systems_en: Post-session replays on DEV-A only: 16 GF3 IS (8 metal, 8 nonmetal) × 1 seed with 200 replayed points; 24 further DEV-A IS for the spatial, mode-turn and Sella pivots; 32 new metal DEV-A IS (G-FACTORY dev sets) for the metal follow-up. Reference `long-best-auto-80`; held-out pool P1 never opened.
systems_zh: 仅在 DEV-A 上做会话后回放：16 个 GF3 初态（金属、非金属各 8）× 1 种子，回放 200 个点；空间、转模与 Sella 转向另用 24 个 DEV-A 初态；金属跟进用 32 个新的金属 DEV-A 初态（G-FACTORY 各代 dev）。参照 `long-best-auto-80`，未打开留出池 P1。
result_en: Counting audit calls, pilot U/call 0.918× [0.904, 0.932], U 136→137; the one extra saddle cost 23,270 extra calls (gate 2,000) and had the exact coordinates of a candidate rejected earlier in the session. Unconverged-point, spatial and mode-turn variants added none. Metal Sella follow-up: 0.927× [0.907, 0.949], U 137→140, 3,528 calls per new saddle. Failed walks rarely hide affordable saddles.
result_zh: 含审计：试点 U/调用 0.918 倍 [0.904, 0.932]，U 136→137，唯一新鞍点多耗 23,270 次力调用（门槛 2,000），且为早先被拒候选；金属 Sella 跟进 0.927 倍，U 137→140。失败轨迹难以低价淘出鞍点。

idea_en: Besides how steep and how curved the slope is, the climber also feels how fast the curvature changes, and uses that to leap toward the pass, size his first strides and aim his compass. Third-derivative information along the bond scan was used three ways: a single cubic-model saddle step from the scan top, a cubic-informed initial Sella trust radius, and a bounded (≤5°) correction of the starting mode.
idea_zh: 登山者不只感受坡有多陡、多弯，还感受弯曲变化得多快，据此跳向山口、定头几步步幅、校准指南针。沿键扫描的三阶导数用于三处：从扫描顶点按三次模型走一步鞍点步、用三阶项设定 Sella 初始信赖半径、对起始模做至多 5° 的有界修正。
systems_en: Cubic step: 24 replayed successful launches (12 metal, 12 nonmetal) from 7 GF3 IS in a 2-seed reference archive; trust-radius and mode H0s: each on 15 G-FACTORY dev metal IS (a different 15 each time) plus 4 GF3 zeolite IS × 2 seeds × 2 arms (76 sessions). Reference `long-best-auto-80`; no DEV or confirmation run.
systems_zh: 三次步：从 2 种子参考存档的 7 个 GF3 初态中抽 24 条成功发射重放（金属、非金属各 12）；信赖半径与模式修正两次 H0 各用 15 个互不重叠的 G-FACTORY dev 金属初态，加 4 个 GF3 分子筛初态 × 2 种子 × 2 臂（76 会话）。参照 `long-best-auto-80`，未进入 DEV 或确认。
result_en: Cubic step: median search steps saved 0% (gate 25%); 15/24 scan tops did not move, 11 having two or more negative eigenvalues. Trust-radius H0: U/call 0.968× [0.851, 1.102], p = 0.707. Mode-correction H0: 0.928× [0.848, 0.990], p = 0.9885, U 195→180 (−7.7%). Scan tops are often not index-1; all three ideas stopped at H0.
result_zh: 三次步：搜索步中位节省 0%（门槛 25%），15/24 个顶点非明确一阶鞍点而未移动。信赖半径 H0：U/调用 0.968 倍 [0.851, 1.102]；模式修正 H0：0.928 倍 [0.848, 0.990]，U 195→180。均止于 H0。

idea_en: A climber who remembers how the slope's push changed over his last few steps can extrapolate a bolder stride, falling back to ordinary steps whenever the guess looks too long or wrong. The dimer's translation steps in zeolites were extrapolated from up to four past step/force pairs by safeguarded Anderson mixing of the inverted force; a pivot used a guarded limited-memory inverse Broyden update instead.
idea_zh: 登山者记住最近几步坡面推力的变化，就能外推出更大胆的一步；一旦猜得太长或方向可疑，就退回普通步伐。分子筛中二聚体的平移步改用带保护的 Anderson 混合，由至多四对历史步长与反转力外推；转向方案改用带保护的有限记忆逆 Broyden 更新。
systems_en: Zeolite (nonmetal) dimer only: H0s on 4 DEV-A zeolite IS × 1 seed; DEV for each method on 12 DEV-A zeolite IS (CHA, MFI, FAU, MOR, LTL, MTT, MTW hosts) × 2 seeds × 2 arms (48 sessions). Metals not sampled. Reference `long-best-auto-80`; held-out pools P1 and P3 not opened.
systems_zh: 仅分子筛（非金属）二聚体：H0 用 4 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态 × 1 种子；两种方法的 DEV 各用 12 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态（CHA、MFI、FAU、MOR、LTL、MTT、MTW 骨架）× 2 种子 × 2 臂（48 会话）。未采样金属。参照 `long-best-auto-80`，未打开留出池 P1、P3。
result_en: Anderson DEV: U/call 1.003× [0.938, 1.069], p = 0.4398, U 255→247 (−3.1%) with 3.4% fewer calls, failing the 1.03 gate and the U guard. Broyden DEV: 0.978× [0.890, 1.072], U 259→266 (+2.7%) but 5.06% more calls; U_ads/call 0.971. Anderson's 4-IS screen (1.029×) did not carry over; both left off.
result_zh: Anderson：U/调用 1.003 倍 [0.938, 1.069]，U 255→247；Broyden：0.978 倍 [0.890, 1.072]，U 259→266，但力调用多 5.06%。两者 DEV 均未过门槛，小样本收益未能延续。

name_en: Census of the saddles v0.80 misses (CENSUS-80)
idea_en: A prospector pools every vein ever found in a district, then checks which ones the regular crew walked past and why. All strictly certified, IS-connected saddles found by many sessions on the 85 DEV-A initial states were merged into one catalogue, and each saddle missed by default v0.80 was traced to a cause: coordinate never scanned, scanned but the walker reached another saddle, or the walk aborted on positive curvature.
idea_zh: 像探矿者把矿区历来发现的矿脉汇成一张图，再查常规队伍漏掉了哪些、为什么。本轮把 DEV-A 85 个初态上多次会话找到的严格认证、连回初态的鞍点合并成目录，并为默认 v0.80 漏掉的每个鞍点归因：坐标未扫描、扫描对了但 walker 走到别的鞍点，或因正曲率中止。
systems_en: DEV-A, 85 IS (61 metal, 24 non-metal): 943 complete sessions (four presets × 2 seeds, long-complete, an extra `--more` seed, a same-seed default rerun, an 8-IS ASE pilot), merged with the older r116 strict census.
systems_zh: DEV-A 共 85 个初态（61 个金属、24 个非金属）：943 个完整会话（四种预设各 2 个种子、long-complete、额外一个 `--more` 种子、同种子默认重跑、8 个初态的 ASE 试点），并合并 r116 的旧严格普查。
result_en: Development analysis on DEV-A: 1,296 strict saddles catalogued (a lower bound). One default session finds 0.3715 [0.3247, 0.4332] of them; the default two-seed union misses 806, 605 involving the adsorbate. 79 % of missed adsorbate saddles with a visible home coordinate had it scanned in the right direction. `--more` vs default: U/call 0.976× [0.919, 1.028], U +21.8 %; ASE diversification found 0 new saddles.
result_zh: DEV-A 开发：严格鞍点至少 1,296 个，默认单会话覆盖 0.3715。两种子漏 806 个，吸附物相关 605 个中可辨坐标者 79 % 已正确扫描。`--more` 对默认 U/调用 0.976 倍 [0.919, 1.028]，U +21.8 %。

idea_en: A hiker with a reliable sketch map probes the ground with a stick only where the map looks doubtful. A Bofill-updated curvature model, seeded with the exact IS Hessian and updated from forces already paid for, predicts small dimer rotations; when the model was just verified, curvature is clearly negative and the predicted angle is at most 8°, up to two finite-difference rotation images in a row are skipped.
idea_zh: 带着可靠草图的登山者，只在图上看不准的地方才用手杖探路。本轮用初态精确 Hessian 起步、再用已付费的力做 Bofill 更新的曲率模型预测 dimer 的小角度旋转；当模型刚被验证、曲率明显为负且预测转角不超过 8° 时，最多连续跳过两次有限差分旋转像。
systems_en: Development on 90 zeolite IS: 24 from DEV-A and 66 from DEV-B (including 10 IS-first and 1 G5), 2 seeds. Confirmation on P2: 27 zeolite IS from G-FACTORY-5P plus 8 metal sentinel IS, 2 seeds (140 sessions).
systems_zh: 开发：90 个分子筛初态，DEV-A 24 个、DEV-B 66 个（含 10 个 IS-first 和 1 个 G5），2 个种子。P2 确认：27 个 G-FACTORY-5P 分子筛初态加 8 个金属哨兵初态，2 个种子（140 个会话）。
result_en: Confirmation on P2 zeolites: U/call 1.090× [1.048, 1.138], p < 0.00025; U +5.5 % (676→713) but unflagged saddles unchanged (226→226); U per ionic step 1.022 (n.s.), per DFT-equivalent call 1.050 [1.021, 1.085]; metals unaffected. A more cautious first arm reached only 1.0401 on development. A later independent audit (r355, P1 + P3) gave 1.049× [1.012, 1.087]. Shipped in the opt-in preset `long-best-auto-81-fullstack-optin` (v0.81).

name_zh: 松弛扫描的线性响应预测（SCAN-CONDENSATION）
idea_en: Tug one knot of a spring net and you can predict, from the spring stiffnesses, where the other knots will settle. When a relaxed scan pushed one bond to its next level, the other atoms were pre-placed using the linear response predicted by the IS Hessian (static condensation), capped at 0.04 Å per atom, to save relaxation steps.
idea_zh: 拉动弹簧网上的一个结点，可以根据各弹簧的刚度预先算出其他结点会停在哪里。松弛扫描把某个键推到下一级时，用初态 Hessian 的静态凝聚（线性响应）预测其余原子的位移并预先放好（每原子最多 0.04 Å），以减少弛豫步数。
systems_en: Scan-replay screens on 21 EARLY IS (250 drives), 16 G-FACTORY-2/3 development IS and 48–67 sealed G-FACTORY-2/3 IS (up to 1,326 drives); residual ablation on 85 DEV-B IS (67 sealed G-FACTORY, 6 G5, 12 G-FACTORY-4 development); v0.80 cost reference on DEV-A, 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 扫描回放筛选：21 个 EARLY 初态（250 次拉键）、16 个 G-FACTORY-2/3 开发初态及 48–67 个其密封初态（最多 1,326 次拉键）；残差消融用 85 个 DEV-B 初态（67 个密封 G-FACTORY、6 个 G5、12 个 G-FACTORY-4 开发）；v0.80 成本参照为 DEV-A，2 个种子。
result_en: Killed at the scan-replay screens; no U/call was measured. Original guarded predictor: scan calls 1.0152× [0.9867, 1.0459]. Best pivot (regularised, first level only): first-level scan calls 0.984× [0.971, 0.998], but only 71.9 % of drives kept the baseline's stop reason and peak level. Lower local forces did not keep the same scan ridge. Options left off.
result_zh: 回放筛选即否决，未测 U/调用。原版扫描调用 1.0152 倍 [0.9867, 1.0459]；最佳变体（正则化、仅首级）扫描调用 0.984 倍 [0.971, 0.998]，但仅 71.9 % 拉键保持停止原因与峰级：局部力低不等于同一山脊。选项关闭。

idea_en: Like ordering by what you want at a restaurant ('something quick', 'the full menu') and getting the price and what is not included printed before the food arrives. `--goal {fast, complete, lowbarrier, network, dft}` maps a chemist's intent onto existing expert presets and options, prints a contract (what is searched, historical cost, what is excluded) before the run, and ends with a bilingual summary and the suggested next command.
idea_zh: 像在餐厅只说“要快的”或“要全套”，上菜前先看价格和不含什么。`--goal {fast, complete, lowbarrier, network, dft}` 把意图映射到已有专家预设，运行前打印“合同”（搜什么、历史成本、不搜什么），结束时给中英文总结和下一条建议命令。
systems_en: DEV-A (85 IS: metal surfaces and zeolites) × 2 seeds × 2 arms = 340 sessions for the candidate ordering behind `fast`; real NEP command-line tasks to check each goal against the equivalent expert command.
systems_zh: DEV-A（85 个初态：金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子 × 2 臂，共 340 个会话，用于检验 `fast` 的候选排序；另用真实 NEP 命令行任务核对每个目标与对应专家命令一致。
result_en: Delivered: 39 targeted tests pass and goal commands are decision-identical to the expert commands. The candidate anytime ordering for `fast` gave, on DEV-A, U/call 0.989× [0.961, 1.019], p = 0.78 (U/DFT-equivalent 0.996), and zeolite U_ads/call fell below the guard, so `fast` maps to the plain default. `--goal` shipped in v0.81.0 (refined in r380).
result_zh: 39 项测试通过，目标命令与专家命令决策一致。`fast` 候选排序（DEV-A）U/调用 0.989 倍 [0.961, 1.019]，p = 0.78，分子筛 U_ads/调用未过护栏，故 `fast` 即默认。`--goal` 随 v0.81.0 发布。

idea_en: Give the search a fixed number of tickets and an honest receipt: every force call, the initial-state preparation and each exact Hessian (at a fixed 47 tickets) come out of the same wallet. `--budget` became one global ledger, and several orderings tried to spend a small budget on the most promising bond drives first (deadline-aware or optimistic ranking, stopping or packing when few calls remain).
idea_zh: 给搜索一沓固定数量的票并开诚实的收据：每次力调用、初态准备和每次精确 Hessian（固定按 47 张票计）都从同一个钱包里出。`--budget` 改为一本全局账，并尝试几种排序让小预算先花在最有希望的拉键上（截止感知或乐观排序、余额不足时停止或改选装得下的键）。
