systems_en: v0.80 anytime curve on DEV-A (85 IS, 2 seeds) and candidate screens on 48 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds; one confirmation of the existing r193 `--anytime` ordering on P2 (36 metal + 27 non-metal IS from G-FACTORY-5M/5P, 1 seed).
systems_zh: v0.80 随时曲线基于 DEV-A（85 个初态，2 个种子），候选筛选用 48 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子；已有的 r193 `--anytime` 排序在 P2（G-FACTORY-5M/5P 的 36 个金属 + 27 个非金属初态，1 个种子）上做一次确认。
result_en: Within 2k / 5k / 10k calls v0.80 finds 35.1 / 64.1 / 78.1 % of a full session's saddles (non-metals only 36.4 % at 5k). All new orderings failed development. P2 confirmation of the r193 ordering: saddles within 2,000 calls 1.082× [0.929, 1.255], p = 0.16; U/call 1.005; non-metal U −4.9 %. Not confirmed; options off.

idea_en: Before hiking in unfamiliar mountains, check that the map of them is trustworthy, then see whether a different climbing style suits the terrain. Oxide surfaces (MgO, CeO2, TiO2, ZnO with small molecules) were built, the NEP89 potential was screened against literature water and CO adsorption, and an optional detector that recognises oxide slabs and routes them to Sella instead of the dimer walker (`oxide_engine=sella`) was tested.
idea_zh: 去陌生山区前，先确认地图可靠，再看换种攀登方式是否更合适。本轮构建 MgO、CeO2、TiO2、ZnO 表面加小分子体系，用文献水与 CO 吸附数据检验 NEP89，并测试可选路由：识别为氧化物表面时改用 Sella 而非 dimer（`oxide_engine=sella`）。
systems_en: DEV-OX only: 39 starting structures — MgO(100), CeO2(111) and TiO2(110) each with H2, CH4, CO, CO2, H2O and CH3OH, two on ZnO(10-10), plus 11 bimolecular and 8 coverage states on MgO. Only 17 MgO IS passed the physics screens; the primary test used the 5 single-molecule MgO IS, 2 seeds. No confirmation pool.
systems_zh: 仅开发集 DEV-OX：39 个起始结构——MgO(100)、CeO2(111)、TiO2(110) 各配 H2、CH4、CO、CO2、H2O、CH3OH，ZnO(10-10) 两个，另有 MgO 双分子 11 个、覆盖度 8 个。通过物理筛选的仅 17 个 MgO 初态；主检验用其中 5 个单分子初态，2 个种子。无确认池。
result_en: Development only. Primary test (5 MgO IS): U/call 1.451× [0.349, 5.892], p = 0.268, U +25 %, but U_ads/call 0.871 fails the 0.98 guard (CO saddles lost). All 17 MgO IS: 1.217× [1.004, 1.565], p = 0.0225, U +6.6 %, yet U per ionic step only 1.006. NEP89 failed the water screen on CeO2, TiO2 and ZnO and over-binds CO on MgO by about 0.34 eV. Option off.
result_zh: 开发（5 个 MgO）：U/调用 1.451 倍 [0.349, 5.892]，p = 0.268，U +25 %，但 U_ads/调用 0.871 未过护栏；17 个 MgO 为 1.217 倍，每离子步仅 1.006。其余氧化物 NEP89 未过筛查。

name_en: Boundary test: large guests and crowded surfaces (LARGE-ADSORBATE-BOUNDARY)
name_zh: 适用边界：大客体与高覆盖度（LARGE-ADSORBATE-BOUNDARY）
idea_en: In a supermarket with hundreds of near-identical aisles, you can either give up sooner after a run of empty aisles or first visit one aisle of each kind. For large guests (C4–C10 chains, aromatics on Pt) with 73–212 candidate bonds, SCALE-DRY shortened the 25-failure dry stop, and COVER tried one bond per class (bond kind, element pair, host or not) before the usual priority order.
idea_zh: 超市有上百条相似通道：要么连续几条空手就早点离开，要么先每类各逛一条。针对候选键 73–212 个的大客体（Pt 上 C4–C10 链、芳烃等），SCALE-DRY 缩短“连续 25 次无新鞍点即停”，COVER 先按类别（键类型、元素对、是否宿主）各试一个键，再按原优先级。
systems_en: New DEV-L set of 15 IS: 12 three-layer metal slabs with large guests, co-adsorbates or H coverage (Pt with C4–C10 chains, benzene, toluene, naphthalene, C4+4H, C4+8H; Ni with C4; Cu with C6 and C4+4H) and 3 water-containing zeolite pores (MFI, CHA); plus 81 DEV-A IS to check for regressions; 2 seeds; no confirmation pool.
systems_zh: 新建 DEV-L 15 个初态：12 个三层金属板上的大客体、共吸附或 H 覆盖（Pt 上 C4–C10 链、苯、甲苯、萘、C4+4H、C4+8H；Ni 上 C4；Cu 上 C6、C4+4H）及 3 个含水分子筛孔道（MFI、CHA）；另加 81 个 DEV-A 初态检验无回归；2 个种子；无确认池。
result_en: SCALE-DRY was killed at the first screen (U 0.8202× of reference). COVER on 81 DEV-A + 11 DEV-L IS: U/call 1.0067× [0.9900, 1.0253], p = 0.2158, U +0.35 %; DEV-L alone 0.9753× [0.9461, 1.0063] with guards failing, and part of the pooled gain was a cold-cache accounting artefact. A 27-IS diagnostic waiting for 50 instead of 25 dry launches: U +11.6 % at U/call 0.894×. Both options off.
result_zh: SCALE-DRY 即被否决（U 为参照 0.8202 倍）。COVER（92 个开发初态）：U/调用 1.0067 倍 [0.9900, 1.0253]，p = 0.2158；DEV-L 单独 0.9753 倍，护栏未过，部分增益源自冷缓存计费。两选项关闭。

name_en: Scan shortcuts and an exact-geometry force cache (SCAN-NEWTON-MU → SCAN-PATH-MEMO)
name_zh: 扫描捷径与同几何力缓存（SCAN-NEWTON-MU → SCAN-PATH-MEMO）
idea_en: A surveyor who writes down every spot already measured never pays to measure it twice. Newton-type rules that used the scan's constraint force (μ = dE/dξ) to skip or shorten scan levels all failed their screens; what survived was SCAN-PATH-MEMO: energies and forces paid for at up to 256 scan points are handed to the walker launched from that scan and reused only for bit-identical geometries within that launch.
idea_zh: 测量员把测过的点记在本子上，就不必为同一点付两次钱。先试的 Newton 式规则（用扫描约束力 μ = dE/dξ 跳过或缩短扫描级）均未过筛选；保留的 SCAN-PATH-MEMO 把扫描已付费的至多 256 个点的能量和力交给由此发射的 walker，仅几何逐位相同时复用。
systems_en: Screens on 24-IS DEV-A and 32-IS DEV-B samples (plus archive replays); full development on DEV-A + DEV-B (309 IS × 2 seeds); one confirmation on P2 (36 metal + 27 non-metal IS from G-FACTORY-5M/5P, 2 seeds).
systems_zh: 筛选用 24 个 DEV-A 初态和 32 个 DEV-B 初态的样本（另有档案回放）；完整开发集 DEV-A + DEV-B（309 个初态 × 2 个种子）；P2 一次确认（G-FACTORY-5M/5P 的 36 个金属 + 27 个非金属初态，2 个种子）。
result_en: Seven earlier candidates were killed at screening (e.g. loosening the scan-relaxation threshold cut proposal calls by 9.02 % but changed 27.8 % of stop or peak-level decisions). The cache changed no decision in 614/614 development sessions. P2 confirmation: U/call 1.001× [0.9998, 1.0019], one-sided p = 0.046, U 1,151→1,151; per DFT-equivalent call 0.999427 (n.s.); no CPU gain. A tiny confirmed saving; opt-in option `drive_scan_path_cache`.
result_zh: 七个早期候选被否（如放宽扫描收敛阈值省 9.02 % 提案调用，但 27.8 % 判定翻转）。缓存不改决策；P2 确认 U/调用 1.001 倍 [0.9998, 1.0019]，单侧 p = 0.046，U 1,151→1,151。确认但极小，仅作可选项。

name_en: Shortcut for re-check descents into known valleys (VALIDATION-ATLAS)
name_zh: 复核下坡的已知山谷捷径（VALIDATION-ATLAS）
idea_en: Halfway down a trail you have already mapped to the valley floor, you can stop walking and mark the destination. Validation re-check descents that rejoin a downhill path the session already knows were stopped early; the decisive version (FLOW-4) accepts the known end point when every atom lies within a narrow tube around that path and the energy is within 4 eV of the end.
idea_zh: 沿着一条已走过、确知通往谷底的小路下山时，走到一半就可以停下，直接记下终点。本轮让验证中的复核下坡在重新汇入本会话已知的下坡路时提前结束；决定性版本 FLOW-4 在每个原子都落在该路径周围的窄管内、且能量距终点 4 eV 以内时，直接接受已知终点。
systems_en: Shadow screens on 16 DEV-A IS (8 metal, 8 non-metal); decisive development on DEV-A + DEV-B, 309 IS × 2 seeds (1,228 searches). No confirmation pool was opened.
systems_zh: 影子筛选用 16 个 DEV-A 初态（8 个金属、8 个非金属）；决定性开发测试在 DEV-A + DEV-B 共 309 个初态 × 2 个种子（1,228 次搜索）上进行；未打开确认池。
result_en: Atlas and corridor variants failed their screens (at most 0.2485 % and 1.264 % of calls saved, below the 2 % gate). FLOW-4 on DEV-A + DEV-B: apparent U/call 1.037× [1.030, 1.045], U 3,350→3,379, but 23/614 paired runs changed decisions and all 29 extra saddles were ones the baseline validator rejects. Not a valid speed-up; options off.
result_zh: atlas/走廊变体仅省 0.2485 %/1.264 % 调用（门槛 2 %）。FLOW-4 表观 U/调用 1.037 倍 [1.030, 1.045]，U 3,350→3,379，但 23/614 对判定改变，多出的 29 个均为基准验证所拒。选项关闭。

name_en: Walker settings tuned per reaction class (CLASS-ADAPTIVE-WALKER)
idea_en: A climber may need different gear for ice, rock and scree; only data show which gear pays off where. Walker settings were learned per reaction class: on metals, Sella's Davidson subspace cap (normally 10) was lifted only for three classes picked in training (C–M and H–O bond formation with a 'SNAP' scan, H–M formation with a 'RIDGE' scan); a follow-up raised the non-metal dimer's positive-curvature patience from 15 to 20.
idea_zh: 冰面、岩壁、碎石坡各需不同装备，用哪种要看数据。按反应类别学习 walker 设置：金属上只对训练选出的三类（SNAP 型 C–M、H–O 成键，RIDGE 型 H–M 成键）解除 Sella Davidson 子空间上限 10；另试非金属 dimer 正曲率耐心 15→20。
systems_en: Training on 178 metal IS from DEV-A + DEV-B (2 seeds × 3 arms, 1,068 sessions); one held-out development test on 61 IS (39 metal, 20 non-metal, 2 refused inputs) × 2 seeds; the non-metal follow-up trained on 70 non-metal IS. The P1 confirmation pool was never opened.
systems_zh: 训练：DEV-A + DEV-B 中 178 个金属初态（2 个种子 × 3 臂，1,068 个会话）；留出开发测试 61 个初态（39 个金属、20 个非金属、2 个被拒输入）× 2 个种子；非金属后续在 70 个非金属初态上训练。从未打开 P1 确认池。
result_en: Held-out development (class cap policy): U/call 1.0045× [0.990, 1.017], p = 0.25, U +0.8 %, U per DFT-equivalent call 1.005, well below the 1.03 gate, so P1 was not run. Non-metal patience 20 vs 15 in training: U/call 0.95997× [0.94690, 0.97243] for U +2.53 %; no class qualified. No default change; options off.

name_en: Real DFT demonstration in Quantum ESPRESSO (DFT-DEMO-QE)
name_zh: QE 真实 DFT 演示（DFT-DEMO-QE）
idea_en: A scout with a cheap sketch map marks likely mountain passes; a costly surveyor starts from those marks, and a pass counts only when the surveyor's own instruments confirm it. NEP89 transition-state candidates and their NEP Hessians seeded Sella on real Quantum ESPRESSO PBE forces, followed by a strict DFT certificate (finite-difference Hessian with one negative mode, two-sided descent to the IS); the direct arm ran DFT Sella from a bond-stretch guess.
idea_zh: 侦察兵粗略标出可能的山口，测量队从标记出发，亲测确认才算数。NEP89 过渡态候选及其 Hessian 作起点，在真实 QE 力上用 Sella 精修，再做严格 DFT 认证（有限差分 Hessian 恰一负模、两侧下降回初态）；对照臂从键拉伸初猜直接做 DFT Sella。
systems_en: Real Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 on CPUs: PBE, PAW 55/440 Ry, 3×3×1 k-points; only SCF converged to 1e-14 Ry passed the force-accuracy gate. Single H on Cu(111) was refused by the input check, a CO/top DFT IS had two negative curvatures and was rejected, and a full-size 3×3×3 Cu(111) OH comparison was stopped by the pre-registered cost rule at 71/68 DFT calls (incomplete, not a negative). Main test: 2×2×2 Cu(111) with 8 fixed Cu and 2 free adsorbate atoms, CO/fcc and OH/fcc, one NEP candidate per arm; development only. In total 1,174 real QE runs and 11.77 node-hours.
systems_zh: CPU 版 Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5：PBE、PAW 55/440 Ry、3×3×1 k 点；只有收敛到 1e-14 Ry 的自洽计算通过力精度门槛。Cu(111) 单 H 被输入检查拒绝；CO 顶位的 DFT 初态有两个负曲率而被拒；全尺寸 3×3×3 Cu(111) OH 比较按预注册成本规则在 71/68 次 DFT 调用时停止（未完成，不算阴性）。主检验：2×2×2 Cu(111)（8 个固定 Cu + 2 个自由吸附原子），CO/fcc 与 OH/fcc，每臂一个 NEP 候选；仅开发集。全轮共 1,174 次真实 QE 计算、11.77 节点时。
result_en: Pre-registered test: NEP→DFT found 0 U in 165 DFT calls, direct DFT 0 U in 199; ratio undefined. Post hoc, not blind: NEP arm 1 U per 568 calls vs direct 1 U per 482 → 0.849, no CI or p, and the arms found different saddles; 0/3 original NEP events survived as DFT saddles. Warm SCF restarts cut wall time to 0.60–0.73× at equal calls. No NEP-prior saving shown.
result_zh: 预注册：NEP→DFT 165 次调用、直接 DFT 199 次调用均得 U=0，比值无定义。事后非盲：NEP 臂 1 U/568 次，直接臂 1 U/482 次 → 0.849，无置信区间与 p，且为不同鞍点；原 NEP 事件 0/3 存活。未显示节省。

name_en: NEP explores, an expensive potential judges (TWO-LEVEL)
name_zh: NEP 探索、昂贵势面裁判（TWO-LEVEL）
idea_en: A cheap drone scouts the whole range and pins every pass it sees; a ground team then climbs only from those pins, carrying the drone's slope readings, and certifies each pass on foot. NEP89 explored as usual; each NEP transition state plus its NEP Hessian seeded refinement on a costlier target surface, with full dense target certification. The target was synthetic (NEP plus a symmetric Gaussian pair-field perturbation), not real DFT.
idea_zh: 无人机先低成本飞遍山区、标出看到的山口；地面队只从这些标记出发，带着无人机测的坡度攀登，并逐一徒步认证。NEP89 照常探索，每个 NEP 过渡态及其 Hessian 作为昂贵目标势面上精修的起点，保留完整密集认证；目标势面是合成的（NEP + 对称高斯对势扰动），不是 DFT。
systems_en: Primary: 12 DEV-A IS (6 metal, 6 non-metal, N_free ≤ 200) × 2 seeds × 3 perturbation amplitudes (0.05, 0.10, 0.20 eV). Breadth run: 110 IS (79 metal, 31 non-metal; 70 DEV-A + 40 DEV-B), 660 pairs. Development only; no confirmation pool.
systems_zh: 主检验：12 个 DEV-A 初态（6 金属、6 非金属，N_free ≤ 200）× 2 个种子 × 3 档扰动幅度（0.05、0.10、0.20 eV）。广度测试：110 个初态（79 金属、31 非金属；DEV-A 70 + DEV-B 40），共 660 对。仅开发集，无确认池。
result_en: At 0.10 eV, U per expensive DFT-equivalent call 2.029× [1.624, 2.411], p < 0.00025, but U fell 145→100 (−31 %); U/ionic step 0.562 [0.389, 0.721]. Pricing NEP calls like expensive ones gives 0.646 (break-even price ratio 0.481). Breadth run: 1.883 [1.738, 2.030], U 1026→781. About twice as efficient per expensive call but misses saddles; synthetic target only, so opt-in APIs.
result_zh: 0.10 eV 档：U/昂贵 DFT 当量调用 2.029 倍 [1.624, 2.411]，p<0.00025，但 U 145→100（−31%）；NEP 调用同价时仅 0.646。广度测试 1.883 倍。效率约翻倍但漏鞍点；仅合成势面，可选 API。

name_en: Explicit water layers on metal surfaces (WATER-LAYER-BOUNDARY)
name_zh: 金属表面显式水层边界（WATER-LAYER-BOUNDARY）
idea_en: At a crowded party, a reporter following one conversation listens to the people next to the speakers, not to every pair of guests chatting across the room. On metal surfaces covered by explicit water, the default enumerates many water–water bond drives; three off-by-default options skipped all water–water drives (I1), skipped only water–water pairs more than 3.5 Å from the active H/O/OH/CO atoms (I2), or tried adsorbate drives first (I4).
idea_zh: 在喧闹的聚会上跟踪一段对话，只需听说话人身边的人，不必听远处每一对闲聊。显式水层覆盖的金属表面上，默认会枚举大量水–水键驱动；三个默认关闭的选项分别跳过全部水–水驱动（I1）、只跳过离活性 H/O/OH/CO 超过 3.5 Å 的水–水驱动（I2），或先试吸附物驱动（I4）。
systems_en: Lab-built water layers on Pt, Cu and Au(111) with active H, O, OH or CO and co-adsorbates, outside every campaign pool: W1 3×3×3 slabs with 7 H2O (11 IS); W2 six waters (10 IS, 2 seeds); W3 12 co-adsorbate designs (10 IS); W4 4×4×4 slabs with 8 waters (10 IS, 4 seeds); W5 three water layers with 12 H2O (9 IS, 4 seeds). Reference `long-best-auto-80`; development only. No electrode potential or electrolyte, and NEP89 binds a single water to Cu too strongly (−0.669 eV vs about −0.26 eV in DFT).
systems_zh: 本轮自建、不属于任何活动池的水层体系：Pt/Cu/Au(111) 上活性 H、O、OH 或 CO 及共吸附物。W1：3×3×3 板、7 个 H2O（11 个初态）；W2：6 个水（10 个初态，2 个种子）；W3：12 种共吸附设计（10 个初态）；W4：4×4×4 板、8 个水（10 个初态，4 个种子）；W5：三层共 12 个 H2O（9 个初态，4 个种子）。参照 `long-best-auto-80`；仅开发集。无电极电位与电解质；NEP89 对 Cu 上单水吸附偏强（−0.669 eV，DFT 约 −0.26 eV）。
result_en: W5 remote-water filter (I2): U_chem/call 1.206× [1.009, 1.377], p = 0.01875, Holm p = 0.0375, but U_chem 58→55 and strict U 133→101 (−24.06 %). W1 skip-all filter (I1): 1.586 [1.286, 2.002], yet Pt U 15→8 failed the per-metal guard. Active-first ordering (I4, W5): 1.078 [0.906, 1.422], Holm p 0.254. Inconclusive boundary result: gains come with lost chemistry on some metals; all options off.
result_zh: W5 远程水过滤：U_chem/调用 1.206 倍 [1.009, 1.377]，Holm p=0.0375，但 U_chem 58→55、严格 U 133→101。W1 全跳过：1.586 倍，但 Pt 上 U 15→8，未过逐金属护栏。选项关闭。

name_en: Multi-core wall clock for the v0.80 default (PARALLEL-80)
name_zh: v0.80 默认的多核墙钟加速（PARALLEL-80）
idea_en: A kitchen with many cooks serves sooner, but cooks who start new dishes before tasting the last one waste ingredients; cooks idle at closing time can still help whoever is slowest. The round measured `--workers K` on `long-best-auto-80` and tested two off-by-default uses of idle cores at a batch tail: lending them to the longest-running searches (E1), or handing a serial search's remaining launches to parallel workers (E5).
idea_zh: 厨师多了出菜更快，但没尝完上一道就开做下一道会浪费食材；收尾时闲下来的厨师还能去帮最慢的那位。本轮测量 v0.80 默认的 `--workers K`，并测试两种默认关闭的批尾闲核用法：借给剩余时间最长的搜索（E1），或把串行搜索的剩余启动交给并行进程（E5）。
systems_en: 12 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds: six surfaces (methoxy/Cu(111); formic acid, ethylene glycol and glycolaldehyde+2H on Pt(111); acetylene+2H/Pd(111); CH3/Ni(111)) and six porous hosts (two H-CHA, three H-MFI, one H-FER), with K = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16. Batch tests E1 and E5 on 8 IS × 2 seeds; the older out-of-order mode on 6 IS × 2 seeds. Development only.
systems_zh: 12 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子：6 个表面（Cu(111) 甲氧基；Pt(111) 上甲酸、乙二醇、乙醇醛+2H；Pd(111) 乙炔+2H；Ni(111) CH3）与 6 个多孔体系（H-CHA 2 个、H-MFI 3 个、H-FER 1 个），K = 1、2、4、8、16。批处理检验 E1、E5 各用 8 个初态 × 2 个种子；旧乱序模式对照 6 个初态 × 2 个种子。仅开发集。
result_en: `--workers 16`: 3.136× faster wall clock but U/call 0.868 [0.775, 0.927]; K = 8: 2.575×, 0.929 [0.854, 0.973]. E1 tail cores: U/call 1.0001 [0.9999, 1.0006], p 0.14, U 189→189, but batch makespans only 1.022× and 1.073×. E5: 0.998 [0.995, 1.000], makespans 0.969× and 1.179×. Out-of-order `virtual+displaced`: 0.811× (slower). Advice: one serial search per IS, parallelise across IS.

name_en: Quickstart, run inspection and Chinese guide (QUICKSTART-ZH)
name_zh: 新手快速上手与中文指南（QUICKSTART-ZH）
idea_en: Before a first climb, a guide checks your boots, map and permit at the trailhead, hands you a written route, and later lets you check progress from base camp. `dimer-explore quickstart` is a zero-force-call preflight that checks the model file and hash, elements, structure and roles and prints copyable commands; `inspect RUN` reads progress and DFT-handoff status without changing anything; a Chinese walk-through guide was added. Search settings were untouched.
idea_zh: 首次登山前，向导在山脚检查你的鞋、地图和许可并递上路线，之后可在大本营看进度。`dimer-explore quickstart` 是零力调用预检，核对模型哈希、元素、结构和角色并打印可复制命令；`inspect RUN` 只读查看进度与 DFT 交接；另附中文教程。搜索不变。
systems_en: Three self-built development systems outside all pools: CO on Pt(211) (26 atoms), NH3 in an H-SOD cage and H2O on Cu21Pd3(111), × 2 seeds; default, more, low-barrier, network and DFT-handoff workflows plus `--goal` variants, 270/270 workflows exited cleanly. No human test users and no DFT.
systems_zh: 3 个自建开发体系（不属于任何池）：Pt(211)+CO（26 个原子）、H-SOD 笼中 NH3、Cu21Pd3(111) 上 H2O，× 2 个种子；覆盖默认、更多、低势垒、网络与 DFT 交接流程及 `--goal` 变体，270/270 个流程正常退出。无真人用户测试，未做 DFT。
result_en: Search unchanged: U 18→18, per-IS seed union 9→9; common-priced U/call 1.0000 [1.0000, 1.0000] (the raw 1.0132 was JIT/pricing noise). The hoped-for ≥ 25 % cut in user decisions was not reached. External ASE LBFGS endpoint relaxation matched only 3/9 saddles, with 8 force-converged false minima; an opt-in guarded LBFGS matched 9/9 at equal cost (2,117 vs 2,118 calls), unconfirmed. `quickstart`/`inspect` shipped in v0.81.0.
result_zh: 搜索不变：U 18→18，统一计价 U/调用 1.0000 [1.0000, 1.0000]；预期的决策减少 ≥25% 未达成。ASE LBFGS 端点松弛仅 3/9 匹配，护栏版同代价 9/9（可选，未确认）。两个新命令随 v0.81.0 发布。

idea_en: Give the climber a map drawn in the adsorbate's own bonds, bends and torsions instead of a Cartesian street grid. Sella ran in hybrid internal coordinates (adsorbate internals plus Cartesian components), seeded with the already-paid exact IS Hessian transformed into them (I1); a backup arm stayed Cartesian and only corrected the starting Hessian through bounded bond-geometry transport (I2).
idea_zh: 不再给登山者一张直角坐标的“街道图”，而是按吸附物自身键长、键角和二面角画的地形图。Sella 改在混合内坐标中运行，并用变换到内坐标的已付费初态精确 Hessian 起步（I1）；备用臂仍用直角坐标，只按键几何变化有界地输运起步 Hessian（I2）。
systems_en: All 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites: GF3 dev set plus F1, F2 and F3 dev) × 2 seeds × 2 arms for each candidate, reference `long-best-auto-80`, after six-IS pilots (4 metal, 2 H-CHA). The held-out pool P1 was never opened.
systems_zh: 全部 85 个 DEV-A 初态（金属表面与分子筛：GF3 开发集 + F1/F2/F3 开发集）× 2 个种子 × 2 臂，参照 `long-best-auto-80`；此前先在 6 个初态（4 金属、2 个 H-CHA）上预试。留出池 P1 未打开。
result_en: I1 internal-coordinate Sella: U/call 0.507× [0.390, 0.687], U 940→885 (−5.9 %); extra Davidson re-diagonalisation raised Sella walk calls 7.51×. I2 Hessian transport: 0.988× [0.961, 1.015], U 971→941, family guards failed. I1 is about half as efficient and I2 brings no gain; both options left off.
result_zh: 内坐标 Sella：U/调用 0.507 倍 [0.390, 0.687]，U 940→885（−5.9%），行走调用增至 7.51 倍，效率约减半。Hessian 输运：0.988 倍 [0.961, 1.015]，无收益且分族护栏未过。选项关闭。

name_en: Exact Hessian at every walker start (START-HESSIAN-FAST)
idea_en: Before setting off, a hiker could survey the full terrain around the starting point instead of following the direction the trail was already heading. With the fast JAX kernel, the ALL arm bought an exact Hessian at every walker start: it replaced Sella's initial Hessian, and the zeolite dimer took the lowest mode plus one RFO first step. Cheaper pivots used a 4-HVP Ritz mode, a BDF2 tangent or an IS-Hessian blend.
idea_zh: 出发前先把四周地形测全，而不只沿来路方向走。借助快速 JAX 核，ALL 臂在每个行走起点算精确 Hessian：替换 Sella 初始 Hessian，分子筛 dimer 改用最低模并先走一步 RFO。较便宜的备选：Ritz 模、BDF2 切向、初态 Hessian 混合。
systems_en: Pilot (H0): 12 DEV-A IS (8 metal, 4 zeolite) × 1 seed. The two final pivots ran on the 309-IS development pool, 1 seed: all 85 DEV-A IS + 224 DEV-B IS (C1, C2, C3 and F4 dev; 2 inputs refused). Reference `long-best-auto-80`; the held-out pool P2 was not opened.
systems_zh: 预试（H0）：12 个 DEV-A 初态（8 金属、4 分子筛）× 1 个种子。最后两个备选在 309 个初态的开发池上检验，1 个种子：全部 85 个 DEV-A + 224 个 DEV-B（C1、C2、C3 与 F4 开发集；2 个输入被拒）。参照 `long-best-auto-80`；留出池 P2 未打开。
result_en: ALL (12-IS pilot): U/call 0.933 [0.798, 1.032], U −26.9 %, U/DFT-equivalent call 0.605 [0.472, 0.723]; the true lowest mode overlapped the scan direction with median |cos| 0.172, pulling walkers off the chemical branch (zeolite U 56→29). CONVEX 0.891, RITZ4 0.9766 and RITZSAFE 0.9993 were killed; on 309 IS, BDF2-TANGENT 1.00044 [0.98467, 1.01782] and IS-BLEND 1.00073 [0.99333, 1.00765]. No gain; all off.
result_zh: ALL 预试（12 个初态）：U/调用 0.933 [0.798, 1.032]，U −26.9%；真实最低模与扫描方向 |cos| 中位数 0.172，行走偏离化学分支。其余备选或被淘汰，或在 309 个初态上约 1.000。无收益，全部关闭。

name_en: Transplanting parent saddles to child states (NETWORK-TS-TRANSFER)
idea_en: After one room of a house is renovated, the doors at the far end are probably still where they were, so a builder checks them first instead of re-surveying everything. In depth-2 reaction networks, parent saddles whose reaction centre lay at least 3 Å from the parent→child change were copied onto the child state, keeping only displacements near that centre (full weight within 3 Å, none beyond 5 Å), then refined and strictly certified.
idea_zh: 房子里一个房间装修后，远处房间的门多半还在原处，先去核对它们比整栋重测省事。在深度 2 反应网络中，把反应中心距父→子变化至少 3 Å 的父态鞍点迁移到子态，只复制该中心附近的位移（3 Å 内权重 1，5 Å 外为 0），再在子态精修并严格认证。
systems_en: Depth-2 networks grown from 24 DEV-A roots (12 metal, 12 non-metal; original systems and F1, F2, F3 dev) × 2 seeds × 2 arms = 96 networks; reference `long-best-auto-80` networks with transfer off. The backup known-exact arm reused the same 24 roots with 2 new seeds. The held-out pool P3 was not opened.
systems_zh: 从 24 个 DEV-A 根初态（12 金属、12 非金属；早期体系与 F1/F2/F3 开发集）生长深度 2 网络，× 2 个种子 × 2 臂 = 96 个网络；参照为关闭迁移的 `long-best-auto-80` 网络。备选 known-exact 臂在同 24 个根上换 2 个新种子。留出池 P3 未打开。
result_en: Only 3 of 24 roots produced proposals: 25 proposals gave 22 new child channels. Local transfer, strict network saddles per call (N/call) 1.00606 [0.99982, 1.01404], p = 0.0865, N 818→825, below the pre-registered 1.03 gate. Backup known-exact transfer: 1.00285 [0.99817, 1.00777], p = 0.161 (its 3.410 pilot was descriptive only). No detectable gain; options off.
result_zh: 仅 3/24 个根有提案，25 个提案得 22 个新通道。局域迁移：严格网络鞍点 N 818→825，N/调用 1.00606 [0.99982, 1.01404]（门槛 1.03），p=0.0865；known-exact 备选 1.00285。无可测收益。

name_en: Watching the second mode in zeolite dimers (TWO-MODE-DIMER)
name_zh: 分子筛 dimer 双模控制（TWO-MODE-DIMER）
idea_en: A climber who feels the ground fall away in two directions at once is near a higher-order summit, not a simple pass, and should watch both slopes. For the zeolite dimer, the final arm F extended the existing six-step Lanczos core with two preconditioned directions that track the second Ritz mode, keeping mode continuity near degeneracy; an earlier arm A made one escape step along the second mode when a walker stalled.
idea_zh: 如果脚下同时向两个方向下降，登山者站的是更高阶的山顶而非简单山口，应同时留意两个坡向。针对分子筛 dimer，最终 F 臂在现有六步 Lanczos 核上增加两个预条件方向，跟踪第二 Ritz 模，并在近简并时保持模式连续；早先 A 臂在行走停滞时沿第二模逃逸一步。
systems_en: Zeolite IS only. Pilots on 12 DEV-A zeolite IS. Final arm F: 90 zeolite IS (24 DEV-A + 66 DEV-B) × 2 seeds × 3 arms (reference, existing Lanczos core, F) = 540 sessions, plus an 8-metal-IS check that metals are untouched. Reference `long-best-auto-80`; the held-out pool P1 was not opened.
systems_zh: 仅分子筛初态。预试用 12 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态。最终 F 臂：90 个分子筛初态（DEV-A 24 + DEV-B 66）× 2 个种子 × 3 臂（参照、现有 Lanczos 核、F）= 540 次会话，另用 8 个金属初态检查对金属无影响。参照 `long-best-auto-80`；留出池 P1 未打开。
result_en: In the pilot, 178/329 (54.1 %) failed zeolite walkers had a second negative curvature (λ₂ < −0.05), but F added nothing over the existing core: U/call 0.98639 [0.96303, 1.01290], p = 0.854, U 1508→1530 (+1.46 %). F vs reference, 1.11577 [1.07104, 1.15971], came mostly from the core itself (core vs reference 1.13117). Arm A: only 4.10 % of stalls showed a second negative mode, killed. Options off.
result_zh: 预试中 54.1% 失败行走有第二负曲率，但 F 较现有核无增益：U/调用 0.98639 [0.96303, 1.01290]，U +1.46%；F 对参照的 1.11577 来自现有核（1.13117）。A 仅 4.10% 停滞有第二负模，淘汰。选项关闭。

idea_en: If you only want passes below 1 km, there is little point letting a climber gain 1.5 km above wherever he set out. With `--max-barrier E`, walkers still stopped only after climbing a fixed 1.5 eV above their start; SCALE set that climb cap to E, and ENV instead added an absolute envelope of E + m above the IS (m = 0.6 eV on metals, 1.5 eV elsewhere). Both are off by default.
idea_zh: 只要 1 公里以下的山口，就不必让登山者从出发点再爬 1.5 公里。`--max-barrier E` 时行走仍在高出起点 1.5 eV 后才停；SCALE 把该上限改为 E，ENV 另加相对初态 E + m 的上限（金属 m=0.6 eV，其他 1.5 eV）。均默认关闭。
systems_en: Reference `long-lowbarrier-auto-80` at the same E. Pilot (H0) on 12 DEV-A IS; development test on 73 further DEV-A IS × 1 seed, then the pre-registered extension to 297 IS (those 73 + 224 DEV-B IS: C1, C2, C3 and F4 dev; 2 inputs refused). An E = 0.8 eV trial was also run. The held-out pool P2 was not opened.
systems_zh: 参照为同一 E 下的 `long-lowbarrier-auto-80`。预试（H0）用 12 个 DEV-A 初态；开发检验用另外 73 个 DEV-A 初态 × 1 个种子，再按预注册扩到 297 个初态（这 73 个 + 224 个 DEV-B：C1、C2、C3 与 F4 开发集；2 个输入被拒）。另试 E = 0.8 eV。留出池 P2 未打开。
result_en: SCALE at E = 1 eV on 297 IS: U(≤1.0)/call 1.0200 [1.0122, 1.0279], p < 0.00025, U 971→963 (−0.824 %); U/ionic step 1.0309 [1.0202, 1.0409]; U/DFT-equivalent call 1.0141 [1.0074, 1.0205]. Real but below the pre-registered > 1.05 gate, so not confirmed. ENV's first 1.084 was a compile/cache artefact (warm rerun 0.9998). E = 0.8: 1.0429 [0.9799, 1.0853], zeolite guard failed. Options off.

name_en: Lifting the adsorbate off the surface (LIFT-DRIVES)
idea_en: Like peeling a fridge magnet straight off the door rather than prying one edge. A new 'lift' coordinate treated an adsorbate atom plus its hydrogens as one unit and raised it in eight 0.15 Å steps away from the substrate atoms it touches (or the nearest within 3.5 Å), relaxing everything else, then handed the highest-energy point to the usual walker. Variants used bonded contacts only or appended a fragment-pushing phase.
idea_zh: 像把冰箱贴整片垂直揭下，而不是只撬一个角。新增“抬升”坐标：把一个吸附原子连同它的 H 当作小单元，相对它已接触的基底原子（或 3.5 Å 内最近的基底原子）分 8 步、每步 0.15 Å 抬高，其余自由度弛豫，再把能量最高点交给原有行走器；变体只用成键接触，或追加片段推离阶段。
systems_en: All 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS (metal surfaces and zeolites; two O+H inputs rejected before search) × 2 seeds: 1,228 completed runs per comparison against the default `long-best-auto-80`. No held-out confirmation was run.
systems_zh: DEV-A + DEV-B 全部 309 个初态（金属表面与分子筛；2 个 O+H 输入在搜索前被拒）× 2 个种子，每个比较 1,228 次完成运行，参照为默认 `long-best-auto-80`；未做留出确认。
result_en: Bonded-only lift (E): U +4.1 % (3,347→3,483) but U/call 1.006× [0.992, 1.020] and U per DFT-equivalent call 1.011× [0.999, 1.024]. Including weak anchors (C): U 3,347→3,524, yet U/call 1.0028× (metals 0.9751). The fragment-pushing bundle F reached 1.019× per ionic step. None passed the 1.03 development gate, so nothing went to confirmation; options stay off.

name_en: Guest soft modes in zeolite searches (ZEO-SOFT-MODE-PROJECTION)
idea_en: A guest molecule in a zeolite cage rattles like a marble in a box. The main arm charged that rattling less against the walker's leash: soft rigid-body directions of each guest came from the IS Hessian (eigenvalues ≤ 0.5 eV/Å²), and displacement along them counted only partly toward the dimer's search radius (r_eff² = r² − 0.5‖Qᵀδ‖², capped at 1.25 R). Other arms (mode projection, damping, a Sella Hessian floor) were killed at screening.
idea_zh: 分子筛笼里的客体像盒中弹珠整体晃动。主臂少计这种晃动：由初态 Hessian 取每个客体的刚体软方向（本征值 ≤ 0.5 eV/Å²），沿其位移平方只按一半计入 dimer 搜索半径（上限 1.25 R）。模投影、阻尼、Sella Hessian 下限等臂在筛选中被淘汰。
systems_en: 94 IS × 2 seeds (376 sessions): 90 zeolite IS from DEV-A + DEV-B plus 4 Ag-surface metal controls; then 24 DEV-A zeolites × 2 seeds on top of the round-300 zeolite stack. No confirmation pool was opened.
systems_zh: 94 个初态 × 2 个种子（376 个会话）：DEV-A + DEV-B 中的 90 个分子筛初态加 4 个 Ag 表面金属对照；另在第 300 轮分子筛栈之上测试 24 个 DEV-A 分子筛 × 2 个种子。未打开确认池。
result_en: Development (94 IS): U/call 0.976× [0.966, 0.984] with U +1.44 % (1,324→1,343); U/ionic step 0.97145, U per DFT-equivalent call 0.98410; chemistry guards failed. On the round-300 zeolite stack: 0.99621× [0.99453, 0.99756], 555→555 saddles, none new. The other arms failed their screens. Negative; nothing confirmed, options off.

name_en: Fair baselines, including an EON-style search (BASELINES-80)
name_zh: 公平基线与 EON 式搜索
idea_en: A fair race: same fuel tank and same finish-line judge for every contender. Six methods ran on the same NEP89 surface and IS certificates, capped at 16,000 charged force calls per IS and seed, with identical strict validation and deduplication. The EON-style baseline is an independent re-implementation, not the EON code: random local Gaussian kicks (σ = 0.1 Å) to adsorbate atoms and mobile neighbours within 3 Å, whose direction starts an ASE dimer.
idea_zh: 公平赛跑：同一油箱、同一裁判。六种方法共用 NEP89 势面与初态证书，每初态每种子限 16,000 次力调用，验证与去重相同。EON 式基线为独立实现（非 EON 程序）：对吸附物原子及 3 Å 内可动邻居做 σ=0.1 Å 高斯随机位移，以此方向启动 ASE dimer。
systems_en: σ picked on a 16-IS DEV-A pilot; development on 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds × 6 arms; confirmation on P2 = 63 G-FACTORY-5 IS (36 metal + 27 porous) × 2 seeds × 6 arms (756 sessions). Arms: `long-best-auto-80`, EON-style, ASE dimer, Sella FAIR-PLUS, a longer-budget Sella (descriptive only) and `long-best`.
systems_zh: 16 个 DEV-A 初态小试选定 σ；开发：85 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子 × 6 臂；确认：P2 池 63 个 G-FACTORY-5 初态（36 金属 + 27 多孔）× 2 个种子 × 6 臂（756 个会话）。六臂：`long-best-auto-80`、EON 式、ASE dimer、Sella FAIR-PLUS、长预算 Sella（仅描述）和 `long-best`。
result_en: P2 confirmation: `long-best-auto-80` had 5.144× [4.449, 6.019] the U/call of the EON-style search (7.81 vs 2.25 saddles per run), 6.867× the ASE dimer, 1.747× [1.392, 2.237] Sella FAIR-PLUS and 1.215× `long-best`, all Holm-significant. Not a clean sweep: versus FAIR-PLUS, per ionic step 1.092× (n.s.) and low-barrier saddles per call 0.782×. EON-style later ranked last in GF8 (0.487 U per 1,000 ionic steps).
result_zh: P2：`long-best-auto-80` 的 U/调用为 EON 式的 5.144 倍 [4.449, 6.019]，ASE dimer 的 6.867 倍，FAIR-PLUS 的 1.747 倍，均显著；对后者每离子步不显著。EON 式在 GF8 垫底。

name_en: Recovering zeolite saddles lost by v0.80 (ZEO-U-RECOVERY)
idea_en: A lost-and-found check: v0.80 found fewer zeolite saddles than the legacy preset, and 77 of 83 legacy-only saddles came from bonds v0.80 had also driven, pointing at the walker's starting direction. A guarded start used the free scan tangent as the dimer's initial mode only if the scan top was concave and the tangent aligned with the bond (|cos| ≥ 0.25); otherwise the default bond-stretch direction, at no extra calls.
idea_zh: 像失物招领核对：v0.80 在分子筛上比旧预设少找到鞍点，83 个旧版独有鞍点中 77 个来自 v0.80 也驱动过的键，问题指向行走器出发方向。“守卫”起始仅在扫描顶点呈凹形且切线与键夹角余弦绝对值≥0.25 时用免费扫描切线作 dimer 初始模，否则用键方向，不增加力调用。
systems_en: Archive comparison on 24 DEV-A zeolites; 16 arms screened on 12 zeolites (1 seed); 70 DEV-A + DEV-B zeolite IS × 2 seeds; confirmation on 25 P3 zeolite IS × 2 seeds × 3 arms (legacy `long-best-auto`, `long-best-auto-80`, round-300 TGW stack), 150 sessions.
systems_zh: 24 个 DEV-A 分子筛的存档对比；12 个分子筛上筛选 16 臂（1 个种子）；DEV-A + DEV-B 的 70 个分子筛初态 × 2 个种子；确认：P3 池 25 个分子筛初态 × 2 个种子 × 3 臂（旧 `long-best-auto`、`long-best-auto-80`、第 300 轮 TGW 栈），共 150 个会话。
result_en: The guarded start raised U 17.4 % on 12 zeolites but U/call fell to 0.894× [0.832, 0.950], so it was killed, as was a retry-after-abort fallback (0.929). Re-testing the round-300 TGW stack against `long-best-auto-80` on fresh P3 zeolites: U/call 1.215× [1.156, 1.289], p < 0.00025, U +26.1 %, U/ionic step 1.149×, but only 27 of 157 legacy-only saddles came back and core-seconds per saddle rose 26.6 %.

name_en: Reusing paid product certificates across sessions (PRODUCT-CERT-LIGHT)
idea_en: Like a building inspector who, on a second visit, keeps the stamped certificates of rooms already inspected. When the same IS is searched again with the same release and model, the run preloads product-minimum certificates (exact Hessian plus branch checks) already paid for and verified in a completed earlier session; no saddles, candidates or scan memory are imported, and the earlier session's cost stays on the bill.
idea_zh: 像验房师第二次上门时沿用已盖章的房间验收单。对同一初态、同一版本和势函数再搜一次时，预先载入前一次已完成会话中已付费、已核验的产物极小值证书（精确 Hessian 与分支检查）；不导入任何鞍点、候选或扫描记忆，源会话的费用照常计入。
systems_en: Development: 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds × 2 arms (340 sessions). Confirmation: P1 = 72 sealed G-FACTORY-4 IS (47 metal, 25 non-metal) × 2 seeds (288 sessions).
systems_zh: 开发：85 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子 × 2 臂（340 个会话）；确认：P1 池 72 个密封 G-FACTORY-4 初态（47 金属、25 非金属）× 2 个种子（288 个会话）。
result_en: P1 confirmation: U per DFT-equivalent call 1.0735× [1.0615, 1.0840], p < 0.00025; per NEP call only 1.0056× [1.0033, 1.0080]; 2198/2198 decisions identical, U 1224→1224, attempt Hessians 2519→1939. A symmetry cache (0/497 hits) and a merge-first recheck were killed first. Useful only if a second search of the same IS is run anyway; off by default, shipped in v0.81 as an explicit opt-in.
result_zh: P1 确认：U/DFT 当量调用 1.0735 [1.0615, 1.0840]，p<0.00025；U/NEP 调用仅 1.0056；2198/2198 判决相同，U 1224→1224。仅当本就要对同一初态再搜时有用；默认关闭，v0.81 中为显式可选项。

name_en: Calling off doomed dimer walks early (EARLY-EXIT-ABORT)
idea_en: Like a search party recalling a hiker whose slope only keeps steepening, rather than waiting until he walks off the map. The dimer walker stopped once the curvature along its mode had stayed positive for 8 steps and was still rising (also screened: time to leave the search sphere, mode rotation, energy drop). Pivots spent a one-shot 6-call Lanczos probe for hidden negative directions before stopping, or used it only to rescue walks.
idea_zh: 像搜救队把脚下坡度越走越陡的登山者提前叫回，而不是等他走出地图。dimer 行走器在模方向曲率连续 8 步为正且仍在上升时提前停止（另筛选：离开搜索球的时间、模转动、能量下跌）。后续变体在停止前用一次 6 次力调用的 Lanczos 探测隐藏的负曲率方向，或只用它挽救行走。
systems_en: Rules screened by replaying recorded traces of the 85 DEV-A IS; paired development run on all 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS (219 metal, 90 non-metal), 1 seed; pivots screened on 24 non-metal DEV-A IS and 24 DEV-B IS, plus a 12-zeolite, 2-seed cost check. No confirmation pool opened.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 初态的已记录轨迹上重放筛选规则；DEV-A + DEV-B 全部 309 个初态（219 金属、90 非金属）× 1 个种子成对开发运行；后续变体在 24 个 DEV-A 非金属初态和 24 个 DEV-B 初态上筛选，另有 12 个分子筛 × 2 个种子的成本核对。未打开确认池。
result_en: Development (309 IS): curvature stop U/call 1.011× [1.006, 1.015], p < 0.00025, but 10 strict saddles lost (1,671→1,661, all non-metal) and U per DFT-equivalent call 0.989; below the 1.03 gate. Lanczos-verified stop: 0.99897× [0.99286, 1.00438], p = 0.627. Rescue-only (0.98640×) and a mode-swing rule (1.00177×) failed screening. Negative; options off.

name_en: Extra walkers from one paid bond scan (SCAN-BRANCH-HARVEST)
name_zh: 复用一次扫描收获多分支
idea_en: A miner who has dug one shaft tries side tunnels from it. After the normal walk from a bond scan's top, extra walkers started from the same paid scan: along the bare bond direction (A), or after small ± displacements along the scan tangent's part orthogonal to the bond (B; ≤ 0.18 Å per atom, ≤ 2 walks). Later arms tried neighbouring scan stages, soft-mode spectator nudges and alternative start modes.
idea_zh: 像矿工在已挖好的竖井里横向开支巷，而不是另挖新井。常规行走之后，从同一次已付费键扫描的顶点再发出额外行走器：沿裸键方向（A），或沿扫描切线中与键正交的分量做 ± 小位移（B；每原子 ≤ 0.18 Å，最多 2 次）。后续各臂改用相邻扫描级、软模旁观原子位移和其他起始模。
systems_en: A and B each on 85 DEV-A IS (metal surfaces and zeolites) × 2 seeds × 2 arms (340 sessions); later variants on 12-IS DEV-A pilots. The P3 confirmation pool was never opened.
systems_zh: A、B 各在 85 个 DEV-A 初态（金属表面与分子筛）× 2 个种子 × 2 臂（340 个会话）上测试；其余变体在 12 个 DEV-A 初态的小试上测试。P3 确认池未打开。
result_en: Arm A on DEV-A: U +9.2 % (948→1,035) but U/call 0.896× [0.869, 0.920], U/ionic step 0.861, U per DFT-equivalent call 0.926, about 3,331 calls per net extra saddle. Arm B: 0.884× [0.857, 0.910]. Each 1 % more saddles cost about 1.1 % per-call efficiency, far above the `--more` preset; all later variants failed their screens. Negative; options off.

name_zh: 跳过规则审计与金属接触拉断
idea_en: First, audit the doorman's list: did the pre-scan skip rules (signature, symmetry, water pruning) turn away reaction coordinates leading to saddles seen in the round-315 census? Then open a new door: after the default search, a migration phase (`migration_phase=metal-break`) stretched up to three weak adsorbate–metal contacts, each with the usual relaxed scan, saddle search and strict validation.
idea_zh: 先核对门卫的拒入名单：扫描前的跳过规则（签名、对称、水剪枝）是否挡掉了普查中通向鞍点的反应坐标？再开一扇新门：默认搜索后加一个迁移阶段（`migration_phase=metal-break`），最多拉伸三个较弱的吸附物–金属接触，各做常规弛豫扫描、鞍点搜索与严格验证。
systems_en: Zero-call audit of the census of the 85 DEV-A IS; 8-IS screens; full development on all 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS × 2 seeds (214 metal-contact IS run paired, the rest replayed); a non-metal add-on on 90 non-metal IS × 2 seeds. No held-out pool opened.
systems_zh: 对 85 个 DEV-A 初态的普查做零调用审计；8 个初态小试；DEV-A + DEV-B 全部 309 个初态 × 2 个种子的开发运行（214 个有金属接触的初态成对实测，其余重放）；非金属附加项在 90 个非金属初态 × 2 个种子上测试。未打开留出池。
result_en: Audit: 6.01 % of signature skips and 13.64 % of symmetry skips hit a missed census saddle's coordinate (not proven losses). Contact phase: U/call 1.01223× [1.00367, 1.02095], U 3,350→3,496, but metals alone 0.99717, a composition effect. Plus a non-metal early-rejection shortcut: 1.022× [1.012, 1.032], U +4.2 %, yet 8 validated paths wrongly rejected. Both below the 1.03 gate: not confirmed. The contact phase later fed the round-378 `--more` candidate.
result_zh: 接触拉断：U/调用 1.01223 [1.00367, 1.02095]，U 3,350→3,496，金属 0.99717（组成效应）；加非金属单侧早拒 1.022，但误拒 8 条有效路径。均低于 1.03 门槛；接触阶段后入第 378 轮 `--more`。

name_en: Imprinting known saddles onto look-alike sites (TS-FAMILY-ENUMERATION)
idea_en: Family resemblance: once you know how one cupboard hinge swings, try the same motion on its look-alike hinges. The bond lengths that change in an already certified transition state were imposed on chemically similar, symmetry-inequivalent atom sets of the same IS ('imprint'), the other coordinates relaxed under constraints, and the result went to the usual saddle search and strict re-validation. Two spectator-rearranging ideas failed a zero-call census screen.
idea_zh: 像弄清了一扇柜门的铰链怎么转，就去试长得一样的其他铰链。把一个已认证过渡态中发生变化的键长“印”到同一初态上化学相似、对称不等价的另一组原子上，其余坐标约束弛豫，再交给常规鞍点搜索和严格复验。另两个调整旁观原子的思路在零调用普查筛选中被淘汰。
systems_en: Zero-call census screens on 85 DEV-A IS; pilot on 24 DEV-A IS (12 metal, 12 non-metal); independent development run on the other 283 runnable DEV-A + DEV-B IS (205 metal, 78 non-metal), 1 seed; a 24-metal-IS pilot for a signed-Hessian variant. No held-out pool opened.
systems_zh: 在 85 个 DEV-A 初态上做零调用普查筛选；24 个 DEV-A 初态小试（12 金属、12 非金属）；其余 283 个可运行的 DEV-A + DEV-B 初态（205 金属、78 非金属）× 1 个种子的独立开发运行；另在 24 个金属初态上小试带符号 Hessian 的变体。未打开留出池。
result_en: Development run: U +7.5 % (1,555→1,672) but U/call 0.974× [0.963, 0.986], U/ionic step 0.941, U per DFT-equivalent call 0.9612; each 1 % more saddles cost 0.344 % efficiency, dearer than `--more`, and non-metal guards failed. A metal-only prefix (1.0087×) was a composition artefact; a signed-Hessian Sella start reached only 0.9958× against the default. Negative; options off.
result_zh: 开发：U +7.5%（1,555→1,672），但 U/调用 0.974 [0.963, 0.986]；每多 1% 鞍点耗 0.344% 效率，贵于 `--more`，非金属护栏未过。带符号 Hessian 的 Sella 起步仅 0.9958。阴性。

name_en: Rearranging spectators, then re-scanning the bond (BRANCH-DIVERSE-SCAN)
name_zh: 调整旁观原子后重扫同键
idea_en: Re-walking a corridor after moving the furniture: keep the reacting bond, give nearby spectator atoms a new pose and scan the same bond again, hoping to reach a different ridge. After the default search, spectators within 3.5 Å were shifted (≤ 0.30 Å) along the softest IS Hessian mode for failed bonds (A) or along a verified saddle's spectator field for successful ones (B); C rotated a nearby fragment, E re-drew the scan grid.
idea_zh: 像挪动家具后再走一遍同一条走廊：反应键不变，让附近旁观原子换个姿势再重扫同一根键，以期越过另一山脊。默认搜索后，把 3.5 Å 内旁观原子沿初态 Hessian 最软模（A，失败的键）或已验证鞍点的旁观位移场（B，成功的键）移动至多 0.30 Å；C 旋转邻近片段，E 重取网格。
systems_en: Each of the four variants (A, B, C, E) ran on 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal, 24 non-metal) × 2 seeds × 2 arms (340 sessions) after small pilots. No confirmation pool opened.
systems_zh: A、B、C、E 四个变体在小试之后，各在 85 个 DEV-A 初态（61 金属、24 非金属）× 2 个种子 × 2 臂（340 个会话）上完整测试。未打开确认池。
result_en: Soft-mode spectators (A): U +6.0 % (949→1,006) but U/call 0.962× [0.946, 0.977], U per DFT-equivalent call 0.9887; 2,471 calls per net extra saddle, so each 1 % more saddles cost 0.63 % efficiency, well above `--more`. B (0.9422×), C (0.9523×) and E (0.9490×) were also below 1, and both family guards failed. Negative; options off.

idea_en: A prospector who has panned a dry stretch of river many times in a row packs up early: quicker, but the next bend might have held gold. The opt-in mode ends a session after 16 consecutive attempts without a new saddle on metals or 8 on non-metals (the default allows 25); strict certification is unchanged, and the `--goal fast` route prints a recall warning.
idea_zh: 淘金者在一段河道连续多次一无所获就提前收工：省了时间，但下一个河湾也许就有金子。可选模式在金属上连续 16 次、非金属上连续 8 次尝试都没有新鞍点时结束会话（默认为 25 次），严格认证不变；`--goal fast` 会打印召回不足的警告。
systems_en: Thresholds picked on DEV-A + DEV-B (309 IS × 2 seeds; 4 refused inputs counted as zero) against `long-best-auto-80`; one confirmation on P1 = 72 sealed G-FACTORY-4 IS (47 metal, 25 non-metal), 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 在 DEV-A + DEV-B（309 个初态 × 2 个种子，4 个被拒输入按零计）上选定阈值，参照 `long-best-auto-80`；P1 一次确认：72 个 G-FACTORY-4 封存初态（47 个金属、25 个非金属），2 个种子。
result_en: P1 confirmation: U/call 1.304× [1.226, 1.385], p < 0.00025, but U fell 1181→835 (70.70 % kept; target ≥ 80 %) and U_ads kept 71.45 % (target ≥ 85 %); non-metals kept only 46.0 % of U, metals 93.3 %. Per DFT-equivalent call 1.2253×. Development timing showed no faster first saddle; only the tail is cut. Recall targets missed.

name_en: Reusing a paid IS Hessian across sessions (OVERHEAD-80)
idea_en: A surveyor who already paid for a detailed map of the trailhead keeps it in the office and reuses it, but only if the trailhead, instruments and paperwork match exactly. The opt-in option reuses a paid exact IS Hessian across sessions on the same host when model, coordinates, constraints, numerical environment and provenance all match; cache costs are charged and any mismatch triggers a fresh computation.
idea_zh: 测量员已为起点付费测过精细地形图，下次就从同一间办公室取出再用，前提是起点、仪器和档案完全一致。可选项在同一主机上跨会话复用已付费的初态精确 Hessian：势函数、坐标、约束、数值环境和来源全部吻合才复用，缓存开销照常计费，任何不符都重新计算。
systems_en: H0 on 8 DEV-A IS; development on DEV-A + DEV-B (307 runnable of 309 IS × 2 seeds, rerun with a fresh process per session); one confirmation on P2: 63 G-FACTORY-5M/5P IS (36 metal, 27 zeolite) × 2 seeds × 2 arms = 252 sessions.
systems_zh: H0：8 个 DEV-A 初态；开发：DEV-A + DEV-B（309 个初态中 307 个可运行 × 2 个种子，后改为每会话独立进程重做）；P2 一次确认：63 个 G-FACTORY-5M/5P 初态（36 个金属、27 个分子筛）× 2 个种子 × 2 臂，共 252 个会话。
result_en: P2 confirmation: U/call 1.002974× [1.002090, 1.004111], p < 0.00025; U 1,161→1,161; per DFT-equivalent call 1.006730× [1.002409, 1.011439]; per ionic step 1.000. Launches, verdicts, saddles and IS Hessian bytes matched in 126/126 pairs; all 63 second sessions hit the cache. An earlier long-lived-worker version failed the safety gate (1/614 pairs differed). Tiny, decision-identical saving; opt-in, same host only.

name_zh: 越过首次下降找第二道山脊（SECOND-RIDGE）
idea_en: A hiker who stops at the first dip in the trail may miss a second ridge just beyond it. Relaxed bond scans stop at the first energy drop; RS-TURN rescans a few more grid steps from the saved first-drop state and hands a second peak to the strict walker only if the energy truly rises and falls again. An alternative, FIRST-BEST, confirms the first drop in Sella scans with up to two extra levels.
idea_zh: 登山者在第一个下坡处就停步，可能错过紧随其后的第二道山脊。松弛键扫描在能量首次下降时停止；RS-TURN 从保存的首降状态再多扫几格，只有能量确实再升再降时才把第二个峰交给严格 walker。备选 FIRST-BEST 在 Sella 扫描中最多多走两级来核实首降。
systems_en: Zero-call check against the DEV-A saddle census (85 IS); screening on DEV-A (85 IS × 2 seeds) against `long-best-auto-80`; FIRST-BEST bundled with an existing one-sided early rejection was also run on DEV-B (224 IS) and judged on DEV-A + DEV-B. No confirmation pool was opened.
systems_zh: 零调用核查：DEV-A 鞍点普查（85 个初态）；筛选：DEV-A（85 个初态 × 2 个种子），参照 `long-best-auto-80`；FIRST-BEST 与已有单侧早拒的组合另在 DEV-B（224 个初态）上运行，并按 DEV-A + DEV-B 合并判定。未打开确认池。
result_en: The census put 121 of 806 missed saddles (15.01 %) within 4 grid steps past the first drop. Yet on DEV-A RS-TURN gave U/call 0.966× [0.946, 0.984] for U +6.0 %, a costlier way to buy saddles than `--more`; the older rescan-all gave 0.93178×. FIRST-BEST alone gave 1.02644×; bundled with an existing early-rejection option, 1.019× [1.008, 1.031] on DEV-A + DEV-B. Both missed the 1.03 gate. Not adopted.
result_zh: 普查：15.01 % 的漏检鞍点在首降后 4 格内。RS-TURN 的 U/调用 0.966 倍 [0.946, 0.984]，不如 `--more`；FIRST-BEST 组合 1.019 倍 [1.008, 1.031]，低于 1.03 门槛。未采纳。

name_en: Independent audit of the zeolite stack (ZEO-TGW-AUDIT)
name_zh: 分子筛组合包独立审计（ZEO-TGW-AUDIT）
idea_en: An independent inspector takes a tool kit that passed in one mine and tests it, unchanged, in mines it has never seen. The frozen round-300 zeolite stack was re-tested without retuning: Sella takes over the walk's tail in systems up to 2000 degrees of freedom (was 469), a Lanczos gate re-checks a few directions when negative curvature flips positive, and clearly disconnected candidates are rejected early.
idea_zh: 独立检查员把在一座矿里验证过的工具包原样带到从未去过的矿井检验。本轮不调参，复测第 300 轮冻结的分子筛组合：自由度不超过 2000（原为 469）的体系由 Sella 接手行走尾段；负曲率翻正时用 Lanczos 闸门复查几个方向；明显不连通的候选单侧提前拒绝。
systems_en: Reproduction on 6 DEV-A IS (3 metal, 3 small zeolite); descriptive re-test on the 66 non-metal DEV-B IS × 2 seeds; one pre-registered confirmation on all 52 zeolite IS of P2 + P3 (27 + 25, new G-FACTORY-5P frameworks), 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 复现：6 个 DEV-A 初态（3 个金属、3 个小分子筛）；描述性复测：DEV-B 的 66 个非金属初态 × 2 个种子；预注册的唯一确认：P2 + P3 全部 52 个分子筛初态（27 + 25，G-FACTORY-5P 新骨架），2 个种子。
result_en: P2 + P3 zeolites: U/call 1.202× [1.146, 1.261], p < 0.00025; U +32.3 % (1,169→1,547), two-seed union +31.1 %; per ionic step 1.151×, per DFT-equivalent call 1.112×; CPU per saddle ×1.288. The AST framework (3 IS) reached only 0.8806×. Audit passed; the stack ships only in opt-in presets (`zeolite-stack-81`, full-stack) in v0.81.
result_zh: P2 + P3 分子筛：U/调用 1.202 倍 [1.146, 1.261]，p < 0.00025；U +32.3 %；每离子步 1.151 倍，每 DFT 当量调用 1.112 倍；AST 骨架仅 0.8806 倍。审计通过；v0.81 中仅作可选预设。

name_en: Soft leash on the driven bond (TETHERED-WALK)
idea_en: A dog on a loose leash can sniff around but cannot run off; once the scent is clear, the leash comes off. In zeolite dimer walks, a soft annealed spring with a dead zone kept the driven bond near its launch value (penalty ½k·max(|δ|−w, 0)² added after the projected dimer force) and was released at negative curvature or after a fixed number of steps; metals were excluded.
idea_zh: 松松牵着的狗可以四处嗅探却跑不远，一旦气味明确就解开牵绳。在分子筛 dimer 行走中，对驱动键加带死区的退火软弹簧（在投影后的 dimer 力上加罚项 ½k·max(|δ|−w, 0)²），使其不远离发射时的键长；遇到负曲率或走满固定步数后释放。金属不使用。
systems_en: H0 on 12 DEV-A IS (8 zeolite, 4 metal); variants A and B on DEV-A (85 IS × 2 seeds); variants C and D on DEV-A + DEV-B (309 IS × 2 seeds; 219 metal, 90 zeolite), reference `long-best-auto-80`. The P2 confirmation pool was not opened.
systems_zh: H0：12 个 DEV-A 初态（8 个分子筛、4 个金属）；变体 A、B：DEV-A（85 个初态 × 2 个种子）；变体 C、D：DEV-A + DEV-B（309 个初态 × 2 个种子；219 个金属、90 个分子筛），参照 `long-best-auto-80`。未打开 P2 确认池。
result_en: The 1.10–1.14× gains in the small H0 did not transfer. Final variant D on 309 IS × 2 seeds: U/call 0.998× [0.985, 1.013], p = 0.5825; U 3350→3314 (−1.07 %); per DFT-equivalent call 1.001×; zeolite U ratio 0.9725 and U_ads per call 0.9779 failed the 0.98 guard. Variants A–C were also flat (0.9917–0.9999×). No effect; not adopted.

name_en: Shared timing calibration for batch jobs (BATCH-AMORTIZE)
idea_en: When several runners need the same course timed, one walks it with a stopwatch and the others read the result. A zero-call check first found no host atoms whose Hessian blocks could provably be shared between IS. The pivot: when concurrent batch jobs need the same timing calibration that prices Hessians in force calls (same potential, kernel, machine and array shape), the first job measures it and the others wait and read it.
idea_zh: 几名跑者要测同一段路，只需一人拿秒表跑一遍，其余人直接读数。零调用核查先发现：没有任何宿主原子的 Hessian 块能被证明可在不同初态间共用。于是转向：并发批处理任务需要同一份 Hessian 计价标定（相同势函数、内核、机器和数组形状）时，由第一个任务测量，其余等待并读取。
systems_en: Zero-call check on the Hessians of 85 DEV-A IS (39 hosts, 146 pairs); pilot on 16 IS; development on DEV-A + DEV-B (309 IS × 2 seeds, plus a host-isolated single-seed run); one confirmation on P3: 63 IS (38 metal, 25 non-metal; 36 hosts) × 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 零调用核查：85 个 DEV-A 初态的 Hessian（39 个宿主、146 对）；16 个初态预试；开发：DEV-A + DEV-B（309 个初态 × 2 个种子，另有按宿主隔离缓存的单种子运行）；P3 一次确认：63 个初态（38 个金属、25 个非金属，36 个宿主）× 2 个种子。
result_en: P3 confirmation: U/call 1.001× [0.995, 1.008], p = 0.3655; per DFT-equivalent call 1.005× [0.999, 1.012]; U 1009→1009 with 126/126 decisions identical; calibration Hessians 378→352. Development had shown 1.00451× [1.00269, 1.00651]. A tiny calibration-only saving that was not statistically confirmed and saves no DFT method cost; the batch option `--share-fce-setup` stays opt-in.
result_zh: P3：U/调用 1.001 倍 [0.995, 1.008]，p = 0.3655；每 DFT 当量调用 1.005 倍；U 1009→1009，标定 Hessian 378→352。节省极小、统计上未确认；`--share-fce-setup` 仅作可选。

name_en: Add-ons on top of the zeolite stack (ZEO-STACK-PLUS)
idea_en: Adding gadgets to a proven hiking kit only helps if each one earns its weight. On top of the round-300 zeolite stack, the round tested round 301's drive-anchored dimer rotation (A), a new gate-aware variant that re-anchors along the shortest arc so the gate's new mode stays within a 22.5° cone (A2), and bit-exact reuse of a paid, provenance-checked IS Hessian from round 296 (B).
idea_zh: 给成熟的登山装备再添配件，每件都得物有所值。在第 300 轮分子筛组合上测试：第 301 轮的驱动锚定 dimer 旋转（A）；新的闸门感知变体，沿最短弧重设锚点，使闸门的新模式落在 22.5° 锥内（A2）；逐位复用第 296 轮已付费、经来源核验的初态 Hessian（B）。
systems_en: Zeolites only (metals untested), reference = the round-300 stack: H0 on 12 DEV-A zeolite IS × 2 seeds × 6 arms; development on all 90 zeolite IS of DEV-A + DEV-B (24 + 66) × 2 seeds; one confirmation planned on 25 P1 zeolite IS × 2 seeds, of which 23 IS could run.
systems_zh: 仅分子筛（未测金属），参照第 300 轮组合：H0 为 12 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态 × 2 个种子 × 6 臂；开发：DEV-A + DEV-B 全部 90 个分子筛初态（24 + 66）× 2 个种子；P1 原定确认 25 个分子筛初态 × 2 个种子，实际只有 23 个可运行。
result_en: A and A2 lost 8.37 % and 7.91 % of saddles in H0 and were dropped. B on 90 zeolite IS: U/call 1.005× [1.004, 1.006], p < 0.00025, U 1,507 unchanged, 180/180 pairs identical; per DFT-equivalent call 1.02393×. On P1, 2 of 25 IS failed the stored Hessian's safety check and 4 reuse sessions were refused, so the 23-IS 1.003× is descriptive only. `zeolite-stack-81` keeps the round-300 stack alone.
result_zh: A、A2 在 H0 中丢失 8.37 %、7.91 % 鞍点，淘汰。B（90 个分子筛初态）U/调用 1.005 倍 [1.004, 1.006]，p < 0.00025，U 不变；P1 中 2/25 个初态 Hessian 未过安全检查，仅作描述。未采纳。

name_en: Exact Hessian-vector products for dimer rotation (JAX-HVP-ROTATION)
idea_en: Feeling the slope exactly with your hand sounds better than tapping with a stick, until the hand turns out to cost three taps. Exact JAX Hessian-vector products were timed as replacements for finite-difference dimer rotation images in zeolites; when too expensive, the round pivoted to cheaper bookkeeping for round 316's curvature-model rotation: compact low-rank storage, reused buffers, and finally a proven bound that skips the element-wise safety scan of the model matrix.
idea_zh: 用手精确摸坡度听起来比手杖点地好，直到发现摸一次要花三次点地的钱。先测 JAX 精确 Hessian-向量积能否替代分子筛 dimer 旋转中的有限差分像；因太贵，转而改进第 316 轮曲率模型旋转的记账：紧凑低秩存储、复用缓冲区，最后用可证明的上界免去模型矩阵的逐元素安全扫描。
systems_en: Pinned single-core timing on 3 DEV-A zeolite IS (FAU, MFI, CHA); H0 on 10 DEV-A IS (8 zeolite, 2 metal); development on 24 DEV-A zeolites + 8 metal sentinels × 2 seeds × 3 arms (reference `long-best-auto-80`, dense round-316 model, candidate), the compact arm extended to all 90 DEV-A + DEV-B zeolites. P2 was not opened.
systems_zh: 单核计时：3 个 DEV-A 分子筛初态（FAU、MFI、CHA）；H0：10 个 DEV-A 初态（8 个分子筛、2 个金属）；开发：24 个 DEV-A 分子筛 + 8 个金属哨兵 × 2 个种子 × 3 臂（参照 `long-best-auto-80`、第 316 轮稠密模型、候选），紧凑存储臂扩展到 DEV-A + DEV-B 全部 90 个分子筛。未打开 P2。
result_en: Each exact HVP cost 2.86–3.40 force-call equivalents, more than one finite-difference image, so it was dropped. Compact storage vs dense: per DFT-equivalent call 0.98968×, below the floor of 1. Bounded check: 64/64 trajectories identical to dense, CPU 0.98173×, but per DFT-equivalent call 0.99996916× still missed the ≥ 1 rule. The 1.056× [1.011, 1.100] U/call against `long-best-auto-80` is mostly round 316's model. Not adopted.
result_zh: 精确 HVP 每向量 2.86–3.40 个力调用当量，过贵，放弃。有界检查 64/64 条轨迹与稠密版一致，但每 DFT 当量调用 0.99996916 倍未达 ≥ 1。U/调用 1.056 倍 [1.011, 1.100] 主要来自第 316 轮。未采纳。

name_en: Exact Hessian for the product-side descent (IONIC-80)
name_zh: 产物下坡尾段精确 Hessian（IONIC-80）
idea_en: Near the valley floor, a hiker who takes one careful look at the valley's shape can stride straight to the bottom instead of shuffling in small steps. Once one side of a candidate is confirmed to return to the IS, the product-side descent buys one exact Hessian when forces first fall below 0.05 eV/Å and uses it as the L-BFGS metric (Newton-like steps); the half-step re-check reuses it and the stall kick is off.
idea_zh: 快到谷底时，先认真看一眼山谷的形状，就能大步直达谷底，而不必小步挪动。候选鞍点一侧确认回到初态后，产物侧下坡在力首次低于 0.05 eV/Å 时付费算一次精确 Hessian，作为 L-BFGS 的度量（类 Newton 步）；半步复核复用这份曲率，并关闭停滞踢。
systems_en: Reference `long-best-auto-80`. H0 on 16 DEV-A IS (8 metal, 8 non-metal), 1 seed; development on DEV-A + DEV-B (309 IS × 2 seeds; 4 refused inputs counted as zero); one confirmation on P3: 63 IS (38 metal, 25 non-metal) × 2 seeds.
systems_zh: 参照 `long-best-auto-80`。H0：16 个 DEV-A 初态（金属、非金属各 8 个），1 个种子；开发：DEV-A + DEV-B（309 个初态 × 2 个种子，4 个被拒输入按零计）；P3 一次确认：63 个初态（38 个金属、25 个非金属）× 2 个种子。
result_en: P3 confirmation: U per ionic step 1.158× [1.125, 1.186] (p < 0.00025) and U/call 1.036× [1.010, 1.061] (p = 0.00525), but U 992→972 (0.97984) missed the 0.98 guard by one saddle (non-metals 0.97769), and per DFT-equivalent call fell to 0.889× [0.864, 0.920]. A guarded variant had failed H0. Not confirmed; round 377 later added a paid strict re-run and shipped opt-in `long-ionic-auto-81`.
result_zh: P3：U/调用 1.036 倍 [1.010, 1.061]，p = 0.00525，每离子步 1.158 倍；但 U 比 0.97984，差一个鞍点未过 0.98 守卫，每 DFT 当量调用 0.889 倍。未确认；第 377 轮改进后发布为可选预设。

name_en: How many saddles are still missing? (COMPLETENESS-ESTIMATOR)
idea_en: Ecologists estimate how many bird species they have not yet seen from how often known ones are re-sighted. From one finished default session (saddles found, recent discovery rate, re-sightings, untried drive coordinates), a ridge-regression model trained on the 85-IS development census predicts the finite census count with a calibrated 90 % interval and lists commonly missed event classes, at zero extra force calls.
idea_zh: 生态学家根据已知物种被重复目击的频率，估计还有多少种鸟没见过。本轮从一次已完成的默认会话（已找到的鞍点、近期发现速率、重复命中、未试过的驱动坐标）出发，用在 85 个开发初态普查上训练的岭回归模型预测有限普查的鞍点数，给出校准的 90 % 区间和常见遗漏类别，不增加任何力调用。
systems_en: Trained and calibrated by five-fold leave-out against the finite saddle census of DEV-A (85 IS: 61 metal, 24 zeolite; 1,296 saddles); checked as lower bounds on DEV-B (222 of 224 IS) and once on P1 (72 IS), one default session per IS.
systems_zh: 以 DEV-A 有限鞍点普查（85 个初态：61 个金属、24 个分子筛；1,296 个鞍点）做五折留出训练与校准；在 DEV-B（224 个中的 222 个初态）和 P1（72 个初态，一次）上做下界检验，每个初态一次默认会话。
result_en: Mean absolute error against the census, relative to the older round-58 estimator: 0.747× [0.635, 0.880], p = 0.00025; leave-out interval coverage 80/85 on DEV-A. On DEV-B and P1, 0/222 and 0/72 upper bounds fell below the saddles already seen, but these censored checks cannot prove coverage. Shipped as a separate `census` command in v0.81; searches are unchanged and intervals are wide.
result_zh: 平均绝对误差为第 58 轮旧估计器的 0.747 倍 [0.635, 0.880]，p = 0.00025；DEV-A 留出区间覆盖 80/85；DEV-B 与 P1 为删失检验，无法证明覆盖。作为独立 `census` 命令进入 v0.81，不改变搜索。

name_en: Three confirmations re-tested on unseen pools (CROSS-POOL-AUDIT-B)
idea_en: A recipe that won in one kitchen is cooked again, unchanged, in kitchens the judges never visited. Three earlier confirmed options were frozen as shipped and re-run against the reference on pools they had never seen: model-predicted dimer rotation (r316) on non-metal IS, the low-barrier over-cap drive memory (r299) and metal-local failure inheritance in reaction networks (r302), tested as one Holm-corrected family of three hypotheses.
idea_zh: 一道获奖的菜，原样拿到评委从没去过的厨房再做一遍。三项已确认的选项按发布配置冻结，在从未见过的池上与参照配对重跑：模型预测的 dimer 旋转（r316，非金属初态）、低势垒超限驱动记忆（r299）和反应网络中仅限金属的失败继承（r302）；三项假设合并做 Holm 校正。
systems_en: Unseen held-out pools: r316 on 50 non-metal IS (25 from P1 = sealed G-FACTORY-4, 25 from P3); r299 on 135 IS (72 P1 + 63 P2); r302 on 83 metal network roots (47 P1 + 36 P2). One paired seed per IS or root; 4,000-sample paired bootstrap.
systems_zh: 均为未见过的留出池：r316 用 50 个非金属初态（P1 即 G-FACTORY-4 封存集 25 个、P3 25 个）；r299 用 135 个初态（P1 72 + P2 63）；r302 用 83 个金属网络根（P1 47 + P2 36）。每个初态或根一组配对种子，4,000 次配对 bootstrap。
result_en: All three passed after Holm correction. r316: U/call 1.049× [1.012, 1.087], p = 0.00350, though its extra DFT-price guard failed (0.998×, traced to cold-cache compile cost; warm rerun 1.093×). r299: U(≤1.5)/call 1.033× [1.013, 1.053]. r302: network saddles per call 1.151× [1.108, 1.198], +13 %. The gains kept 0.546, 0.830 and 0.929 of their original size; no default changed.
result_zh: 三项均过 Holm 校正：r316 U/调用 1.049 [1.012, 1.087]，DFT 当量护栏因冷缓存编译未过；r299 U(≤1.5)/调用 1.033；r302 网络鞍点/调用 1.151。收益为原值的 0.546–0.929 倍，默认不变。

name_zh: 决策不变的省调用组合包（SAVINGS-PACK-81）
idea_en: Keep the receipts: if this exact starting point was already surveyed and paid for, or the walker steps on a spot it measured before, look the answer up instead of measuring again. The pack combined reuse of a certified initial-state exact Hessian from an earlier paid session (fenced by host, potential, structure and hash; the kink guard is still re-checked), an exact energy/force cache for repeated scan and walk geometries, and compact checkpoints.
idea_zh: 保留收据：同一初态若已付费勘测过，或行走者踏到测过的同一点，就直接查记录而不重测。组合包包括：复用早先付费会话中已认证的初态精确 Hessian（按主机、势函数、结构和哈希隔离，kink 检查照做）、扫描与行走中完全重复几何的能量/力缓存，以及紧凑 checkpoint。
systems_en: Development on DEV-A + DEV-B (309 IS, 307 searchable pairs); confirmation on 24 P3 IS (12 metal + 12 non-metal, hash-selected from 63), each with one earlier paid source session, one paired seed.
systems_zh: 开发：DEV-A + DEV-B 共 309 个初态（307 对可搜索）；确认：从 P3 的 63 个初态中按哈希抽取 24 个（金属 12 + 非金属 12），每个初态先有一次付费源会话，一组配对种子。
result_en: P3 confirmation: 24/24 decisions identical (1,531 trajectories, 0 flips); U 239→239; U/call 1.00686× [1.00555, 1.00893], p < 0.00025; U per DFT-equivalent call 1.01691×; exact Hessians 514→490. Development: 307/307 identical, U/call 1.01208×. A small, lossless saving that needs an earlier paid session; shipped in v0.81 only as the opt-in multi-session template `savings-81`, not as a preset.
result_zh: P3 确认：24/24 决策一致，U 239→239；U/调用 1.00686 [1.00555, 1.00893]，U/DFT 当量调用 1.01691。节省小而无损，但需先有付费会话；v0.81 仅作可选多会话模板 `savings-81`。

idea_en: To certify a pass, survey only the ground near the crossing and get a written guarantee that the far terrain hides no second dip. Using Haynsworth inertia additivity, the saddle Hessian was split into an active block (atoms within 2.5 Å of the reaction centre) and its Schur complement; 'exactly one negative eigenvalue' was accepted early only with a certified bound on the environment, otherwise the full Hessian was computed.
idea_zh: 认证山口时只细测附近，再要一份“远处没有第二个凹陷”的保证。为省 DFT 成本，按 Haynsworth 惯性可加性把鞍点 Hessian 拆成活性块（反应中心 2.5 Å 内）与 Schur 补；仅当环境有严格证明的界时才提前认定“恰一个负本征值”，否则算完整 Hessian。
systems_en: DEV-A only: H0 on 80 archived saddle decisions from 68 DEV-A IS plus 35 enriched cases (exact NEP Hessians recomputed), expanded descriptively to 1,458 decisions; shadow run on 12 DEV-A IS (6 metal + 6 non-metal), 2 seeds. No confirmation pool.
systems_zh: 仅 DEV-A：H0 用 68 个 DEV-A 初态的 80 个存档鞍点判定外加 35 个富集样例（重算 NEP 精确 Hessian），并描述性扩展到 1,458 个判定；影子运行用 12 个 DEV-A 初态（金属 6 + 非金属 6），2 组种子。未开确认池。
result_en: H0 failed: idealised early accepts covered only 12/80 decisions (15.0 %, gate 20 %; 0 false accepts), certificate cost efficiency 0.8347× [0.7937, 0.8833], and even ideal column reuse saved just 4.29 %. The 1,458/1,458 agreement held only through the full-Hessian fallback. Shadow DEV run: U 68→68, U per DFT-equivalent call 0.9922× [0.9747, 1.0009]. No cheap, rigorous environment bound was found.
result_zh: H0 失败：提前接受仅覆盖 12/80（门槛 20 %），0 误接受；证书成本效率 0.8347，理想列复用也只省 4.29 %；判定一致全靠完整 Hessian 回退。影子 DEV：U 68→68，U/DFT 当量调用 0.9922，p = 0.94。

name_en: Joint Bayesian tuning of six knobs (HYPER-BO-80)
name_zh: 六参数联合贝叶斯调优（HYPER-BO-80）
idea_en: Tune six dials of a race car together on a short practice track, then race on circuits it has never seen. A constrained Bayesian optimiser (Gaussian process with expected improvement, 16 settings evaluated, saddle count kept ≥ 0.98× the default) jointly tuned six continuous knobs of the default that had never been tuned together: atom search radius, two Sella stop thresholds, the walker positive-curvature abort, the dimer lazy-rotation angle and the bond-drive step.
idea_zh: 在一小段练习赛道上同时调好赛车的六个旋钮，再上陌生赛道。用带约束的贝叶斯优化（高斯过程+期望改进，16 组设置，鞍点数 ≥ 默认 0.98 倍）联合调节默认预设从未合调的六个连续参数：原子搜索半径、两个 Sella 停止阈值、行走者正曲率中止、dimer 惰性旋转角和键驱动步长。
systems_en: Each setting tuned on 16 DEV-A IS (12 metal + 4 CHA zeolite), 1 seed; held-out test on all 224 DEV-B IS plus the other 69 DEV-A IS. P2 confirmation not run.
systems_zh: 每组设置在 16 个 DEV-A 初态（金属 12 + CHA 分子筛 4）上评估，1 组种子；留出检验用 DEV-B 全部 224 个初态及其余 69 个 DEV-A 初态。未做 P2 确认。
result_en: Overfit. In-sample winner 1.184× [1.039, 1.279]; on held-out DEV-B: U/call 0.989× [0.959, 1.017], p = 0.777, U 1197→1109 (−7.4 %), U/ionic step 1.044×, U per DFT-equivalent call 0.958×, metals 0.947×. Other 69 DEV-A IS: 1.000×. The tuned values did not transfer; the opt-in preset `long-best-auto-80-hyper-bo-r358` exists but is not recommended.

name_en: Per-IS online choice of walker engine (ONLINE-ENGINE-BANDIT)
name_zh: 逐初态在线选择行走引擎（ONLINE-ENGINE-BANDIT）
idea_en: A climbing party tries two guides early and keeps the better one, or lets the second retry from the same spot when the first fails. Plan 1, a per-IS bandit choosing Sella or dimer from the first four launches, failed a zero-cost archive replay (0.946×). Plan 2: after a failed Sella walk on a metal, retry the dimer from the same start and direction; stop once four fallbacks in an IS find nothing new.
idea_zh: 登山队先试两位向导、留下更好的，或一位失败后让另一位从原地再试。方案一：按初态用多臂老虎机在前四次发射中挑 Sella 或 dimer，零调用存档回放仅 0.946，放弃。方案二：金属上 Sella 行走失败后，从同一起点和方向改用 dimer 重试；某初态四次重试无新鞍点即停。
systems_en: Archive replay on DEV-A + DEV-B; pilot on 16 metal IS; full development test on DEV-A + DEV-B, 309 IS × 2 seeds (614 pairs). No confirmation (P3 not opened).
systems_zh: DEV-A + DEV-B 存档回放；16 个金属初态试点；完整开发检验为 DEV-A + DEV-B 共 309 个初态 × 2 组种子（614 对）。未开 P3 确认。
result_en: Development: U/call 1.00088× [0.98917, 1.01251], p = 0.4435. U rose 2.65 % (3,355→3,444) with 89 new saddles and none lost, but the 842 fallbacks cost 141,181 force calls, so efficiency did not move; U/ionic step 0.99546×, metals 0.99061×. Below the 3 % development gate, so no confirmation; option left off.

idea_en: Airport security for structure files: odd luggage is scanned before boarding, and anything unsafe is turned back with a clear reason instead of failing mid-flight. Zero-force-call pre-checks now catch atoms too close to their own periodic images (after lattice reduction, < 0.5 Å), non-zero charge or magnetic-moment metadata and bad role data; surface roles are inferred from the surface normal, so rotated cells work. The user's charge, cell, roles and constraints are never silently changed.
idea_zh: 像机场安检：可疑行李登机前先过检，不安全的当场退回并说明原因，而不是飞到半路出事。新增零力调用预检查：原子与自身周期像过近（格点约化后 < 0.5 Å）、非零电荷或磁矩元数据、错误的角色数据；表面角色改由表面法向推断，旋转晶胞也能识别。绝不悄悄改动用户的电荷、晶胞、角色或约束。
systems_en: 60 fuzzed inputs (31 valid, 29 invalid) made from five DEV-A structures (Cu(111), Pt(111), H-CHA and Cu(211) systems) plus 5 hand-made files, each run in default and `--goal fast` mode; search identity checked on 10 untransformed DEV IS and 13 transformed inputs.
systems_zh: 60 个模糊测试输入（31 个有效、29 个无效），由五个 DEV-A 结构（Cu(111)、Pt(111)、H-CHA 与 Cu(211) 体系）变形而来，另加 5 个手工文件，各用默认与 `--goal fast` 运行；搜索一致性检查用 10 个未变换 DEV 初态和 13 个变换输入。
result_en: Acceptable outcomes rose from 50/60 to 60/60 inputs (ratio 1.200 [1.050, 1.556]; 10 improved, 0 worse); the old version had 1 crash, 5 silent errors and 3 unhelpful rejections. Searches stayed bit-identical in all 23 identity checks (U 3→3, U/call 1.000). Built into v0.81.0. The inputs come from few structures, so this is not a claim about all user files.
result_zh: 可接受结果 50/60→60/60（1.200 [1.050, 1.556]；10 例改善、0 例变差）；旧版 1 次崩溃、5 次无声错误、3 次无用拒绝。23 项检查中搜索逐位相同（U/调用 1.000）。已并入 v0.81.0；输入来源少，不代表所有文件。

idea_en: Turn a hiker's raw GPS logs into one trail poster: the height of every pass, a table you can sort and a map of which valleys connect. The new command `dimer-explore view RUN` writes an offline, self-contained HTML page (plus an optional 300-dpi PNG) with an energy-level diagram (IS = 0 eV), a sortable barrier/reaction-energy table, a minima–saddle network graph and downloads of TS structures and DFT hand-off files. No force calls.
idea_zh: 把登山的 GPS 记录画成标出山口高度与山谷连通的路线海报。新命令 `dimer-explore view RUN` 生成离线 HTML（可选 300 dpi PNG）：能级图（初态 = 0 eV）、可排序能垒表、极小点–鞍点网络图，及过渡态与 DFT 交接文件下载。零力调用。
systems_en: Three real runs from the quickstart examples (CO on Pt(211), H2O on CuPd(111), NH3 in H-SOD), one CuPd reaction network and an analytic toy surface; no new searches.
systems_zh: 快速入门示例的三次真实运行（Pt(211) 上的 CO、CuPd(111) 上的 H2O、H-SOD 中的 NH3）、一个 CuPd 反应网络和一个解析玩具势能面；不做新搜索。
result_en: All 15/15 table rows, TS files and DFT ZIPs matched the run records (360 files byte-checked); 40 tests passed; searches unchanged (U/call 1.000). A scripted five-task timing proxy was 5.72× slower than reading the raw files, so the hoped-for 30 % time saving was not shown, and no human trial was run. Shipped as the `view` command in v0.81.0.
result_zh: 表格行、过渡态文件和 DFT 压缩包 15/15 与记录一致（核对 360 个文件），40 项测试通过，搜索不变（U/调用 1.000）。脚本化五项任务计时比直接读文件慢 5.72 倍，未达省时 30 % 目标，无真人试用。已随 v0.81.0 发布。

name_en: Exp graph preconditioner for downhill descents (EXP-PRECOND-80)
name_zh: 下坡优化的 Exp 预条件（EXP-PRECOND-80）
idea_en: A ball rolling downhill over stiff bonds and floppy angles is told by a map of which atoms are bonded to take bigger steps along the soft directions. A sparse Exp (Packwood–Kermode) graph preconditioner from ASE, scaled by the existing secant curvature, was added to the endpoint L-BFGS descents; variants limited its turn to ≤ 15° (cone), applied it to bond scans, or switched it on earlier in the descent.
idea_zh: 小球在“键硬角软”的地形上滚下坡，一张原子成键图告诉它在软方向上迈大步。在端点 L-BFGS 下降中加入 ASE 的稀疏 Exp（Packwood–Kermode）图预条件器，并用现有割线曲率定标；变体包括把方向偏转限制在 15° 以内（锥形）、用于键扫描，以及在下降早期就启用。
systems_en: Development only: H0 screens on 12 IS, then full DEV-A + DEV-B runs (309 IS × 2 seeds) for four arms against a same-cache reference. No confirmation pool opened.
systems_zh: 仅开发集：先在 12 个初态上做 H0 筛选，再在 DEV-A + DEV-B（309 个初态 × 2 组种子）上对四个臂做完整检验，参照使用同一缓存。未开确认池。
result_en: Best variant (early cone, development): U/call 1.02261× [1.01331, 1.03094], p = 0.00025; U/ionic step 1.06128×; U per DFT-equivalent call 1.01666×; descent calls −9.45 %. But U fell 3350→3337 and a conservative non-metal decision-change bound (3.63 %) broke the 3 % guard. Other full-DEV arms ≤ 1.00955×; the scan variant was killed at H0 (U 72→62). Missed the 1.03 gate.
result_zh: 最佳臂（早期锥形）开发集 U/调用 1.02261 [1.01331, 1.03094]，每离子步 1.06128；但 U 3350→3337，非金属决策变化上界 3.63 % 超 3 % 护栏。扫描变体 H0 即淘汰，其余臂更弱。未达 1.03 门槛。

name_en: Independent audit of the SAFE4 bundle (SAFE4-AUDIT)
idea_en: An independent inspector re-tests a certified toolkit on sites the original crew never visited. The SAFE4 bundle of r303 (curved-endpoint recheck, smaller non-metal walker sphere with more patience, guarded one-sided rejection, Sella stall stop), which separates `long-best-auto-81` from `-80`, was applied unchanged on both G-FACTORY-5 pools against a freshly run reference, requiring a gain above 2 %; an exploratory run tested stacking with the r300 zeolite package.
idea_zh: 独立检验员到原施工队没去过的工地复检工具包。r303 的 SAFE4 包（弯曲端点复检、非金属缩小行走球、带护栏单侧拒绝、Sella 停滞即停）即 `long-best-auto-81` 的新增部分；本轮原样用于 G-FACTORY-5 两池，对照新跑参照，要求增益 > 2 %。
systems_en: Confirmation on P2 + P3 jointly: 126 G-FACTORY-5 IS (74 metal/alloy, 52 non-metal porous) × 2 seeds, 504 sessions. Exploratory four-arm interaction test on 66 DEV-B zeolite IS, 1 seed.
systems_zh: 确认：P2 + P3 合并，126 个 G-FACTORY-5 初态（金属/合金 74、非金属多孔 52）× 2 组种子，共 504 个会话。探索：66 个 DEV-B 分子筛初态上的四臂交互检验，1 组种子。
result_en: Passed: U/call 1.0425× [1.0248, 1.0604] (p = 0.0070 against the 2 % margin); U 2,167→2,256 (+4.1 %); U/ionic step 1.062×; U per DFT-equivalent call 1.016×. Gains came from non-metals (1.079×; metals 1.002×), in line with r303's 1.040× on P1. Stacked with the r300 zeolite package the gains were sub-multiplicative (interaction 0.959×). Supports the `long-best-auto-81` ingredients; nothing changed.

idea_en: A pattern book of known mountain passes: when a new ridge looks locally like one already crossed, try that crossing directly instead of scouting. From strict saddles of training DEV-A/B runs, 1,017 local templates (bond change, displacement, negative mode) were extracted; at a new IS on a different host, a bond coordinate matching by elements, roles and neighbour graph (Kabsch-aligned) swaps its scan for the template's displacement and mode. Validation stays strict.
idea_zh: 已知山口图谱：新山脊若局部像走过的山口，就照原路线直接试，不先侦察。从训练用 DEV-A/B 的严格鞍点提取 1,017 个局部模板（键变化、位移、负模态）；在不同主体的新初态上，若某键坐标的元素、角色和近邻图匹配（Kabsch 对齐），就用模板位移和模态替代扫描，严格验证不变。
systems_en: Library from 232 training DEV-A/B IS; held out by host: 32 IS (16 metal + 16 zeolite) × 2 seeds as the pre-registered test, plus 44 further held-out IS (76 in total); H0 on 8 enriched IS. P2 not opened.
systems_zh: 模板库来自 232 个训练用 DEV-A/B 初态；按主体留出：预注册检验 32 个初态（金属 16 + 分子筛 16）× 2 组种子，另补 44 个留出初态（共 76 个）；H0 用 8 个富集初态。未开 P2。
result_en: Templates matched under 1 % of bond coordinates (40 of 4,264). Pre-registered 32 IS: U/call 0.99950× [0.97969, 1.01404], p = 0.51425, U 328→324, 50 template launches; all 76 IS: 0.99621×, U 988→978. Template launches used 25.4 % fewer calls than the matching scans, but turned 16 reference successes into failures and only 6 failures into successes. Missed the 1.03 gate; killed.

name_zh: 离线计算 HTST 速率常数（RATES-HTST）
idea_en: Knowing how high a mountain pass is does not tell you how often hikers cross it; you also need to know how roomy the valley and the pass are. A new `dimer-explore rates` command reads Hessian spectra stored by a finished search (no new force calls) and computes classical harmonic transition-state-theory rates (Vineyard prefactor times Boltzmann factor) in both directions, flagging soft modes and frozen atoms; missing spectra give 'unavailable', not a default 10¹³ s⁻¹.
idea_zh: 只知山口多高，算不出每天多少人翻过，还要看山谷和山口多宽敞。新命令 `dimer-explore rates` 读取已存的 Hessian 频谱（不新增力调用），按经典简谐过渡态理论（Vineyard 前因子）分别算正逆向速率，标出软模与冻结原子；缺谱报“不可用”而不套默认值。
systems_en: No new searches; offline processing of stored development sessions: acetylene+2H/Pd(111) (two sessions, 10 and 9 saddles), H2O/H-FAU (6), two methanol/H-CHA (22, spectra not stored), a stored network run (15), CO/Pt(211) from r329 (TS spectrum missing), plus an analytic H/Cu(100) toy anchored to a published 88 meV barrier and 71.2 meV vibration.
systems_zh: 不新跑搜索，离线处理已存的开发集会话：Pd(111) 上乙炔+2H（两个会话，10 和 9 个鞍点）、H-FAU 中 H2O（6 个）、H-CHA 中双甲醇（22 个，未存频谱）、一个网络运行（15 个）、r329 的 Pt(211)+CO（缺 TS 频谱）；另有以文献能垒 88 meV、振动 71.2 meV 为锚的 H/Cu(100) 解析玩具模型。
result_en: Search untouched, so U/call 1.000 by construction (no CI); 32 tests passed. H/Cu(100) toy prefactor 8.02908×10¹² s⁻¹ (illustrative, from an assumed cosine potential). Both directions computed for 10/10 Pd saddles (prefactors 1.35e12–2.23e14 s⁻¹, soft modes in 20/20 directions) and 6/6 H-FAU saddles; 0/22 and 0/15 without spectra, with no invented events. `rates` shipped in v0.81.0; absolute rates not validated.
result_zh: 搜索不变，U/调用 1.000（恒等）。H/Cu(100) 玩具前因子 8.02908×10¹² s⁻¹（仅示意）；Pd 10/10 个鞍点双向可算（均含软模），H-FAU 6/6，缺谱不编造。`rates` 随 v0.81.0 发布；绝对速率未验证。

idea_en: A sofa pushed straight at a doorway jams; a slight twist gets it through. A census found that 57.58 % of missed plausible adsorbate saddles involve two bond changes on a shared atom, so angle-aware drives were tried: extra angle and two-bond scans after a session (killed in a pilot), and a zero-extra-call blend (`drive_bend_mode`) that tilts the climbing direction at hydrogen-transfer scan tops by 0.35× the transfer-angle gradient.
idea_zh: 沙发正对门口硬推会卡住，稍一拧就过去。普查发现漏掉的合理吸附物鞍点中 57.58% 涉及共享原子的两处键变化，于是试验兼顾键角的驱动：会话后追加键角与两键扫描，及零额外调用的混合方案（`drive_bend_mode`），在氢转移扫描顶点按 0.35 倍转移角梯度偏转爬升方向。
systems_en: Zero-call census of 488 missed plausible adsorbate saddles from earlier default runs; pilot on 12 enriched DEV-A IS (6 metal, 6 non-metal) × 1 seed × 4 arms; main test on all 85 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds (340 sessions), extended to DEV-A + DEV-B (309 IS nominal) × 2 seeds; reference `long-best-auto-80`. Confirmation pool not opened.
systems_zh: 零力调用普查早先默认运行漏掉的 488 个合理吸附物鞍点；试点 12 个富集 DEV-A 初态（金属、非金属各 6）× 1 个种子 × 4 臂；主检验全部 85 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子（340 个会话），再扩展到 DEV-A + DEV-B（名义 309 个初态）× 2 个种子；参照 `long-best-auto-80`。未开确认池。
result_en: Post-session scans each added only 1 saddle at 4,438–8,812 calls per new saddle and were killed. Blend on DEV-A: U/call 0.994× [0.969, 1.021], U 958→907 (−5.32 %); non-metal U/call 0.9498 and U 0.8834, failing the 0.98 guard. DEV-A + DEV-B: 0.998× [0.985, 1.010], U −2.6 % (non-metal −6 %). No gain; not adopted.

name_zh: 网络模式复用断连鞍点（NETWORK-DISCONNECTED-CREDIT）
idea_en: A surveyor who finds a pass that does not start from today's camp writes it down; when the team later camps in that valley, it re-walks the trail to check it and counts it instead of searching again. In network mode, saddles not connected to the root IS were strictly certified and stored; when a child IS search reached one of their endpoint basins, fresh downhill descents re-validated the edge before it was credited.
idea_zh: 勘测员发现一个不通往今天营地的山口，先记下来；等队伍日后驻扎到那个山谷，再重走一遍核实，直接计入而不必重找。网络模式下，与根初态不相连的鞍点经严格认证后存档；当子初态的搜索到达其某个端点所在盆地时，用新的下坡验证复核这条边，再计入该子初态。
systems_en: 19 GF3 dev roots (7 EARLY, 8 GEN3, 4 GEN4; 13 metal, 6 non-metal) in `long-best-auto-80` network mode (depth 2, up to 3 children per node), 2 seeds × 2 arms = 76 network runs. Development only; confirmation pool not opened.
systems_zh: GF3 开发集中 19 个根初态（EARLY 7、GEN3 8、GEN4 4；金属 13、非金属 6），`long-best-auto-80` 网络模式（深度 2，每个节点最多 3 个子节点），2 个种子 × 2 臂，共 76 次网络运行。仅开发集，未开确认池。
result_en: Network saddles per call 1.009× [0.975, 1.050], p 0.37; network saddles 880→904 (+2.7 %); metal ratio 0.97579, below the 0.98 guard. 133 disconnected root edges were certified; 36 passed child revalidation, 28 were actually used, and 36/36 independent audits found 0 false credits. Safe, but no detectable efficiency gain; not adopted.
result_zh: 网络鞍点/调用 1.009 倍 [0.975, 1.050]；鞍点 880→904（+2.7%）；金属比值 0.97579，低于 0.98 护栏。认证 133 条根断连边，36 条复核通过、28 条实际计入，36/36 次审计零误计。安全但无可测收益，未采用。

name_en: Low-barrier shortlist refined on target PES (LOWBARRIER-TWO-LEVEL)
name_zh: NEP 低势垒初筛、目标势面精修（LOWBARRIER-TWO-LEVEL）
idea_en: A scout with a cheap altimeter lists the lowest passes; an expensive survey team then climbs only those, starting from the scout's notes. NEP89 low-barrier searches (source window widened to 2.0 eV, with two-local memory) ranked candidates by barrier; the top ones were refined on a costlier target surface, seeded with the NEP transition-state Hessian, and strictly certified. The target was synthetic (NEP plus a Gaussian pair field), not DFT.
idea_zh: 侦察员用便宜高度计列出最低的山口，昂贵的测量队只按笔记攀登这些山口。NEP89 低势垒搜索（源窗口 2.0 eV，双局部记忆）按能垒排序候选，靠前者以 NEP 过渡态 Hessian 为起点在更贵的目标势面上精修并严格认证；目标势面为合成的 NEP + 高斯对势场，非 DFT。
systems_en: Primary: 12 DEV-A IS × 2 seeds. Breadth: 110 IS (79 metal, 31 non-metal; DEV-A and DEV-B, same cohort as r326) × 2 seeds at two perturbation amplitudes (0.05 and 0.20 eV), barrier margins 0–0.5 eV; reference is a direct low-barrier search on the target surface. Development only; no real DFT.
systems_zh: 主检验：12 个 DEV-A 初态 × 2 个种子。广度：110 个初态（金属 79、非金属 31；DEV-A 与 DEV-B，与 r326 同一批）× 2 个种子，扰动幅度 0.05 与 0.20 eV，能垒余量 0–0.5 eV；参照为直接在目标势面上做低势垒搜索。仅开发集，无真实 DFT。
result_en: Perturbation 0.05 eV: U per DFT-equivalent call 2.185× [2.004, 2.387], but U 593 vs 680 (−12.8 %), recall 69.9 %; 0.20 eV: 1.706× [1.424, 1.978], U −24.2 %, recall 64.3 %. Charging NEP calls at the target price gives 0.622 and 0.250; wider margins added cost without recall. Fails the 0.80 recall rule; not adopted. A DFT protocol guide was delivered.

name_en: Metal-organic frameworks as a boundary test (MOF-BOUNDARY)
name_zh: 金属有机框架边界测试（MOF-BOUNDARY）
idea_en: Before taking a mountain guide into a new range, check that the map is reliable and that the usual climbing technique still works. The round built metal-organic framework (MOF) initial states, measured how the default search and NEP89 chemistry behave in them, and tested one routing switch (`mof_engine=sella`) that sends explicitly labelled periodic MOFs to Sella instead of the dimer walker.
idea_zh: 带向导进入陌生山脉前，先确认地图可靠、惯用的攀登技术依然管用。本轮构建金属有机框架（MOF）初态，测量默认搜索与 NEP89 化学在其中的表现，并测试一个路由开关（`mof_engine=sella`）：把显式标注的周期性 MOF 交给 Sella，而不是 dimer 行走器。
systems_en: 15 DEV-MOF IS built for this round: 14 Zn-MOF-74 with 1–3 CO2/H2O guests and 1 UiO-66 + CO2 (ZIF-8 dropped: its cell relaxation did not converge); roles labelled by hand. Baseline: 15 IS × 2 seeds; switch test: 5 single-guest IS × 1 seed, truncated to 8 attempts. Development only.
systems_zh: 本轮自建 15 个 DEV-MOF 初态：14 个 Zn-MOF-74（含 1–3 个 CO2/H2O 客体）与 1 个 UiO-66+CO2（ZIF-8 晶胞弛豫未收敛，未纳入）；角色手工标注。基线 15 个初态 × 2 个种子；开关检验 5 个单客体初态 × 1 个种子，截短至 8 次尝试。仅开发集。
result_en: Switch: U/call 1.075× [0, 1.392], p 0.36, U 7→7 (MOF-74 2→1; MOF-74 U_ads/call 0.534 fails the guard). Baseline: 56 saddles at 4,024.8 calls each; 34/56 change metal–node bonds, 20 create Zn/Zr–H contacts below 2 Å, and all 36 MOF-74 saddles distort the framework. H2O binding −0.994/−0.927 eV vs ≈ −0.766 eV in the literature. NEP89 MOF chemistry needs DFT checks.
result_zh: 开关 U/调用 1.075 倍 [0, 1.392]，U 7→7，MOF-74 未过护栏。基线 34/56 个鞍点改变节点成键，MOF-74 鞍点均扭曲骨架；H2O 结合能 −0.994/−0.927 eV，强于文献约 −0.766 eV，需 DFT 核查。

name_zh: 表面与分子筛模型尺寸效应（SLAB-SIZE-SCALING）
idea_en: A bigger map costs more to carry but may show trails that a small one cuts off. The round rebuilt surfaces and zeolites at several sizes to measure how cost and the saddles found change with model size, and tested an off-by-default switch that lets Sella do its linear algebra only on the free atoms of large, partly fixed slabs, while forces and certification still use the full slab.
idea_zh: 地图越大越重，但可能显示小地图截掉的小路。本轮把表面和分子筛模型重建成多种尺寸，测量成本与所得鞍点如何随尺寸变化，并测试一个默认关闭的开关：对较大、部分固定的表面，Sella 只在可动原子上做线性代数，力和最终认证仍用完整模型。
systems_en: 24 models rebuilt from six DEV-A templates: methoxy/Cu(111), formic acid/Pt(111) and CO+H/Rh(111) at six slab sizes from 3×3×3 to 6×6×4 with different fixed layers; two methanol/H-CHA, water/H-MOR and water/H-FAU as unit cell vs 1×1×2 supercell. 118 complete `long-best-auto-80` sessions, 2 seeds; switch tested on 6 cold-cache metal pairs. Development only.
systems_zh: 由 6 个 DEV-A 模板重建 24 个模型：Cu(111) 甲氧基、Pt(111) 甲酸、Rh(111) CO+H 各做 3×3×3 到 6×6×4 共六档表面（固定层不同）；H-CHA 双甲醇、H-MOR 水、H-FAU 水各做原胞与 1×1×2 超胞。共 118 个完整 `long-best-auto-80` 会话、2 个种子；开关在 6 对冷缓存金属配对上检验。仅开发集。
result_en: No universal size rule: Cu/Pt channels matched across sizes within 0.0001–0.0005 eV, but many Rh and zeolite channels had no partner. Free-atom switch (cold cache): U/call 1.177× [0.945, 1.252], p 0.148, U 10→12, both extra saddles low-barrier Rh channels; opt-in, not recommended. Zeolite tail-off control: U 68→53. Advice: start metals at 4×4×4 with two fixed layers and check channels across sizes.
result_zh: 无通用尺寸规则：Cu/Pt 通道跨尺寸能垒差 0.0001–0.0005 eV，Rh 与分子筛大量通道无法配对。可动原子开关 U/调用 1.177 倍 [0.945, 1.252]，U 10→12，仅可选。关闭分子筛 Sella 尾段则 U 68→53。

name_en: Guard routing crowded zeolites to the reference (ZEO-STACK-GUARD)
name_zh: 分子筛拥挤孔道回退保护（ZEO-STACK-GUARD）
idea_en: A ski instructor who sees a crowded, narrow slope sends the group down the familiar trail before they start.
