The opt-in zeolite TGW stack had lost saddles on one framework (AST), so two pre-run guards (`zeolite_stack_guard=crowding-v1|size450`) were tested: run the plain reference search when the guest is crowded by framework atoms and the system is small (3N_free ≤ 450), or simply when it is small.
idea_zh: 滑雪教练见雪道狭窄拥挤，出发前就让学员改走老路。可选的分子筛 TGW 组合曾在 AST 骨架上丢鞍点，本轮测试两种开跑前保护：客体被骨架拥挤包围且 3N_free ≤ 450，或仅 3N_free ≤ 450 时，整场改用参照搜索（`zeolite_stack_guard`）。
systems_en: 66 non-metal DEV-B IS (zeolites from G-FACTORY 1–4, the IS-first set and G5) × 2 seeds × reference/stack, plus component ablations on 18 and 66 IS; zero-call routing audit of 52 earlier P2/P3 porous IS, including the 3 AST cases. Development only.
systems_zh: 66 个 DEV-B 非金属初态（G-FACTORY 1–4、IS-first 与 G5 中的分子筛）× 2 个种子 × 参照/组合两臂，另做 18 与 66 个初态的组件消融；对早先 P2/P3 中 52 个多孔初态（含 3 个 AST）做零力调用路由审计。仅开发集。
result_en: DEV-B: crowding guard vs stack U/call 1.0052× [0.9852, 1.0305], p 0.3425, U −0.95 %; size guard 1.0076× [0.9872, 1.0330]. On the 3 AST cases the size guard raised U/call to 1.1356 but cut U to 0.8723×; the crowding guard covered only 1 of 3. Ablation: one-sided early rejection alone missed 2 strict saddles. No useful guard; both stay opt-in.
result_zh: 拥挤保护对组合 U/调用 1.0052 倍 [0.9852, 1.0305]，U −0.95%；尺寸保护 1.0076 倍。AST 上尺寸保护 U/调用 1.1356 倍，但 U 仅 0.8723 倍。消融：单侧提前拒绝漏掉 2 个严格鞍点。无可用保护。

name_en: Runtime-model batch scheduling and live ETA (BATCH-WALLTIME)
name_zh: 批量排程时长模型与实时预计（BATCH-WALLTIME）
idea_en: Movers finish sooner if they start with the bulkiest pieces, which requires judging bulk well, and a good foreman can also say when the job will end. A fitted session-duration model (old estimate, free atoms, coordinates, zeolite flag) re-ordered the longest-first (LPT) batch queue, and a live remaining-time estimate was added; all off by default (`--time-model`, `--one-core-per-session`, `--live-eta`). Searches themselves were unchanged.
idea_zh: 搬家先搬最笨重的家具能早收工，前提是估得准哪件最重；好工头还能说出何时完工。本轮用拟合的会话时长模型（旧估计、自由原子数、坐标数、是否分子筛）重排“最长任务优先”（LPT）批处理队列，并新增实时剩余时间估计，均默认关闭（如 `--time-model`）。搜索本身不变。
systems_en: 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal, 24 zeolite): zero-call replay of recorded run times with cross-validated folds, then real NEP batches with one dedicated core per search at 16, 32 and 64 workers (one new seed per IS, both arms). Development only.
systems_zh: 85 个 DEV-A 初态（金属 61、分子筛 24）：先用已记录耗时做零力调用回放（交叉验证分折），再以每个搜索独占一核、16/32/64 个并行进程实跑 NEP 批次（每个初态 1 个新种子，两臂）。仅开发集。
result_en: Replay makespan ratio 1.000 [1.000, 1.000]: the existing LPT order already starts the longest zeolite job first and reaches the lower bound. Live makespan ratios 1.019/1.015/0.994 at 16/32/64 workers; U 481→481. Per-session predictions improved (within 1.5× from 64.7 % to 81.2 %), but the new ETA was optimistic (0.633–0.817 of the true remaining time). Not recommended; defaults unchanged.

name_en: Resumable DFT refinement of NEP saddles (DFT-REFINE-CLI)
name_zh: 可断点续算的 DFT 精修（DFT-REFINE-CLI）
idea_en: A prospector's map of likely gold spots goes to an assay lab that re-tests each spot with its own instruments, logs every costly sample as it goes, and resumes after a power cut without repeating work. The new `dimer-explore dft-refine` takes NEP saddles in barrier order, starts Sella on the user's ASE calculator (e.g. DFT) from the NEP transition-state Hessian, certifies independently on that surface, and saves every call for exact resume.
idea_zh: 探矿图上的候选点交给化验室逐点复检，昂贵样品随做随记，停电后接着做。新命令 `dimer-explore dft-refine` 按能垒取 NEP 鞍点，以 NEP Hessian 启动 Sella 在用户 ASE 计算器（如 DFT）上精修并独立认证；每次调用即时落盘，可续算。
systems_en: Synthetic target (NEP plus a 0.10 eV pair field): the r325 Cu(111) CO and OH systems and 4 DEV-A metal IS (HCO/Au(211), CO oxidation on Ir(111), NH2/Pt(100), NH3/Pt(211)), top-2 NEP saddles each, 1 seed, with vs without the NEP Hessian. Real Quantum ESPRESSO (PBE): one artificial, heavily constrained H5 cluster with 2 free coordinates.
systems_zh: 合成目标势面（NEP + 0.10 eV 对势场）：r325 的 Cu(111) CO、OH 两个体系及 4 个 DEV-A 金属初态（Au(211) HCO、Ir(111) CO 氧化、Pt(100) NH2、Pt(211) NH3），各取 NEP 能垒最低的 2 个鞍点，1 个种子，比较有无 NEP Hessian。真实 Quantum ESPRESSO（PBE）：一个人造、强约束的 H5 体系，仅 2 个自由坐标。
result_en: Synthetic target, NEP-Hessian start vs none: U per target call 1.0133× [0.9725, 1.0199], p 0.0848, U 5→5. Real QE: the planned 0.01 finite-difference step failed (26 calls, unresolved curvature); a post-hoc finer step certified 1 saddle in 145 QE calls, 187 including tests and failures. Resuming twice after budget stops repeated no SCF. Shipped in v0.81.0; speed-up not shown.
result_zh: 合成势面，有/无 NEP Hessian：U/目标调用 1.0133 倍 [0.9725, 1.0199]，U 5→5。真实 QE：原定差分步长失败；事后细化步长，145 次调用认证 1 个鞍点（共 187 次）。续算无重复 SCF。随 v0.81.0 发布。

name_zh: 跨机器可复现的搜索决策（DETERMINISM-80）
idea_en: A recipe that says 'stir until the timer rings' turns out differently on fast and slow stoves; 'stir 40 times' gives the same dish everywhere. In v0.80, measured timings (Hessian cost, compile time) fed budget decisions, so runs could diverge between machines. An opt-in mode (`deterministic_budget_charge=40` with `hessian_exact_padding=geometry`) counts each Hessian as a fixed 40 calls for decisions while still reporting true costs.
idea_zh: 菜谱写“搅到计时器响”，灶台快慢不同菜就不同；写“搅 40 下”，哪儿都一样。v0.80 用实测耗时做预算决策，换机器可能分叉。可选的 `deterministic_budget_charge=40` 在决策中把每个 Hessian 固定计为 40 次调用，真实成本照记。
systems_en: 30 DEV-A IS (the 10 metal and 10 zeolite IS with the fewest free atoms, plus a 10-IS diversity block) × two presets (`long-best-auto-80`, `long-best`) = 60 pairs, 1 seed, run on two different machines with deliberately distorted timing caches, plus a same-machine reference arm. Development only.
systems_zh: 30 个 DEV-A 初态（自由原子最少的金属、分子筛各 10 个，另加 10 个多样性补块）× 两种预设（`long-best-auto-80`、`long-best`）= 60 对，1 个种子；在两台不同机器上运行并人为扭曲计时缓存，另在同一机器上跑参照臂。仅开发集。
result_en: With the options, 60/60 cross-machine pairs gave identical launch sequences, verdicts and saddle sets. Same-machine U/call 1.001× [0.993, 1.007], U 375→375; padding changed one quench path without changing saddles. An apparent +1.22 % DFT-equivalent gain was a cache artefact. Options shipped off by default in v0.81.0; the gain is reproducibility, not speed.
result_zh: 启用后，60/60 对跨机器运行的启动序列、判定与鞍点集一致。同机 U/调用 1.001 倍 [0.993, 1.007]，U 375→375。DFT 当量 +1.22% 是缓存伪影。选项默认关闭，随 v0.81.0 发布；收获是可复现而非加速。

name_en: Crash-safe resume with a work ledger (RESUME-80)
name_zh: 断点续算与已完成工作账（RESUME-80）
idea_en: Like sealing a measurement and its receipt in one tamper-evident envelope: after a power cut it is reused only if the seal proves it is yours, while a logbook shows at least how much work was lost. The initial-state Hessian and its accounting are saved as one transaction and reused only after a same-session check; a sparse ledger logs completed force calls and Hessians at least every 64 calls. Default off; certification unchanged.
idea_zh: 像把测量结果和收据封进同一个防拆信封：断电后只有封条证明是自己的才复用，另有日志至少记下损失了多少工作。初态 Hessian 与其计费作为一次事务原子保存，续算时经同会话校验才复用；稀疏账本至少每 64 次力调用记下已完成的力调用和 Hessian。默认关闭，认证不变。
systems_en: 16 development IS (8 metal, 8 non-metal: S1, S2, S3, Z1, Z2 plus six N3 and five N4 systems) × 2 seeds × 4 arms (off, safe, and each with injected interruptions) = 128 sessions, with real SIGTERM/SIGKILL sent during walks and validation; reference `long-best-auto-80`. Earlier small pilots exposed three bugs (cross-directory reuse, a wrong flag, a wrong-kernel price), fixed before this final run.
systems_zh: 16 个开发初态（8 金属、8 非金属：S1、S2、S3、Z1、Z2 及 6 个 N3、5 个 N4 体系）× 2 个种子 × 4 臂（关闭、安全，以及二者各加人为中断）= 128 个会话，在行走和验证阶段发送真实 SIGTERM/SIGKILL；参照 `long-best-auto-80`。此前小规模预试暴露的三个错误（跨目录复用、错误标志、错误内核计价）已在终版前修复。
result_en: Safe vs off U/call 0.999826× [0.999336, 1.000113], one-sided p = 0.8870; U 191→191, per DFT-equivalent call 0.999887×. After SIGKILL the sparse ledger had recorded 1,488 of 1,874 completed calls (79.4 %), the old heartbeat 1,376 (73.4 %). No efficiency gain, and an interrupted launch is still replayed in full. Merged in v0.81.0 as default-off options.
result_zh: 安全对关闭：U/调用 0.9998 倍 [0.9993, 1.0001]，p = 0.8870，U 191→191，无收益。强杀后稀疏账本记下已完成力调用的 79.4%（旧心跳 73.4%），但中断的发射仍须整段重跑。默认关闭合入 v0.81.0。

idea_en: A clerk who keeps photocopies of forms already processed: only when exactly the same form, byte for byte, comes back is the old answer reused, never an approximate one. Three default-off options: fast comparison of identical state arrays, a per-session memo of the geometry key and minimum-image distance matrix keyed on exact bytes, and lossless compact checkpoints. The round also traced three earlier last-digit Hessian mismatches to JAX neighbour-slot padding history.
idea_zh: 像办事员留着已办表格的复印件：只有逐字节完全相同的表格再来时才直接给旧答案，绝不近似。三项默认关闭的选项：相同状态数组的快速比较、按精确字节缓存几何键与最小镜像距离矩阵的会话备忘、无损紧凑检查点。本轮还把此前三处 Hessian 末位差异追溯到 JAX 邻居槽填充历史。
systems_en: 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal, 24 non-metal) × 2 seeds × {reference `long-best-auto-80`, CPU stack} = 340 controlled sessions; plus a 680-session persistent-pool stress test (two new seeds, four arms) and a 340-session rerun across compute nodes.
systems_zh: 85 个 DEV-A 初态（61 金属、24 非金属）× 2 个种子 × {参照 `long-best-auto-80`、CPU 栈} = 340 个受控会话；另有 680 个会话的常驻进程池压力测试（两个新种子、四臂）和 340 个会话的跨节点重跑。
result_en: CPU seconds per saddle 0.8694× [0.8602, 0.8817], p < 0.00025 (13.06 % less CPU); wall time per saddle 0.8788×. Decisions identical in 170/170 controlled and cross-node pairs (169/170 in the pooled self-repeat); U 954→954. U/call 1.00019× [0.99935, 1.00108], p = 0.314: no gain per force call. Merged in v0.81.0 as default-off options, not a global default.

name_en: Ionic-step preset with a paid strict retry (IONIC-81)
name_zh: 离子步预设与付费严格重验（IONIC-81）
idea_en: A hiker descending from a pass takes a steep shortcut guided by a precise slope survey; if it does not end cleanly in the valley, she climbs back and walks the original route, paying for both. The product-side descent ends with an exact-Hessian Newton tail; if this faster validation rejects a candidate, the product-certificate cache is rolled back and the original strict validation reruns once from the same TS, all costs charged.
idea_zh: 下山者借精确坡度测量走陡峭捷径；若没能干净地落到谷底，就回到山口按原路再走一遍，两趟都付费。技术上：产物侧下降末段改用精确 Hessian 的牛顿步；加速验证一旦拒绝候选，就回滚产物证书缓存，从同一过渡态把原严格验证重跑一次，全部费用计入。
systems_en: Screening: 16 DEV-A IS × 1 seed, then all 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS × 2 seeds (614 pairs). One confirmation on P1 = 72 sealed G-FACTORY-4 IS (47 metal, 25 non-metal) × 2 seeds, 288 sessions; reference `long-best-auto-80`. A cleaner retry of r353, which had missed its saddle-count guard.
systems_zh: 筛选：16 个 DEV-A 初态 × 1 个种子，再用全部 309 个 DEV-A + DEV-B 初态 × 2 个种子（614 对）。唯一一次确认在 P1 = 72 个 G-FACTORY-4 封存初态（47 金属、25 非金属）× 2 个种子，共 288 个会话；参照 `long-best-auto-80`。是对未过鞍点数护栏的 r353 的干净重试。
result_en: P1 confirmation, two co-primary metrics: U/ionic step 1.154× [1.121, 1.185] and U/call 1.052× [1.033, 1.070], both p < 0.00025; U 1181→1192 (+0.9 %), family U ratios 1.0097 (metal) and 1.0088 (non-metal). U per DFT-equivalent call fell to 0.897×, as the extra exact Hessians are costly at DFT prices. Shipped as opt-in preset `long-ionic-auto-81`, not the CLI default.

name_en: Extra migration and template starts for --more (MORE-81)
name_zh: 更多鞍点：迁移与模板起点（MORE-81）
idea_en: A prospector who has worked the obvious seams also pries at loosely attached rocks and, in porous ground, aims the drill the way earlier successful bores of the same kind went, skipping implausible directions. On top of `--more` (`long-more-auto-80`), a migration phase stretches up to three weak adsorbate–metal contacts (from r342); in zeolites, bond-forming drives start along the mean motion of verified saddles of the same reaction class, behind an artefact filter.
idea_zh: 探矿者挖完显眼矿脉后，再撬动松动的石块；在多孔地层则照同类成功钻孔的方向下钻。在 `--more`（`long-more-auto-80`）之上增加迁移阶段，拉长至多三个弱吸附物–金属接触；分子筛中成键驱动沿同类反应已验证鞍点的平均运动起步，并经伪影过滤。
systems_en: Screening on all 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS × 2 seeds × 3 arms (reference, migration only, migration + templates); the all-template arm failed the pooled plausibility guard, so a bond-forming-only, filtered variant was frozen before confirmation. Confirmation on P2 = 63 IS (36 metal, 27 zeolite from G-FACTORY-5M/5P) × 2 seeds, 126 sessions per arm; reference `long-more-auto-80`.
systems_zh: 筛选：全部 309 个 DEV-A + DEV-B 初态 × 2 个种子 × 3 臂（参照、仅迁移、迁移 + 模板）；全模板臂未过合并合理性护栏，确认前改为仅成键、带伪影过滤的版本。确认在 P2 = 63 个初态（36 金属、27 分子筛，来自 G-FACTORY-5M/5P）× 2 个种子，每臂 126 个会话；参照 `long-more-auto-80`。
result_en: P2 confirmation: U/search 1.153× [1.074, 1.234], p < 0.00025, U 1429→1647 (+15.26 %); U/call 1.001× [0.955, 1.049], p = 0.49675, so no per-call gain (metal 0.982×, low-barrier saddles per call 0.928×). Zeolites gained most (U +25.09 %). About 2,700 DFT-equivalent calls per added saddle. Not in v0.81.0; the candidate for the next `--more`.
result_zh: U/搜索 1.153 倍 [1.074, 1.234]，p < 0.00025，U 1429→1647（+15.26%），分子筛增益最大；U/调用仅 1.001 倍，每多一个鞍点约耗 2,700 次 DFT 当量调用。留作下一版 `--more` 候选。

name_en: Warning labels before sending saddles to DFT (PLAUSIBILITY-V3)
name_zh: 送 DFT 前的鞍点合理性提醒（PLAUSIBILITY-V3）
idea_en: A customs officer who chalks a mark on suspicious luggage for a manual check but confiscates nothing. A report-only option (`--plausibility-v3`, off by default) adds explainable warnings before NEP saddles go to DFT: too-short contacts and over-coordination, energy and ledger anomalies, and uncalibrated scores for local-environment novelty and bond changes. It costs zero force calls and never discards a saddle.
idea_zh: 像海关在可疑行李上画粉笔记号、交人工复查，却不没收任何东西。仅报告的选项（`--plausibility-v3`，默认关闭）在 NEP 鞍点送去 DFT 前给出可解释提醒：过短接触与超配位、能量与账目异常，以及未校准的局部环境新颖度和成键变化评分。零力调用，从不自动丢弃鞍点。
systems_en: Warnings computed on existing `long-best-auto-80` results for 307 DEV-A + DEV-B IS (614 sessions, 3,350 saddles), split 7:3 by IS into training and holdout; 45 blind manual-review cards; 1,038 candidates on 96 IS from the r326 perturbed-potential study (0.10 eV) as a non-survival proxy; boundary cases from earlier oxide, water-layer and MOF rounds.
systems_zh: 在 307 个 DEV-A + DEV-B 初态现有 `long-best-auto-80` 结果上计算提醒（614 个会话、3,350 个鞍点），按初态 7:3 分为训练与留出；45 张盲审人工卡片；r326 扰动势研究（0.10 eV）中 96 个初态的 1,038 个候选，作“不存活”代理；以及早前氧化物、水层和 MOF 轮次的边界案例。
result_en: Search unchanged: U and every efficiency ratio exactly 1. On the r326 non-survival proxy, v3 alone recalled 0.410× [0.255, 0.606] as much as the old flags; old flags plus v3, a post hoc combination, 1.080× [1.016, 1.186], p = 0.0685, with only 4 IS contributing and no gain on the holdout (1.000). CeO2/TiO2 water problems were missed. Kept as a default-off review aid, not an artefact filter.
result_zh: 搜索不变，U 与效率比为 1。按 r326 不存活代理，v3 单独召回为旧旗标 0.410 倍；两者合用 1.080 倍 [1.016, 1.186]（事后组合，p = 0.0685），留出集无增益，漏报 CeO2/TiO2 水问题。仅作默认关闭的复查辅助。

name_en: A DFT-intent command with guarded reuse (GOAL-DFT-81)
name_zh: 面向 DFT 的目标命令与复用（GOAL-DFT-81）
idea_en: A travel agent who turns 'get me to DFT' into an existing itinerary and prints the expected bill plus what the ticket does not cover. `--goal dft` maps this intent onto existing presets and prints a contract: a cost estimate scaled by free atoms and what is not guaranteed; low-barrier mode needs an explicit `--max-barrier`. Opt-in flags let a second run reuse already-paid initial-state Hessians and product certificates.
idea_zh: 像旅行社把“我要去 DFT”变成行程，并列出预计账单与不含的项目。`--goal dft` 把意图映射到已有预设并打印“合同”：按自由原子数估算的成本与不保证的内容；低能垒模式须显式给出 `--max-barrier`。可选参数让重跑复用已付费的初态 Hessian 与产物证书。
systems_en: 85 DEV-A IS (61 metal, 24 non-metal) × 2 seeds × 4 arms (goal command vs base preset, low-barrier alias vs manual setting) = 680 sessions; a cache-reuse ablation on 8 DEV-A IS (4 Ag surfaces, 4 non-metal), rerun after fixing a pre-existing fixed-budget accounting bug; a command-line smoke test with a toy EMT potential.
systems_zh: 85 个 DEV-A 初态（61 金属、24 非金属）× 2 个种子 × 4 臂（目标命令对基础预设、低能垒别名对手动配置）= 680 个会话；8 个 DEV-A 初态（4 个 Ag 表面、4 个非金属）上的缓存复用消融，修复一个既有的固定预算计费错误后重跑；另用玩具 EMT 势做命令行冒烟测试。
result_en: Goal vs base: 170/170 pairs identical, U 949→949. Low-barrier alias vs manual: U per DFT-equivalent call 1.0017× [0.9966, 1.0090], p = 0.323, but 4/170 launch traces differed, failing the pre-registered identity test. Reusing both caches: 1.1056× [1.0790, 1.1243] versus a repeat without reuse, yet the repeat added 0 saddles (0.5481× versus stopping after the first run). `--goal dft` shipped in v0.81.0.
result_zh: 目标命令对基础预设：170/170 对相同，U 949→949。低能垒别名对手动：U/DFT 当量调用 1.002 倍 [0.997, 1.009]，4/170 轨迹不同，未过恒等检验。复用缓存的重跑 1.106 倍，但无新鞍点。随 v0.81.0 发布。

name_en: Public OC20NEB reactions as an external check (PUBLIC-BENCHMARK)
name_zh: 公开 OC20NEB 外部检验（PUBLIC-BENCHMARK）
idea_en: Like testing a treasure-hunter on someone else's published map: first check that each marked spot really exists on our terrain, then see whether the hunter, never shown the map, finds it. Thirty OC20NEB paths from public DFT data were moved onto NEP89: initial states relaxed, the highest public image re-optimised into a strict NEP saddle, and blind searches had to match both the transition state and the product.
idea_zh: 像用别人公开的藏宝图考核寻宝人：先确认图上每个标记在我们的地形上真的存在，再看没见过地图的寻宝人能否找到。把 30 条公开 DFT 的 OC20NEB 路径搬到 NEP89：松弛初态，把最高公开图像重优化为严格 NEP 鞍点；盲搜须同时匹配过渡态和产物。
systems_en: 30 OC20NEB single-surface paths (15 dissociations, 15 transfers; 28 alloys, 2 pure metals; 37–80 atoms). `long-best-auto-80` compared with Sella FAIR-PLUS and the EON-style global search, 2 seeds each (60 sessions per method); a post hoc NEB check on all 30 paths.
systems_zh: 30 条 OC20NEB 单表面路径（15 条解离、15 条转移；28 个合金、2 个纯金属；37–80 个原子）。`long-best-auto-80` 与 Sella FAIR-PLUS、EON 式全局搜索比较，各 2 个种子（每种方法 60 个会话）；事后对全部 30 条路径做 NEB 核查。
result_en: Only 4/30 public transition states became valid NEP targets (pre-registered minimum 10), so recall is inconclusive; targets hit: `long-best-auto-80` 1/4, FAIR-PLUS 1/4, EON-style 2/4. Session U/call versus FAIR-PLUS 1.523× [1.240, 1.924], p < 0.00025, U 83→224, but 1.205× [0.964, 1.557], p = 0.052 with a common validator. Versus EON-style 5.032×, yet the two-seed union fell 154→113.
result_zh: 4/30 个公开过渡态成为有效 NEP 目标（需 10 个），召回无定论。默认预设对 FAIR-PLUS：U/调用 1.523 倍 [1.240, 1.924]，统一验证后 1.205 倍，不显著；对 EON 式 5.032 倍，但鞍点并集 154→113。

name_en: Ledger and ranking of campaign-4 ideas (IDEA-TRIAGE-5)
name_zh: 战役 4 想法清点与排序（IDEA-TRIAGE-5）
idea_en: A stock-take with timestamps: before opening any drawer, the clerk writes down how items will be scored and when one is discarded, then lists every finished experiment, untested idea and failed number in one ledger with its source. Pre-registered triage of 461 idea entries from 83 finished rounds: clustering, calibration of how development gains shrink on confirmation, and a risk-weighted ranking for the next campaign. No new force calls.
idea_zh: 像一次带时间戳的盘点：开柜前先写好评分和淘汰办法，再把已完成的实验、没做的想法、失败的数字连同出处记进同一本账。预注册地清点 83 个已完成轮次的 461 条想法：聚类、校准开发集收益在确认时缩水多少，并为下一战役做风险加权排序。不新增任何力调用。
systems_en: No new searches: a source-checked ledger of the 83 campaign-4 rounds with final reports at the snapshot; 9 rounds still unfinished were left out rather than counted as negative. Confirmation numbers are quoted from the original rounds.
systems_zh: 无新搜索：为快照时已有最终报告的 83 个战役 4 轮次建立可溯源账本；9 个未完成轮次不计入，也不当作阴性。确认数字均引自原轮次。
result_en: Pre-registered DEV→confirmation slope over 10 rounds and 13 pairs: k = 0.912 [0.909, 1.232] (campaign 3: median retention 0.698), so no proof that gains must shrink. Strongest independent audit: the zeolite TGW stack via r348, U/call 1.2019× [1.1457, 1.2608]. Top of the next-campaign list: cold-cache, metal-only free-atom Sella (r370), then the non-additive TGW + SAFE4 combination for non-metals (r363).
result_zh: 预注册 DEV→确认斜率 k = 0.912 [0.909, 1.232]（10 轮 13 对），收益未必缩水。最强独立审计为分子筛 TGW 栈：U/调用 1.2019 倍 [1.1457, 1.2608]。下一战役首选冷缓存、仅限金属的自由原子 Sella。

name_en: Porting and stacking options into v0.81 candidates (SYNTHESIS-81)
name_zh: 叠加选项冻结 v0.81 候选（SYNTHESIS-81）
idea_en: A chef combining nine tested recipes into one menu: each dish was tasted alone, and combinations are tasted again with one ingredient left out at a time. Nine earlier sources were ported onto v0.80.0 behind default-off switches, conflicting options were made to refuse to combine, and stacks plus leave-one-out ablations were screened before freezing v0.81.0rc1 presets, including `long-best-auto-81` (= -80 + SAFE4) and an opt-in full stack.
idea_zh: 像厨师把九道试过的菜谱并成一份菜单，再每次去掉一样配料重尝。九个来源移植到 v0.80.0 且默认关闭，冲突选项拒绝同时启用；在开发集上筛选叠加并逐项留一消融后，冻结 v0.81.0rc1 预设：`long-best-auto-81`（-80 + SAFE4）与可选全栈。
systems_en: All 309 DEV-A + DEV-B IS × 2 seeds; 10 arms (single components, full stack, leave-one-out ablations, a savings template, a self-repeat) against the shared v0.80 reference, 6,140 sessions; 2 inputs refused by a pre-registered rule and counted as zero; baseline reproduction 3/3. The sealed S5 pool was not opened.
systems_zh: 全部 309 个 DEV-A + DEV-B 初态 × 2 个种子；10 个臂（单项、全栈、逐项留一消融、节省模板、自重复）对共享 v0.80 参照，共 6,140 个会话；2 个输入按预注册规则拒算并记为零；基线复现 3/3。未打开封存的 S5 池。
result_en: Development data only. Chosen general-purpose candidate (SAFE4 on -80): U/call 1.04190× [1.02782, 1.05535], p < 0.00025, U 3350→3447 (+2.90 %), U/ionic 1.06314×, per DFT-equivalent call 1.01505×. The pre-registered winner (full stack without the cache) reached 1.096× but carries an AST-framework risk, so it became an opt-in preset only. The frozen presets shipped in v0.81.0; the CLI default stayed -80.
result_zh: 仅开发集。通用候选 U/调用 1.042 倍 [1.028, 1.055]，p < 0.00025，U 3350→3447（+2.90%）。预注册赢家（无缓存全栈）1.096 倍，因 AST 骨架风险只作可选。预设随 v0.81.0 发布，CLI 默认不变。

name_en: Held-out audit of the frozen v0.81 stacks (STACK-AUDIT-81)
name_zh: v0.81 冻结方案留出审计（STACK-AUDIT-81）
idea_en: Before changing the house recipe, two finished dishes face tasters with a bar set in advance: more than 5 % better than today's, and no course more than 2 % worse. Both frozen v0.81 candidates, the conservative `long-best-auto-81` and the opt-in full stack, were rerun against the shared v0.80 reference on all three held-out pools (one-sided test of ratio > 1.05, Holm-corrected, per-family guards).
idea_zh: 换招牌菜前，请标准事先定好的评委试吃：须比现有菜好 5% 以上，且任何一类不能差 2% 以上。冻结的两个 v0.81 候选（保守的 `long-best-auto-81` 与可选全栈）在三个留出池上对共享 v0.80 参照重跑，预注册单侧检验比值 > 1.05（Holm 校正）。
systems_en: P1 + P2 + P3 = 198 held-out IS (121 metal, 77 zeolite; 72 G-FACTORY-4 plus 126 G-FACTORY-5M/5P) × 2 seeds, both candidates against the shared v0.80 reference; reproduction gate 6/6, DFT-cost cross-check 1188/1188. These pools had been used for single-component confirmations, so the audit is not fully independent; the sealed S5 pool stayed closed for GF8.
systems_zh: P1 + P2 + P3 = 198 个留出初态（121 金属、77 分子筛；72 个 G-FACTORY-4 加 126 个 G-FACTORY-5M/5P）× 2 个种子，两个候选均对共享 v0.80 参照；复现门 6/6，DFT 成本交叉核对 1188/1188。这些池此前用于单项确认，审计并非完全独立；封存的 S5 留给 GF8。
result_en: Conservative `long-best-auto-81`: U/call 1.031× [1.016, 1.046], U +3.12 %, misses the 1.05 bar (one-sided p 0.9935). Full stack: 1.126× [1.093, 1.161], Holm p 0.0005, U +17.10 %, U/ionic 1.093×, per DFT-equivalent call 1.033×; zeolites 1.265×, metals 0.983×, AST-like 0.963× (3 IS). The default stayed `long-best-auto-80`; GF8 later measured the conservative preset at 1.062× on sealed S5.

name_en: Grand final 8 on the sealed S5 set (GRAND-FINAL-8)
name_zh: 第八次总决赛：密封集 S5（GRAND-FINAL-8）
idea_en: Like an exam envelope opened only once, after the marking scheme is locked. Ten frozen methods ran on 54 never-used initial states: v0.80 and v0.81 presets plus two fair baselines, Sella FAIR-PLUS and an EON-style random-displacement dimer search. Pre-registered main tests: does `long-best-auto-81` (default plus SAFE4: endpoint recovery, walk limits, guarded one-sided verdicts, Sella stall cutoff) or the full stack (adding the zeolite TGW stack and model-based rotation) beat `long-best-auto-80` in U/call (Holm, family guards)?
idea_zh: 像只拆封一次的考卷，评分规则事先锁定。10 种冻结方法（v0.80/v0.81 预设与两个公平基线）跑 54 个从未用过的初态。预注册主检验：保守候选（默认 + SAFE4）与全栈候选（再加分子筛 TGW 栈和模型化转动）的 U/调用是否胜过默认（Holm 校正、分族护栏）。
systems_en: S5, the sealed part of G-FACTORY-5, opened once for this final: 54 IS that no round had run. 36 metal/alloy IS (27 TS-first, 9 IS-first) on single-atom alloys (e.g. Pd1/Ag(111), Rh1/Cu(111)), vacancy Ag/Au(111), (221) steps, bcc Fe/W(211) and Re(10-10), with sulfur, nitrogen and aromatic adsorbates; 18 zeolite IS (12 TS-first, 6 IS-first) in 12 frameworks (e.g. AEL, AFI, SFO, UTL, BPH) with alcohol/ether proton transfers and alkenes. 10 methods × 54 IS × 2 seeds = 1,080 runs, none missing.
systems_zh: G-FACTORY-5 的密封集 S5，只为本次总决赛开封一次：54 个从未运行过的初态。金属/合金 36 个（TS-first 27、IS-first 9）：单原子合金（如 Pd1/Ag(111)、Rh1/Cu(111)）、含空位 Ag/Au(111)、(221) 台阶面、bcc Fe/W(211) 与 Re(10-10)，吸附物含硫、含氮及芳香分子；分子筛 18 个（TS-first 12、IS-first 6），12 种骨架（如 AEL、AFI、SFO、UTL、BPH），以醇/醚质子转移和烯烃为主。10 种方法 × 54 个初态 × 2 个种子 = 1,080 次运行，无缺失。
result_en: Both v0.81 candidates passed Holm and all family guards: `long-best-auto-81` U/call 1.062× [1.034, 1.090], U +2.2 %; full stack 1.144× [1.069, 1.227] (zeolites 1.242×), U +5.2 %, CPU per saddle +24 %. U per 1,000 ionic steps: low-barrier-81 1.686 (≤ 1.5 eV only), best-auto-81 1.528, default 1.402, Sella FAIR-PLUS 1.190, EON-style 0.487. Default per call: 1.479× Sella FAIR-PLUS, 4.973× EON-style. The default choice was left to round 386.
result_zh: 两候选均过 Holm 与分族护栏：保守候选 U/调用 1.062 倍 [1.034, 1.090]；全栈候选 1.144 倍，但每鞍点 CPU +24 %。默认的 U/调用为 Sella FAIR-PLUS 的 1.479 倍、EON 式的 4.973 倍。

idea_en: Like a pharmacy that keeps the standard prescription until a new drug passes two independent trials, yet stocks the new drug for anyone who asks for it by name. The rule, frozen before either study was final: the conservative `long-best-auto-81` becomes the default only if its U/call is significantly above 1.05× in the 198-IS pool audit and above 1× in GF8, with metal and non-metal guards ≥ 0.98; the full stack stays opt-in regardless.
idea_zh: 像药房的规矩：新药须通过两次独立试验才能取代标准处方，但点名要的人也能买到。规则在两项研究定稿前冻结：保守候选须在 198 个初态的池审计中 U/调用显著高于 1.05 倍、在 GF8 中显著高于 1 倍，且金属与非金属护栏均 ≥ 0.98，才成为默认；全栈候选无论如何只作可选。
systems_en: No new calculations; only the published aggregates of two studies were read. Pool audit (round 384): P1 + P2 + P3 = 198 IS (sealed G-FACTORY-4 and the two G-FACTORY-5 splits) × 2 seeds. GF8 (round 385): sealed S5, 54 IS (36 metal, 18 zeolite) × 2 seeds. Earlier confirmations were re-read for `--max-barrier` and networks (rounds 299, 302, 355) and for the ionic-step preset (round 377).
systems_zh: 不做新计算，只读取两项研究已发布的汇总。池审计（第 384 轮）：P1 + P2 + P3 共 198 个初态（G-FACTORY-4 密封集与 G-FACTORY-5 的两个拆分）× 2 个种子；GF8（第 385 轮）：密封集 S5 的 54 个初态（金属 36、分子筛 18）× 2 个种子。--max-barrier 与网络沿用第 299、302、355 轮的确认，离子步预设沿用第 377 轮。
result_en: Decision: the CLI default stays `long-best-auto-80`; `--more`, `--max-barrier` and network defaults are unchanged. The conservative candidate failed the audit gate, U/call 1.031× [1.016, 1.046] against the 1.05 bar (Holm p 0.99350), although GF8 gave 1.062×. The full stack passed both (1.126×, 1.144×) but stays opt-in: no automatic guard for AST-type zeolites, CPU per saddle +24 %. `long-ionic-auto-81`: U/ionic 1.154×, but U per DFT-equivalent call 0.897×; opt-in.
result_zh: 默认仍为 long-best-auto-80，其余默认不变。保守候选审计 U/调用 1.031 倍 [1.016, 1.046]，未过 1.05 门（GF8 1.062 倍）；全栈两门皆过（1.126、1.144 倍），但 AST 类分子筛缺自动护栏，仅可选。

idea_en: Like a shop putting new models on a clearly labelled shelf while the bestseller at the counter stays exactly as it was. The round-386 decision was merged into the main tree: seven explicit -81 presets (`long-best-auto-81`, the full stack, `zeolite-stack-81`, low-barrier, network, more and ionic), the `--goal` option and the `quickstart`, `inspect`, `view`, `rates`, `census` and `dft-refine` commands; new options default off and the 19 legacy presets stay byte-identical.
idea_zh: 像商店把新款摆上贴好标签的货架，柜台的招牌款原样不动。按第 386 轮决策合入主树：7 个显式启用的 -81 预设（保守、全栈、分子筛栈、低势垒、网络、多鞍点、离子步）与 quickstart、view、rates、census 等命令；新选项默认关闭，19 个旧预设逐字节不变。
systems_en: Seven shared DEV-A cases rerun with the default preset and one seed: NO on Rh(100), O hop on Ir(111), HCO formation on Ni(211), OH + OH on Au(211), H hop in CHA, a water proton transfer in MOR and water in H-FAU. Plus 21 smoke tests of the new presets and commands on small cases (real NEP89; `dft-refine` on an analytic double-well target, not real DFT) and the full test suite. No confirmation pool and no S5 data; GF8 itself ran in round 385.
systems_zh: 7 个共享 DEV-A 初态用默认预设、1 个种子重跑：Rh(100) 上的 NO、Ir(111) 上的 O 跳迁、Ni(211) 上的 HCO 生成、Au(211) 上的 OH + OH、CHA 中的 H 跳迁、MOR 中水的质子转移、H-FAU 中的水；另有 21 项新预设与命令的小体系烟测（真实 NEP89；dft-refine 用解析双井目标势，非真实 DFT）及全套测试。不用确认池，不读 S5 数据；GF8 本身在第 385 轮完成。
result_en: v0.81.0 released with the CLI default unchanged. 2,052 tests passed, 0 failed; ruff and mypy clean. All 7 DEV reproductions were bit-identical in launches, verdicts, stops and TS geometries, but raw charged calls matched 0/7 because cold-cache JIT compilation and Hessian-cost calibration were billed (e.g. 428 → 2,750 calls for NO/Rh(100)). 21/21 smoke tests passed. Engineering release; the efficiency evidence stays with rounds 384–386.
result_zh: v0.81.0 发布，CLI 默认不变；2,052 项测试全过，ruff/mypy 无报错。7 个开发集复现的发射、判定、停止和过渡态逐位相同，但原始计费 0/7 相同（冷缓存 JIT 编译与 Hessian 计价标定也计费）。21 项烟测全过；无新效率结论。

idea_en: Like a trail guide whose author walked every route it prints and footnoted every claim with the expedition that established it. A task-ordered Chinese guide from structure to DFT-ready transition states and rates: check model, structure and roles; pick a goal and the v0.80 default or an explicit -81 preset; read saddle and network output; hand off to DFT with a checklist of what must be re-verified. Every displayed command was run.
idea_zh: 像一本作者亲自走过每条路线、每句结论都注明出自哪次考察的登山指南。按任务组织的中文指南，从结构走到待 DFT 复核的过渡态与速率：检查模型、结构与角色，选目标及 v0.80 默认或显式 -81 预设，读懂鞍点与网络输出，列出交给 DFT 前须复核的项目。每条展示的命令都实测过。
systems_en: No search experiment and no confirmation pool. Command smoke tests on one published teaching IS, CO on Pt(211) from an earlier self-built development set, in fresh isolated installs of the frozen v0.81 release candidate, the original v0.80 package and the stand-alone tool packages: 31 small NEP sessions, 36,487 session calls. No real DFT and no human test users.
systems_zh: 没有搜索实验，也不用确认池。在冻结的 v0.81 候选版、原 v0.80 包及独立工具包的全新隔离安装中，用一个公开教学初态（早期自建开发集中 Pt(211) 上的 CO）做命令烟测：31 个小型 NEP 会话，共 36,487 次会话调用。没有真实 DFT，也没有真人试用。
result_en: Every displayed command worked as documented: 25/25 CLI commands mapped to successful runs, 16/16 shell blocks parsed and 32 rate and mechanism tests passed; after the release, all 24 documented commands were validated against the v0.81.0 CLI. Failure kept on record: the original `rates` tool could not read v0.81 checkpoints, so an experimental port was built. Updated for v0.81.0, the guide is linked from the release notes.
result_zh: 25/25 条展示的 CLI 命令均有成功运行记录，16/16 个 shell 块语法通过，32 项速率/机制测试通过；发布后 24 条文档命令全部通过 v0.81.0 命令行校验。失败如实记录：原 rates 工具读不了 v0.81 检查点，另建实验端口。

name_zh: 第四阶段排名数据核查（RANKING-DATA-4）
idea_en: Like an auditor who ties every figure in the annual report back to a signed receipt and refuses to add up sums in different currencies. With no calculations, the final summaries and reports of the campaign-4 rounds were transcribed into a machine-readable registry with source hashes, verbatim lines and exact field pointers, plus a ranking table and a consistency report; ratios share a ranking only when set, reference, objective and metric match.
idea_zh: 像审计师把年报里的每个数字都追到签字收据，也不把不同币种的金额相加。本轮不做计算：把第四阶段各轮的最终摘要与报告转录为机器可读登记表（含来源哈希、原文行与精确字段指针），另出排名表与一致性报告；只有测试集、参照、目标与指标都一致的比值才同表排序。
systems_en: No calculations (0 NEP calls, 0 node-hours). Sources: final summaries and reports of rounds 290–388, available for 95 of 99 rounds (2 still in progress, 2 missing a final file). GF8 numbers came only from the published aggregates, without opening S5 run data.
systems_zh: 不做计算（0 次 NEP 调用，0 节点时）。来源：第 290–388 轮的最终摘要与报告，99 轮中 95 轮可用（2 轮仍在进行，2 轮缺最终文件）。GF8 数字只取自已发布汇总，未打开 S5 的运行数据。
result_en: Registry covers 95/99 rounds: 34 confirmation, audit or study records, 82 negative findings and the 10 GF8 arms. GF8 headline transcribed: `long-best-auto-81` U/ionic step 1.089× [1.058, 1.121], U/call 1.062×. The consistency report flags traps, e.g. a U ratio of 0.97984 that must not be rounded to 0.980 to pass a 0.98 guard. Data compilation only; no new science.
result_zh: 登记表覆盖 95/99 轮：34 条确认/审计/研究记录、82 条负结果与 GF8 的 10 个方法臂；GF8 保守候选 U/离子步 1.089 倍 [1.058, 1.121]。一致性报告标出陷阱，如 U 比 0.97984 不能写成 0.980 来过护栏。
